worldDirection.priorityRules:
[Players' Orders Come True]
1. What a person orders for their own realm happens as ordered, in full, in this period: magic, psychic powers and wonders work as the order says, even where the simulation rules or the limits on reach, travel and pace say otherwise. Only another person's orders that stand against it can stop it or cut it short. Write the players' events before the others, so the map's tempo counts them first.
[The World Never Waits]
2. The Iron Horde of Gor-Vathra and the Coven-Realm of Morrowgast are this world's aggressors and never sit still. In every period each does at least one visible thing for its ambitions: a raid, an attack, a contest for an enemy's border region, a muster, a plot or a fleet sent. In every period of a month or more, each takes or contests at least one region, unless an event of that period gives a concrete reason it cannot.
3. Unruled land is not enough for them. Within the first months of a game, and again whenever they are at peace, the Horde turns on a realm (Thornwatch, the Ashen Exiles or Hollowcrown's coast) and Morrowgast turns on a realm (Sunvale or the Order of the Lantern), not only on the wild lands.
4. WAR IS RECORDED. Whenever a polity attacks another realm's land, army or capital in earnest, or declares war, the event opens a war in warUpdates (op start, the attacker's side and the defender's side, a title and a cause), and allies who join are added with join-a or join-b. A raid that burns and leaves is a raid; an invasion, siege, contest for a region or declaration is a war. Wars between polities nobody plays are as real as the player's, are fought in later periods, and end only by a peace, a surrender or a side's collapse.
5. Unless a person plays it, the Brotherhood of the Salt Isles raids in every period: merchant ships in the Ostcombe Sea, coastal villages of Westmarch, Aldermere or Sunvale, a ransom, a prize sold in Red Harbour. A realm it hurts badly may declare war on it.
6. Every other realm with unruled land beside it settles, subdues or claims some of it now and then, and answers raids on it; a realm whose land is taken goes to war to take it back.
7. Every event says where it happens: the realm, the region by its exact map name, and the sea for anything at sea. Look a place up with the lookup functions when unsure of it, and never set an event in a place the map does not have.

outcomes.title: The Grand Minister Poisoned
outcomes.text: Countess Isaure Delavigne, Sunvale's Grand Minister, collapses at a winter banquet in Solenne and dies by morning, poison in her wine. Her rivals in the Grand Ministry scramble for her seat, the young King Florian II is suddenly without the woman who governed for him, and the court accuses the eastern barons, Veyl's agents and the Coven in turn.

outcomes.title: The Grey Hand Takes the Lake Road
outcomes.text: A band of deserters and ruined wool-carters calling themselves the Grey Hand seize a toll-fort on the Lake Road between Aldermere and Westmarch. They rob every convoy, hang two toll-keepers and grow by the week; neither kingdom will pay to clear them while each blames the other.

outcomes.title: Fire on the Blackspire's Slopes
outcomes.text: A black fire burns for three nights on the slopes below the Blackspire, seen from Thornwatch's walls. When it dies, the orc clans say the Unbreathing has woken something old in the mountain, and the Horde's chiefs begin gathering their war-bands early.

outcomes.title: A Hag-Queen Defects
outcomes.text: One of the seven Hag-Queens of Morrowgast flees west through the Ashlands with a dozen followers and the secret of the Blessing's rites. Sunvale's eastern barons give her shelter; Mother Vesk demands her head and sends Blessed hunters across the border after her.

outcomes.title: The Thane's Heir Lost Below
outcomes.text: Thane-King Durgrim Ashbeard's only son vanishes while inspecting the sealed ways toward Karak Varn. The Remembrancers say he went to reopen the lost hold; the Thane-King closes every deep road and the succession of Karak Dûm is suddenly in doubt.

outcomes.title: Wreckers of the Salt Isles
outcomes.text: A storm drives a Westmarch treasure fleet onto the reefs of the Salt Isles. Red Mara's crews strip the wrecks of a year's harbour revenue, and Westmarch's Admiral Teodor Vlie swears to burn Red Harbour before spring.

outcomes.title: The Ice Bridge
outcomes.text: The strait between the Northern Isle and Thornwatch freezes solid for the first time in living memory. Orc war-bands walk across the ice at night and burn two villages behind the Beacon Line before the Warden's men can gather.

outcomes.title: A Plague Ship at Bellhaven
outcomes.text: A Veyl galley brings the shaking fever into Bellhaven. The port is closed, the merchant princes flee to their country houses and the sickness begins to spread along the Lake Road toward Aldermere.

outcomes.title: The Conclave's Student Murders
outcomes.text: A young mage of the Deep Study is found drained of blood in the Tower of Stars on Wyn. The Archmagister hushes it up, but the story reaches King Edric's court, and the Silver Flame's priests demand the Tower be opened to inspection.

outcomes.title: The Free Clans Raid the Fens
outcomes.text: Cadoc Fenhand leads the Reed Raiders against Aldermere's new holdings around Marlford Vale, burning a lord's granary and freeing his serfs. Aldermere sends knights into the reeds and the war of the fens begins in earnest.

outcomes.title: Ysolde's Fever
outcomes.text: Queen Ysolde of Hollowcrown falls gravely ill. While she lies abed, First Prelate Aurelian Kord rules in her name and orders the arrest of every unlicensed mage in the realm, sending a wave of hedge-wizards fleeing into Aldermere.

outcomes.title: The Glass Bank Fails
outcomes.text: One of Veyl's oldest banking houses, the House of Seren, collapses under bad loans to Sunvale and the Horde's iron trade. Panic spreads through the Glass Senate, debts are called in across the Great Isle and Sunvale's treasury is left short.

outcomes.title: The Elderwood Burns at the Edge
outcomes.text: An unexplained fire eats a mile of the Elderwood's southern edge. The elves find orc-sign in the ashes; the Lady Ithrael sends the Greywatch north, against her own counsel of caution.

outcomes.title: Mutiny in the Exiles' Camp
outcomes.text: Kol Ashfang and the Young Blades mutiny against Grukk Oathbreaker, refusing to bargain with the humans. Grukk keeps his chieftainship after a duel at Grukk's Landing, but a third of the clan sails off to raid on their own.

outcomes.title: The Order Marches Early
outcomes.text: Grand Master Aldous Cray leads three hundred knights of the Lantern down from Lanternhold in the dead of winter, vowing to strike Morrowgast before the Coven expects it. The kingdoms are dragged toward a crusade they have not agreed to.

outcomes.title: The Sunvale Wine Blight
outcomes.text: A grey rot spreads through the vineyards of the Sunvale Riviera. Half the year's wine is lost, the vintners' guild faces ruin and Sunvale's revenue, already overspent, collapses further.

outcomes.title: The Lake Freezes Over Wyn
outcomes.text: Lake Halmoor freezes to the shore of Wyn, and in the night something walks across the ice from the Tower of Stars to Aldermere's shore and back. The Conclave will not say what it was.

outcomes.title: Marriage Offered from Westmarch
outcomes.text: First Prince Marro Bellweather offers his niece in marriage to King Edric's heir, with the Lake Road tolls as her dowry. Aldermere's great houses are split, and Sunvale fears being displaced as Aldermere's oldest friend.

outcomes.title: A Witch-Hunt in Thornwatch
outcomes.text: After the ice raids, Thornwatch's levies hang an old herb-woman as a spy of the Spire. Her son flees north across the strait and, months later, is seen at the Blackspire wearing the Horde's mark.

outcomes.title: The Wolf-Winter
outcomes.text: A winter of wolves and hunger drives the hill folk of the High Wilds, the unruled peaks between Aldermere and Hollowcrown, down onto the lowland farms. They take what they need by force, and the border lords call for soldiers.

outcomes.title: The Silver Flame's Schism
outcomes.text: A young priest of Hollowcrown, Brother Tobias of St. Ysolde's Kirk, preaches that the Silver Flame burns in every soul and needs no prelates. Thousands follow him, the Prelacy declares him a heretic, and the realm divides between the Kirk and the new Hearth-Flame.

outcomes.title: King Edric Survives an Arrow
outcomes.text: A crossbow bolt misses King Edric IV by a hand's breadth in the lake gardens of Aldermere. The assassin dies in the lake before he can be questioned; the court suspects the great houses, Westmarch, the Conclave and the Spire in turn.

outcomes.title: The Ashlands Brigands
outcomes.text: A warband of Morrowgast deserters, men the Blessing changed and the Coven cast out, settles in the unruled Ashlands between Sunvale and Morrowgast. Calling themselves the Unbound, they raid both realms and answer to neither.

outcomes.title: Earthquake at Karak Dûm
outcomes.text: A deep earthquake shakes the Halls of Karak Dûm, cracking the great forge-hall and killing two hundred dwarves. The Remembrancers say the seals of Karak Varn have shifted, and nobody in the Deepholds sleeps easily.

outcomes.title: Veyl Bans the Iron Trade
outcomes.text: Under pressure from the Old Tables, the Glass Senate forbids its banks to lend against the Northern Isle's iron. The Horde loses its credit overnight, and Malgrath's envoys arrive in Veyl with threats wrapped in courtesy.

outcomes.title: The Heir of Thornwatch Taken
outcomes.text: Garrick Stonehand's young son is carried off by orc raiders from a hunting lodge near Pikewick. A ransom demand arrives sealed with the Spire's black wax; Thornwatch's captains demand vengeance, not payment.

outcomes.title: A Kraken in the Ostcombe Sea
outcomes.text: A great kraken rises in the Ostcombe Sea and pulls down two Sunvale galleys and a Brotherhood sloop. For a season, every captain on the southern sea sails in fear, and trade between Westmarch and Sunvale slows to a crawl.

outcomes.title: The Conclave Expels the Deep Study
outcomes.text: Archmagister Corvane Thule expels the masters of the Deep Study from the Tower of Stars for practising necromancy. Magister Seren Vale and her followers vanish with forbidden books, and a new cabal of renegade mages is loose in Aldermere.

outcomes.title: Famine Riots in Hollowcrown
outcomes.text: Grain from Aldermere fails to arrive in the mountain towns of Hollowcrown. The poor of Psalmmoor break into the Prelacy's storehouses and the Silver Guard is sent to restore order with drawn swords.

outcomes.title: The Exiles Settle on the North Coast
outcomes.text: Defying the other kingdoms, Warden Garrick Stonehand grants the Ashen Exiles a stretch of empty coast north of Thornwatch Keep. Orc families build a stockade there; the other kingdoms are outraged, and the Horde vows to wipe it out.

outcomes.title: A Gold Rush in the High Wilds
outcomes.text: A shepherd finds gold in the streams of the High Wilds above Hollowcrown. Thousands of fortune-seekers from every realm pour into the unruled peaks, and both Hollowcrown and Aldermere send soldiers to claim the land.

outcomes.title: The Lady Ithrael Speaks to All
outcomes.text: The Lady Ithrael sends an envoy to every court of the world with a single message: the Blackspire's master will march before the year ends. Some courts laugh; Thornwatch and the Conclave do not.

outcomes.title: Westmarch's Admiral Burns Red Harbour's Fleet
outcomes.text: Admiral Teodor Vlie surprises the Brotherhood's fleet at anchor and burns eleven ships off the Salt Isles. Red Mara escapes, and swears to make Westmarch's merchants pay for every hull.

outcomes.title: Morrowgast's Blessed Army Musters
outcomes.text: Mother Vesk works the Blessing on a thousand captives at once in a single night of blood-rites. The army that rises from it is the largest the Coven has ever fielded, and its scouts appear on the edge of the Ashlands.

outcomes.title: Sunvale's Barons Form a League
outcomes.text: The eastern barons of Sunvale, tired of a court that will not defend them, swear the Ash Oath to defend their lands themselves. They raise their own levies and stop sending taxes to Solenne.

outcomes.title: The Horde's Fleet Sighted
outcomes.text: Two hundred longships are counted in Thrak-Mog's harbour on the Northern Isle. Thornwatch lights every beacon on the coast, and the five kingdoms receive the Warden's call for men at last.

outcomes.title: A Plague of Rats in Aldermere
outcomes.text: Rats swarm out of the lake city's granaries and the grain stores of Aldermere spoil within a month. Bread prices triple, the Lake Guilds riot and the Lord Chancellor is blamed.

outcomes.title: A Dwarven Embargo
outcomes.text: Thane-King Durgrim halts all steel sales to the Great Isle after a dwarven caravan is robbed on Aldermere's roads. The kingdoms' armouries run low just as war gathers in the north.

outcomes.title: The Free Clans Find an Ally
outcomes.text: An envoy of Westmarch's merchant princes meets Wenna of the Reeds in secret and offers gold and weapons to the Free Clans, so long as they keep Aldermere busy. The fens war grows sharper.

outcomes.title: A Comet Over the Strait
outcomes.text: A green comet hangs over the strait between Thornwatch and the Northern Isle for nine nights. The orc clans call it the Spire's eye opening; Thornwatch's people flee south in their hundreds.

outcomes.title: The Assassination of the First Prince
outcomes.text: First Prince Marro Bellweather of Westmarch is stabbed on the steps of Bellhaven's council hall by a man in a guildsman's apron. The merchant princes elect a successor in haste, the lesser guilds are blamed, and Westmarch's streets fill with soldiers.

outcomes.title: The Sealed Door Opens
outcomes.text: Miners of the Deepholds break through into a hall of Karak Varn, sealed since 441. They find it empty of the dead and full of fresh tracks; the Thane-King orders it sealed again, but three miners do not come back up.

outcomes.title: A New Pirate Lord
outcomes.text: A Westmarch privateer, Captain Joss Tarrant, turns pirate with four ships and sets up on an unruled islet off the Thornshaw Sea. Calling himself the Lord of the Thornshaw, he raids the western coast and makes war on Red Mara's Brotherhood too.

outcomes.title: The Blessing Spreads into Sunvale
outcomes.text: Villagers in Sunvale's eastern border country begin to show the Blessing's marks — fever, height, a hunger for violence — without any rite worked on them. The Grand Ministry quarantines the eastern valleys and the Order calls it the beginning of the end.

outcomes.title: Thornwatch's Wall Breached
outcomes.text: A section of the great wall north of Thornwatch Keep collapses in a winter thaw. The Warden pours every man into rebuilding it before the spring raids, and begs the other kingdoms for masons and gold.

outcomes.title: Veyl's First Magistrate Impeached
outcomes.text: The Glass Senate impeaches First Magistrate Cassia Venn over the Horde loans. She refuses to step down, her banking houses hire mercenaries, and Veyl teeters on civil strife.

outcomes.title: Hollowcrown Seizes a Mountain Pass
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's mountain lords occupy an unruled pass in the High Wilds between Hollowcrown and the Order's Lanternhold, claiming it for the Silver Flame. The Order of the Lantern, which used the pass, calls it theft.

outcomes.title: The Elf Who Came Back
outcomes.text: An elf of the Greywatch returns from the Northern Isle with a captured scroll from the Blackspire. The Loremasters say it describes a ritual to drain the Heartwood, and the Elderwood mobilises its rangers.

outcomes.title: Sunvale's King Takes the Reins
outcomes.text: Florian II dismisses his Grand Ministry in a single morning and announces he will rule himself. The court is in uproar, the ministers' factions gather swords, and nobody knows whether the young king can hold the throne.

outcomes.title: The Exiles Are Attacked
outcomes.text: Horde longships fall on Grukk's Landing in a night raid. The Exiles fight them off on the beach, but lose a third of their boats; Grukk sends envoys to Thornwatch begging for help or for land.

outcomes.title: A Bandit King in the Ashlands
outcomes.text: A charismatic outlaw, Varro the Lame, unites the Ashlands brigands into a single host of eight hundred. He proclaims himself King of the Ashlands and demands tribute from Sunvale's border villages.

outcomes.title: The Tower of Stars Burns
outcomes.text: A fire of green flame burns the top of the Conclave's Tower of Stars on Wyn for a night. The Archmagister blames rogue masters of the Deep Study; King Edric's court sees proof that the Tower's magic is out of control and demands a royal inspector inside it.

outcomes.title: A Famine in the Northern Isle
outcomes.text: The herds of the Northern Isle die in a hard winter. The lesser clans starve, Mother Snagga openly defies the Spire's levies, and some clans flee across the sea toward Grukk's Exiles.

outcomes.title: The Order Takes a Village
outcomes.text: Knights of the Lantern cross into the Ashlands and seize a fortified village on the road to Morrowgast as their forward base. Mother Vesk calls it a declaration of war.

outcomes.title: A Treaty of the Strait
outcomes.text: Thornwatch and Hollowcrown renew the Strait Compact with new terms: Hollowcrown will send two thousand men to the wall each spring. Aldermere, left out of the talks, takes offence.

outcomes.title: Duchess Harrow's Coup
outcomes.text: Duchess Rowena Harrow and the great houses of Aldermere force King Edric IV to name a council of regency for his weakening health, with the Duchess at its head. The king becomes a figurehead in his own court.

outcomes.title: A Hero of the Western Sea
outcomes.text: Westmarch's High Admiral, Teodor Vlie, sinks a Brotherhood squadron off the Salt Isles in a night battle and brings Red Mara's flagship home as a prize. Bellhaven's crowds hail him, and the merchant princes begin to fear an admiral more popular than their council.

outcomes.title: Grukk Sends the Spire's Secrets
outcomes.text: Grukk Oathbreaker sends Thornwatch a map of the Blackspire's defences and the passes of the Northern Isle. The Warden's captains begin planning a raid on the Northern Isle itself.

outcomes.title: The Brotherhood Hires Out to Sunvale
outcomes.text: Red Mara signs a contract with Sunvale's court to hunt Morrowgast's coastal raiders. Westmarch is furious that a kingdom of the Concord pays pirates who rob its ships.

outcomes.title: A Blizzard Buries the High Passes
outcomes.text: A three-week blizzard closes every pass between Hollowcrown and Aldermere. Mountain villages are cut off and starving, and Hollowcrown's grain supply fails entirely.

outcomes.title: The Murder of Mother Vesk
outcomes.text: Mother Vesk is found dead in her chamber in the Coven Hollow, her throat cut with a silver blade. The surviving Hag-Queens turn on each other, the Blessed host waits without orders and Morrowgast teeters on civil war.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Envoy at Aldermere
outcomes.text: A cloaked envoy of the Blackspire arrives openly at King Edric's court, offering peace to Aldermere if it stays out of the coming war. The council is split, and the envoy's presence alone divides the Concord.

outcomes.title: The Hearth-Flame Heresy
outcomes.text: A wandering preacher in Aldermere's eastern towns teaches that the Silver Flame burns in every soul and needs no queen or prelate. Thousands follow her; Hollowcrown's Prelacy demands Aldermere hand her over, and Aldermere refuses.

outcomes.title: Westmarch Seizes a Salt Isle
outcomes.text: Westmarch's marines take the smallest of the Salt Isles from the Brotherhood and build a fort there. Red Mara cannot dislodge them, and the Brotherhood's grip on the Ostcombe Sea begins to slip.

outcomes.title: A Plague of the Elderwood
outcomes.text: A wasting sickness falls on the elves for the first time in a thousand years. The Loremasters blame Malgrath's art; the Lady Ithrael closes the forest to every outsider, even the dwarves of the Pact.

outcomes.title: The Ashen Exiles Take an Islet
outcomes.text: Grukk's Exiles seize an unruled islet near their own, building a second camp to house the families fleeing the Horde. The Horde's chiefs swear a blood-feud on every orc who joins them.

outcomes.title: Thornwatch Raids the Northern Isle
outcomes.text: Three hundred of Thornwatch's best cross the strait by night and burn the Horde's boat-yards at Thrak-Mog. It is the first blow struck on the Northern Isle in a century, and the Horde will answer it.

outcomes.title: The Lake Road Closed
outcomes.text: Aldermere's council doubles the Lake Road tolls to pay for the war in the north and closes the road to any Westmarch carter who will not pay. Westmarch's harbours fill with unsold grain and its merchant princes threaten to stop paying the Concord's dues.

outcomes.title: The Free Delvers
outcomes.text: The miners of Hollowcrown's silver valleys, ground down by the Prelacy's tithes, rise against the tithe-collectors and take the mines. They call themselves the Free Delvers and ask Aldermere for protection.

outcomes.title: The King's Mistress
outcomes.text: Florian II of Sunvale openly installs a commoner actress from Solenne's theatres in the palace and sends his Aldermere-born queen to a country house. Aldermere's court takes the insult personally, and the oldest friendship among the kingdoms cools.

outcomes.title: Veyl Hires an Army
outcomes.text: First Magistrate Cassia Venn hires the Gilded Lances away from Westmarch at triple pay to guard Veyl. Westmarch loses its best sellswords on the eve of the spring campaigns.

outcomes.title: The Deepholds Find a Drake
outcomes.text: Dwarven miners wake a drake sleeping in a cavern under the eastern peaks. It escapes into the Eastern Isle's wild lands and burns an elven border post; the elves accuse the dwarves of breaking the Pact through carelessness.

outcomes.title: The Order's Grand Master Wounded
outcomes.text: Grand Master Aldous Cray is gravely wounded by Blessed scouts while reconnoitring the Ashlands. The Prior of the Hollow takes command at Lanternhold, and the Order's knights split between those who would wait for the kingdoms and those who would march at once.

outcomes.title: A Horde Warlord Breaks Away
outcomes.text: Ugzthrak Ironjaw, High Chief of the clans, refuses Malgrath's command to march south and leads his own war-band to seize the Northern Isle's western coast for himself. The Spire sends its Voices to bring him to heel.

outcomes.title: Storms Close the Western Sea
outcomes.text: A month of storms closes the Thornshaw and Pelcrest seas. Westmarch's fleet is trapped in harbour and the Lord of the Thornshaw's pirates raid the coast unopposed.

outcomes.title: The Conclave Takes a Seat
outcomes.text: King Edric, in exchange for the Tower's secrets about the Binding, grants the Conclave of the Lake a seat at the Council of the Kingdoms. Hollowcrown walks out in protest.

outcomes.title: An Elven Envoy Murdered
outcomes.text: An envoy of the Elderwood travelling to Aldermere is found murdered on the Lake Road. The Lady Ithrael recalls every elf from the Great Isle and the kingdoms lose their best counsel about the Spire.

outcomes.title: A Hag's Prophecy
outcomes.text: A captured Hag of Morrowgast prophesies before Hollowcrown's priests that the Silver Flame will go out within a year. The prophecy spreads across the Great Isle and pilgrims flood to the Flame's shrine to see it burning.

outcomes.title: The Free Clans Take Marlford Vale
outcomes.text: The Free Clans storm Aldermere's fort at Marlford Vale and drive the knights out of their old fens. Wenna of the Reeds proclaims the Lakeshore free, and Aldermere's great houses demand a punitive war.

outcomes.title: Thornwatch's Warden Wed
outcomes.text: Garrick Stonehand marries a daughter of Hollowcrown's mountain lords. The match binds the north together, and Hollowcrown's Silver Guard marches north to stand on the wall.

outcomes.title: The Black Fleet Sails
outcomes.text: The Iron Horde's longships sail at last. A hundred hulls land on Thornwatch's eastern coast while the rest hold the strait, and the war Thornwatch has waited a thousand years for begins in earnest.

outcomes.title: Sunvale's Barons Proclaim a Republic
outcomes.text: The barons of Sunvale's eastern march, abandoned by Solenne, proclaim the Free March of the East, a republic of lords. Sunvale's court sends an army to bring them back, and the barons ask Aldermere and the Order for help.

outcomes.title: The Quiet Mothers Rise
outcomes.text: Mother Hesper Vane and the Quiet Mothers seize the Coven Hollow in a night of knives while Mother Vesk is away with the Blessed host. They halt the mass Blessings and send envoys to Sunvale offering peace; Vesk turns her army back to retake her capital.

outcomes.title: The Archmagister Dies
outcomes.text: Archmagister Corvane Thule dies in his sleep in the Tower of Stars. The Conclave's masters split between Magister Ilsa Brand's battle-mages and the scholars, and the Tower's charter with Aldermere comes into question.

outcomes.title: Westmarch Buys a Mountain
outcomes.text: Westmarch's merchant princes buy the rights to a rich unruled silver valley in the High Wilds from the hill clans who hold it, and send mercenaries to guard it. Hollowcrown, which claims the valley, calls it an act of war; Westmarch calls it business.

outcomes.title: The Pact of Root and Stone Suspended
outcomes.text: The Lady Ithrael suspends the Pact of Root and Stone after dwarven miners burn a stretch of forest to clear a road. Dwarven caravans are turned back at the forest's edge and the Deepholds' grain supply fails.

outcomes.title: Raiders from the Deep
outcomes.text: Pale, eyeless things come up out of the sealed ways of Karak Varn and kill a dwarven mining village. The Deepholds call every clan to arms and send for help, but no one outside the mountains believes them.

outcomes.title: An Earthquake in the Ashlands
outcomes.text: An earthquake splits the Ashlands open and a ruined Elder Age city rises from the ground. Sunvale, the Order and Morrowgast all send men to claim the ruins.

outcomes.title: Westmarch's Admiral Seizes Power
outcomes.text: Admiral Teodor Vlie marches his marines into Bellhaven's council hall and dissolves the merchant princes' council. He rules Westmarch as Lord Protector, promising to crush the pirates and restore trade.

outcomes.title: A Horde Champion Defects
outcomes.text: Mog the Broad, a war-chief of the Horde's lesser clans, sails to Thornwatch with three hundred warriors and offers his axe to the Warden against the Spire. Thornwatch does not know whether to trust him.

outcomes.title: A Plague of Wolves in Aldermere
outcomes.text: Wolves grown huge and fearless come out of the High Wilds into Aldermere's farmland, killing livestock and travellers. The Conclave says they are touched by Malgrath's art.

outcomes.title: Veyl's Glass Senate Dissolved
outcomes.text: First Magistrate Cassia Venn, facing impeachment over the Horde loans, dissolves the Glass Senate with hired swords and rules Veyl alone. The dwarven and elven senators flee, and Veyl's neutrality is in doubt for the first time in three centuries.

outcomes.title: The Lantern Besieges a Coven Town
outcomes.text: The knights of the Lantern march without the kingdoms' leave and besiege Morrowgast's westernmost fortified town. The crusade has begun, and the Coven's Blessed muster to break the siege.

outcomes.title: The Brotherhood Splits
outcomes.text: The old captains of the Brotherhood, tired of Red Mara's rule, sail off under Captain Bilge Harrow to found their own pirate band on the Thornshaw Sea. The Salt Isles are divided, and two pirate fleets now prey on the west.

outcomes.title: Hollowcrown's Queen Dies
outcomes.text: Queen Ysolde of Hollowcrown dies suddenly at prayer. Her infant daughter is crowned under the regency of First Prelate Aurelian Kord, and the mountain lords mutter against priestly rule.

outcomes.title: The Exiles' Champion Kills a Horde Chief
outcomes.text: Kol Ashfang of the Exiles kills a Horde war-chief in single combat on the beach of Grukk's Landing. The Horde's raiders withdraw, and orcs across the Northern Isle begin to speak the Exiles' name with respect.

outcomes.title: Thornwatch Loses Barhythe
outcomes.text: A Horde war-band takes Barhythe and holds it, the first town of the Great Isle in orc hands for a thousand years. Refugees flood south into Hollowcrown.

outcomes.title: The Conclave's Battle-Mages Go North
outcomes.text: Magister Ilsa Brand leads twenty battle-mages north to Thornwatch without the Conclave's leave. Their first fire-storm breaks a Horde war-band at the wall, and the orcs learn to fear the north.

outcomes.title: A Rebel Prince in Aldermere
outcomes.text: Prince Aldric, King Edric's nephew, gathers knights in the west of Aldermere and accuses the king's council of selling the realm to the Conclave. Aldermere edges toward civil war.

outcomes.title: The Salt Isles Burn
outcomes.text: A fire set by Westmarch's agents burns half of Red Harbour. The Brotherhood loses its warehouses and its prizes, and Red Mara vows a war without quarter on Westmarch's shipping.

outcomes.title: The Ice Wraiths
outcomes.text: Out of the frozen strait come wraiths of ice that walk through Thornwatch's walls and freeze the men on them. The Conclave says Malgrath has woken the drowned dead of the First War of the Spire.

outcomes.title: Sunvale Hires the Free Company
outcomes.text: Sunvale's court hires the Red Lantern free company to crush the eastern barons. The sellswords sack two of the barons' castles and then the town of Lisac, and Sunvale's own people turn against the crown.

outcomes.title: An Orc King in the West
outcomes.text: A Horde war-chief of the Northern Isle's western coast refuses the Spire's levies, proclaims himself King of the West and sends envoys to Thornwatch offering a truce against Malgrath. A second orc realm rises on the Northern Isle.

outcomes.title: Aldermere's King a Prisoner
outcomes.text: The great houses of Aldermere confine King Edric IV to his palace as unfit to rule and govern through a council of regency headed by Duchess Rowena Harrow. The king's loyalists slip out of the city to raise an army.

outcomes.title: Skarn the Red Rebels
outcomes.text: Warlord Skarn the Red and the Blessed host, tired of waiting on the Hag-Queens' rites, march on the Coven Hollow and demand war on Sunvale now. Morrowgast's civil war is open.

outcomes.title: The Heartwood Withers
outcomes.text: The Heartwood's leaves begin to fall in midwinter. The elves say the Spire is drawing on its roots from afar, and the Lady Ithrael prepares to go north herself.

outcomes.title: The Iron Market Collapses
outcomes.text: With war closing the strait and Veyl's banks frightened, the price of iron collapses across the world. The Deepholds' trade is ruined and the dwarven clans demand the Thane-King sell to anyone, even the Horde.

outcomes.title: A Peace Offer from the Coven
outcomes.text: The Hag-Queens of Morrowgast send Sunvale a peace offer: Morrowgast will cede its westernmost valleys in return for Sunvale's help against its own rebellious Blessed. Sunvale's court is torn between seizing land and keeping out of the Coven's war.

outcomes.title: Pirates Seize a Westmarch Town
outcomes.text: Brotherhood pirates storm the Westmarch harbour town of Kormouth and hold it for ransom while Westmarch's fleet is away. The town waits, and Westmarch's merchant princes must pay or fight.

outcomes.title: The Queen of the Lakeshore
outcomes.text: The clan-mothers' moot crowns Wenna of the Reeds Queen of the Lakeshore and asks the Concord to recognise the Free Clans as a sixth kingdom of the Great Isle. Aldermere refuses, and the Clans swear to take back their fens.

outcomes.title: A Volcano Wakes on the Northern Isle
outcomes.text: A dead mountain on the Northern Isle erupts, burying a Horde camp in ash and darkening the skies over the strait for weeks. The orcs say Malgrath's anger has broken the mountain.

outcomes.title: The Deepholds Break the Seals
outcomes.text: Thane Hilda Varnsdottir and the Remembrancers open the seals of Karak Varn by force to reclaim the lost hold. What comes out kills the first company that goes in, and the Thane-King orders the halls of Karak Dûm closed.

outcomes.title: Hollowcrown's Mountain Lords Revolt
outcomes.text: Lord Benedek Ashkirk and the mountain lords refuse the Prelacy's new war tithe and seize the high passes. Hollowcrown is split between the Kirk and the lords, while its men stand on Thornwatch's wall.

outcomes.title: A Duel of Archmagisters
outcomes.text: Royal Battle-Mage Ilsa Brand challenges Archmagister Corvane Thule for the Tower of Stars in a contest of spells. A master dies, Brand wins, and the Conclave turns its full power toward the war in the north.

outcomes.title: Bread Riots in Bellhaven
outcomes.text: Bellhaven's poor riot for bread while the merchant princes' granaries stand full for export. The council hangs the ringleaders, the guild halls close in protest and Westmarch's harbours stand idle.

outcomes.title: A New Island Found
outcomes.text: Westmarch sailors blown off course find an unknown island west of the Thornshaw Sea, green and empty. The merchant princes claim it, and settlers set sail.

outcomes.title: The Blessed Raid Sunvale
outcomes.text: A great war-band of Morrowgast's Blessed raids deep into Sunvale's eastern valleys, burning everything between the Ashlands and the coast. Sunvale's court can no longer pretend the war is far away.

outcomes.title: An Orc Uprising on the Northern Isle
outcomes.text: The lesser clans under Mother Snagga rise against the Spire's Voices, killing the overseers who demand their young for the rites. The rising spreads across the southern Northern Isle.

outcomes.title: A Plague in Hollowcrown's Army
outcomes.text: Camp fever breaks out among Hollowcrown's priests and soldiers serving on Thornwatch's wall. A third of them are sick, and the Warden must hold the wall with fewer men just as the Horde presses.

outcomes.title: The Lady Ithrael Sails North
outcomes.text: The Lady Ithrael leaves the Elderwood for the first time in a thousand years, sailing for Thornwatch with the Greywatch to see the Blackspire herself.

outcomes.title: The Battle of the Grey Strand
outcomes.text: The Horde's main host lands on the Grey Strand and the armies of Thornwatch and Hollowcrown meet it on the sand. Thousands die on both sides, and the beach is held, barely, by nightfall.

outcomes.title: Duchess Harrow Murdered
outcomes.text: Duchess Rowena Harrow, the most powerful of Aldermere's great lords, is poisoned at her own table. The great houses accuse the king's friends in the Conclave, and Aldermere's court divides into armed factions.

outcomes.title: Brigands Take a Sunvale Town
outcomes.text: Brigands out of the unruled Ashlands storm the Sunvale border town of Celay and make it their stronghold. A bandit lordship now holds land carved from Sunvale.

outcomes.title: Westmarch Declares War on the Brotherhood
outcomes.text: Westmarch formally declares war on the Brotherhood of the Salt Isles and on anyone who pays them. Sunvale, whose ministers secretly pay Red Mara, is warned to break the contract or share the Brotherhood's fate.

outcomes.title: The Lantern's Knights Fall
outcomes.text: A column of the Order's knights scouting the Ashlands is ambushed by Morrowgast's Blessed. Half of them die, Squire-Captain Mira Lumen is captured and the Order's crusade is set back a year.

outcomes.title: Veyl's Mercenaries Rebel
outcomes.text: Veyl's hired harbour guard, unpaid after a banking scare, seize the city's harbour and hold its ships for ransom. The Glass Senate must pay them or call on its neighbours.

outcomes.title: A Shipwreck of Gold
outcomes.text: A Veyl treasure ship carrying a year of Sunvale's loan payments sinks off the Ostcombe coast. Treasure-hunters, pirates and three navies race to the wreck.

outcomes.title: The Elderwood's Greywatch Raids the Spire
outcomes.text: Thalion Ash-Eye leads the Greywatch into the Northern Isle's peaks and burns one of the Blackspire's outer shrines. The orcs hunt them for weeks, and only half return.

outcomes.title: The Exiles Win Land in Thornwatch
outcomes.text: In payment for the Spire's secrets, Thornwatch grants the Ashen Exiles three empty coastal regions on the Great Isle. Orc families from across the Northern Isle cross the strait to join them.

outcomes.title: Florian II Abdicates
outcomes.text: King Florian II of Sunvale abdicates in favour of his cousin, Baron Lucien Rosonde of the eastern march, to end the barons' anger. Sunvale has a soldier-king, and the court ministers flee to Veyl.

outcomes.title: The Bridges of the Lake Burn
outcomes.text: Saboteurs burn three bridges on the Lake Road. Aldermere and Westmarch blame each other, and the road is closed for a season.

outcomes.title: A Deep-Thing in the Lake
outcomes.text: Something huge moves under the ice of Lake Halmoor near Wyn. Fishing boats vanish and the Conclave forbids anyone to sail near the Tower.

outcomes.title: The Order Calls a Holy War
outcomes.text: The Prior of the Hollow proclaims a holy war against Morrowgast and calls every knight of the Great Isle to Lanternhold. Young nobles from every kingdom answer, against their kings' orders.

outcomes.title: Hollowcrown's Heir Kidnapped
outcomes.text: The only heir of Hollowcrown's queen is stolen from the palace. The Prelacy accuses the mountain lords, the lords accuse heretics, and the realm tears itself apart searching.

outcomes.title: The Horde Takes the Strait
outcomes.text: The Horde's longships destroy Thornwatch's small fleet in the strait. The orcs can now cross whenever they wish, and the wall is all that stands between them and the south.

outcomes.title: A Coven Hag Seeks Asylum
outcomes.text: A Hag-Queen of Morrowgast flees to the Conclave's Tower of Stars and offers the Blessing's secrets in exchange for asylum. The Conclave accepts; the Order and Hollowcrown are outraged.

outcomes.title: Plague in the Horde Camps
outcomes.text: A camp fever sweeps through the Horde's war-camps on the Northern Isle. The orcs burn their own dead by the hundred, and the spring offensive stalls.

outcomes.title: Marriage of Westmarch and Veyl
outcomes.text: Westmarch's First Prince marries the daughter of Veyl's First Magistrate, binding Westmarch's fleet and Veyl's gold together. The other kingdoms watch a new power rise on the western sea.

outcomes.title: Aldermere's Lords Take Up Arms
outcomes.text: Two of Aldermere's great houses go to war over a disputed inheritance, and their armies meet at Chelbridge. The crown cannot stop them, and Aldermere's neighbours begin to take sides.

outcomes.title: The Spire Speaks
outcomes.text: At midnight, every orc on the Northern Isle hears Malgrath's voice in their heads at once: the south will burn before the summer. The Horde's chiefs, even Ugzthrak Ironjaw, fall silent.

outcomes.title: The Thaw Floods Aldermere
outcomes.text: An early thaw sends the rivers of the High Wilds roaring into Lake Halmoor. The lake rises over Aldermere's lower city, drowning the wool warehouses and the Lake Guilds' stores, and the capital's poor flee to higher ground with nothing.

outcomes.title: The Corsairs of the Embermarsh
outcomes.text: Sailors cast out of the Brotherhood for cheating their crews take three ships and found a new band, the Embermarsh Corsairs, on an unruled rock off Westmarch's southern coast. They raid both Westmarch's convoys and Red Harbour's prizes.

outcomes.title: The Thane-King's Brother Seizes the Throne
outcomes.text: While the Thane-King of Karak Dûm is away inspecting the eastern mines, his younger brother Bram Ashbeard takes the stone throne with the forge-guilds' backing. The Thane-King returns to find the gates barred against him, and the Deepholds split.

outcomes.title: A Coven Rite Poisons the Ashlands
outcomes.text: A great blood-rite of Morrowgast's Hag-Queens goes wrong in the Ashlands. The ground for twenty miles turns red and barren; nothing grows there, and the people of the border flee into Sunvale.

outcomes.title: The Heartwood Speaks
outcomes.text: For the first time since the Fading, the Heartwood sings aloud. Every elf in the Elderwood hears it name an heir: a child born that spring, the first in fifty years. The elves call it a sign the Binding can be woven again.

outcomes.title: Thornwatch's Levies Desert
outcomes.text: Unpaid since the autumn, a third of Thornwatch's levies walk off the wall and go home to their farms. The Warden hangs a few deserters, begs the kingdoms for silver and holds the wall with his household troops.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Agent Unmasked
outcomes.text: A secretary of Aldermere's Lord Chancellor is caught copying the Council of the Kingdoms' plans for the Spire. Under torture he names others in the courts of Sunvale and Westmarch, and the courts of the Great Isle turn on each other in suspicion.

outcomes.title: Salt Isle Volcano
outcomes.text: The largest of the Salt Isles shakes and a fissure opens near Red Harbour, pouring smoke and ash over the town. Half the Brotherhood's people flee onto their ships, and Red Mara must find a new home or rebuild under the ash.

outcomes.title: Westmarch's Grain to the Horde
outcomes.text: Westmarch's merchants are caught selling grain to the Horde through Veyl's agents. Thornwatch demands Westmarch's merchants be punished; the merchant princes say grain has no allegiance.

outcomes.title: The Wild Hunt
outcomes.text: Riders of bone and shadow pour out of the High Wilds on moonless nights and hunt travellers on the roads of Aldermere and Hollowcrown. The Conclave says a barrow of the First War has been opened; the Lantern's knights ride out to close it.

outcomes.title: Hollowcrown Expels the Mages
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's Prelacy declares all magic outside the Silver Flame's priesthood a crime and expels every wizard from the realm. The refugees cross into Aldermere and the Conclave takes them in, deepening the feud between Tower and Flame.

outcomes.title: A New Archmagister by Murder
outcomes.text: The Archmagister of the Conclave is found dead at the foot of the Tower of Stars. The masters elect the leader of the Deep Study, who promises to defeat Malgrath by understanding his art, and the kingdoms watch in fear.

outcomes.title: The Free Clans Kidnap a Lord
outcomes.text: The Reed Raiders carry off an Aldermere lord's son from his hunting lodge on the lake shore. Their price is the return of one fen region to the clans; Aldermere's great houses demand the clans be destroyed instead.

outcomes.title: Veyl Sells a Fleet
outcomes.text: Veyl's Glass Senate sells ten war galleys to Sunvale on credit Sunvale cannot repay. When the first payment fails, Veyl seizes Sunvale's customs house at Solenne in lieu, and Sunvale's court is humiliated.

outcomes.title: The Blight of the Grain Coast
outcomes.text: A red blight kills the wheat across Westmarch's western farmland. Westmarch, the breadbasket of the Great Isle, has nothing to sell, and the price of bread doubles from Bellhaven to Hollowcrown.

outcomes.title: The Horde Burns the Exiles' Camp
outcomes.text: A Horde war-fleet finds the Ashen Exiles' camp undefended and burns Grukk's Landing to the ground. The Exiles flee to their boats and beg Thornwatch for a shore to land on.

outcomes.title: A Sunvale Duke Declares Independence
outcomes.text: The Duke of Sunvale's western hills, insulted by the court and owed a fortune by the crown, declares his duchy independent and closes the roads to Solenne. Sunvale's ministers must buy him back or fight him.

outcomes.title: The Ice Breaks Early
outcomes.text: The strait between the Northern Isle and Thornwatch thaws a month early. The Horde's longships can sail weeks before Thornwatch expected, and the Warden has no time left to rebuild the beacons.

outcomes.title: The Brotherhood's Prize Princess
outcomes.text: Red Mara's crews capture a ship carrying a Westmarch merchant prince's daughter to her wedding in Aldermere. Red Mara asks a king's ransom and an amnesty for her captains; Westmarch's council is split between paying and fighting.

outcomes.title: A Plague of Madness in Morrowgast
outcomes.text: A sickness spreads through Morrowgast's Blessed: those it touches lose their reason and attack anyone near them. The Coven quarantines whole towns, and its army shrinks by a third.

outcomes.title: The Murder of the Warden
outcomes.text: Garrick Stonehand, Warden of Thornwatch, is killed by an orc assassin who climbs the walls of Thornwatch Keep by night. His young heir is proclaimed Warden, and the captains of the Beacon Line vow a war of vengeance across the strait.

outcomes.title: A Kingdom of Wolves
outcomes.text: The wolf packs of the High Wilds are led by a great white wolf that speaks with a man's voice. They drive the shepherds out of three unruled valleys, and the hill folk begin to pay them tribute in cattle.

outcomes.title: Aldermere's Treasury Robbed
outcomes.text: The royal treasury beneath Aldermere's palace is emptied in a single night by thieves who left no trace. The crown cannot pay its soldiers or its debts to Veyl, and the great houses suspect magic.

outcomes.title: The Coven Sends an Envoy to the Spire
outcomes.text: Morrowgast's Hag-Queens send an embassy across the sea to the Blackspire. Its purpose is secret, but Sunvale and the Order fear the two greatest dark powers of the world have joined hands.

outcomes.title: A Rebellion in the Horde's South
outcomes.text: The orc clans of the Northern Isle's southern coast, weary of feeding the Spire's war, kill their overseers and declare themselves free. They send word to the Ashen Exiles asking to join them.

outcomes.title: The Lost Hold Reclaimed
outcomes.text: The Remembrancers of the Deepholds fight their way into Karak Varn and clear its upper halls of the things that lived there. The lost hold is dwarven again, its riches are opened, and the Remembrancers' power at court grows.

outcomes.title: A Merchant Prince Founds a City
outcomes.text: A Westmarch merchant prince builds a fortified trading town on unruled coast between Westmarch and Aldermere, with his own guards and his own laws. He calls it Freeport and invites any trader of any realm.

outcomes.title: Florian II Falls from His Horse
outcomes.text: Sunvale's king is thrown from his horse at a hunt and lies near death. His ministers and his barons race to control the succession, and the court of Solenne fills with daggers.

outcomes.title: The Lantern Burns a Village
outcomes.text: Knights of the Order of the Lantern burn a village in Sunvale's eastern hills, claiming its people were Blessed. They were not; Sunvale's court demands the Order leave its lands, and the Order refuses.

outcomes.title: The Strait Fleet
outcomes.text: Thornwatch, Hollowcrown and Aldermere together pay for a war fleet of thirty ships to hold the strait against the Horde. It is the first fleet the kingdoms have built together, and command of it is fiercely disputed.

outcomes.title: Veyl's Glassmakers Strike
outcomes.text: The furnaces of Veyl go cold when the Glassmakers' Guild strikes against the banking houses. Veyl's trade stops, and the guild demands seats in the Glass Senate.

outcomes.title: A Storm Wrecks the Brotherhood
outcomes.text: A great spring storm catches the Brotherhood's fleet at sea and sinks half of it. Red Mara survives, but the Brotherhood's power on the Ostcombe Sea is broken for a season, and its enemies move in.

outcomes.title: The Elves Leave the Eastern Isle
outcomes.text: A third of the elves of the Elderwood take ship westward, beyond the edge of the known world, saying the Fading cannot be stopped. The Lady Ithrael lets them go, and the Elderwood's borders shrink.

outcomes.title: The Ashlands Kingdom
outcomes.text: A Sunvale exile, the knight Sir Raoul Vauquelin, gathers outlaws, refugees and runaway Blessed in the unruled Ashlands and crowns himself King of the Ashlands. He demands recognition from Sunvale and Morrowgast both.

outcomes.title: A Hag-Queen Turns Against the Coven
outcomes.text: A Hag-Queen of Morrowgast denounces the Blessing as a curse and leads three towns of the Coven-Realm in revolt. The Order offers her protection; the Coven sends the Blessed to burn the towns.

outcomes.title: The Conclave's Mages Burn a Horde Fleet
outcomes.text: Battle-mages of the Conclave call a fire-storm on the Horde's fleet gathering at Thrak-Mog. Thirty longships burn, and the Spire's raids across the strait stop for a season.

outcomes.title: An Earthquake in the Deepholds
outcomes.text: A great earthquake shakes the eastern mountains. Karak Dûm's halls stand, but two lesser holds collapse and thousands of dwarves are buried; the Deepholds turn inward to dig out their dead.

outcomes.title: Aldermere Annexes the Free Clans' Hills
outcomes.text: Aldermere's knights march into the unruled hills where the Free Clans shelter and build forts there. The clans are driven further into the wild, and Aldermere's border moves south.

outcomes.title: The Spire Recruits the Dead
outcomes.text: The barrows of the First War of the Spire on the Northern Isle are found empty. The Horde's enemies understand that Malgrath has raised the dead of the Weeping Fields to march again.

outcomes.title: A Poisoned Well in Hollowcrown
outcomes.text: The great well of Hollowcrown's capital is poisoned; hundreds sicken and dozens die. The Prelacy blames witches of Morrowgast and burns three women in the square.

outcomes.title: The Council of the Kingdoms Breaks Up
outcomes.text: The Council of the Kingdoms at Aldermere breaks up in shouting when Westmarch refuses to pay for Thornwatch's wall and Hollowcrown walks out over the Conclave's seat. Each kingdom will face the Spire alone, unless something brings them back.

outcomes.title: The Blessed Cross the Ashlands
outcomes.text: Morrowgast's Blessed host crosses the Ashlands in force and lays siege to Sunvale's eastern fortress town. The war between Sunvale and the Coven, long feared, has begun.

outcomes.title: The Salt Isles Sell Themselves
outcomes.text: Red Mara offers the Salt Isles to Sunvale as a vassal in exchange for pardons and a royal charter for her captains. Westmarch threatens war on both if Sunvale accepts.

outcomes.title: The Thane-King's Steel to the Horde
outcomes.text: Thane-King Durgrim Ashbeard, his halls ruined by a collapsing trade, sells a thousand steel blades to the Horde's agents. When the kingdoms learn of it, they ban dwarven goods, and the Deepholds' own Remembrancers call it treason.

outcomes.title: Raiders of the Northern Sea
outcomes.text: A band of orc raiders that answers neither to the Spire nor to the Exiles takes to the sea in stolen longships and raids Thornwatch's coast and the Exiles' camps alike. They call themselves the Free Oars.

outcomes.title: A Prophet in Aldermere's Slums
outcomes.text: A barefoot prophet in Aldermere's lower city preaches that the kings have failed and the Spire is coming for them all. Thousands follow her into the streets, and the royal guards cannot clear them.

outcomes.title: The Deep Study Raises a Dead King
outcomes.text: Renegade mages of the Conclave's Deep Study raise the body of Aldric the Founder from his tomb to ask how he held the Great Isle together. The dead king speaks before crumbling; Aldermere's people are horrified, and the Conclave is disgraced.

outcomes.title: A Comet Over Hollowcrown
outcomes.text: A blazing comet hangs over Hollowcrown's mountains, its tail pointing at the Silver Flame. Pilgrims pour into the realm, the Prelacy says the god has spoken and the war tithe is doubled.

outcomes.title: The Order Elects a New Grand Master
outcomes.text: The Order of the Lantern's knights elect a new Grand Master, a zealot who swears to cleanse not only Morrowgast but every unlicensed mage on the Great Isle. The Conclave begins to fear the Lantern more than the Spire.

outcomes.title: Westmarch's Great Fleet Lost
outcomes.text: Westmarch's war fleet, sailing to break the Brotherhood, is caught by a storm off the Salt Isles and scattered. Twelve ships are lost and Westmarch's sea power is broken for a year.

outcomes.title: The Dwarves Reopen the Old Mines
outcomes.text: The Deepholds reopen an abandoned silver mine in the unruled mountains east of Veyl. The mine is rich, and the dwarves build a new hold there, the first in a century.

outcomes.title: An Elven Assassin in the Spire
outcomes.text: An elf of the Greywatch slips into the Blackspire itself and is never seen again. A week later, every orc chief on the Northern Isle receives an elven arrow wrapped in a message: the Unbreathing can be reached.

outcomes.title: A Peasant War in Sunvale
outcomes.text: The peasants of Sunvale's southern lowlands, crushed by taxes for the court's festivals, rise in rebellion, burning manors and killing tax-collectors. The rising spreads across a dozen regions.

outcomes.title: The Heartwood Burns
outcomes.text: Fire set by agents of the Spire reaches the Heartwood itself. The elves save the great tree, but half of Caras Ithrael burns, and the Lady Ithrael swears the elves will go to war.

outcomes.title: A Pirate Fleet Takes Kormouth
outcomes.text: A combined pirate fleet storms the Westmarch port of Kormouth and holds it as a free port for every outlaw of the western sea. Westmarch's merchant princes argue over whether to buy it back.

outcomes.title: The Horde's Champion
outcomes.text: A giant orc called Grushnak Bloodmaw rises among the Horde's clans, killing three war-chiefs in single combat and uniting their bands. He swears to be the first to stand on Thornwatch's wall.

outcomes.title: Veyl Recognises the Free Clans
outcomes.text: The Glass Republic of Veyl recognises the Free Clans of the Lakeshore as a sovereign people and lends them money. Aldermere breaks off its debts to Veyl in fury.

outcomes.title: Thornwatch Takes a Northern Beach
outcomes.text: Thornwatch's captains land on the Northern Isle's southern shore and seize a beachhead in unruled land below the Horde's camps. They fortify it as a forward post against the Spire.

outcomes.title: The Plague of the Lake
outcomes.text: A fever rising from the stagnant shores of Lake Halmoor kills thousands in Aldermere's lake towns. The court flees to the hills, and the realm is governed from horseback.

outcomes.title: The Conclave Offers a Weapon
outcomes.text: The Conclave of the Lake reveals it has built a weapon from Elder Age lore that can break a ward like the Spire's. It offers the weapon to the kingdom that pays most, and the kingdoms bid against each other.

outcomes.title: The Blood Moon Rite
outcomes.text: On the night of a blood moon, every Blessed warrior of Morrowgast falls into a frenzy at once. Three border towns of Sunvale are overrun before dawn, and the Coven's Hag-Queens claim they did not order it.

outcomes.title: A Dragon Over the Eastern Isle
outcomes.text: A red dragon, unseen for centuries, flies over the Eastern Isle and burns a Veyl merchant convoy and a dwarven caravan. It nests in the unruled peaks between the Deepholds and the Elderwood, and both realms send hunters.

outcomes.title: Aldermere's Heir Dies
outcomes.text: King Edric IV's heir dies of a sudden fever. The king has no other child, and Aldermere's great houses begin to marshal their claims to the oldest crown of the Great Isle.

outcomes.title: The Free Oars Join the Exiles
outcomes.text: The orc sea-raiders who answer to no master join Grukk Oathbreaker's Exiles, doubling their warriors. The Exiles become a power on the northern sea that the Horde cannot ignore.

outcomes.title: Westmarch Seizes the Lake Road Forts
outcomes.text: Westmarch's mercenaries seize the toll-forts on the Lake Road at the border and hold them, refusing to pay Aldermere's tolls. The Concord's oldest quarrel turns into fighting.

outcomes.title: A Rogue Mage Burns Solenne's Palace
outcomes.text: A rogue mage hired by persons unknown sets fire to the royal palace of Solenne. The court escapes, but the palace and its treasures burn, and Sunvale's ministers accuse the Conclave.

outcomes.title: The Hearth-Flame Takes a Town
outcomes.text: Followers of a heretic preacher of the Silver Flame seize the Hollowcrown town of Brightstrand and declare it free of the Prelacy. The Silver Guard marches to retake it.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Voice in Aldermere
outcomes.text: A noble of Aldermere's court is found to hear the Spire's voice in his sleep. Under questioning by the Conclave he names five more, and Aldermere's court is purged.

outcomes.title: An Orc Kingdom on the Northern Coast
outcomes.text: The free orc clans of the Northern Isle's southern coast crown a chief of their own and build a stockade-town. The Spire calls them traitors, and Thornwatch wonders whether they could be allies.

outcomes.title: The Treasury of Veyl Robbed
outcomes.text: The vaults of Veyl's oldest bank are robbed of a fortune in glass ducats. The thieves are never found; Veyl's credit collapses and every kingdom with loans there loses its money.

outcomes.title: Famine in Thornwatch
outcomes.text: With the harvest burned by raids and the fishing fleet kept in harbour, Thornwatch goes hungry. Its people flee south, and the Warden begs the kingdoms for grain to hold the wall.

outcomes.title: The Blessing on the Wind
outcomes.text: A red mist rises from the Coven Hollow and blows west on the spring wind. Those who breathe it fall sick with the Blessing's fever; Sunvale closes its eastern roads and the Order says the end has come.

outcomes.title: The Brotherhood Takes a Sunvale Isle
outcomes.text: Red Mara's crews seize an island off Sunvale's coast and make it their second base. Sunvale's ministers protest weakly; they still owe the Brotherhood for last year's contract.

outcomes.title: The Thane-King Exiled
outcomes.text: Thane-King Durgrim Ashbeard is deposed by the Hall of Thanes for ruining the Deepholds' trade and goes into exile in Veyl. Thane Hilda Varnsdottir of the Remembrancers takes the stone throne.

outcomes.title: A Witch-Hunter's Massacre
outcomes.text: A Hollowcrown witch-hunter and his followers massacre a village of Aldermere they believe harbours witches. Aldermere demands justice, Hollowcrown refuses, and the two kingdoms' borders bristle with soldiers.

outcomes.title: A New Pass Through the Mountains
outcomes.text: Dwarven engineers of the Deepholds finish a tunnel through the eastern peaks, linking Karak Dûm to the Eastern Isle's eastern coast. A new trade route opens, and the Elderwood's monopoly on the forest road ends.

outcomes.title: The Elves Send a Fleet
outcomes.text: The Elderwood sends its last war-fleet of silver ships to Thornwatch to fight the Horde. For the first time since the Weeping Fields, elves stand on the Great Isle's wall.

outcomes.title: The Horde Crosses to Hollowcrown
outcomes.text: An orc war-band lands on Hollowcrown's northern coast, slipping past Thornwatch's wall by sea, and burns three mountain villages. Hollowcrown realises the wall cannot protect it.

outcomes.title: A Peasant King in Westmarch
outcomes.text: A farmer from Westmarch's blighted west, called Tam Corrow, leads ten thousand starving peasants against the merchant princes' estates. He proclaims a commonwealth of the fields, and the princes must buy soldiers to stop him.

outcomes.title: The Conclave's Tower Stands Alone
outcomes.text: Aldermere's council revokes the Charter of the Tower and orders the Conclave to submit to the crown. The Archmagister refuses, raises wards around Wyn and declares the Conclave independent.

outcomes.title: The Siege of Thornwatch Keep
outcomes.text: The Horde's host crosses the strait and lays siege to Thornwatch Keep itself. The Warden's garrison holds, but every village of the Wardenmark burns, and the kingdoms' armies are weeks away.

outcomes.title: Sunvale Sells Its Eastern March
outcomes.text: Sunvale's court, bankrupt and frightened, sells its eastern march to Veyl's banks for gold to pay its debts. Veyl now owns land on the Great Isle for the first time, and the eastern barons refuse to accept it.

outcomes.title: A Sickness in the Deep
outcomes.text: A wasting sickness spreads through the Deepholds from the newly opened halls of Karak Varn. Dwarves who go below come back grey and silent, and the holds close their gates to each other.

outcomes.title: The Hag-Queens Turn on Each Other
outcomes.text: The seven Hag-Queens of Morrowgast quarrel over the war with Sunvale; two are killed in a duel of blood-magic, and the Coven-Realm splits into rival towns. Its armies halt on the edge of the Ashlands.

outcomes.title: A Gold Rush on the Northern Isle
outcomes.text: Escaped slaves bring word of gold in the unruled northern mountains of the Northern Isle. Adventurers, Exiles and free orcs pour north, and the Spire sends war-bands to keep them out.

outcomes.title: The King of Aldermere Abdicates
outcomes.text: King Edric IV, worn out by war and grief, abdicates in favour of his cousin Duchess Rowena Harrow. Half of Aldermere's lords refuse her, and the oldest kingdom of the Great Isle has a queen it does not want.

outcomes.title: The Ostcombe Pirate Wars
outcomes.text: Three pirate bands fight a sea battle in the Ostcombe Sea for control of the southern shipping lanes. Westmarch's and Sunvale's trade stops entirely while they fight, and the winner will rule the southern sea.

outcomes.title: The Lady Ithrael Dies
outcomes.text: The Lady Ithrael of the Elderwood dies, her life spent holding the Heartwood against the Spire's draining. The elves choose no successor; the Loremasters and the Greywatch rule together and argue over everything.

outcomes.title: A Lord of Aldermere Joins the Free Clans
outcomes.text: A disinherited son of an Aldermere great house joins the Free Clans with his household knights. He teaches the clans to fight in armour, and Aldermere's fens become a real war.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Bridge
outcomes.text: Malgrath raises a bridge of black ice across the strait between the Northern Isle and Thornwatch. The Horde can cross at will, and the Conclave says the Unbreathing's power is greater than anyone feared.

outcomes.title: A Flood of Refugees in Hollowcrown
outcomes.text: Tens of thousands flee Thornwatch's burning villages into Hollowcrown's mountain valleys. The Prelacy cannot feed them, and refugee camps become towns of their own.

outcomes.title: Veyl Hires Pirates
outcomes.text: Veyl's Glass Senate hires the Brotherhood of the Salt Isles to protect its convoys to the Great Isle. Westmarch, at war with the Brotherhood, cuts off trade with Veyl.

outcomes.title: The Order Marches with Sunvale
outcomes.text: The Order of the Lantern and Sunvale's eastern barons march together into the Ashlands against the Coven. The Order's knights and Sunvale's men-at-arms win a battle at the Raven Road and push the Blessed back.

outcomes.title: Ugzthrak Ironjaw Slain
outcomes.text: The High Chief of the Horde's clans, Ugzthrak Ironjaw, is slain by Malgrath's own Voices for doubting the Spire. The clans are terrified into obedience, and the Spire's grip on the Horde tightens.

outcomes.title: An Uprising in Veyl's Slums
outcomes.text: The poor of Veyl, the glass-cutters and lamp-blowers, rise against the banking houses and burn the Glass Senate's records. The Republic's guards side with the rebels, and Veyl's government falls.

outcomes.title: Westmarch's Admiral Defects
outcomes.text: Westmarch's High Admiral sails his flagship and four galleys to the Brotherhood of the Salt Isles, saying the merchant princes have betrayed the sea. Red Mara makes him her second, and Westmarch's navy is crippled.

outcomes.title: A Kraken in Lake Halmoor
outcomes.text: A great kraken, brought up from the sea through underground rivers by the Conclave's experiments, appears in Lake Halmoor. It sinks lake boats and the Tower of Stars' own barges.

outcomes.title: The Silver Flame Flickers
outcomes.text: The Silver Flame in Hollowcrown's hollow flickers and nearly goes out for an hour. Panic sweeps Hollowcrown, the Prelacy calls for penance and war, and the pilgrims flee.

outcomes.title: Grukk's Exiles Take the Northern Coast
outcomes.text: The Ashen Exiles and the free orc clans together seize an unruled stretch of the Northern Isle's western coast, building a fortified camp. A free orc realm is growing on the Spire's doorstep.

outcomes.title: The Deepholds Open Their Gates
outcomes.text: The Thane-King of Karak Dûm opens the Deepholds to refugees of the Great Isle in exchange for labour. Thousands of humans go to work in the dwarven mines, and the Deepholds grow rich and crowded.

outcomes.title: The Battle of the Beacon Line
outcomes.text: The Horde attacks Thornwatch's wall along its whole length. Battle-mages, Hollowcrown's priests and the Warden's levies hold most of it, but three towers fall and orcs pour through into the Wardenmark.

outcomes.title: A Dwarven Army Marches
outcomes.text: The Deepholds send three thousand dwarven warriors across the sea to Thornwatch to fight the Horde, the first dwarven army on the Great Isle in a thousand years. Their price is the Northern Isle's iron mines when the Spire falls.

outcomes.title: The Coven Burns Its Own
outcomes.text: Morrowgast's Hag-Queens burn a town of their own people who refused the Blessing. The smoke is seen in Sunvale, and refugees bring the story west; the Order demands the kingdoms march.

outcomes.title: The Free Clans Burn Aldermere's Granaries
outcomes.text: The Reed Raiders slip into Aldermere's lake city and burn the royal granaries. The capital faces hunger, and the great houses demand the king end the fens war at any cost.

outcomes.title: A Silver Mine Collapses
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's richest silver mine collapses, killing three hundred miners. The Prelacy's treasury loses its main income just when the war tithe was meant to pay for the wall.

outcomes.title: Sunvale's King Takes a Coven Bride
outcomes.text: Florian II of Sunvale announces his betrothal to a daughter of Morrowgast's Hag-Queens to end the border war. The court is aghast, the Order calls it damnation, and the barons ride for Solenne.

outcomes.title: The Brotherhood Sacks Bellhaven's Harbour
outcomes.text: Red Mara's fleet sails into Bellhaven's harbour at night and burns the merchant princes' ships at their moorings. Westmarch loses half its merchant fleet in a single night.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Voices Come South
outcomes.text: Three of Malgrath's Voices, sorcerers in black masks, land on the Great Isle in secret. Wherever they pass, the dead rise and the living lose their will to fight.

outcomes.title: A Rebellion in Westmarch's West
outcomes.text: The farmers of Westmarch's western lowlands, ruined by blight and taxes, rise against the merchant princes and proclaim the Free Fields. Westmarch's mercenaries march west to crush them.

outcomes.title: The Elderwood Moves
outcomes.text: The Heartwood's seedlings are planted in a new grove in the unruled forest to the east, and half the elves move there with them. The Elderwood's borders shift east, away from the Spire's reach.

outcomes.title: A Veyl Banker Owns a Kingdom
outcomes.text: Veyl's richest banking house buys up all of Sunvale's royal debts. Its master now controls Sunvale's customs, mints and harbours, and Sunvale's ministers must ask him for every coin.

outcomes.title: The Exiles' Chief Dies
outcomes.text: Grukk Oathbreaker dies of wounds from a Horde ambush. Kol Ashfang of the Young Blades takes his place and swears to carry the war to the Spire, not to bargain with humans.

outcomes.title: Plague on the Northern Isle
outcomes.text: A plague of the bones sweeps the Northern Isle's camps. Thousands of orcs die, the Horde's host melts away, and the Spire sends its Voices to raise the dead to fill the ranks.

outcomes.title: The Hollow Crown Stolen
outcomes.text: The hollow crown of Hollowcrown, the realm's holiest relic, is stolen from the Silver Flame's shrine. The Prelacy accuses the Conclave, the Conclave accuses the Hearth-Flame heretics, and the queen cannot be seen without it.

outcomes.title: An Alliance of the Sea
outcomes.text: Westmarch and Sunvale sign a pact to hunt down the pirates of the Ostcombe Sea together, pooling their fleets under a joint admiral. The Brotherhood finds itself facing two kingdoms at once.

outcomes.title: A Lord Rebels in Thornwatch
outcomes.text: Captain Hesk Bitterburn of the Beacon Line refuses the Warden's orders to abandon the coast and holds the eastern beacons with his own men. Thornwatch's command splits in the middle of the war.

outcomes.title: The Conclave's Weapon Fails
outcomes.text: The Conclave tests its Elder Age weapon against the Blackspire from Thornwatch's wall. The blast kills a hundred of its own battle-mages and does not touch the Spire, and the Conclave's reputation collapses.

outcomes.title: Morrowgast Takes an Ashlands Fort
outcomes.text: Morrowgast's Blessed seize a ruined Elder Age fort in the unruled Ashlands and garrison it. The Coven now has a foothold halfway to Sunvale's heartland.

outcomes.title: A Royal Wedding at Aldermere
outcomes.text: Aldermere's heir marries a princess of Hollowcrown in a ceremony blessed by the Silver Flame. The two kingdoms swear to defend each other, and Westmarch and Sunvale feel left out.

outcomes.title: Thornwatch Recruits the Exiles
outcomes.text: The Warden of Thornwatch formally takes the Ashen Exiles into his service as a free company, paying them in land on the coast. Orcs stand on the wall beside men for the first time.

outcomes.title: The Spring Offensive
outcomes.text: With the passes open, the Horde launches its spring offensive across the strait in three columns. Thornwatch's wall breaks in the east and the orcs reach the edge of Hollowcrown's foothills.

outcomes.title: A Kingdom Divided
outcomes.text: Aldermere's council divides the realm between two claimants to avoid civil war: the north to one, the lake and the south to the other. The oldest kingdom of the Great Isle is suddenly two.

outcomes.title: Sunvale's Barons Elect a King
outcomes.text: Sunvale's eastern barons, defying Solenne, elect Baron Lucien Rosonde king of the east. Sunvale has two kings, and the Coven watches its enemy tear itself apart.

outcomes.title: The Red Mist Lifts
outcomes.text: The red mist of Morrowgast suddenly lifts, and the Blessed who breathed it wake from their frenzy as ordinary men. The Coven's grip on its army slips, and some of its soldiers begin to desert.

outcomes.title: A Merchant Republic in Aldermere
outcomes.text: The lake towns of Aldermere, led by the wool guilds, declare themselves a free merchant league and refuse the crown's taxes. They hire the Gilded Lances to defend their walls.

outcomes.title: The Dragon of the East Slain
outcomes.text: Dwarven and elven hunters together kill the red dragon of the Eastern Isle in its nest. They find a hoard of Elder Age gold, and quarrel over it until the Pact of Root and Stone nearly breaks.

outcomes.title: The Brotherhood Founds a Kingdom
outcomes.text: Red Mara proclaims herself Queen of the Salt Isles and the Southern Sea, with a crown made from a captured Westmarch chalice. She demands every kingdom pay her tribute for safe passage.

outcomes.title: The Deep Study's Lich
outcomes.text: Renegade mages of the Deep Study perform the rite that made Malgrath undying on their own master. She does not die, and the Great Isle has a second Unbreathing hidden somewhere in Aldermere's hills.

outcomes.title: Westmarch Breaks the Concord
outcomes.text: Westmarch's council renounces the Concord of the Lake, refusing to pay its share for the war in the north. The other kingdoms call it treason against the Great Isle, and Aldermere masses troops on the border.

outcomes.title: The Heartwood's Heir
outcomes.text: An elven child born in the Heartwood speaks in the voice of the queen who died weaving the Binding a thousand years ago. The elves take her as their queen, and she orders the Elderwood to war.

outcomes.title: The Fall of Barhythe
outcomes.text: The Horde takes Barhythe on Thornwatch's coast and holds it as a base on the Great Isle. Longships unload more orcs there every week.

outcomes.title: A Hag-Queen Rules Alone
outcomes.text: One Hag-Queen of Morrowgast kills her six sisters in a single night of blood-rites and rules the Coven alone. Her first order is a mass Blessing of every child in the realm.

outcomes.title: The Exiles' New Home
outcomes.text: Thornwatch grants the Ashen Exiles a coastal region for their families, in exchange for their service on the wall. The orc Exiles have land on the Great Isle, and the Horde swears to drive them into the sea.

outcomes.title: A Mutiny in the Lantern
outcomes.text: Young knights of the Order of the Lantern, tired of waiting, mutiny against the Grand Master and march on Morrowgast alone. Half are killed, and the Order is left weakened and divided.

outcomes.title: The Glass Plague
outcomes.text: A sickness that turns the skin to glass breaks out in Veyl's furnace quarters. The Glass Senate closes the harbour, and Veyl's trade stops for a season.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Envoys Seek Allies
outcomes.text: Envoys of the Blackspire arrive in Westmarch and Sunvale offering gold and promises of land if they stay out of the war. Westmarch's council listens; Sunvale's court splits over it.

outcomes.title: The Wall Rebuilt with Dwarven Stone
outcomes.text: Dwarven masons of the Deepholds rebuild Thornwatch's broken towers in black granite that no fire can crack. The wall is stronger than ever, and the Warden owes the dwarves a fortune.

outcomes.title: An Orc Warlord Takes Thornwatch Keep
outcomes.text: A giant orc warlord storms Thornwatch Keep in a night assault. The Warden escapes with a handful of men, and the Horde holds the keep that has guarded the strait since the year 241.

outcomes.title: The Lake Road Robbers
outcomes.text: Bands of deserters from every kingdom's army rob the Lake Road so boldly that trade between Aldermere and Westmarch stops. Calling themselves the Brotherhood of the Road, they offer their swords to any lord who pays.

outcomes.title: The Conclave Opens Its Archives
outcomes.text: The Conclave of the Lake opens its archives to every kingdom of the Concord, revealing the full lore of the Binding. The kingdoms learn that a new Binding needs the blood of the Elderwood's royal line, and the elves refuse.

outcomes.title: The Council Opens in Uproar
outcomes.text: The Council of the Kingdoms opens at Aldermere and dissolves into shouting on its first day, when Thornwatch's envoy throws the bill for the wall onto the table and Westmarch's envoy laughs. Each kingdom's delegation sends home for orders, and the Spire's spies send home their reports.

outcomes.title: The Envoy Who Vanished
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's envoy to the Council of the Kingdoms disappears from his rooms in Aldermere on the council's first night, leaving only his seal and a smear of black frost on the window. Hollowcrown accuses the Conclave; the Conclave says it smells of the Spire.

outcomes.title: The Spring Fair of Bellhaven
outcomes.text: Westmarch holds its great spring fair while the kingdoms argue at Aldermere. Merchants of every realm make fortunes, the merchant princes show off their wealth and Thornwatch's envoy notes bitterly that Westmarch can afford a fair but not a wall.

outcomes.title: The Prince Who Rode North
outcomes.text: A younger prince of Aldermere, tired of the council's talk, rides north with a hundred knights to stand on Thornwatch's wall without the king's leave. The king disowns him; the people sing about him.

outcomes.title: The Brigands of the Lake Road Spring
outcomes.text: With the spring thaw, brigands return to the Lake Road in force, robbing the envoys' baggage trains on their way to the council. The kingdoms' delegations arrive at Aldermere angry and short of gifts.

outcomes.title: A Witch at the Council
outcomes.text: An envoy of Morrowgast arrives uninvited at the Council of the Kingdoms and asks to speak. Sunvale's barons draw their swords in the council hall, Aldermere's king lets her speak, and what she says about the Spire silences the room.

outcomes.title: The Thaw Floods
outcomes.text: The spring thaw floods the rivers of Aldermere's south, drowning fields just sown. The farmers must sow again, and the realm's harvest will be late.

outcomes.title: The Exiles' Envoy at the Council
outcomes.text: Grukk Oathbreaker sends an orc envoy to the Council of the Kingdoms. The envoy is refused entry to the hall, speaks instead in the market square, and draws a crowd larger than any king's.

outcomes.title: The Spring Raids
outcomes.text: The Horde's longships cross the thawing strait and raid Thornwatch's coast while the council talks. The Warden's envoy reads the list of burned villages aloud every morning until the council can no longer pretend not to hear.

outcomes.title: The Elves' Envoy Speaks
outcomes.text: An envoy of the Elderwood addresses the Council of the Kingdoms for the first time in five hundred years. She tells them what the Weeping Fields cost, and asks if they mean to pay it again; the hall is silent.

outcomes.title: A Plague of Mice in the Granaries
outcomes.text: Mice swarm out of Aldermere's granaries in the spring and spoil the stores meant to feed the council's delegations. The crown buys grain from Veyl at a high price, and the council's hosts are embarrassed.

outcomes.title: The Bargain of the Lake Road
outcomes.text: Westmarch offers to pay its share for Thornwatch's wall if Aldermere abolishes the Lake Road tolls. Aldermere's great houses, who live on the tolls, refuse, and the council's first deal dies.

outcomes.title: The Free Clans' Petition
outcomes.text: The Free Clans of the Lakeshore send a petition to the Council of the Kingdoms asking for their fens back. The council refuses to hear it, and the clans' Reed Raiders burn a lake-town warehouse the same night.

outcomes.title: The Conclave's Demonstration
outcomes.text: The Conclave of the Lake demonstrates its war-magic to the Council of the Kingdoms by burning a ship on the lake from a mile away. The kingdoms are impressed and frightened, and Hollowcrown's priests leave the hall.

outcomes.title: The Wool Price Falls
outcomes.text: The price of Aldermere's wool falls by a third when Westmarch's merchants refuse to buy during the council. The great houses' incomes shrink, and their envoys at the council grow more stubborn.

outcomes.title: The Veyl Ledgers Read Aloud
outcomes.text: Aldermere's envoy reads Veyl's secret ledgers aloud to the Council of the Kingdoms, showing the Republic's loans to the Horde. Veyl's envoy walks out, and the Republic's credit falls across the Great Isle.

outcomes.title: The Spring Muster in the North
outcomes.text: Thornwatch musters every man of the Wardenmark for the spring, leaving the fields to women and children. The wall's garrison doubles, and the Wardenmark's harvest will suffer.

outcomes.title: The Order's Envoy Demands War
