outcomes.text: The Order of the Lantern's envoy demands the Council of the Kingdoms declare war on Morrowgast before the Spire. The council refuses, and the Order's knights leave Aldermere vowing to fight alone.

outcomes.title: The Bridges of the Council
outcomes.text: Aldermere's engineers rebuild the lake city's bridges for the council, and one collapses under a delegation's carriages. Two envoys drown, and the council pauses for their funerals.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Herald at the Council
outcomes.text: A herald of the Blackspire rides openly into Aldermere and asks to address the Council of the Kingdoms. The kings refuse him; he speaks at the gates instead, offering peace to any kingdom that leaves the council.

outcomes.title: The Lambing Snow
outcomes.text: A late blizzard falls on the High Wilds and the hill pastures of Aldermere and Hollowcrown in the middle of lambing. Half the year's lambs die in the drifts, wool and mutton will be scarce by autumn and the shepherds go into debt to the great houses.

outcomes.title: The Envoy's Bride
outcomes.text: Sunvale's chief envoy to the Council of the Kingdoms falls in love with a daughter of Aldermere's great houses and marries her in secret within the week. Her family disowns her, his king recalls him and the two kingdoms' delegations stop speaking to each other.

outcomes.title: The Night Market of the Lake City
outcomes.text: Smugglers, fences and the Free Clans' traders set up a night market in the reed-islands at the edge of Lake Halmoor, selling everything Aldermere taxes. The crown's lake patrols cannot find it, and the lake city's poor shop there every night.

outcomes.title: The Book of Malgrath's Youth
outcomes.text: A scholar of Veyl publishes a life of Malgrath drawn from the Elderwood's oldest records, telling how the apprentice became the Unbreathing. The book is copied across the Great Isle, and for the first time people speak of Malgrath as a man who could be beaten.

outcomes.title: The Ploughmen's Strike
outcomes.text: Ploughmen across Westmarch's lowlands refuse to plough for the merchant princes' estates until their wages are raised. The spring sowing stops, and the princes must pay or face a year without grain.

outcomes.title: The Coven's Lost Daughters
outcomes.text: Three young witches of Morrowgast flee to Sunvale's eastern barons, refusing to work the Blessing. The Coven demands them back; the barons hide them, and the girls begin teaching Sunvale's healers what they know.

outcomes.title: The Stone Bridge of the Strait
outcomes.text: Thornwatch's masons begin building a stone causeway out into the strait from the Wardenmark's shore, to carry siege engines within reach of the Northern Isle. The Horde attacks the works every night, and every stone costs a life.

outcomes.title: A Comet at Noon
outcomes.text: A comet bright enough to be seen at noon crosses the sky over the Great Isle for a week. The Council of the Kingdoms adjourns for prayer, the markets close and the Spire's agents spread word that it is Malgrath's star.

outcomes.title: The Eel Plague
outcomes.text: The eels of Lake Halmoor die in their thousands from a sickness in the spring water. The lake towns' fishermen are ruined, the Free Clans go hungry and both blame the Conclave's experiments on Wyn.

outcomes.title: The Silver Guard Mutinies
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's Silver Guard, ordered to the wall without pay, refuse to march until the Prelacy opens its treasury. The Prelacy gives way, and Hollowcrown's priests lose face before their own soldiers.

outcomes.title: The Bandit Abbey
outcomes.text: Outlaws take over a ruined abbey in the unruled hills between Aldermere and Westmarch and turn it into a fortress. They rob travellers by day and pray in the chapel by night, and both crowns' sheriffs refuse to besiege a holy place.

outcomes.title: The Archmagister's Warning
outcomes.text: The Archmagister of the Conclave tells the Council of the Kingdoms that the Spire's black light is spreading south a mile a month. The council laughs; within a week Thornwatch's sentries report it on the strait's near shore.

outcomes.title: The Herring Feud
outcomes.text: Fishermen of Westmarch and Aldermere's coast fight over the spring herring shoals of the Ostcombe Sea. Boats are rammed and nets cut, and both crowns' envoys at the council find themselves arguing about fish.

outcomes.title: The Thane-King's Embassy
outcomes.text: The Thane-King of Karak Dûm comes to the Council of the Kingdoms in person, the first dwarven king on the Great Isle in a thousand years. He offers dwarven steel to every kingdom that will grant the Deepholds land on the Great Isle's coast.

outcomes.title: The Fens Rise in Spring
outcomes.text: The spring floods raise Aldermere's fens over the new farms the great houses drained from them. The settlers' crops drown, and the Free Clans move back into the land the water returned to them.

outcomes.title: A Plot Against the Council
outcomes.text: A plot to burn the council hall with every envoy inside is discovered in Aldermere: barrels of oil hidden under the floor. The plotters are never found, and every delegation suspects the others.

outcomes.title: The Spring Fever of Solenne
outcomes.text: A fever spreads through Solenne's crowded quarters in the spring rains. The court moves to the countryside, and Sunvale's envoy at the council can get no orders from home.

outcomes.title: The Orc Envoy's Gift
outcomes.text: The Ashen Exiles' envoy to the council presents each king with an axe taken from a Horde war-chief. Some kings refuse the gift; Thornwatch's Warden hangs his over his throne.

outcomes.title: The Wild Horses Run
outcomes.text: The wild horses of the unruled Ashlands stampede into Sunvale's eastern farmland in a spring storm. The barons' men round up hundreds, and Sunvale's cavalry gains its best mounts in a generation.

outcomes.title: The Glass Senate's Apology
outcomes.text: Veyl's Glass Senate formally apologises to the Council of the Kingdoms for its banks' loans to the Horde and fines the banking house responsible. The kingdoms accept the apology, and quietly borrow from Veyl again.

outcomes.title: The Breaking of the Ice-Dams
outcomes.text: The ice-dams on the rivers of the Northern Isle break all at once, and a flood pours down onto the Horde's spring war-camps. Thousands of orcs drown, the spring offensive is delayed by a month and the orc shamans say the rivers have turned against the Spire.

outcomes.title: The Witch-Hunter General
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's Prelacy appoints a Witch-Hunter General with power to try anyone accused of witchcraft anywhere in the realm. Within a month, a hundred are burned, and Hollowcrown's healers flee to Aldermere.

outcomes.title: The Salt Road War
outcomes.text: The salt merchants of Sunvale and the Brotherhood fight over the salt trade of the southern coast. Salt warehouses burn on both sides, and the price of salt doubles from Solenne to Bellhaven.

outcomes.title: The Prince of the Strait
outcomes.text: A young captain of Thornwatch's wall, the son of a fisherman, wins three battles against the Horde in a month and is made a lord by the Warden. The old families of the Wardenmark resent him; the soldiers worship him.

outcomes.title: The Weavers' Riot
outcomes.text: The weavers of Aldermere's lake towns riot when the great houses import cheap cloth from Veyl. They burn the warehouses, the crown arrests the ringleaders and the lake towns' guilds swear revenge.

outcomes.title: The Dwarves Buy a Harbour
outcomes.text: The Deepholds buy a harbour on the Eastern Isle's west coast from Veyl and build a sea-hold there. The dwarves have their own port for the first time, and Veyl's harbour fees from dwarven ships vanish.

outcomes.title: The Spring Sickness of the Wall
outcomes.text: A sickness from bad water spreads through Thornwatch's wall in the spring thaw. A third of the garrison falls sick, and the Horde attacks the weakened towers.

outcomes.title: The Lake Tower's Lights
outcomes.text: Strange lights burn in the Tower of Stars on Wyn every night for a week, and the lake glows green around the isle. The Conclave refuses to explain, and Aldermere's court demands an inspection.

outcomes.title: The Brigand Queen
outcomes.text: A woman called Long Meg gathers the outlaws of Westmarch's inland forests and declares herself their queen. She robs the merchant princes' tax-wagons, and the forest villages call her their protector.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Spy in the Order
outcomes.text: A knight of the Order of the Lantern is unmasked as a spy of the Blackspire, sending word of the Order's plans across the strait. The Order burns him at Lanternhold, and every knight is questioned.

outcomes.title: A Cattle Plague in Hollowcrown
outcomes.text: A sickness kills the cattle of Hollowcrown's mountain valleys. The mountain villages lose their wealth, and the Prelacy's tithe falls by half.

outcomes.title: The Exiles Hold a Moot
outcomes.text: The Ashen Exiles hold a great moot on their islet and vote to send warriors to Thornwatch's wall. Grukk Oathbreaker leads them himself, and orcs stand on the wall beside men for the first time.

outcomes.title: The Wreck of the Glass Galley
outcomes.text: Veyl's newest glass-lens galley runs aground on the reefs of the Salt Isles on its first voyage. The Brotherhood strips it of its lenses, and the pirates now have the Republic's secret weapon.

outcomes.title: The Heartwood Sheds
outcomes.text: The Heartwood sheds all its leaves in a single night in spring, and the elves fear it is dying. The Loremasters say the Spire is drawing on its roots, and the Lady Ithrael calls the Greywatch home.

outcomes.title: The Spring Rains Fail in the South
outcomes.text: The spring rains fail in Sunvale, and the young crops wither. The court fears a famine, and its eastern barons blame the Coven's witchcraft.

outcomes.title: The Merchant Who Bought the Toll
outcomes.text: A Westmarch merchant buys the right to collect the Lake Road tolls from Aldermere's indebted crown. The tolls double, the road's traders curse him and the great houses who once collected them are furious.

outcomes.title: The Goblins Come Up
outcomes.text: Goblins come up out of the earth in Aldermere's northern hills for the first time in living memory, raiding farms for grain and iron at night. The villagers barricade their homes, and nobody knows how many are below.

outcomes.title: The Order's Lost Lantern
outcomes.text: The founder's lantern of the Order of the Lantern goes out during a storm at Lanternhold and cannot be relit. The knights fear their vows are broken, and their Grand Master sends to Hollowcrown's Silver Flame for new fire.

outcomes.title: The Strait Fishing Truce
outcomes.text: Thornwatch's fishermen and orc fishermen of the Northern Isle meet on the strait and agree not to fight on the fishing grounds, whatever their masters do. Both shores eat well for a season.

outcomes.title: The Lady Ithrael's Vision
outcomes.text: The Lady Ithrael sees, in a pool beneath the Heartwood, the Blackspire cracking and a child of the Great Isle standing in the breach. She sends word to every kingdom to protect their children with magic.

outcomes.title: The May Fair Brawl
outcomes.text: Aldermere's great May Fair on the lake shore ends in a brawl between the great houses' retainers and the Lake Guilds' apprentices. Three die, a merchant's warehouse burns and the king must judge between the nobles and the guilds whose taxes he needs.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Bride Chosen
outcomes.text: Word reaches the Great Isle that Malgrath has demanded a bride of royal blood from every orc clan's chief. The clans' daughters flee across the Northern Isle, and three chiefs refuse the Spire openly for the first time.

outcomes.title: The Hornet Year
outcomes.text: Hornets swarm in their thousands across the orchards of Westmarch and Sunvale in the warm spring. Pickers will not go into the trees, the fruit rots and the cider-makers of both realms face a poor year.

outcomes.title: The Grand Ministry's Purge
outcomes.text: Sunvale's Grand Minister arrests a dozen courtiers she accuses of selling the court's secrets to Morrowgast. Three are noblemen of the eastern march, and the barons ride to Solenne to demand their release.

outcomes.title: The Ashlands Brigands Unite
outcomes.text: The brigand bands of the unruled Ashlands meet at a ruined fort and swear to raid together under a single captain. Their combined host of five hundred raids Sunvale's border and Morrowgast's alike, and neither realm can ignore them.

outcomes.title: The Exiles' First Ship
outcomes.text: The Ashen Exiles launch their first sea-going longship, built with timber bought from Thornwatch. It raids a Horde fishing fleet within the week, and the Spire learns its runaways can strike back by sea.

outcomes.title: The Lake City Rats
outcomes.text: Rats swarm out of the lake city's granaries in a warm spring and spoil a third of the stores. Bread prices rise in Aldermere's capital, and the Lake Guilds blame the crown's granary-keepers.

outcomes.title: The Deep Study's Book of Names
outcomes.text: A master of the Conclave's Deep Study is caught copying a book of true names from the Tower's forbidden vault. She flees across the lake with it, and the Conclave hunts her through Aldermere's hills.

outcomes.title: The Thornwatch Ironworks
outcomes.text: Thornwatch opens ironworks on its coast, smelting bog iron for the wall's weapons. The Wardenmark grows less dependent on the south, and its smiths become a power in the Warden's council.

outcomes.title: The Hag-Queen's Son
outcomes.text: A son of one of Morrowgast's Hag-Queens, unBlessed and raised by Sunvalese foster-parents, comes of age and claims his mother's lands in the Coven-Realm. The Coven refuses him, and Sunvale's barons see a claimant they could use.

outcomes.title: The Relic Forgers
outcomes.text: A ring of forgers selling false relics of the Silver Flame's saints is exposed in Hollowcrown's markets. Half the relics in the realm's churches are suspect, and the pilgrims' faith is shaken.

outcomes.title: The Veyl Bank's Gift
outcomes.text: Veyl's oldest banking house forgives a third of Thornwatch's debts in exchange for the right to mint coins for the Wardenmark. Thornwatch's treasury breathes; its coins now bear a Veyl banker's mark.

outcomes.title: The Spring Storm of the Salt Isles
outcomes.text: A spring storm wrecks the Brotherhood's fleet at anchor in Red Harbour. A dozen pirate ships sink, and the Ostcombe Sea is safer for merchants than it has been in years.

outcomes.title: The Order Takes the Pass
outcomes.text: The knights of the Order of the Lantern seize an unruled mountain pass between Lanternhold and the Ashlands and fortify it. The Order now controls the shortest road from the Great Isle's heart to Morrowgast.

outcomes.title: The Lake Road Toll Riots
outcomes.text: Carters on the Lake Road riot at the toll-forts over the doubled tolls. Two toll-keepers are killed, and Aldermere sends knights to guard the forts.

outcomes.title: The Elves' Envoy to Thornwatch
outcomes.text: The Elderwood sends an envoy to Thornwatch's wall, the first elf on the strait since the Weeping Fields. She tells the Warden where the Horde's longships hide, and Thornwatch's raids begin to find them.

outcomes.title: The Fullers' Strike
outcomes.text: The fullers of Aldermere's wool towns, who wash and thicken the cloth, strike for higher pay. The weavers' cloth piles up unfinished, and the great houses' wool trade stops.

outcomes.title: The Thane-King's Heir
outcomes.text: The Thane-King of Karak Dûm names his daughter heir to the stone throne, the first woman ever named. The Hall of Thanes is divided, and the Remembrancers threaten to choose another.

outcomes.title: The Tin of the West
outcomes.text: Westmarch's prospectors find tin in its western hills. Bronze becomes cheaper, Westmarch's foundries cast new bells and the merchant princes grow rich on a metal nobody else has.

outcomes.title: The Coven's Envoy to the Order
outcomes.text: Morrowgast's Hag-Queens send an envoy to Lanternhold under a white banner, offering the Order a truce. The Grand Master sends the envoy back with a single word: never.

outcomes.title: The Plague of Flies
outcomes.text: Flies hatch in their millions from the warm spring marshes of Aldermere's fens and spread a fever through the lake country. Field-workers fall sick in the sowing season, and the great houses' fields go untended.

outcomes.title: The Murder of a Merchant Prince
outcomes.text: A merchant prince of Westmarch is stabbed in his counting-house by a debtor he ruined. His family's fortune passes to a cousin who trades with the Horde, and the guild halls demand an inquiry.

outcomes.title: The Mine Collapse at Brightstrand
outcomes.text: A silver mine near Hollowcrown's coast collapses with two hundred miners inside. Diggers save forty after a week, the Prelacy is blamed for skimping on the props and the miners' families march on the capital.

outcomes.title: The Free Clans' Witch-Queen
outcomes.text: An exiled Hag of Morrowgast takes refuge with the Free Clans and teaches their Reed Raiders curses. Aldermere's soldiers in the fens begin to fall sick, and the great houses call for the fens to be burned.

outcomes.title: The Sunvale Wine Fleet Lost
outcomes.text: Sunvale's spring wine fleet bound for Veyl is taken by pirates in the Ostcombe Sea. The vintners are ruined, the court's revenues fall and Sunvale's ministers borrow again from Veyl.

outcomes.title: A Hag's Book for Sale
outcomes.text: A stolen book of the Coven's blood-rites is offered for sale in Veyl's market. The Conclave, the Order and Morrowgast all bid, and the book disappears before the auction ends.

outcomes.title: The Snow-Blind Spring
outcomes.text: A blinding glare off the late snows of the High Wilds blinds herdsmen and travellers for weeks. The passes are abandoned until the snow melts, and the mountain trade stops.

outcomes.title: A Prince Joins the Free Clans
outcomes.text: A younger son of one of Aldermere's great houses, disinherited for a quarrel with his father, joins the Free Clans in the fens with his household knights. He teaches the clans to fight in armour, and the fens war grows harder.

outcomes.title: The Strait's Spring Fog
outcomes.text: A thick fog lies on the strait for a month, and the Horde's longships slip through it to raid Thornwatch's coast unseen. The Warden's patrols cannot find them, and the coast villages burn.

outcomes.title: The Archmagister's Apprentices
outcomes.text: The Archmagister of the Conclave takes ten apprentices from the poor of Aldermere's lake city, choosing them for talent rather than birth. The great houses are scandalised; the lake city's poor adore the Tower.

outcomes.title: The Glass-Blowers' Exodus
outcomes.text: A hundred master glass-blowers leave Veyl for Westmarch, lured by the merchant princes' gold. Westmarch begins making its own glass, and Veyl's Senate forbids its craftsmen to emigrate.

outcomes.title: An Orc Taught to Read
outcomes.text: A scholar of Aldermere, captured by the Horde and rescued by the Ashen Exiles, stays among them to teach their children letters. The first orc to write a letter sends it to Thornwatch's Warden, asking for a treaty in his own hand.

outcomes.title: The Silver Flame's Feast
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's Prelacy holds the great feast of the Silver Flame, and pilgrims pour into the mountains. The Prelacy's treasury fills, and the mountain towns grow rich for a week.

outcomes.title: The Pirate Who Became a Priest
outcomes.text: A notorious captain of the Brotherhood walks into Hollowcrown's shrine and takes the vows of the Silver Flame, giving away his whole fortune to the poor of Solenne. Red Mara calls him mad; half the pirates' crews start going to prayers.

outcomes.title: The Highway Murders
outcomes.text: A band of robbers on the road between Sunvale and Aldermere murders three merchants and a priest. Both kingdoms' sheriffs ride out, and the robbers vanish into the unruled hills between them.

outcomes.title: The Coven's Healer
outcomes.text: A Hag of Morrowgast crosses into Sunvale and cures a village of a fever its own priests could not. Sunvale's court does not know whether to thank her or burn her.

outcomes.title: The Dwarven Strike
outcomes.text: Dwarven miners of the Deepholds' outer holds strike against the Thane-King's taxes on iron. The Deepholds' steel stops flowing, and the kingdoms' armouries run short.

outcomes.title: The Lake Tower's Visitor
outcomes.text: A tall figure in grey walks out of Lake Halmoor onto the isle of Wyn and is admitted to the Tower of Stars. The Conclave will not say who it was, and the lake towns whisper of the lake's spirit.

outcomes.title: The Ashlands Fever
outcomes.text: A fever spreads through the brigands and refugees of the unruled Ashlands and into Sunvale's border villages. Sunvale closes its eastern roads.

outcomes.title: The Order's Martyr
outcomes.text: A young knight of the Order of the Lantern is captured and burned by Morrowgast's Blessed. The Order makes her a martyr, and recruits flock to Lanternhold.

outcomes.title: The Spring Offensive Begins
outcomes.text: The Horde launches its spring offensive across the strait, landing war-bands on three stretches of Thornwatch's coast at once. The wall holds, but the coast villages burn and the Warden begs the kingdoms for the men they promised.

outcomes.title: The Great Houses' League
outcomes.text: Aldermere's great houses form a league to defend their rights against the crown and the guilds. They raise their own soldiers and refuse the king's new taxes, and Aldermere's council splits.

outcomes.title: The Bridge of Solenne Falls
outcomes.text: The great bridge over Sunvale's river at Solenne collapses in a spring flood, cutting the capital in two. The court cannot cross to its own palace for a month, and Sunvale's government stalls.

outcomes.title: The Exiles Win Land
outcomes.text: In return for the Ashen Exiles' service on the wall, the Warden of Thornwatch grants them an empty coastal region on the Great Isle. Orcs hold land south of the strait for the first time in a thousand years.

outcomes.title: The Pirates Take Kormouth
outcomes.text: Brotherhood pirates seize the Westmarch harbour town of Kormouth and hold it for ransom. Westmarch's fleet is away, and the merchant princes must pay or fight.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Envoy to the Coven
outcomes.text: An envoy of the Blackspire is received at the Coven Hollow. Sunvale's spies report it, and the kingdoms fear an alliance of the two dark powers.

outcomes.title: The Spring Sowing Fails
outcomes.text: A cold, wet spring rots the seed in the fields of Aldermere and Westmarch. The farmers must sow again, and the year's harvest will be late and thin.

outcomes.title: The Lady Ithrael's Envoy Murdered
outcomes.text: An envoy of the Elderwood is murdered on the road to Aldermere. The elves recall every elf from the Great Isle, and the kingdoms lose the elves' counsel on the Spire.

outcomes.title: The Nail-Makers' Monopoly
outcomes.text: The nail-makers of Aldermere's lake city buy up the realm's scrap iron and fix the price of nails. Every roof, ship and barrel on the Great Isle costs more, and the crown's shipwrights cannot afford to build.

outcomes.title: A Coup in Veyl
outcomes.text: The guards of the Glass Senate seize the Senate house and proclaim their captain First Magistrate. Veyl's banks flee to the Great Isle, and the Republic's neutrality is in question.

outcomes.title: The Wolf Packs of the North
outcomes.text: Wolves grown bold on the war's dead roam Thornwatch's coast and attack the wall's sentries at night. The Warden orders them hunted, and the wall's archers waste arrows on wolves.

outcomes.title: The Conclave's War-Mages Ride North
outcomes.text: The Conclave of the Lake sends twenty battle-mages to Thornwatch's wall. Their first fire-storm breaks a Horde war-band at the wall, and the orcs learn to fear the north.

outcomes.title: The Free Clans' Spring Raid
outcomes.text: The Free Clans' Reed Raiders burn Aldermere's new farms in the drained fens. The great houses who own them demand the clans be destroyed, and the king hesitates.

outcomes.title: The Silver Flame's Heretic
outcomes.text: A priest of the Silver Flame in Hollowcrown preaches that the Flame needs no prelates. Thousands follow him, and the Prelacy declares him a heretic.

outcomes.title: The Spring Floods of the Lake
outcomes.text: The spring floods raise Lake Halmoor over its banks, and the lake towns are flooded. Aldermere's crown must feed the homeless, and its treasury empties.

outcomes.title: The Thane-King's Embassy to the Wall
outcomes.text: The Thane-King of Karak Dûm sends a thousand dwarven warriors to Thornwatch's wall. Dwarves stand on the wall for the first time, and the Horde's assaults on their towers fail.

outcomes.title: The Brigands of Westmarch's Forest
outcomes.text: Outlaws in Westmarch's inland forests rob the merchant princes' convoys. The princes hire sellswords to hunt them, and the forest villages hide the outlaws.

outcomes.title: The Coven's Spring Rite
outcomes.text: Morrowgast's Hag-Queens work a great spring rite, and the Blessing passes into a thousand captives. The Coven's army grows, and Sunvale's eastern barons send for help.

outcomes.title: The Lake City's Sewers
outcomes.text: Aldermere's king orders the lake city's open drains covered and built into stone sewers after a summer of fevers. The work takes a year and a fortune, and the city's fevers fall by half.

outcomes.title: The Order Marches on Morrowgast
outcomes.text: The knights of the Order of the Lantern march into Morrowgast's western borderlands and besiege a Coven town. The crusade has begun, without the kingdoms' leave.

outcomes.title: The Dancing Plague
outcomes.text: In a market town of Aldermere's south, the townsfolk begin to dance in the square and cannot stop. Within a week hundreds are dancing day and night, some until they die; the Conclave suspects a curse, the Prelacy a punishment and the crown closes the town's gates.

outcomes.title: The Menagerie Escapes
outcomes.text: The royal menagerie of Solenne, the pride of Sunvale's court, breaks open in a storm. Lions, a bear and a great Blessed ape from the Ashlands roam the capital's streets, and the king's guards hunt them for a week while the court hides in the palace.

outcomes.title: The Census Riot
outcomes.text: Aldermere's Lord Chancellor orders every household in the realm counted for a new hearth-tax. Villages refuse the counters, a census-taker is drowned in a millpond and the count is abandoned in three counties.

outcomes.title: The Forged Will
outcomes.text: The will of a great lord of Westmarch, leaving his fleet to the merchant princes' council, is found to be forged by his steward. The real heir, a guild apprentice, claims the fleet, and Westmarch's courts must choose between the law and the princes.

outcomes.title: The Whirlpool of the Ostcombe
outcomes.text: A great whirlpool opens in the Ostcombe Sea between the Salt Isles and Sunvale's coast. Ships that sail near it vanish, the shipping lanes must swing wide around it and the Brotherhood loses its shortest route to Sunvale's coast.

outcomes.title: The White Stag Killed
outcomes.text: A hunting party of Hollowcrown's mountain lords kills a white stag, sacred to the Silver Flame, in the high forests. The Prelacy declares the lords cursed, the lords say the priests are using it against them and the realm's quarrel between Kirk and lords grows bitter.

outcomes.title: The Hot Springs of the High Wilds
outcomes.text: Shepherds find hot springs in an unruled valley of the High Wilds whose waters cure aching joints and old wounds. Lords of Aldermere and Hollowcrown race to build bath-houses there, and the valley's goblins resent the crowds.

outcomes.title: The Mirror of Veyl
outcomes.text: A glassmaker of Veyl makes a mirror that shows the room as it will be a day from now. The Glass Senate buys it for a fortune and locks it away, and every court of the world sends spies to steal a look.

outcomes.title: The Debtors' Prison Breaks
outcomes.text: The debtors' prison of Bellhaven, crammed with the war's ruined merchants and sailors, breaks out in a night riot. Hundreds of debtors flee to the Brotherhood's ships, and the merchant princes lose their hostages.

outcomes.title: The Horse Race of Sunvale
outcomes.text: Sunvale's great midsummer horse race is won by a Blessed horse from the Ashlands, ridden by an orphan of the eastern march. The court disqualifies the horse, the crowd riots and the orphan becomes the hero of the eastern barons.

outcomes.title: The Postal Riders
outcomes.text: Westmarch's merchant princes set up relays of riders carrying letters across the Great Isle in days instead of weeks. News travels faster than ever, merchants grow richer and every crown's spies learn to open the riders' bags.

outcomes.title: The Bell That Rings Alone
outcomes.text: The great bell of Thornwatch Keep rings by itself at midnight for three nights running. The garrison takes it as a warning, the Warden doubles the watch and on the fourth night the Horde attacks a tower and finds it ready.

outcomes.title: The Bridge-Toll War
outcomes.text: The lords on either side of a great river bridge between Aldermere and Westmarch each raise their toll until no carter will cross. The bridge stands empty, trade goes the long way round and the two crowns must buy the bridge from their own lords.

outcomes.title: A Child Raised by Wolves
outcomes.text: Hunters in the unruled forests north of Aldermere find a girl of ten living with a wolf pack. She cannot speak, but the wolves follow her, and the Conclave and the Elderwood both ask to take her.

outcomes.title: The Fairy Ring
outcomes.text: A ring of mushrooms appears overnight in the lake city's palace gardens, and a page who steps into it vanishes. He returns a month later, swearing only an hour has passed, and the court is afraid to walk on its own lawns.

outcomes.title: The Canal of the Lake Country
outcomes.text: Aldermere's engineers finish a canal linking Lake Halmoor to the sea, so ships can sail from the lake city straight to the Ostcombe Sea. Aldermere no longer needs Westmarch's harbours, and the merchant princes lose their hold on Aldermere's trade.

outcomes.title: The Masked Festival
outcomes.text: Sunvale's court holds a festival of masks in Solenne, and the whole city goes masked for a week. Under cover of the masks, a minister is murdered, a princess elopes and three Coven spies walk the palace halls unseen.

outcomes.title: The Royal Mint Robbed
outcomes.text: Thieves tunnel into Aldermere's royal mint and take a year's coinage before it is struck. The crown cannot pay its soldiers on the wall, and the lake city's money-changers suddenly have more silver than the king.

outcomes.title: The Iceberg in the Strait
outcomes.text: A great iceberg drifts south out of the Northern Isle's frozen sea and grounds in the strait, blocking it for a month. The Horde cannot cross, Thornwatch cannot raid and both sides stare at a mountain of ice.

outcomes.title: The Duel of Mages
outcomes.text: Two masters of the Conclave fight a duel of spells in the lake city's market square over a quarrel nobody will explain. The square is wrecked, one master dies and Aldermere's council demands the Tower be brought under the crown's law.

outcomes.title: The Bird Migration
outcomes.text: Flocks of birds so vast they darken the sky for days fly south over the Great Isle from the Northern Isle. Farmers lose their seed to them, the priests read omens in them and the Conclave says they are fleeing something in the north.

outcomes.title: The Calendar Quarrel
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's Prelacy declares that the year has been miscounted since the Founding and moves every feast day by a week. Aldermere refuses to follow, the two kingdoms keep different calendars and their merchants' contracts fall into chaos.

outcomes.title: The Salt Mine of the Ashlands
outcomes.text: Prospectors find a mountain of rock salt in the unruled Ashlands. Sunvale and Morrowgast both claim it, and their soldiers fight over a mine that could free the south from the Brotherhood's salt prices.

outcomes.title: The Living Statue
outcomes.text: A sculptor of Westmarch carves a statue of a dead princess so lifelike that it begins to walk at night. The merchant princes buy it, lock it away and the sculptor flees to Veyl before anyone can ask how he did it.

outcomes.title: The Lighthouse Keeper's Warning
outcomes.text: The keeper of the lighthouse on Westmarch's western cape sends word that he has seen a fleet with black sails gathering beyond the horizon. The merchant princes send scouts, and find nothing; the keeper vanishes the following night.

outcomes.title: The Reforged Sword
outcomes.text: Smiths of the Deepholds reforge the broken sword of Aldric the Founder from star-iron, and send it to Aldermere's king as a gift. The sword sings when drawn, and the great houses fear what the king will do with it.

outcomes.title: The Tide That Did Not Come
outcomes.text: For a whole week, the tide does not rise on the coasts of the Great Isle. Harbours dry out, ships lie on their sides in the mud and the fishing towns wait in terror until the sea comes back all at once.

outcomes.title: The Prisoner Exchange Gone Wrong
outcomes.text: A prisoner exchange between Thornwatch and the Horde on the strait's shore turns into a massacre when someone looses an arrow. Both sides blame the other, and no exchange will be tried again for a year.

outcomes.title: The Spice Garden
outcomes.text: A gardener of Sunvale's Riviera grows a pepper vine from seeds brought by a silk-sailed ship from beyond the eastern sea. Sunvale begins growing its own spices, and Veyl's spice trade loses its richest customer.

outcomes.title: The Cook Who Poisoned a Court
outcomes.text: The royal cook of Hollowcrown is caught putting poison in the Prelacy's bread. Under questioning he names the mountain lords, then the Conclave, then the Spire, and dies in his cell before anyone knows the truth.

outcomes.title: The Falcon Messengers
outcomes.text: Thornwatch trains falcons to carry messages from the wall's towers to the keep. Warnings of raids arrive in minutes, and the Horde's surprise attacks begin to fail.

outcomes.title: The Abandoned Wedding
outcomes.text: The heir of one of Aldermere's great houses abandons his bride at the altar to run off with a Free Clans woman. The bride's family declares a blood feud, and the lake country's great houses take sides.

outcomes.title: The Sinkhole of the Lake Country
outcomes.text: The ground opens beneath a great lord's manor in Aldermere's south and swallows it whole, with its lord asleep inside. Below lies an Elder Age vault, and treasure-hunters, scholars and the crown's soldiers race to it.

outcomes.title: The Ban on Duels
outcomes.text: Aldermere's king forbids duelling on pain of death after three young lords kill each other in a month. The great houses call it an attack on their honour, and the first lord to defy the ban is hanged at the lake city's gate.

outcomes.title: The Silver Herring
outcomes.text: Shoals of herring with scales of real silver are netted off Westmarch's coast. The fishermen grow rich, the merchant princes claim the catch and the Conclave says the fish have swum through something they should not have.

outcomes.title: The Talking Statues of Hollowcrown
outcomes.text: The statues of the Silver Flame's saints in Hollowcrown's shrine begin to speak at night, each repeating a single word. The Prelacy writes the words down and finds they make a sentence: the Flame is not alone.

outcomes.title: The Merchant Princes' Fair Rigged
outcomes.text: Westmarch's great fair is found to have been rigged by the merchant princes, who fixed the prices of every stall. The guild halls riot, the princes pay a fine and the guilds win a seat on the fair's council.

outcomes.title: A Princess Elopes with a Pirate
outcomes.text: A princess of Sunvale's royal house elopes with a Brotherhood captain who came to the court disguised as a merchant. Sunvale's king demands her return; Red Mara demands a dowry.

outcomes.title: The Moonless Month
outcomes.text: The moon does not rise for a whole month over the Great Isle. Thieves flourish in the dark, the tides behave strangely and every prophet in the world proclaims the end.

outcomes.title: The Exiles' Treaty with the Sea-Folk
outcomes.text: The Ashen Exiles make a treaty with the sea-folk of the northern waters, trading iron for fish and guides through the reefs. The Exiles' longships can now sail where the Horde's cannot.

outcomes.title: The Wine Tax Revolt
outcomes.text: Sunvale's vintners refuse the court's new tax on wine and dump their barrels into the river rather than pay it. The river runs red for a day, the court backs down and the vintners become heroes of the south.

outcomes.title: The Ghost of Saelind
outcomes.text: The ghost of the elf-queen who wove the first Binding appears in the Heartwood and speaks to the Lady Ithrael. The elves will not say what she said, but the Greywatch rides out the next morning.

outcomes.title: The Pottery Trade
outcomes.text: Potters of Aldermere's south discover a white clay that makes porcelain as fine as anything from beyond the eastern sea. The great houses grow rich on it, and Veyl's merchants lose their porcelain trade.

outcomes.title: The Prince Who Lost a Kingdom at Dice
outcomes.text: A prince of Westmarch gambles away his inheritance, three harbour towns, to a Veyl banker in a single night. The banker claims the towns, the merchant princes' council refuses and Westmarch faces a war over a game of dice.

outcomes.title: The Plague of Owls
outcomes.text: Owls gather in their hundreds on the roofs of Aldermere's lake city and hoot through the night. The people cannot sleep, the priests call it an omen of death and the Conclave says the owls are watching something.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Lost Map
outcomes.text: A map of the Northern Isle's secret paths, drawn by an escaped slave of the Spire, is sold in Thornwatch's market for a pittance. The Warden buys it, and Thornwatch's raiders begin to find the Horde's hidden camps.

outcomes.title: The Ropemakers' Monopoly
outcomes.text: The ropemakers of Westmarch buy up the Great Isle's hemp and double the price of rope. Every ship costs more to rig, and the kingdoms' navies are slow to put to sea.

outcomes.title: The Coven's Bridge
outcomes.text: Morrowgast's Hag-Queens raise a bridge of red stone across a chasm in the Ashlands in a single night of blood-magic. The bridge leads straight toward Sunvale, and the eastern barons fortify its far end.

outcomes.title: The Great Drought
outcomes.text: The late summer rains fail across the Great Isle. Rivers shrink to streams, Lake Halmoor falls a man's height and the harvest withers in Aldermere, Sunvale and Westmarch alike; every granary-holder in the world suddenly holds power.

outcomes.title: The Thornbrook Reavers
outcomes.text: Two hundred hill-men of the unruled peaks between Hollowcrown and Aldermere band together under a one-eyed woman called Mother Thorn. Calling themselves the Thornbrook Reavers, they begin raiding the harvest carts on both kingdoms' mountain roads.

outcomes.title: The Sunken City Rises
outcomes.text: A drought-shrunk lake in Aldermere's south reveals the roofs of a drowned Elder Age town. Scholars, looters and the Conclave's mages descend on it, and something in its sealed temple is carried off before the crown's soldiers arrive.

outcomes.title: The Ashlands Free Company
outcomes.text: Deserters from Sunvale's eastern levies and runaways from Morrowgast's Blessed forge a free company in the unruled Ashlands, the Ash Wardens. They sell protection to the border villages of both realms and kill the tax-gatherers of each.

outcomes.title: Assassination at the Glass Senate
outcomes.text: Veyl's First Magistrate is stabbed on the steps of the Glass Senate by a lamp-blower whose family was ruined by the banks. The Senate elects a successor in haste, the poor quarters riot, and Veyl's neutrality is shaken.

outcomes.title: The Great Harvest of the East
outcomes.text: While the Great Isle burns in drought, the Eastern Isle brings in the richest harvest in memory. Veyl's grain merchants sell it west at three times the price, and the Republic grows richer than ever on the kingdoms' hunger.

outcomes.title: The Orc Prophet
outcomes.text: An old orc shaman in the Northern Isle's southern wilds begins preaching that the old spirits, not the Spire, are the orcs' true masters. Whole clans slip away from the Horde's camps to follow him into the wild.

outcomes.title: Wildfire in the Elderwood
outcomes.text: The drought dries the Elderwood's outer groves and a wildfire burns for two weeks along its western border. The elves lose a tenth of their forest and blame careless dwarven charcoal-burners; the Pact of Root and Stone is strained.

outcomes.title: The Deepholds' Great Bell
outcomes.text: Dwarven smiths of Karak Dûm cast the Great Bell, a bell of star-iron said to wake the dead of a hold so they can defend it. Its first ringing is heard across the Eastern Isle, and the Remembrancers say Karak Varn's dead answered.

outcomes.title: The Brotherhood's Black Fleet
outcomes.text: Red Mara launches three new war-galleys built with stolen Westmarch timber. The Brotherhood's fleet is now the strongest on the Ostcombe Sea, and every merchant who sails it pays her toll or burns.

outcomes.title: The Silver Flame Turns Red
outcomes.text: For one night the Silver Flame of Hollowcrown burns red. The priests call it a warning of the god's anger, the Prelacy orders a month of penance, and pilgrims flee the realm in terror.

outcomes.title: Wild Horses of the Ashlands
outcomes.text: Great herds of wild horses are found grazing in the unruled Ashlands, the descendants of Elder Age war-steeds. Sunvale's barons, Morrowgast's Blessed and the Ashlands brigands race to round them up for cavalry.

outcomes.title: The Exiles Find an Isle
outcomes.text: The Ashen Exiles' scouts find an unruled island beyond the north-western islet, warmer and greener than their own. Half the Exiles' families set sail for it, and the Horde's fleet follows.

outcomes.title: Thornwatch Hangs a Lord
outcomes.text: The Warden of Thornwatch hangs a lord of the Wardenmark caught selling grain to the Horde across the strait. The lord's kin flee to Aldermere and accuse the Warden of tyranny before the Council of the Kingdoms.

outcomes.title: A Comet and a Birth
outcomes.text: A comet crosses the sky the night a child is born in Aldermere's royal palace with a silver birthmark shaped like a flame. Hollowcrown's priests claim the child for the Silver Flame, and Aldermere's court refuses.

outcomes.title: The Lake Road Fair
outcomes.text: Aldermere and Westmarch hold a great fair at the border to settle the toll dispute. Merchants of every realm attend, a three-year toll truce is signed, and trade on the Lake Road doubles before winter.

outcomes.title: A Rogue Battle-Mage
outcomes.text: A battle-mage of the Conclave, maddened by what he saw at the Blackspire, burns a village of Aldermere and flees into the High Wilds. The Conclave sends hunters after him, and Aldermere's court blames the Tower.

outcomes.title: The Blessed Breed Beasts
outcomes.text: Morrowgast's Hag-Queens work the Blessing on war-hounds and boars. Monstrous beasts the size of horses are loosed into the Ashlands, killing anyone they find, and Sunvale's border farmers flee.

outcomes.title: A Dwarven Prince Elopes
outcomes.text: A prince of the Deepholds elopes with a daughter of Veyl's richest banking house. The Thane-King demands her return, Veyl demands the prince's, and the two oldest partners in the east fall out.

outcomes.title: Locusts in Westmarch
outcomes.text: A plague of locusts descends on Westmarch's lowlands and strips the fields bare in a week. The merchant princes, who sold their surplus abroad, have nothing left to feed their own people.

outcomes.title: The Fall of a Royal House
outcomes.text: Aldermere's king falls dead at a council meeting, felled by poison in his cup. The great houses accuse each other, the crown passes to a distant cousin few respect, and the oldest kingdom of the Great Isle enters a winter of factions.

outcomes.title: The Iron Wolves
outcomes.text: Runaway slaves of the Horde's iron mines, humans and orcs together, escape into the unruled mountains of the Northern Isle and form a raiding band called the Iron Wolves. They free other slaves and burn the Spire's forges.

outcomes.title: A Path Through the Deep
outcomes.text: Dwarven miners break into a natural cavern-road running under the sea toward the Great Isle. The Deepholds keep it secret, but word reaches the Conclave, and every kingdom wants to know where it comes up.

outcomes.title: Plague in Solenne
outcomes.text: A sweating sickness breaks out in Sunvale's capital during the harvest festival. The court flees to the country, the city's markets close and Sunvale's government falls silent for a month.

outcomes.title: The Spire Opens Its Gates
outcomes.text: For the first time in living memory the Blackspire's gates stand open, and its Voices ride out to every orc clan with a summons. Every chief who does not come to the Spire by the new moon is to be hunted.

outcomes.title: The Ash Wardens Take a Town
outcomes.text: The free company called the Ash Wardens storms a Sunvale border town in the Ashlands and holds it as their own. They proclaim it the Free Town of the Ashlands and invite every runaway to settle there.

outcomes.title: The Order's Lost Fortress
outcomes.text: Scouts of the Order of the Lantern find an Elder Age fortress in the unruled mountains near Lanternhold, its gates intact. The Order occupies it and doubles its lands overnight; Hollowcrown's lords claim the same mountains.

outcomes.title: The Grain Fleet Sinks
outcomes.text: Sunvale's grain fleet, bound for starving Aldermere, sinks in an early autumn storm in the Ostcombe Sea. Aldermere's hunger deepens and its council accuses the Brotherhood of wrecking it.

outcomes.title: The Bridge of Veyl
outcomes.text: Veyl's engineers finish a great bridge of glass and stone across the Republic's harbour mouth, the wonder of the age. Merchants of every realm come to see it, and Veyl's harbour fees double.

outcomes.title: The Thornwatch Militia Revolts
outcomes.text: The levies of the Wardenmark, starved and unpaid, march on Thornwatch Keep demanding grain. The Warden must open the keep's stores, leaving the wall's garrison short for the winter.

outcomes.title: An Elf Ambassador at Aldermere
outcomes.text: The Elderwood sends an ambassador to live at Aldermere's court for the first time in five hundred years. She brings warnings, and a gift of healing herbs that ends a plague in the lake city.

outcomes.title: The Great Hunt
outcomes.text: A monstrous boar, twice the height of a man, ravages the farmland of Hollowcrown's southern valleys. The lords of three realms ride out to hunt it, and the lord who kills it wins renown and a seat at the Prelacy's table.

outcomes.title: Grukk's Treaty
outcomes.text: The chief of the Ashen Exiles signs a treaty with Thornwatch: the Exiles will guard Thornwatch's northern coast against the Horde, and in return receive two empty coastal regions as their own. Orcs hold land on the Great Isle legally for the first time.

outcomes.title: The Brotherhood Seizes a Sunvale Port
outcomes.text: The Brotherhood takes the Sunvale harbour town of Rosport in a dawn raid and holds it for ransom. Sunvale's ministers, already in debt to Red Mara, must pay again or fight.

outcomes.title: Hollowcrown's Saints Walk
outcomes.text: Pilgrims report the dead saints of Hollowcrown walking in their shrines at night, silver flames in their eyes. The Prelacy calls it a miracle; the Conclave quietly suspects the Spire's necromancy.

outcomes.title: The Lake Pirates
outcomes.text: Outlaws seize a fleet of fishing boats on Lake Halmoor and begin raiding the lake towns of Aldermere. The Lake Pirates make the crown's own lake unsafe, and the Conclave refuses to help.

outcomes.title: A Sunvale Prince Marries a Hag's Daughter
outcomes.text: A prince of Sunvale's royal house runs off with a daughter of Morrowgast's Hag-Queens. The court disowns him; the Coven proclaims him the rightful heir of Sunvale.

outcomes.title: The Witch-Finders of Westmarch
outcomes.text: A new order of witch-finders, the Hounds of the Hearth, rises in Westmarch's towns and burns anyone accused of magic. The Conclave sends envoys, and two are burned; the Tower declares the Hounds its enemies.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Iron Sold in the South
outcomes.text: A Horde iron ship slips into Bellhaven under a false flag and sells its cargo before it is discovered. Westmarch's merchant princes refuse to return the money, and Thornwatch demands Westmarch be expelled from the Concord.

outcomes.title: An Earthquake Swallows a Pass
outcomes.text: An earthquake brings down the main pass between Hollowcrown and Thornwatch. Hollowcrown's soldiers on the wall are cut off from home, and supplies must go the long way by sea.

outcomes.title: The Battle of the Harvest Moon
outcomes.text: The Horde launches a surprise assault on Thornwatch's wall at the harvest moon, when the levies have gone home to their fields. The wall holds by a hair, but the Wardenmark's harvest burns, and Thornwatch faces a hungry winter.

outcomes.title: The Red Sail Pirates
outcomes.text: A crew of Sunvalese sailors, ruined by the court's debts, steal a royal galley and turn pirate under a red sail. The Red Sail band raids Sunvale's own coast first, then Westmarch's convoys, and grows by the week.

outcomes.title: A Hag-Queen Poisoned
outcomes.text: One of Morrowgast's seven Hag-Queens dies of poison at a Coven feast. The others accuse each other, the Blessed host waits for orders that do not come, and Sunvale's border breathes for a month.

outcomes.title: The Gold of the High Wilds
outcomes.text: Prospectors strike gold in the unruled valleys of the High Wilds. Within a month, ten thousand fortune-seekers have built a lawless boom-town there, and Aldermere and Hollowcrown both send soldiers to claim it.

outcomes.title: The Conclave's Prisoner Escapes
outcomes.text: A sorcerer of the Spire, held prisoner in the Tower of Stars since the Black Dawn, escapes across Lake Halmoor in a storm. He knows the Conclave's wards, and the Tower trembles.

outcomes.title: Sunvale's Debt Defaults
outcomes.text: Sunvale's treasury cannot pay Veyl's banks. Veyl seizes Sunvale's ships in its harbours, the court's credit dies, and the kingdom's soldiers go unpaid as the Coven's raids grow bolder.

outcomes.title: The Orc Prophet's Rising
outcomes.text: An orc shaman preaching the old spirits leads three clans in rising against the Spire's overseers on the Northern Isle's southern coast. The Horde must turn back from the strait to crush its own people.

outcomes.title: A Bandit Lord in the Eastern Wilds
outcomes.text: A human adventurer called Joren the Bold gathers a company of sellswords in the unruled wilds of the Eastern Isle and carves out a lordship between Veyl and the Deepholds. He asks both for recognition.

outcomes.title: The Heartwood Blooms
outcomes.text: The Heartwood flowers for the first time in a thousand years. The elves rejoice, and three elf children are born in a season; the Elderwood stops fading, and its rangers begin to ride beyond its borders again.

outcomes.title: A Fire in Westmarch's Docks
outcomes.text: Fire breaks out in Bellhaven's harbour during the harvest shipping. Half the merchant fleet burns at anchor, the grain warehouses go with it, and Westmarch's merchant princes are ruined overnight.

outcomes.title: The Lantern's Holy Relic
outcomes.text: Knights of the Order of the Lantern find the lantern of their founder, lost since the year 409, in an abandoned shrine. They say it burns without oil, and young men from every kingdom flock to Lanternhold to take the vows.

outcomes.title: Thornwatch Raids Across the Strait
outcomes.text: The Warden of Thornwatch sends his best captains across the strait in fishing boats to burn the Horde's harvest on the Northern Isle. The raid succeeds; the Horde faces a starving winter and swears revenge.

outcomes.title: Aldermere Claims the High Wilds
outcomes.text: Aldermere's council annexes the unruled valleys of the High Wilds south of Hollowcrown, building forts on every pass. Hollowcrown protests that the mountains are its own; the Concord's council is asked to decide.

outcomes.title: The Coven's Ambassadors
outcomes.text: Morrowgast sends ambassadors to Aldermere and Westmarch offering peace and trade, and promising to stop the raids on Sunvale. The Order calls it a trick; the kings are tempted.

outcomes.title: The Sea Dragon
outcomes.text: A sea dragon surfaces in the strait between the Northern Isle and Thornwatch and sinks a fleet of Horde longships. The orcs say the sea itself has turned against them; Thornwatch calls it the blessing of the old gods.

outcomes.title: A Great Fair at Solenne
outcomes.text: Sunvale's court holds a great harvest festival in Solenne to show it is not bankrupt. It is magnificent, nobody is paid, and the vintners' guild marches on the palace when the bills arrive.

outcomes.title: The Dwarves Strike Mithril
outcomes.text: Miners of Karak Dûm strike a vein of the silver-steel the dwarves call star-iron. Every kingdom of the world wants it, and the Deepholds' Thane-King sets a price no one can pay without land.

outcomes.title: The Free Clans Sack a Lake Town
outcomes.text: The Reed Raiders of the Free Clans storm an Aldermere lake town by night and carry off its harvest. Aldermere's great houses demand the clans be destroyed, and knights ride into the fens.

outcomes.title: A Holy War Proclaimed
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's First Prelate proclaims a holy war against Morrowgast and calls every believer of the Silver Flame to arms. Aldermere and Sunvale must decide whether to join the crusade or watch it from the side.

outcomes.title: A Lord Sells His Land to Veyl
outcomes.text: An Aldermere lord, ruined by the drought, sells his estates on the Great Isle's coast to a Veyl banking house. The Republic now owns a harbour on the Great Isle, and Aldermere's council debates whether to allow it.

outcomes.title: The Lord of the Lake Road
outcomes.text: An Aldermere knight, Sir Gawen Marlford, seizes the toll-forts on the Lake Road and declares himself its lord, charging both kingdoms. Aldermere and Westmarch must cooperate to remove him, or pay.

outcomes.title: A New Sea Route
outcomes.text: Westmarch sailors find a channel through the reefs west of the Thornshaw Sea, opening a route to the unknown waters beyond the known world. The merchant princes fit out an expedition to see what lies there.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Bride
outcomes.text: A princess of Sunvale's royal house disappears from Solenne and is seen weeks later on the Northern Isle, riding with the Spire's Voices. The court says she was taken; others say she went willingly.

outcomes.title: The Ashlands War
outcomes.text: Sunvale's eastern barons and Morrowgast's Blessed fight a pitched battle in the unruled Ashlands over the wild horse herds. Thousands die, and neither side wins the Ashlands.

outcomes.title: A Rebel Orc Kingdom
outcomes.text: The orc clans of the Northern Isle's western coast proclaim a free kingdom under their own chief, refusing the Spire's levies. The Horde's host, gathered against Thornwatch, must turn back to crush them.

outcomes.title: Famine Marches in Aldermere
outcomes.text: Starving peasants march on Aldermere's lake city to demand bread from the king's granaries. The crown opens its stores, the granaries empty in a month and Aldermere's army goes hungry.

outcomes.title: The Elderwood Closes Its Borders
outcomes.text: After elven rangers are killed by hunters from Veyl, the Elderwood closes its borders to every human. Veyl loses its forest trade, and the Glass Senate's merchants call for war on the elves.

outcomes.title: An Inventor's Engine
outcomes.text: A Veyl glass-maker builds an engine of lenses that focuses sunlight into fire, setting a ship ablaze at a mile. The Glass Senate keeps it secret, and every kingdom's spies try to steal it.

outcomes.title: The Order Splits
outcomes.text: The Order of the Lantern splits over whether to march on Morrowgast alone. The zealots under a young knight-captain take half the knights and march into the Ashlands; the rest stay at Lanternhold.

outcomes.title: Smugglers Take Over Kormouth
outcomes.text: Smugglers and fences take over the Westmarch port of Kormouth, paying the town's lord to look away. Kormouth becomes the market for every stolen cargo on the western sea.

outcomes.title: A Hag-Queen Defects to the Order
outcomes.text: A Hag-Queen of Morrowgast surrenders to the Order of the Lantern with the secret of the Blessing's rites. The Order's Grand Master must decide whether to burn her or use her.

outcomes.title: Floods After the Drought
outcomes.text: The autumn rains return all at once, flooding the dried-out rivers of Aldermere and Sunvale. Fields that survived the drought drown, bridges wash away and the harvest is lost a second time.

outcomes.title: The Dwarven Pact Broken
outcomes.text: The Deepholds cut down a stretch of the Elderwood's eastern forest for charcoal. The elves call it a breach of the Pact of Root and Stone and expel every dwarf from their lands.

outcomes.title: A Merchant Prince's Private Army
outcomes.text: Westmarch's richest merchant prince hires two thousand sellswords and takes over the council by force, ruling Westmarch as First Prince for life. The guild halls call it tyranny and close in protest.

outcomes.title: A Child-King in Hollowcrown
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's queen dies in childbirth, leaving an infant heir. The First Prelate rules as regent, and the mountain lords swear they will not be ruled by priests.

outcomes.title: The Northern Isle Freezes Early
outcomes.text: Winter comes a month early to the Northern Isle. The Horde's camps freeze, the harvest Thornwatch did not burn rots in the fields and the Spire's army starves.

outcomes.title: The Lake Road Monster
outcomes.text: A great serpent comes out of Lake Halmoor onto the Lake Road and devours a merchant caravan. Traffic between Aldermere and Westmarch stops, and the Conclave is begged to kill it.

outcomes.title: A Free Port in the Salt Isles
outcomes.text: Red Mara declares Red Harbour a free port open to every ship, pirate or merchant, that pays her toll. Merchants of Veyl and Sunvale begin to trade there openly, and Westmarch's harbours lose business.

outcomes.title: The Conclave Splits
outcomes.text: The Conclave of the Lake splits between the battle-mages, who want to fight the Spire, and the scholars, who want to study it. The battle-mages leave the Tower of Stars for Thornwatch, taking a third of the Conclave's power with them.

outcomes.title: An Assassin's Guild
outcomes.text: A guild of assassins, the Quiet Knives, opens for business in the Ashlands, killing for any realm that pays. Within a month two barons and a Coven captain are dead, and every court looks over its shoulder.

outcomes.title: The Siege of Lanternhold
outcomes.text: Morrowgast's Blessed march into the mountains and besiege the Order of the Lantern's fortress, Lanternhold. The knights hold their walls, but they cannot hold forever without help from the kingdoms.

outcomes.title: A King Struck Mad
outcomes.text: Sunvale's king falls into a madness after a fever, raving about the Spire in his sleep. His ministers rule in his name, and the barons demand a regency council of their own.

outcomes.title: The Gold Rush War
outcomes.text: Soldiers of Aldermere and Hollowcrown clash in the unruled gold valleys of the High Wilds. Dozens die, the gold-camps burn and the two kingdoms come to the edge of war.

outcomes.title: The Exiles' Victory at Sea
outcomes.text: The Ashen Exiles' longships ambush a Horde fleet in the fog off the north-western islet and burn twenty ships. The orcs of the Northern Isle hear of it, and more clans slip away to join the Exiles.

outcomes.title: A New Sickness in the Deep
outcomes.text: Dwarves of the Deepholds who work the new mines fall sick with a creeping grey rot. The holds close their gates to each other, and the Thane-King orders the new mines sealed.

outcomes.title: The Banking Crash of Veyl
outcomes.text: Three of Veyl's banking houses fail in a week when Sunvale and Aldermere default on their loans together. The glass ducat loses half its value, and merchants across the world lose their savings.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Ice Wall
outcomes.text: The Spire raises a wall of black ice along the Northern Isle's southern coast. No ship can land there, and Thornwatch's raids across the strait end.

outcomes.title: The Brigands of the Lake Road
outcomes.text: With the harvest failed, whole villages of Aldermere's starving peasants take to the roads as brigands. The Lake Road becomes a gauntlet, and merchants hire small armies to cross it.

outcomes.title: Hollowcrown Sends Priests North
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's Prelacy sends five hundred priests of the Silver Flame to Thornwatch's wall. Their prayers burn the risen dead the Horde sends against it, and the wall stands firmer than ever.

outcomes.title: A Corsair Queen in the West
outcomes.text: A Westmarch noblewoman, ruined by debt, buys a ship and turns corsair, raiding only Veyl's banking ships. She calls herself the Debt-Taker and the poor of every port cheer her name.

outcomes.title: The Elderwood's Children
outcomes.text: The first elf children born in fifty years come of age in the Elderwood. Their coming-of-age rite reveals that all of them can hear the Heartwood's song, and the Loremasters say a new age of the elves has begun.

outcomes.title: Westmarch Expels the Mages
outcomes.text: Westmarch's council, frightened by rogue magic, expels every mage who will not swear to the merchant princes. Dozens flee to the Conclave, and Westmarch loses its battle-mages on the eve of war.

outcomes.title: The Ashlands Kingdom Recognised
outcomes.text: Veyl's Glass Senate recognises the Ashlands' self-proclaimed lord as a sovereign prince and opens trade with him. Sunvale and Morrowgast both call it an insult, and the Ashlands' brigand-lordship grows bolder.

outcomes.title: An Uprising of the Blessed
outcomes.text: The Blessed of a Morrowgast border town, sick of the Hag-Queens' rites, kill their Hag and declare themselves free. They ask Sunvale for protection, and Sunvale's court must decide whether to protect monsters.

outcomes.title: The Drought Ends in Fire
outcomes.text: A great fire, started by lightning at the drought's end, sweeps through the forests of Aldermere's south. Three towns burn, and the smoke darkens the skies over Sunvale for a week.

outcomes.title: The Dwarves Hire Out
outcomes.text: With their trade in ruins, the Deepholds hire out a thousand dwarven warriors to any kingdom that will pay in grain. Thornwatch takes them, and dwarves stand on the wall against the Horde.

outcomes.title: The Lost Fleet Returns
outcomes.text: A Westmarch fleet lost at sea for three years sails into Bellhaven with holds full of unknown spices and a map of lands beyond the western ocean. The merchant princes fit out a new expedition, and every kingdom's spies take notice.

outcomes.title: A Holy Relic Stolen
outcomes.text: The Order of the Lantern's founder's lantern is stolen from Lanternhold. The knights blame the Conclave, the Conclave blames the Coven, and the Order sends its knights out to search every road.

outcomes.title: The Hag of the Fens
outcomes.text: An old Hag of Morrowgast, exiled by her sisters, settles in Aldermere's fens among the Free Clans and teaches them witchcraft. The Free Clans' raiders begin to use curses as well as arrows.

outcomes.title: The Concord's Emergency Council
outcomes.text: The Council of the Kingdoms meets in an emergency session at Aldermere after the Horde's latest assault. For once, the kingdoms agree: every realm will send soldiers to Thornwatch's wall before winter.

outcomes.title: The Duke of the West Rebels
outcomes.text: A great lord of Westmarch's western lowlands refuses the merchant princes' taxes and declares himself Duke of the West, independent of Bellhaven. Westmarch's mercenaries march west, and the realm splits.

outcomes.title: The Blackspire's First Voice Slain
outcomes.text: An elven ranger of the Greywatch kills one of Malgrath's masked Voices in an ambush on the Northern Isle. The orcs are shaken, and for the first time the Spire's sorcerers do not ride out alone.

outcomes.title: The Coven's Red Rain
outcomes.text: A rain red as blood falls on Sunvale's eastern valleys for three days. Those it touches fall sick with fever, and some rise from their beds with the Blessing's hunger; Sunvale quarantines its whole eastern march.

outcomes.title: A Treaty of the Eastern Isle
outcomes.text: Veyl, the Deepholds and the Elderwood sign the Treaty of the Three Tables, binding the Eastern Isle together against any threat. The Eastern Isle becomes a single power in the eyes of the world.

outcomes.title: The Wool Guild Strike
outcomes.text: The weavers of Aldermere's wool towns strike against the great houses' new taxes. The cloth trade stops, the Lake Guilds join them and the crown must choose between the guilds and the lords.

outcomes.title: An Exile's Revenge
outcomes.text: A noble exiled from Aldermere twenty years ago returns with an army of sellswords from Veyl and claims his family's lands by force. The great houses must fight him, or accept him.

outcomes.title: The Brotherhood's Civil War
outcomes.text: Two of the Brotherhood's captains fight for Red Mara's place after she is wounded in a sea battle. The Salt Isles' fleet fights itself in the Ostcombe Sea, and for a season the southern sea is safe for merchants.

outcomes.title: The Northern Lights Turn Black
outcomes.text: The northern lights over the Northern Isle burn black for a week. Orcs and humans alike flee the coasts, and the Conclave says the Unbreathing is drawing power from the sky itself.

outcomes.title: A Royal Bastard Claims the Crown
outcomes.text: A bastard son of Sunvale's last king, raised in Veyl, lands at Solenne with Veyl's mercenaries and claims the crown. Half the court rallies to him, and Sunvale is split.

outcomes.title: The Silver Mines Flood
outcomes.text: The silver mines of Hollowcrown flood when an underground river breaks through. The Prelacy's main income is gone, and the war tithe on the people doubles.

outcomes.title: An Orc Fleet Lands in Hollowcrown
outcomes.text: A Horde fleet slips past Thornwatch's wall and lands on Hollowcrown's northern coast. Mountain villages burn and the Silver Guard must turn from the wall to defend their own homes.

outcomes.title: Veyl's Glass Navy
outcomes.text: Veyl launches a fleet of galleys with lenses that burn ships at a distance. No pirate will approach a Veyl ship, and the Republic's power at sea grows overnight.

outcomes.title: The Free Clans Elect a War-Leader
outcomes.text: The Free Clans' moot elects a young war-leader who swears to take back every fen Aldermere ever stole. The Reed Raiders grow from a band to an army, and Aldermere's lake towns double their walls.

outcomes.title: The Lantern's Light Fails
outcomes.text: The founder's lantern at Lanternhold goes out, and no prayer can relight it. Half the Order's knights despair and leave; the rest swear a desperate oath to die fighting the Coven.

outcomes.title: A Great Market in the Ashlands
outcomes.text: Merchants of Sunvale, Veyl and even Morrowgast meet at a great market in the unruled Ashlands, trading horses, slaves and weapons. The Ashlands become a crossroads, and every power wants to own it.

outcomes.title: The Spire Offers Peace
outcomes.text: The Blackspire sends an envoy to Thornwatch offering peace: the strait for the Ashen Exiles' heads. The Warden refuses, but the offer divides the Council of the Kingdoms.

outcomes.title: The Deepholds Elect a New King
outcomes.text: The Hall of Thanes deposes the Thane-King of Karak Dûm for his failures and elects a Remembrancer in his place. The new Thane-King swears never to sell steel to the Horde and to reclaim Karak Varn.

outcomes.title: A Plague of the Lake Towns
outcomes.text: A spotted plague breaks out in Aldermere's lake towns and spreads to the capital. The court flees, the markets close and the plague spreads along the Lake Road to Westmarch.

outcomes.title: Sunvale's Navy Mutinies
outcomes.text: The sailors of Sunvale's fleet, unpaid for a year, mutiny and sail their ships to the Brotherhood. Sunvale loses its navy in a night, and its coast lies open.

outcomes.title: The Conclave's New Ward
outcomes.text: The Conclave of the Lake raises a great ward over Aldermere's lake city that no spirit or undead can pass. Aldermere's people feel safe for the first time since the Black Dawn, and the crown owes the Tower a great debt.

outcomes.title: The Battle of the Black Ice
outcomes.text: The Horde crosses the frozen strait in the first frost and storms Thornwatch's wall along its whole length. Thornwatch, Hollowcrown and the Exiles hold it, but at a terrible cost; the wall's garrison is halved.

outcomes.title: A Queen Murdered in Hollowcrown
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's queen is murdered in the Silver Flame's own shrine. The Prelacy accuses the Conclave's mages; the Conclave accuses the Prelacy; and the mountain lords take up arms.

outcomes.title: The Ashlands Raiders Burn Lisac
outcomes.text: Brigands of the Ashlands burn the Sunvale town of Lisac and carry off its harvest. Sunvale's barons, abandoned by the court, raise their own armies to hunt them down.

outcomes.title: A Merchant Prince Founds a Colony
outcomes.text: A Westmarch merchant prince plants a colony on an unruled island west of the Thornshaw Sea. Settlers flock to it, and Westmarch has its first holding beyond the Great Isle.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Plague
outcomes.text: A plague that turns its victims into walking dead breaks out in the Horde's camps and spreads to Thornwatch's coast. The Conclave says it is the Spire's work; Thornwatch burns its own villages to stop it.

outcomes.title: The Elderwood Marches
outcomes.text: The Elderwood sends its rangers to the Northern Isle to strike the Spire, the first elven army to leave the Eastern Isle in a thousand years. Thalion Ash-Eye leads them.

outcomes.title: The Iron Road
outcomes.text: The Deepholds build a road of iron rails from Karak Dûm to Veyl's harbour, carrying ore and steel in carts pulled by mules. Trade between the two doubles, and the Elderwood watches its forest shrink.

outcomes.title: An Elven Heir Kidnapped
outcomes.text: An elven child of the Heartwood's line is kidnapped by orc raiders and carried to the Northern Isle. The elves say the Spire needs royal elven blood; the Greywatch rides north to find her.

outcomes.title: A Peasant Revolt in Hollowcrown
outcomes.text: The peasants of Hollowcrown's southern valleys, crushed by the war tithe, rise against the Prelacy and burn its granaries. The mountain lords side with them, and Hollowcrown's priests flee to the capital.

outcomes.title: The Coven's Peace Offer
outcomes.text: Morrowgast's Hag-Queens offer Sunvale a treaty: the Ashlands divided, the raids ended and an exchange of prisoners. Sunvale's court accepts, and the Order of the Lantern calls it a pact with damnation.

outcomes.title: The Brotherhood Sails North
outcomes.text: The Brotherhood of the Salt Isles sells its fleet's service to the Horde, ferrying orc war-bands south past Thornwatch's wall. The kingdoms are horrified, and Westmarch and Sunvale unite against the pirates.

outcomes.title: The Free Clans Win Back a Fen
outcomes.text: The Free Clans storm an Aldermere fort and take back one of their old fens. Wenna of the Reeds is acclaimed by every clan, and Aldermere's lords begin to talk of peace with them.

outcomes.title: Veyl Buys the Salt Isles
outcomes.text: Veyl's Glass Senate buys the Salt Isles from Red Mara for a fortune in glass ducats, and makes her its admiral. The Brotherhood becomes Veyl's navy, and the Ostcombe Sea is Veyl's.

outcomes.title: A Great Fire in Karak Dûm
outcomes.text: A forge fire spreads through the halls of Karak Dûm and burns for a week. The dwarves lose their greatest forge, and the Deepholds' trade in steel stops for a year.

outcomes.title: A Hedge-Witch's Curse
outcomes.text: A hedge-witch of Westmarch, burned by the witch-finders, curses the town of Merkhoven with her last breath. The town's wells turn black, its children fall sick and its people flee.

outcomes.title: The Order Takes the Ashlands Fort
outcomes.text: The knights of the Lantern storm an Elder Age fortress in the Ashlands and hold it against the Coven. The Order now has a fortress on Morrowgast's doorstep, and the Coven gathers to destroy it.

outcomes.title: Thornwatch Buys Mercenaries
outcomes.text: Thornwatch hires the Gilded Lances and two other free companies to hold the wall, paying with the Wardenmark's lands. Sellswords become lords on the northern coast.

outcomes.title: The Conclave's Great Library Opens
outcomes.text: The Conclave of the Lake opens its great library to scholars of every realm. The lore it reveals about the Binding of the Blackspire changes how every kingdom sees the war.

outcomes.title: A Plague of Wolves in Sunvale
outcomes.text: Wolves made huge by the Blessing come out of the Ashlands and kill shepherds and travellers across Sunvale's east. The court offers a gold piece for every wolf head, and hunters flood the eastern hills.

outcomes.title: An Alliance Against the Spire
outcomes.text: Aldermere, Hollowcrown and Thornwatch sign the Alliance of the Wall: every realm will send an army north in the spring. Westmarch and Sunvale are invited, and refuse.

outcomes.title: The First Snow on the Wall
outcomes.text: Winter comes early to the north, and the first snows close the strait to the Horde's longships. Thornwatch has a winter to rebuild, and the Horde must wait for the ice.

outcomes.title: Aldermere's Crown Lost
outcomes.text: Aldermere's king dies without an heir, and three great houses claim the crown. The council deadlocks, the realm's army splits between them and Aldermere enters a winter of civil war.

outcomes.title: The Pirates of the Lake
outcomes.text: Outlaws seize boats on Lake Halmoor and raid the lake towns of Aldermere. The Lake Pirates make Aldermere's own lake unsafe, and the crown must build a lake fleet to hunt them.

outcomes.title: A Treaty with the Exiles
outcomes.text: The kingdoms of the Great Isle formally recognise the Ashen Exiles as a free people and grant them a coastal region. The orcs of the Northern Isle hear of it, and more clans flee the Horde.

outcomes.title: The Coven's Winter Raid
outcomes.text: Morrowgast's Blessed launch a winter raid deep into Sunvale, burning towns the court thought safe. Sunvale's army is not ready, and its king must beg the other kingdoms for help.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Envoy at Veyl
outcomes.text: An envoy of the Blackspire arrives in Veyl offering gold for steel and glass. The Glass Senate debates for a week and agrees, in secret, to sell; the Republic's neutrality is a lie.

outcomes.title: A Frozen Harvest
outcomes.text: An early frost kills the late harvest across the Great Isle. Famine looms in every realm, and the price of bread triples by midwinter.

outcomes.title: The Order's Grand Master Dies
outcomes.text: The Order of the Lantern's Grand Master dies of wounds taken in the Ashlands. The knights elect a young zealot who swears to march on Morrowgast before spring.

outcomes.title: The Exiles Raid the Spire's Forges
outcomes.text: The Ashen Exiles raid the Horde's iron forges on the Northern Isle's coast, freeing hundreds of slaves and burning the Spire's weapon-stores. The Horde's spring offensive will be short of steel.

outcomes.title: A New Hold in the North
outcomes.text: The Deepholds found a new hold in the unruled mountains of the Northern Isle, mining iron under the Horde's nose. The Spire sends war-bands to destroy it, and the dwarves dig in.

outcomes.title: Westmarch's Treasure Fleet
outcomes.text: Westmarch's treasure fleet returns from the western seas with gold, spices and silks. The merchant princes are richer than ever, and every pirate on the western sea sharpens their knives.

outcomes.title: A Prophecy of the Heartwood
outcomes.text: The Heartwood's song tells the elves the day the Binding can be woven again: the next midwinter. The Elderwood prepares the rite, and the kingdoms are asked to send their mages.

outcomes.title: Hollowcrown's Lords Rebel
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's mountain lords refuse the Prelacy's war tithe and seize the high passes. The realm splits between priests and lords, and Thornwatch loses Hollowcrown's soldiers on the wall.

outcomes.title: A Coven Spy in Solenne
outcomes.text: A Hag of Morrowgast is found living in Solenne's palace as a lady-in-waiting. The court is purged, and Sunvale's king trusts no one.

outcomes.title: The Brigand King of the High Wilds
outcomes.text: A brigand lord unites the outlaws of the High Wilds and declares himself King of the Peaks, demanding tribute from Aldermere and Hollowcrown. Neither kingdom can spare soldiers to remove him.

outcomes.title: The Northern Isle's Volcano
outcomes.text: A volcano erupts on the Northern Isle, burying one of the Horde's war-camps in ash. The orcs flee south toward the strait, and Thornwatch braces for a desperate invasion.

outcomes.title: The Free Port of Veyl
outcomes.text: Veyl declares its harbour a free port for every ship of every realm, even pirates and the Horde. Merchants flock to it, and the kingdoms of the Great Isle accuse it of trading with the enemy.

outcomes.title: A Wizard's Duel at Aldermere
outcomes.text: Two masters of the Conclave fight a wizard's duel in Aldermere's market square over the Tower's future. Half the square burns, one master dies and the crown demands the Conclave be brought to heel.

outcomes.title: An Uprising in the Wardenmark
outcomes.text: The peasants of Thornwatch's Wardenmark, ruined by war, rise against the Warden's tax-collectors. The Warden must choose between crushing his own people and losing the wall's supplies.

outcomes.title: The Lost Princess Returns
outcomes.text: A princess of Sunvale's royal house, thought dead for twenty years, returns from Veyl with proof of her birth and a claim to the throne. The court is thrown into turmoil, and Veyl's bankers smile.

outcomes.title: The Winter Wolves of the North
outcomes.text: Packs of white wolves cross the early ice from the Northern Isle into the Wardenmark, led by orc beast-masters. They kill sentries on the wall at night and drive Thornwatch's shepherds from the coast.

outcomes.title: Sunvale's Queen Flees
outcomes.text: Sunvale's Aldermere-born queen flees Solenne for her uncle's court at Aldermere, accusing the Grand Ministry of plotting to poison her. Aldermere takes her in, and the oldest friendship of the Great Isle turns cold.

outcomes.title: The Bone Pickers
