outcomes.text: Scavengers who strip the dead on Thornwatch's battlefields band together under a former gravedigger and begin robbing the wounded and the supply wagons. The Bone Pickers grow into a band of three hundred that preys on the war itself.

outcomes.title: A Hold Beneath the Sea
outcomes.text: Dwarven miners following a vein under the seabed break into a dry Elder Age hall beneath the strait itself. It holds weapons of star-iron, and every power on the strait wants them.

outcomes.title: A Plague of Ravens
outcomes.text: Ravens in their thousands settle on Hollowcrown's capital and will not leave. The priests call them the Spire's spies; the people refuse to leave their houses, and trade in the mountain kingdom stops.

outcomes.title: The Hag-Queens' Fair
outcomes.text: Morrowgast opens a winter market at the edge of the Ashlands where Sunvale's merchants may buy the Coven's herbs and healing draughts. Sunvale's poor flock to it for medicines their own priests cannot give, and the Order calls it the Coven's bait.

outcomes.title: The Lake City Burns
outcomes.text: A fire in Aldermere's lake city burns the wool quarter and the Lake Guilds' hall. The guilds lose a year's cloth, the crown loses its taxes and Aldermere goes into the winter poorer than in a century.

outcomes.title: The Silent Foundry of Karak Dûm
outcomes.text: The dwarven forge-guilds unveil an automaton of iron and star-iron that walks and fights. The Thane-King offers to build more for any kingdom that will cede him a mountain, and the Conclave fears what the dwarves have made.

outcomes.title: Westmarch's Winter Convoy Lost
outcomes.text: Westmarch's winter grain convoy to Thornwatch is taken by pirates in the Thornshaw Sea. The wall's garrison goes hungry, and the Warden accuses Westmarch of letting it happen.

outcomes.title: The Exiles' Moot
outcomes.text: The Ashen Exiles hold a great moot and elect a council of chiefs instead of one ruler. The new council sends envoys to every free orc clan of the Northern Isle, inviting them to join a free orc people.

outcomes.title: A Saint of the Hearth
outcomes.text: A blacksmith's daughter in Aldermere's east cures the sick with a touch and preaches that the Silver Flame burns in every hearth. Hollowcrown's Prelacy demands her surrender as a heretic; Aldermere's people defend her with pitchforks.

outcomes.title: The Blessed Desert
outcomes.text: A whole company of Morrowgast's Blessed walks into Sunvale and surrenders, asking for land to farm. Sunvale's court must decide whether to welcome soldiers the Coven made into monsters.

outcomes.title: The Iron Wolves Raid
outcomes.text: The band of escaped slaves called the Iron Wolves burns a Horde iron mine on the Northern Isle and frees two hundred captives. The Spire sends a war-band after them into the wild mountains, and the Wolves vanish.

outcomes.title: Veyl's Elections
outcomes.text: Veyl holds its first open election in a century, and a glass-cutter's son wins the First Magistracy against the banking houses' candidate. The banks refuse to accept him, and Veyl's streets fill with armed guildsmen.

outcomes.title: The Thornshaw Storm
outcomes.text: A great storm drives the Thornshaw Sea over Westmarch's western coast. Three fishing towns are swept away, and the merchant princes are slow to send help.

outcomes.title: A Child Saint of the Elderwood
outcomes.text: An elf child of the Heartwood heals a dying ranger by singing to him. The Loremasters say she is the first of the Heartwood's chosen in a thousand years, and every elf comes to see her.

outcomes.title: Lantern Knights in Aldermere
outcomes.text: The Order of the Lantern sends knights into Aldermere to hunt hedge-witches and rogue mages without the crown's leave. They burn two women in a market town, and Aldermere's lords expel them by force.

outcomes.title: A Kingdom for Sale
outcomes.text: A ruined lord of Sunvale's southern coast sells his lands and his title to a Brotherhood captain for a chest of pirate gold. The pirate becomes a lord of Sunvale, and the court cannot undo the sale.

outcomes.title: The Ice Bridge Forms
outcomes.text: The strait freezes early, and the Horde's war-bands walk across the ice to raid Thornwatch's coast. The Warden pulls his garrison back to the wall and leaves the coast villages to fend for themselves.

outcomes.title: A Royal Pilgrimage
outcomes.text: The heir of Aldermere makes a pilgrimage to Hollowcrown's Silver Flame and is crowned with silver by the Prelacy. Aldermere's great houses suspect the heir has been won over by the priests.

outcomes.title: Hunger Riots Across the Great Isle
outcomes.text: Bread riots break out on the same week in Aldermere, Bellhaven and Solenne. In every capital the crowds storm the granaries, and the crowns must choose between feeding the poor and feeding their armies.

outcomes.title: The Thane-King Weds an Elf
outcomes.text: The Thane-King of Karak Dûm weds an elven lady of the Elderwood to heal the rift between their peoples. The marriage scandalises both, but the Pact of Root and Stone is renewed for a hundred years.

outcomes.title: The Ghost Fleet of the Strait
outcomes.text: On moonless nights the drowned ships of the First War of the Spire rise from the strait, crewed by the dead, and attack anything afloat. Neither the Horde nor Thornwatch can cross until the Conclave lays them to rest.

outcomes.title: A Merchant Prince Turns Pirate
outcomes.text: A merchant prince of Westmarch, bankrupted by the Brotherhood, fits out his own ships as pirates and raids the Brotherhood's convoys. The western sea now has a pirate who hunts pirates.

outcomes.title: The Horde's Winter Camp Burns
outcomes.text: A fire sweeps through the Horde's great winter camp below the Blackspire, burning stores and longships. The orc clans blame the Exiles' agents and the Spire hangs a hundred slaves in vengeance.

outcomes.title: An Embassy to the Free Clans
outcomes.text: Aldermere sends an embassy to the Free Clans' moot offering peace: two fens returned in exchange for an end to the raids. The clans debate for a month while the great houses call it surrender.

outcomes.title: The Hounds of the Hearth
outcomes.text: A brotherhood of witch-finders rises in Westmarch's market towns and drags suspected witches from their homes. They burn a Conclave envoy, and the Tower of Stars declares them its enemies.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Herald at Solenne
outcomes.text: A masked herald of the Blackspire arrives at Solenne with an offer: the Ashlands and Morrowgast's western valleys for Sunvale, if Sunvale keeps its army at home. The court is tempted.

outcomes.title: An Earthquake in the Salt Isles
outcomes.text: An earthquake splits the main island of the Salt Isles, and half of Red Harbour slides into the sea. The Brotherhood loses its warehouses and its shipyards, and its captains quarrel over where to go.

outcomes.title: The Miners Seize the Mountain
outcomes.text: The silver miners of Hollowcrown's mountains, crushed by the war tithe, seize their mines and declare themselves free. They call themselves the Free Delvers and offer to sell their silver to any realm but Hollowcrown.

outcomes.title: A Deadly Winter Fever
outcomes.text: A winter fever spreads from the refugee camps of the Wardenmark into Hollowcrown and Aldermere. The sick fill the churches and the dead are buried in pits.

outcomes.title: The Conclave's Apprentices Rebel
outcomes.text: The apprentices of the Tower of Stars rebel against the masters and demand the right to teach magic outside the Tower. A dozen of them flee to Westmarch and set up a school; the Conclave hunts them.

outcomes.title: The Elderwood Sends Healers
outcomes.text: The Elderwood sends healers to every realm of the Great Isle to fight the winter fever. They save thousands, and for the first time in centuries the humans of the Great Isle speak of the elves with love.

outcomes.title: A Hag-Queen's Prophecy
outcomes.text: A Hag-Queen of Morrowgast prophesies before her sisters that Sunvale's crown will pass to a child of the Coven within a year. The Coven begins to prepare a claimant, and Sunvale's court learns of it.

outcomes.title: The Horde Raids the Exiles
outcomes.text: Horde war-bands cross the winter sea and fall on the Ashen Exiles' camp, killing hundreds and burning their boats. The Exiles beg Thornwatch for shelter on the Great Isle.

outcomes.title: A Lord Builds a Castle in the Wilds
outcomes.text: A younger son of an Aldermere great house builds a castle in the unruled High Wilds and claims the valley around it. He calls himself Lord of the Wilds and invites landless men to settle there.

outcomes.title: The Strait Freezes Solid
outcomes.text: The strait between the Northern Isle and Thornwatch freezes solid for the first time in living memory. The Horde's war-bands can walk south, and the Warden calls every kingdom's soldiers to the wall.

outcomes.title: A Kidnapped Archmagister
outcomes.text: The Archmagister of the Conclave is kidnapped from a barge on Lake Halmoor by masked men. The Tower's wards fail without him, and the kingdoms wonder who took him and why.

outcomes.title: The Wool Crisis
outcomes.text: Aldermere's wool trade collapses when Westmarch refuses to buy at the old prices. The lake towns' weavers starve, and the great houses blame the Lake Road treaty.

outcomes.title: The Silver Flame's Pilgrimage
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's Prelacy calls a great pilgrimage of the Silver Flame. A hundred thousand pilgrims march through the mountains to the hollow, bringing gold, disease and fervour in equal measure.

outcomes.title: The Midwinter Raid
outcomes.text: Horde war-bands slip across the winter strait and burn three villages of the Wardenmark in a single night. The wall holds, but Thornwatch's coast is emptied of its people.

outcomes.title: The Murder of a Veyl Banker
outcomes.text: The master of Veyl's greatest banking house is found strangled in his counting-house. His heirs fight over his fortune, and every kingdom indebted to him wonders who will call in the loans.

outcomes.title: The Salt Riots
outcomes.text: The price of salt doubles when the Brotherhood blockades the salt pans of Sunvale's coast. Riots break out in Solenne and Bellhaven, and the kingdoms' fishermen cannot preserve their catch.

outcomes.title: A Child-King Crowned
outcomes.text: Thornwatch's Warden dies of a winter fever, and his ten-year-old son is proclaimed Warden. The captains of the Beacon Line rule in his name, and the Horde sees its chance.

outcomes.title: A Monster Under Karak Dûm
outcomes.text: Something huge moves in the deep roots of the eastern mountains, shaking Karak Dûm's halls. The dwarves send a war-party down; it does not come back, and the Thane-King seals the lower deeps.

outcomes.title: The Conclave Recognised as a Kingdom
outcomes.text: Aldermere's council recognises the Conclave of the Lake as a free principality with its own lands on the lake shore. The Tower of Stars has territory for the first time, and Hollowcrown is outraged.

outcomes.title: A Plague of Rats in Solenne
outcomes.text: Rats swarm out of Solenne's sewers in a hard winter and devour the city's grain. The court flees to the countryside, and Sunvale's capital starves.

outcomes.title: The Blessed's Champion
outcomes.text: A Blessed warrior of Morrowgast, a giant three times a man's strength, defeats every challenger in the Ashlands and is proclaimed War-Lord by the Coven's soldiers. The Hag-Queens fear him as much as Sunvale does.

outcomes.title: A Smugglers' Road
outcomes.text: Smugglers open a road through the High Wilds' passes, carrying wool, salt and weapons past both Aldermere's and Hollowcrown's tolls. Both crowns lose revenue and both blame the other.

outcomes.title: An Orc Saint
outcomes.text: A wounded orc of the Ashen Exiles, nursed by Hollowcrown's priests, takes the vows of the Silver Flame. He preaches to the orcs of the Exiles, and a few convert; the Prelacy does not know whether to be proud or appalled.

outcomes.title: The Brigands of Westmarch's Woods
outcomes.text: Outlaws of Westmarch's inland forests, led by a disgraced knight, rob the merchant princes' convoys and give to the starving villages. The princes hire sellswords to hunt them; the villages hide them.

outcomes.title: The Elderwood's Silver Ships
outcomes.text: The Elderwood launches a fleet of silver ships for the first time in centuries. They sail for Thornwatch with elven archers, and the orcs on the strait learn to fear the sea.

outcomes.title: Aldermere Annexes a Wild Valley
outcomes.text: Aldermere's knights march into an unruled valley of the High Wilds and build a fort there to guard the passes. The hill clans who lived there flee to the Free Clans in the fens.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Plague Ship
outcomes.text: A ship crewed by the dead sails into Bellhaven's harbour and runs aground. A plague breaks out among the dockworkers who boarded it, and Westmarch quarantines its capital.

outcomes.title: A Wedding of Pirates
outcomes.text: Two of the Brotherhood's greatest captains marry, binding their crews together. The new pair command half the Brotherhood's fleet and challenge Red Mara for the leadership.

outcomes.title: The Order Takes Hostages
outcomes.text: The Order of the Lantern seizes the families of three Hag-Queens living in the Ashlands and holds them as hostages. Morrowgast offers a truce in exchange; the Order demands surrender.

outcomes.title: A Bridge of Ice
outcomes.text: The Lake Halmoor freezes, and Aldermere's army crosses the ice to strike the Free Clans' winter camps in the fens. The clans lose their boats and their winter stores.

outcomes.title: The Silver Flame Goes Out
outcomes.text: For a single night the Silver Flame of Hollowcrown goes out. The priests rekindle it with a prayer at dawn, but the realm is shaken, and many say the god has turned away.

outcomes.title: A Duel of Captains
outcomes.text: The commanders of Thornwatch and Hollowcrown on the wall fight a duel over who commands the defence. One dies, the other is disgraced and the alliance of the wall is shaken.

outcomes.title: A Witch Queen in the Fens
outcomes.text: An exiled Hag of Morrowgast becomes the queen of the Free Clans' war-band in the fens, teaching them curses. The raids on Aldermere grow crueller, and the great houses demand the fens be burned.

outcomes.title: The Winter Siege of Thornwatch
outcomes.text: The Horde crosses the frozen strait in force and besieges Thornwatch Keep in the dead of winter. The garrison holds, but the keep is cut off from the south until the thaw.

outcomes.title: A Revolution in Westmarch
outcomes.text: The guild halls of Bellhaven seize the council chamber and depose the merchant princes. They proclaim the Commonwealth of Westmarch, ruled by the guilds, and every other crown on the Great Isle watches in fear.

outcomes.title: The Bandits of the Frozen Lake
outcomes.text: Outlaws build a fortified camp on an island of frozen Lake Halmoor and raid the lake towns on skates and sledges. Aldermere's knights cannot reach them until the thaw.

outcomes.title: The Death of the Thane-King
outcomes.text: The Thane-King of Karak Dûm dies of age. Two thanes claim the stone throne, and the Deepholds split into rival halls while the Remembrancers argue over the succession.

outcomes.title: An Avalanche Buries a Hold
outcomes.text: An avalanche buries the dwarven hold of Karak Ornok in the eastern mountains. Hundreds of dwarves are trapped, and the Deepholds beg Veyl and the Elderwood to help dig them out.

outcomes.title: A New Order of Knights
outcomes.text: Young nobles of Aldermere and Sunvale found a new order of knights, the Order of the White Hart, sworn to defend the Great Isle against the Spire. They ride north to the wall without their kings' leave.

outcomes.title: A Horde Deserter's Map
outcomes.text: An orc deserter brings Thornwatch a map of the Blackspire's defences and the secret paths of the Northern Isle. The Warden's captains plan a raid on the Spire itself for the spring.

outcomes.title: The Brotherhood Seizes a Veyl Ship
outcomes.text: Red Mara's crews capture a Veyl galley carrying the Glass Senate's gold to the Great Isle. Veyl's Senate sends its glass-lens galleys to hunt the Brotherhood, and the Ostcombe Sea becomes a battlefield.

outcomes.title: The Free Clans' Winter
outcomes.text: A hard winter in the fens kills the Free Clans' herds and children. Their moot sends envoys to Aldermere begging for grain; the great houses demand surrender in return.

outcomes.title: A Rebel Hag-Queen
outcomes.text: A Hag-Queen of Morrowgast seizes three towns in the Coven-Realm's north and declares her own realm, refusing the Blessing's rites. The Coven sends its Blessed to crush her, and Sunvale is asked for help.

outcomes.title: A Plague of Madness in Aldermere
outcomes.text: A madness spreads among Aldermere's lords: they hear voices and rage at their families. The Conclave says it is the Spire's work, and the great houses are paralysed.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Envoy Murdered
outcomes.text: An envoy of the Blackspire is murdered in Aldermere's court by a grieving father whose son died on the wall. The Spire swears vengeance on Aldermere, and the kingdoms brace.

outcomes.title: A Market of Slaves
outcomes.text: The Brotherhood opens a slave market in Red Harbour, selling captured Horde orcs and Coven Blessed to the highest bidder. The kingdoms condemn it, and buy.

outcomes.title: The Elves Return to the Great Isle
outcomes.text: An elven company settles in an unruled forest of Aldermere's south, the first elves to live on the Great Isle since the Fading. Aldermere's lords do not know whether to welcome or expel them.

outcomes.title: Winter Fever in the Horde
outcomes.text: A winter fever spreads through the Horde's camps on the Northern Isle. Thousands of orcs die, and the Spire's spring offensive is delayed.

outcomes.title: The Conclave's Exile
outcomes.text: The Conclave of the Lake is expelled from Aldermere after a rogue mage burns a church. The masters take ship for the Eastern Isle, and the Tower of Stars stands empty.

outcomes.title: A Royal Hunt Ends in Murder
outcomes.text: A royal hunt in Sunvale's forests ends with the king's favourite cousin dead of an arrow. The court accuses the eastern barons, and the barons accuse the Coven.

outcomes.title: A Comet of Silver
outcomes.text: A silver comet crosses the winter sky for a week. Hollowcrown's priests call it the Silver Flame's sign of victory, and the war tithe is paid willingly for the first time in a year.

outcomes.title: The Dwarven Tunnel Collapses
outcomes.text: The dwarves' new tunnel under the sea collapses, drowning a hundred miners. The Deepholds blame Veyl's engineers, and the Treaty of the Eastern Isle is strained.

outcomes.title: An Orc Kingdom Recognised
outcomes.text: Thornwatch recognises the free orc clans of the Northern Isle's southern coast as a kingdom, sending them weapons against the Spire. The Horde's war turns inward.

outcomes.title: The Siege of the Glass City
outcomes.text: Veyl's guilds and banks fight a street war for control of the Republic. The harbour burns, the glass furnaces go cold and Veyl's ships are trapped in harbour.

outcomes.title: A Queen of the Free Clans
outcomes.text: The Free Clans' moot crowns Wenna of the Reeds Queen of the Lakeshore and declares the fens a kingdom. Aldermere refuses to recognise it, and the clans swear to take back their land.

outcomes.title: A Dragon's Egg Found
outcomes.text: Dwarven miners find a dragon's egg in a cavern under the eastern mountains. The Thane-King wants to hatch it, the elves want it destroyed and Veyl's banks want to buy it.

outcomes.title: The Coven's Army Marches
outcomes.text: Morrowgast's Blessed host marches west through the Ashlands in the dead of winter, the largest army the Coven has ever fielded. Sunvale's eastern barons send for help from every kingdom.

outcomes.title: The Pirate Kingdom
outcomes.text: The Brotherhood of the Salt Isles proclaims itself a kingdom under Red Mara, with its own coin and its own laws. Westmarch and Sunvale refuse to recognise it; Veyl does.

outcomes.title: A Plague of the Silver Mines
outcomes.text: A lung-sickness kills a third of Hollowcrown's silver miners. The mines close, the Prelacy's treasury empties and the realm cannot pay its soldiers on the wall.

outcomes.title: The Lake Road Treaty Broken
outcomes.text: Aldermere's council doubles the Lake Road tolls to pay for the war. Westmarch's merchant princes close their harbours to Aldermere's wool, and the Concord's oldest quarrel turns bitter.

outcomes.title: Orcs on the Wall
outcomes.text: A Horde war-chief and three hundred warriors cross the ice to Thornwatch and offer their axes against the Spire. The Warden accepts, and orcs stand on the wall beside men.

outcomes.title: The Burning of the Fens
outcomes.text: Aldermere's knights set fire to the frozen reeds of the fens to drive out the Free Clans. The clans flee into the hills, and the smoke darkens the sky over the lake city for a week.

outcomes.title: The Conclave's New Tower
outcomes.text: The Conclave of the Lake raises a new tower on the shore of the strait at Thornwatch, to fight the Spire from close by. The Tower of Stars on Wyn is left to the scholars.

outcomes.title: The Ashlands Brigand Kingdom
outcomes.text: A brigand chief unites the outlaw bands of the Ashlands and crowns himself King of the Ashes. He demands tribute from Sunvale and Morrowgast both, and both send armies to crush him.

outcomes.title: An Heir Born in Hollowcrown
outcomes.text: An heir is born to Hollowcrown's queen with a silver mark on her brow. The Prelacy proclaims her the Silver Flame's chosen, and Hollowcrown's people rally to the crown.

outcomes.title: A Storm Destroys a Fleet
outcomes.text: A winter storm destroys Westmarch's war fleet in harbour at Bellhaven. Westmarch is defenceless at sea, and the Brotherhood's captains rejoice.

outcomes.title: An Elven Ranger Reaches the Spire
outcomes.text: An elven ranger of the Greywatch reaches the Blackspire's gates and sees the Unbreathing on its walls. She returns with the first true description of Malgrath in a thousand years.

outcomes.title: A Winter of Wolves
outcomes.text: Packs of wolves come out of the wild lands into every realm of the Great Isle in a hard winter. They kill sheep and travellers, and the kings offer a bounty on every wolf.

outcomes.title: The Exiles Win a Battle
outcomes.text: The Ashen Exiles defeat a Horde war-band on the Northern Isle's western coast and capture its chief. They send him to Thornwatch as a gift, and the Warden makes them allies.

outcomes.title: A Bank Run in Veyl
outcomes.text: The merchants of Veyl rush to withdraw their savings when rumours spread of the banks' losses in Sunvale. Three banks close their doors, and Veyl's economy freezes.

outcomes.title: A Mage-King
outcomes.text: A master of the Conclave, Magister Ilsa Brand, is offered the crown of a small lordship on Aldermere's lake shore for her services against the Spire. Aldermere has a mage among its lords for the first time.

outcomes.title: The Order's Winter Crusade
outcomes.text: The Order of the Lantern marches into Morrowgast in the dead of winter, catching the Coven by surprise. They burn a Hag-Queen's tower and retreat before the Blessed can gather.

outcomes.title: The Ice Breaks
outcomes.text: An early thaw breaks the ice on the strait, drowning a Horde war-band crossing to Thornwatch. The orcs lose a thousand warriors to the sea, and the Spire's winter campaign ends.

outcomes.title: The Murder of Sunvale's Heir
outcomes.text: Sunvale's heir is found dead in his bed, poisoned. The court accuses the Coven's agents; the barons accuse the Grand Ministry. Sunvale has no heir, and every great house begins to plot.

outcomes.title: The Bandit Lords of the East
outcomes.text: Sellswords who served Veyl's banks in the street war band together in the unruled wilds of the Eastern Isle and carve out a lordship. They demand recognition from Veyl and the Deepholds.

outcomes.title: The Conclave's Secret Revealed
outcomes.text: A traitor in the Conclave reveals that the Tower has been studying Malgrath's art for centuries. Aldermere's people riot outside the lake city's gates and demand the Tower be burned.

outcomes.title: A Plague of Locusts in Sunvale
outcomes.text: Locusts from the Ashlands strip Sunvale's winter wheat. The court cannot feed its people, and riots break out in every town of the south.

outcomes.title: The Exiles Settle on the Great Isle
outcomes.text: The Ashen Exiles land on an unruled coast of the Great Isle's north and build a town there. The kingdoms do not know whether to drive them out or make them allies.

outcomes.title: A Holy War in the Mountains
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's priests and the Order of the Lantern fight over who leads the war against Morrowgast. Their knights clash in the mountains, and the war against the Coven is forgotten.

outcomes.title: A Dragon Hatches
outcomes.text: A dragon hatches in the Deepholds' forge, and the dwarves raise it in the deep halls. The Thane-King says it will fight the Horde; the elves say it will burn the world.

outcomes.title: The Wool Guilds Rebel
outcomes.text: Aldermere's wool guilds refuse to pay the crown's war taxes and close the lake towns' gates. The crown must choose between bargaining and starving its own cities.

outcomes.title: A Winter Truce on the Strait
outcomes.text: Thornwatch and the Horde's western chiefs sign a truce for the winter, exchanging prisoners. The kingdoms are horrified, but the wall's garrison sleeps for the first time in a year.

outcomes.title: The Lake Pirates' Island
outcomes.text: The Lake Pirates build a fortress on an island in Lake Halmoor and raid the lake towns at will. Aldermere's crown must build a lake fleet to drive them out.

outcomes.title: A Hag-Queen Converts
outcomes.text: A Hag-Queen of Morrowgast takes the vows of the Silver Flame and denounces the Blessing. Hollowcrown's priests hail her as a miracle; the Coven calls her a traitor and sends assassins.

outcomes.title: The Free Clans' Uprising
outcomes.text: The Free Clans rise across Aldermere's fens, burning forts and freeing serfs. Aldermere's knights are stretched between the fens and the wall in the north.

outcomes.title: The Dwarves Buy a City
outcomes.text: The Deepholds buy a ruined city on the Great Isle's coast from a bankrupt Sunvale lord and garrison it. The dwarves now own a port on the Great Isle, and the kingdoms are alarmed.

outcomes.title: A Winter Without Snow
outcomes.text: The winter passes without snow on the Great Isle. The springs dry up, the farmers fear a second drought and the price of water rises in the cities.

outcomes.title: A New Archmagister Elected
outcomes.text: The Conclave of the Lake elects a new Archmagister who swears to bring the Tower under Aldermere's crown. The scholars rebel and leave for the Eastern Isle.

outcomes.title: The Spire Sends Assassins
outcomes.text: The Blackspire sends assassins to kill the rulers of Thornwatch and Hollowcrown on the same night. One succeeds, one fails, and the kingdoms of the wall are thrown into chaos.

outcomes.title: A Great Peace Conference
outcomes.text: Envoys of every realm of the world meet at Veyl for a peace conference. They agree nothing, but for a week the world's rulers talk instead of fighting.

outcomes.title: The Ashlands Burn
outcomes.text: A great fire set by the Coven's Blessed sweeps through the Ashlands, burning the brigands' camps and the wild horse herds. The Ashlands are a wasteland, and their people flee into Sunvale.

outcomes.title: The Lantern Rekindled
outcomes.text: The Order of the Lantern's knights relight their founder's lantern from the Silver Flame itself. The Order and Hollowcrown's Prelacy are reconciled, and their knights march together.

outcomes.title: The Midwinter Assault
outcomes.text: On the longest night of the year, the Horde throws everything it has against Thornwatch's wall. The battle lasts until dawn, and when the sun rises the wall still stands, but its towers are red with blood.

outcomes.title: A Royal Divorce
outcomes.text: Sunvale's king divorces his Aldermere-born queen to marry a daughter of Veyl's richest banker. Aldermere breaks its friendship with Sunvale, and Veyl's banks take Sunvale's debts in hand.

outcomes.title: The Thieves of the Lake City
outcomes.text: A guild of thieves takes control of Aldermere's lower city, paying the guards and ruling the docks. The crown's officers cannot enter the lower city without their permission.

outcomes.title: The Elderwood's Queen Crowned
outcomes.text: The elves of the Elderwood crown a new queen for the first time in a thousand years, a child of the Heartwood's line. She swears the elves will weave a new Binding before the next midwinter.

outcomes.title: A Great Storm in the Ostcombe Sea
outcomes.text: A winter storm sinks dozens of ships in the Ostcombe Sea, pirates and merchants alike. The Brotherhood loses half its fleet, and the merchants of the south rejoice.

outcomes.title: The Deepholds' War
outcomes.text: The Deepholds declare war on the Horde and send their army across the sea to the Northern Isle's southern coast. Dwarves and orcs fight in the snows below the Spire for the first time in a thousand years.

outcomes.title: A Witch-Burning in Sunvale
outcomes.text: Sunvale's priests burn twelve women accused of serving the Coven. The Coven sends Blessed raiders to avenge them, and Sunvale's eastern villages burn.

outcomes.title: The Free Clans Make Peace
outcomes.text: The Free Clans sign a peace with Aldermere, receiving two fens and the right to their own moot. The fens war ends, and Aldermere's knights march north to the wall.

outcomes.title: The Merchant Princes' Bankruptcy
outcomes.text: Westmarch's three greatest merchant houses go bankrupt in the same month. The council cannot pay its sellswords, and the Gilded Lances seize Bellhaven's customs house in lieu.

outcomes.title: The Coven's Envoys at the Spire
outcomes.text: Morrowgast's Hag-Queens send envoys to the Blackspire. The kingdoms fear an alliance of the two dark powers, and the Order demands the Coven be destroyed before it can be made.

outcomes.title: A Volcano on the Eastern Isle
outcomes.text: A volcano erupts in the eastern mountains, burying a dwarven hold in ash and lava. The Deepholds lose a tenth of their people, and Veyl's harbour is choked with ash.

outcomes.title: An Assassin in the Tower
outcomes.text: An assassin of the Spire slips into the Tower of Stars and kills two masters of the Conclave before he is caught. The Conclave's wards are strengthened, and the Tower trusts no one.

outcomes.title: The Winter Fair at Aldermere
outcomes.text: Aldermere holds a great winter fair to raise money for the war. Merchants of every realm come, a fortune is raised and the crown pays its soldiers on the wall for the first time in a year.

outcomes.title: A Prophet Among the Orcs
outcomes.text: An old orc shaman proclaims that the Spire's master is not undying, and can be killed. Whole clans leave the Horde to follow him into the wild mountains of the Northern Isle.

outcomes.title: The Bridges of Westmarch Fall
outcomes.text: Winter floods bring down the great bridges of Westmarch's lowlands. Trade between the west and Aldermere stops, and the merchant princes' convoys must go by sea.

outcomes.title: A Sunvale Duke Rebels
outcomes.text: A great duke of Sunvale's west refuses the crown's taxes and declares his duchy free. The court cannot pay an army to bring him back, and Sunvale begins to fall apart.

outcomes.title: An Orc Raid on Hollowcrown
outcomes.text: An orc war-band slips past the wall and raids Hollowcrown's northern valleys, carrying off cattle and children. The Prelacy calls for a holy war across the strait.

outcomes.title: A Ship from Beyond the World
outcomes.text: A ship of unknown make, with sails of red silk and a crew who speak no known tongue, arrives in Veyl's harbour. The Glass Senate takes them in, and every kingdom wants to know where they came from.

outcomes.title: The Conclave's Fire-Ships
outcomes.text: The Conclave of the Lake sends fire-ships against the Horde's fleet in its winter harbour. Fifty longships burn, and the Spire's spring crossing will be smaller.

outcomes.title: A Midwinter Miracle
outcomes.text: On midwinter night, the Heartwood's song is heard across the whole world. Every elf weeps, the orcs on the Northern Isle fall silent and the Spire's black light dims for an hour.

outcomes.title: The Starving Winter
outcomes.text: Snow buries the Great Isle for a month and the roads close. Villages eat their seed corn, the poor of every capital queue at the churches for bread and the crowns' armies on the wall go on half rations.

outcomes.title: A Throne Seized in the Snow
outcomes.text: While the court of Sunvale is snowbound in its winter palace, a general of the royal guard seizes Solenne and proclaims himself Protector of the Realm. The king is a prisoner in his own palace, and the barons ride for the capital as the snows allow.

outcomes.title: The Snow-Wraiths of the High Wilds
outcomes.text: Pale wraiths walk out of the snows of the High Wilds and freeze whole villages in a night. Hollowcrown's priests and the Conclave's mages must work together, for once, to drive them back.

outcomes.title: The Coven Opens Its Granaries
outcomes.text: Morrowgast, whose fens kept their harvest, opens its granaries to Sunvale's starving border villages in exchange for oaths of friendship. Whole valleys of Sunvale's east swear themselves to the Coven to eat.

outcomes.title: The Brotherhood of the Ice
outcomes.text: Fishermen of Thornwatch's coast, ruined by the war, take to the frozen strait as raiders, robbing both the Horde's camps and the wall's supply carts. They call themselves the Brotherhood of the Ice and answer to no Warden.

outcomes.title: An Avalanche Kills a Prince
outcomes.text: An avalanche sweeps a royal hunting party off a mountain road in Hollowcrown. The queen's younger brother is among the dead, and the mountain lords say the Prelacy arranged it.

outcomes.title: Wolves in the Lake City
outcomes.text: Starving wolves come across the frozen lake into Aldermere's lower city at night. They kill a dozen people before the guards drive them out, and the city is gripped by terror.

outcomes.title: The Thane-King's Gift
outcomes.text: The Thane-King of Karak Dûm sends a hundred wagons of grain from the Deepholds' stores to Thornwatch's starving garrison. The wall is saved for the winter, and Thornwatch owes the dwarves a debt in iron mines it does not yet hold.

outcomes.title: Veyl's Ice-Bound Harbour
outcomes.text: Veyl's harbour freezes for the first time in a century, trapping the Republic's fleet and stopping its trade. The Glass Senate's banks call in their loans to cover their losses, and every kingdom feels the squeeze.

outcomes.title: A Saint Freezes
outcomes.text: A beloved saint of Aldermere's poor freezes to death giving her cloak to a beggar. Her funeral draws ten thousand mourners, and the Hearth-Flame movement she preached spreads across the lake country.

outcomes.title: The Ice Raiders of the Exiles
outcomes.text: The Ashen Exiles cross the frozen sea on sledges and fall on a Horde camp on the Northern Isle's western coast. They burn its stores, free its slaves and vanish into the snow before the Horde can answer.

outcomes.title: A Midwinter Murder at Court
outcomes.text: A favourite of Aldermere's king is found dead in the palace snow, stabbed in the back. The great houses accuse each other, the king trusts no one and Aldermere's council stops meeting.

outcomes.title: Westmarch's Grain Hoarders
outcomes.text: Westmarch's merchant princes hoard grain while their people starve, waiting for prices to rise. The guild halls storm the granaries, the princes' sellswords fire on them and Bellhaven runs with blood.

outcomes.title: The Free Clans Starve
outcomes.text: The Free Clans, driven from their fens, starve in the hills. Their moot sends their children to Aldermere's churches to be fed, and some of the great houses are shamed into opening their stores.

outcomes.title: A Lord Hoards Fire
outcomes.text: A great lord of Aldermere's north buys up all the charcoal in the realm and sells it at ten times the price. The poor freeze, and the crown must seize his stores by force.

outcomes.title: A Comet Over the Ice
outcomes.text: A white comet hangs over the frozen strait for a week. Orcs and men alike stop fighting to stare at it; the Exiles say it means the Spire's fall, and the Horde says it means the Spire's victory.

outcomes.title: A Plague of the Cold
outcomes.text: A coughing sickness kills the old and the young across the Great Isle in the hard winter. Every realm counts its dead in thousands, and the armies on the wall are thinned by it.

outcomes.title: The Lake Road Avalanche
outcomes.text: An avalanche buries a section of the Lake Road under ice and rock. Trade between Aldermere and Westmarch stops until spring, and both realms' merchants are ruined.

outcomes.title: A Monster in the Snow
outcomes.text: A great white beast with too many legs comes out of the snows of the Northern Isle's wild north and attacks the Horde's camps. The orcs flee south, and Thornwatch braces for refugees it cannot feed.

outcomes.title: The Elves Bring Spring
outcomes.text: The Elderwood's healers sing in Thornwatch's frozen villages, and the snow melts around them. Thornwatch's people call it a miracle, and the alliance between the Elderwood and the Great Isle grows.

outcomes.title: Midwinter Night
outcomes.text: On the longest night of the year the Blackspire's black light blazes across the strait, and every corpse on Thornwatch's battlefields rises. The living fight the dead until dawn, and the wall holds by fire and prayer.

outcomes.title: A Royal Child Born
outcomes.text: A son is born to Aldermere's king on midwinter night, an heir after years of waiting. The great houses' plots collapse, and Aldermere celebrates its first good news in a year.

outcomes.title: The Coven's Winter Rite
outcomes.text: Morrowgast's Hag-Queens work a great rite on midwinter night, and the Blessing passes through every child born in the Coven-Realm that winter. A generation of Blessed is being born.

outcomes.title: The Order's Midwinter Vigil
outcomes.text: The knights of the Lantern keep a vigil on midwinter night, and their lantern burns so bright it is seen in Morrowgast. The Coven's Blessed fall sick for a week, and the Order calls it a sign.

outcomes.title: A Midwinter Feast Poisoned
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's midwinter feast is poisoned; a dozen lords die and the queen barely survives. The Prelacy blames the Coven, the lords blame the Prelacy and the mountain kingdom splits.

outcomes.title: The Heartwood's Gift
outcomes.text: The Heartwood drops a single seed on midwinter night, the first in a thousand years. The elves plant it in secret, and the Loremasters say a second Heartwood could weave a new Binding.

outcomes.title: Thieves in the Treasury of Veyl
outcomes.text: Thieves break into Veyl's treasury on midwinter night while the guards feast. They take the Republic's reserve of glass ducats, and the Glass Senate cannot pay its fleet.

outcomes.title: The Spire Speaks to All
outcomes.text: On midwinter night every living being in the world hears the Unbreathing's voice for a heartbeat. Kings wake screaming, and the next morning the Council of the Kingdoms meets in fear.

outcomes.title: A Pirate Feast
outcomes.text: The Brotherhood holds a great midwinter feast at Red Harbour, and the captains swear a new oath to Red Mara. The pirates are united again, and their spring raids will be fiercer than ever.

outcomes.title: A Wedding at Midwinter
outcomes.text: The heirs of Westmarch and Sunvale marry on midwinter night, binding the two southern kingdoms together. The other kingdoms watch a southern alliance rise.

outcomes.title: The Midwinter Raid on Barhythe
outcomes.text: Thornwatch's soldiers retake the ruined town of Barhythe in a midwinter raid, driving out the Horde's garrison. The Warden plants his banner on the ruins and swears never to lose it again.

outcomes.title: The Exiles' Midwinter Moot
outcomes.text: The Ashen Exiles' midwinter moot decides to send their warriors to fight for Thornwatch in exchange for land. A thousand orcs will stand on the wall in the spring.

outcomes.title: Snowbound Armies
outcomes.text: Snow traps an Aldermere army in the High Wilds' passes on its way north. Hundreds freeze, and the army arrives at the wall in spring half its size.

outcomes.title: A Hag-Queen's Death
outcomes.text: A Hag-Queen of Morrowgast dies in a midwinter rite gone wrong. Her death releases the Blessing on a town of the Coven, and its people go mad, killing each other until dawn.

outcomes.title: A Fire in the Deepholds' Forge
outcomes.text: A midwinter fire in Karak Dûm's great forge burns for a week. The dwarves lose their stores of steel, and the kingdoms waiting for dwarven arms must wait another season.

outcomes.title: An Elven Embassy to the Spire
outcomes.text: The Elderwood sends an embassy to the Blackspire to ask Malgrath what he wants. The envoys do not return, and the elves' last hope of peace dies.

outcomes.title: The Free Clans' Midwinter Raid
outcomes.text: The Free Clans cross the frozen lake on midwinter night and burn an Aldermere fort on the shore. The great houses demand the clans be destroyed, and the king hesitates.

outcomes.title: A Comet Falls
outcomes.text: A falling star crashes into the unruled hills of the Ashlands, leaving a crater and a lump of star-iron. Sunvale, Morrowgast and the Order all send soldiers to claim it.

outcomes.title: The Midwinter Market of Veyl
outcomes.text: Veyl holds a great midwinter market where merchants of every realm, even the Horde's agents, trade openly. The kingdoms of the Great Isle are outraged, and Veyl grows rich.

outcomes.title: The Lantern's Prophecy
outcomes.text: An old knight of the Lantern prophesies on midwinter night that the Order will die within a year unless it makes peace with the Conclave. The Grand Master sends envoys to the Tower of Stars.

outcomes.title: The Last Week of the Year
outcomes.text: The year 523 ends in snow and war. The Council of the Kingdoms meets at Aldermere to count the year's losses, and agrees on nothing but that the next year will be worse.

outcomes.title: A King Dies in His Sleep
outcomes.text: Westmarch's First Prince dies in his sleep at the year's end. The merchant princes elect a successor in a single night, and the guild halls say the election was bought.

outcomes.title: The Year's End Riots
outcomes.text: The poor of Aldermere's lake city riot at the year's end, burning the tax-collectors' office and the great houses' warehouses. The crown declares martial law.

outcomes.title: A New Order Founded
outcomes.text: A company of veterans of Thornwatch's wall found a new order, the Wardens of the Strait, sworn to defend the wall until the Spire falls. Young men from every kingdom take its vows.

outcomes.title: The Brotherhood's New Year
outcomes.text: The Brotherhood greets the new year by capturing the Westmarch treasure fleet in the Ostcombe Sea. Westmarch's merchant princes lose a year's profits, and Red Mara is richer than any king.

outcomes.title: A Hag-Queen Proclaims Herself Queen
outcomes.text: A Hag-Queen of Morrowgast kills her sisters at the year's end and proclaims herself Queen of the Coven. She rules alone, and her first order is war on Sunvale.

outcomes.title: The Dwarves' New Year Feast
outcomes.text: The Deepholds hold a great new year feast at Karak Dûm, inviting envoys from every realm. The Thane-King announces the reopening of Karak Varn, and the dwarves rejoice.

outcomes.title: An Elven Prince Returns
outcomes.text: An elven prince who left the Elderwood centuries ago returns from beyond the western sea with a fleet of silver ships. The elves are no longer alone, and the Spire takes notice.

outcomes.title: A Year's End Flood
outcomes.text: The ice on Lake Halmoor breaks in a sudden thaw and floods Aldermere's lower city. Thousands are homeless at the year's end, and the crown cannot help them.

outcomes.title: The Spire's New Year
outcomes.text: The Blackspire greets the new year with a black fire seen across the strait. The orc clans gather at its foot, and Thornwatch braces for the spring.

outcomes.title: A Merchant's Fortune
outcomes.text: A Veyl merchant who bought Sunvale's debts at a tenth of their value becomes the richest man in the world. He buys a lordship in Sunvale and a seat in Aldermere's council.

outcomes.title: A Saint's Relics Found
outcomes.text: The bones of Saint Anselm, founder of the Order of the Lantern, are found in a ruined shrine in the High Wilds. The Order and Hollowcrown's Prelacy fight over them.

outcomes.title: The Free Clans' Year
outcomes.text: The Free Clans greet the new year by burning an Aldermere fort in the fens. Their raiders are stronger than ever, and Aldermere's great houses demand peace or war.

outcomes.title: A Royal Pardon
outcomes.text: Aldermere's king pardons every outlaw who will fight on Thornwatch's wall. Thousands of bandits, deserters and Free Clans raiders march north, and the roads of the Great Isle are suddenly safe.

outcomes.title: A Year's End Plague
outcomes.text: A plague breaks out in Sunvale's capital at the year's end. The court flees, and the Coven's agents spread the rumour that it is the gods' punishment for Sunvale's sins.

outcomes.title: The Conclave's New Year
outcomes.text: The Conclave of the Lake opens its doors to students from every realm at the new year, offering to teach magic to any who can pay. The Order and Hollowcrown are outraged.

outcomes.title: A Winter Harvest in the East
outcomes.text: The Eastern Isle's winter harvest is the richest in memory. Veyl sells grain to the starving Great Isle at three times the price, and the kingdoms grumble but buy.

outcomes.title: A Hold Reclaimed
outcomes.text: The dwarves of the Deepholds reclaim a lost hold in the eastern mountains, driving out the beasts that lived there. The Deepholds grow, and their trade in iron revives.

outcomes.title: A Year's End Battle
outcomes.text: The Horde and Thornwatch fight a battle on the frozen strait at the year's end. Neither side wins, and both lose a thousand warriors to the ice.

outcomes.title: A New Year's Prophecy
outcomes.text: A prophet in Aldermere's lake city proclaims that the year 524 will see the Spire fall or the world end. The kingdoms prepare for both.

outcomes.title: The Thaw Comes Early
outcomes.text: An early thaw melts the strait's ice in the first week of the new year. The Horde's war-bands on the Great Isle's shore are cut off, and Thornwatch hunts them down one by one.

outcomes.title: A New King in Westmarch
outcomes.text: Westmarch's merchant princes elect a new First Prince, a young sea-captain who swears to destroy the Brotherhood. Westmarch's fleet is rebuilt, and the Ostcombe Sea braces for war.

outcomes.title: The Spring Floods Begin
outcomes.text: The snowmelt floods the rivers of the Great Isle. Aldermere's lake rises, Sunvale's lowlands drown and the spring sowing is delayed by a month.

outcomes.title: The Coven Calls a Truce
outcomes.text: Morrowgast's Hag-Queens call a truce with Sunvale to deal with a rebellion in their own north. Sunvale's eastern barons rebuild their villages, and the Order calls the truce a trick.

outcomes.title: A Plague of Frogs
outcomes.text: Frogs swarm out of Aldermere's fens in their millions, fouling the wells and the fields. The priests call it the Free Clans' witchcraft, and the great houses demand the fens be burned.

outcomes.title: The Elves Plant a New Heartwood
outcomes.text: The elves of the Elderwood plant the Heartwood's seed in a secret grove. The Loremasters say it will take a century to grow, but the Spire will not wait.

outcomes.title: A Merchant Fleet Lost
outcomes.text: A Veyl merchant fleet sailing to the Great Isle vanishes in a spring storm. The Glass Senate's banks lose a fortune, and Veyl's credit falls again.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Ambassador
outcomes.text: The Blackspire sends an ambassador to the Council of the Kingdoms offering peace: Thornwatch's coast for the Spire, the rest of the Great Isle free. The kingdoms are tempted.

outcomes.title: The Free Clans' New Queen
outcomes.text: The Free Clans' moot elects a new queen who swears to make peace with Aldermere. The fens war ends, and the clans return to their old fens.

outcomes.title: A Dwarven Army in the North
outcomes.text: The Deepholds send an army of three thousand dwarves to Thornwatch's wall. The dwarves rebuild the wall's towers in black granite, and the Horde's spring offensive will meet stone.

outcomes.title: A Rebellion in Hollowcrown's South
outcomes.text: The peasants of Hollowcrown's southern valleys rise against the Prelacy's war tithe. The Silver Guard must turn from the wall to crush them.

outcomes.title: A New Archmagister
outcomes.text: The Conclave of the Lake elects a new Archmagister who swears to fight the Spire with every spell the Tower knows. The battle-mages ride north, and the scholars go into exile.

outcomes.title: A Pirate Defeated
outcomes.text: Westmarch's new fleet defeats a Brotherhood squadron in the Ostcombe Sea. The pirates lose ten ships, and Westmarch's merchants sail again.

outcomes.title: The Order Marches North
outcomes.text: The Order of the Lantern's knights march north to Thornwatch's wall, abandoning their crusade against the Coven. The Spire is the greater enemy, the Grand Master says.

outcomes.title: A Bridge Rebuilt
outcomes.text: Aldermere and Westmarch rebuild the Lake Road's bridges together. Trade between them doubles, and the Concord's oldest quarrel cools.

outcomes.title: The Exiles' Champion
outcomes.text: A champion of the Ashen Exiles defeats a Horde war-chief in single combat on the strait's shore. The orcs of the Northern Isle hear of it, and more clans desert the Spire.

outcomes.title: A Fever in the Horde
outcomes.text: A fever spreads through the Horde's winter camps. Thousands of orcs die, and the Spire's spring offensive is delayed.

outcomes.title: A Royal Marriage Arranged
outcomes.text: Aldermere's heir is betrothed to a princess of Hollowcrown. The two kingdoms bind themselves together against the Spire, and Westmarch and Sunvale feel left out.

outcomes.title: A Gold Strike in the Ashlands
outcomes.text: Prospectors strike gold in the unruled Ashlands. Sunvale, Morrowgast and the brigands of the Ashlands all race to claim it.

outcomes.title: The Conclave and the Lantern Reconciled
outcomes.text: The Conclave of the Lake and the Order of the Lantern sign a pact: the Order will not hunt the Conclave's mages, and the Conclave will teach the Order to fight the Spire's sorcery.

outcomes.title: The Ferrymen's Strike
outcomes.text: The ferrymen and bargemen of Lake Halmoor strike against Aldermere's new boat-tax, mooring every hull across the lake's harbours. Grain cannot reach the lake city, the Conclave's island is cut off from the shore and the crown must bargain with men it has never noticed.

outcomes.title: The Prince Who Walked into the Ashlands
outcomes.text: A younger prince of Sunvale, sick of the court, rides into the unruled Ashlands with fifty companions and founds a frontier lordship there. He invites runaways and refugees to settle under his banner, and both Sunvale and Morrowgast must decide whether he is a rebel or a buffer.

outcomes.title: The Sea Wall of Bellhaven
outcomes.text: Westmarch's engineers finish a great sea wall around Bellhaven's harbour with chains that can close its mouth. The Brotherhood's raids on the capital end, and the merchant princes' confidence returns.

outcomes.title: The Twin Moons Omen
outcomes.text: A second, pale moon rises beside the first for three nights over the Eastern Isle. The elves say it is the Elder Age's lost star; the dwarves say it is a weapon of the Spire; Veyl's astronomers sell maps of its course.

outcomes.title: The Mapmakers of Veyl
outcomes.text: Veyl's guild of mapmakers publishes the first true chart of the known world, its coasts measured by glass instruments. Every captain wants one, every crown wants its borders drawn its way and the chart starts three quarrels over islands.

outcomes.title: A Speaking Stone in the High Wilds
outcomes.text: Shepherds in the unruled High Wilds find a standing stone that speaks in the Elder tongue when touched. Scholars of the Conclave, priests of the Flame and elven Loremasters race to hear it first.

outcomes.title: The Black Market of Kormouth
outcomes.text: The Westmarch port of Kormouth becomes the world's market for stolen goods, its lord paid to look away. Pirates, Horde agents and Veyl's bankers trade there openly, and Westmarch's council cannot agree to close it.

outcomes.title: The Elderwood Opens a Road
outcomes.text: The Elderwood opens a single road through its forest to human merchants for the first time in centuries, guarded by its rangers. Elven healing herbs and woodwork reach the Great Isle's markets and Veyl loses its monopoly.

outcomes.title: Orc Refugees on Hollowcrown's Coast
outcomes.text: Hundreds of orc families fleeing the Spire land on Hollowcrown's northern coast with nothing. The Prelacy wants them driven into the sea; the mountain lords want them as labourers in the silver mines, and the realm divides over them.

outcomes.title: An Alchemist's Powder
outcomes.text: An alchemist of Veyl creates a black powder that burns with a thunderclap. The Glass Senate buys his secret and keeps it, but rumours spread, and every kingdom's spies set out to steal it.

outcomes.title: The Thornwatch Tithe Revolt
outcomes.text: Thornwatch's fishermen and farmers refuse the Warden's war tithe, saying the wall protects the south and the south should pay for it. The Warden must beg the Council of the Kingdoms for gold or squeeze his own people further.

outcomes.title: A Hidden Valley of the Deepholds
outcomes.text: Dwarven scouts find a hidden valley in the eastern mountains, warm with hot springs and rich soil. The Deepholds settle it, growing their own grain for the first time and ending their need of Veyl's harvests.

outcomes.title: The Pilgrim Road Bandits
outcomes.text: Bandits prey on the pilgrims walking to the Silver Flame, robbing and killing them in the mountain passes. Hollowcrown's Silver Guard must turn from the wall to guard the pilgrim road.

outcomes.title: The Lake Kingdom's Envoy
outcomes.text: The Free Clans send an envoy to Veyl, and the Glass Senate receives her as the ambassador of a free people. Aldermere protests, and Veyl lends the Clans money for boats.

outcomes.title: A Great Hunt of the Ashlands
outcomes.text: Sunvale's nobles hold a great hunt in the Ashlands for the Blessed beasts that roam there. They kill dozens, lose twenty knights and bring home a Blessed bear the size of a cart, which the king keeps in a cage at Solenne.

outcomes.title: The Silent Monks
outcomes.text: A brotherhood of monks who have taken a vow of silence settles in an unruled valley between Aldermere and Hollowcrown. They heal the sick of both realms and answer no questions; both crowns suspect them of spying.

outcomes.title: The Ice Shelf Breaks
outcomes.text: A great shelf of ice breaks from the Northern Isle's frozen coast and drifts into the strait. It blocks the passage for a month, cutting the Horde off from the south and Thornwatch off from its raids.

outcomes.title: A Fleet of Fishing Kings
outcomes.text: The fishing towns of Westmarch's southern coast band together into a league and refuse the merchant princes' fish taxes. They hire their own guards and sell their catch directly to Sunvale.

outcomes.title: The Earthquake of Caras Ithrael
outcomes.text: An earthquake shakes the Elderwood and topples a quarter of Caras Ithrael's tree-halls. The Heartwood stands, but the elves lose libraries older than any kingdom of men.

outcomes.title: A Horde Princess Flees
outcomes.text: A daughter of a great Horde war-chief flees the Northern Isle to Thornwatch to escape a marriage to one of the Spire's Voices. She brings knowledge of the Horde's chiefs, and her father swears to take her back.

outcomes.title: The Gilded Lances Take a Castle
outcomes.text: The Gilded Lances, unpaid by Westmarch, seize a border castle on the Lake Road and declare it their own. They offer their swords to any crown that will pay their arrears and recognise them as lords.

outcomes.title: Aldermere's Chancellor Arrested
outcomes.text: Aldermere's Lord Chancellor is arrested in council on the king's orders, accused of selling the realm's secrets to Westmarch. His party in the great houses takes up arms, and the lake city's streets fill with liveried retainers.

outcomes.title: A Sickness of the Vines
outcomes.text: A fungus spreads through Sunvale's vineyards and kills the old vines on half the Riviera. The vintners' guild faces ruin and Sunvale's richest trade withers for a decade.

outcomes.title: The Heartwood's Chosen Walks Out
outcomes.text: A child of the Heartwood's line walks out of the Elderwood and across the sea to Thornwatch alone, saying the Heartwood sent her. The elves send rangers after her; the Warden does not know whether she is a weapon or a hostage.

outcomes.title: The Orc Market
outcomes.text: Thornwatch opens a market on the strait's shore where free orcs of the Northern Isle may trade furs and iron for grain. It is the first peaceful trade across the strait in a thousand years, and the Spire forbids it on pain of death.

outcomes.title: The Coven Builds a Fleet
outcomes.text: Morrowgast launches its first war-fleet, galleys crewed by Blessed oarsmen who never tire. The Coven can now raid Sunvale's coast as well as its border, and the Brotherhood finds a rival on its own sea.

outcomes.title: Bridges of the Deep Road
outcomes.text: The Deepholds finish a great underground road linking their holds, so that no dwarf need walk under the sky to cross the eastern mountains. Trade between the holds doubles, and the dwarves care less than ever for the world above.

outcomes.title: The Mage Who Spoke to the Spire
outcomes.text: A master of the Conclave admits she has been speaking with Malgrath through a black mirror, trying to learn how to bind him. The Tower is split over whether she is a traitor or the world's best hope.

outcomes.title: A Plague of Moths
outcomes.text: Swarms of grey moths devour the wool stores of Aldermere's lake towns. The cloth trade collapses for a season, and the weavers blame the Free Clans' hag-witches.

outcomes.title: The Brotherhood Buys a Saint
outcomes.text: Red Mara buys the bones of a Silver Flame saint from a ruined shrine and enshrines them in Red Harbour, inviting pilgrims. Hollowcrown's Prelacy declares her excommunicate, and pilgrims come anyway.

outcomes.title: The Thornshaw Lighthouse
outcomes.text: Westmarch builds a great lighthouse on the Thornshaw coast, ending a century of shipwrecks on its reefs. Trade on the western sea grows, and the wreckers of the coast turn to piracy instead.

outcomes.title: A King's Bastard Legitimised
outcomes.text: Aldermere's king legitimises his bastard son and names him heir. The great houses who hoped for the crown are outraged, and two of them begin raising armies.

outcomes.title: The Winter Fair of Thornwatch
outcomes.text: Thornwatch holds a fair on the frozen strait itself, with tents on the ice and orcs of the free clans trading beside men. It lasts a week before the Horde attacks it; the free orcs fight beside Thornwatch's men.

outcomes.title: A Deep Study Book Stolen
outcomes.text: A book of the Conclave's Deep Study, describing the rite that made Malgrath undying, is stolen from the Tower of Stars. The Conclave hunts the thief across the Great Isle, and every court fears who holds it.

outcomes.title: Hollowcrown's New Tithe-Barns
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's Prelacy builds great tithe-barns in every valley and stores the realm's grain against famine. The peasants grumble at the tithe, but when the next hard winter comes, Hollowcrown alone does not starve.

outcomes.title: The Coven's Healers
outcomes.text: Morrowgast sends healers to Sunvale's plague-stricken east, curing hundreds with witch-medicine. Sunvale's villages begin to look east with gratitude, and the court in Solenne is alarmed.

outcomes.title: A Duel for the Ashlands
outcomes.text: Champions of Sunvale and Morrowgast fight a duel in the Ashlands to settle a border dispute without war. The Coven's champion wins, and Sunvale's court must decide whether to honour the result.

outcomes.title: The Elder Road Uncovered
outcomes.text: Floods in the Ashlands uncover a paved Elder Age road running from Sunvale's border straight to Morrowgast's capital. Both realms see an invasion route, and both race to fortify it.

outcomes.title: A New Breed of Horse
outcomes.text: Sunvale's horse-breeders cross Ashlands wild horses with Riviera mares and breed a war-horse faster than any in the world. Every kingdom wants them, and Sunvale's barons grow rich selling them.

outcomes.title: The Exiles' Treaty with the Dwarves
outcomes.text: The Ashen Exiles sign a treaty with the Deepholds: orc warriors to guard dwarven caravans on the Northern Isle in exchange for steel. The Spire's enemies are learning to work together.

outcomes.title: The Fall of Kormouth
outcomes.text: A fleet of pirates and smugglers seizes the Westmarch port of Kormouth and declares it a free city ruled by its captains. Westmarch's council must choose between a costly siege and accepting a pirate city on its own coast.

outcomes.title: Sunvale's Grand Ministry Falls
outcomes.text: Sunvale's king dismisses the whole Grand Ministry after a scandal over sold offices, and rules through a council of barons. The court's old factions flee to Veyl, taking the treasury's records with them.

outcomes.title: The Northern Isle's Ice Giants
outcomes.text: Giants of ice and stone come down from the Northern Isle's frozen north and attack the Horde's northern camps. The orcs flee south, and the Spire turns its sorcery against the giants.

outcomes.title: A Marriage of Orcs and Men
outcomes.text: A captain of Thornwatch's wall marries a daughter of the Ashen Exiles' chief. The wedding scandalises the south, but it binds the Exiles to the wall, and other marriages follow.

outcomes.title: The Glass Plague Returns
outcomes.text: The sickness that turns skin to glass returns to Veyl's furnace quarters. The Glass Senate closes the furnaces, Veyl's trade stops and its glassmakers flee to the Great Isle.

outcomes.title: The Silver Flame Divided
outcomes.text: A great council of Hollowcrown's priests splits over whether the Silver Flame permits magic in the war against the Spire. The Prelacy divides into two churches, and Hollowcrown's people must choose.

outcomes.title: A Monster in the Ostcombe Sea
outcomes.text: A sea monster with the head of a horse and the tail of a serpent attacks ships in the Ostcombe Sea. Pirates and merchants alike stay in harbour, and the southern sea's trade stops for a month.

outcomes.title: A Hidden City of the Elves
outcomes.text: Elven rangers find a hidden city of their own people in the unruled forests of the Eastern Isle's north, cut off since the Fading began. The Elderwood is no longer alone, and its people are twice as many.

outcomes.title: The Westmarch Road
outcomes.text: Westmarch builds a new road to Hollowcrown through the unruled hills, avoiding Aldermere's Lake Road tolls. Aldermere's council calls it an act of hostility and sends soldiers to the hills.

outcomes.title: A Comet Strikes the Northern Isle
outcomes.text: A falling star strikes the Northern Isle near the Blackspire, shaking the whole island. The Spire's black light flickers for a week, and the orc clans say the heavens have turned against Malgrath.

outcomes.title: The Conclave's Floating Island
outcomes.text: The Conclave of the Lake raises the isle of Wyn out of Lake Halmoor on a column of stone, so no army can reach the Tower of Stars. Aldermere's court is terrified of what else the mages can do.

outcomes.title: The Thane-King's Pilgrimage
outcomes.text: The Thane-King of Karak Dûm makes a pilgrimage to the Heartwood, the first dwarven king to do so in a thousand years. The Pact of Root and Stone is renewed with an oath of war against the Spire.

outcomes.title: A Bandit Queen in Westmarch
outcomes.text: A bandit queen called Black Sal unites the outlaws of Westmarch's forests and robs the merchant princes' convoys. The poor of the west call her their champion, and the princes hire a small army to hunt her.

outcomes.title: The Morrowgast Exodus
outcomes.text: Thousands of Morrowgast's people who refused the Blessing flee west across the Ashlands into Sunvale. Sunvale's court does not know whether to welcome them or turn them back, and the Coven calls them traitors.

outcomes.title: A Great Shipyard in Veyl
outcomes.text: Veyl builds the greatest shipyard in the world, launching a war-galley every week. The Republic's fleet doubles in a season, and the Brotherhood and Westmarch watch with fear.

outcomes.title: The First Orc Knight
outcomes.text: Thornwatch's Warden knights an orc of the Ashen Exiles for holding a tower alone against a Horde war-band. Southern nobles are scandalised, and orcs across the Northern Isle hear of it.

outcomes.title: A Famine in the Ashlands
outcomes.text: The Ashlands' brigands and refugees starve in a hard winter. They raid Sunvale and Morrowgast alike for food, and both realms send soldiers into the Ashlands.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Ambassador to Veyl
outcomes.text: The Blackspire sends an ambassador to Veyl to buy steel and ships. The Glass Senate refuses publicly and sells privately, and the kingdoms' spies discover it.

outcomes.title: A Great Wedding in Hollowcrown
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's heir marries a daughter of Thornwatch's Warden in the Silver Flame's own shrine. The two northern realms bind themselves together for the war.

outcomes.title: A Lost Legion Returns
outcomes.text: A legion of Aldermere's soldiers, lost on the Northern Isle in a raid years ago, marches back across the frozen strait having survived in the wilds. They bring knowledge of the Northern Isle's paths, and a hatred of the Spire beyond any other.

outcomes.title: The Salt Road Opens
outcomes.text: Merchants of Sunvale and Hollowcrown open a new road for salt through the unruled hills between them, bypassing Aldermere's tolls. Caravans of salt and silver pass in both directions, and Aldermere's council sends riders to claim the hills the road crosses.

outcomes.title: A Plot of the Great Houses
outcomes.text: Three great houses of Aldermere are caught plotting to replace the king with a council of lords. Their leaders are arrested at a feast, their castles besieged, and the realm spends the spring at war with its own nobility.

outcomes.title: The Fens Burn Blue
outcomes.text: Strange blue fires burn across Aldermere's fens at night, and the Free Clans say the spirits of the marsh have woken. Aldermere's soldiers refuse to patrol the fens after dark, and the clans move freely again.

outcomes.title: The Orc Who Would Be King
outcomes.text: A young war-chief of the Horde's southern clans kills the Spire's overseer in his camp and proclaims himself king of the southern coast. He sends envoys to Thornwatch and the Exiles, and the Spire sends its Voices to destroy him.

outcomes.title: The Grain Ships of the East
outcomes.text: Veyl sends a great grain fleet to the starving Great Isle, selling at a price the poor can pay for the first time in a year. The Republic's name is blessed in every market, and the kingdoms' grain-hoarders are ruined.

outcomes.title: The Tower Takes an Apprentice
outcomes.text: The Conclave of the Lake takes a peasant boy from Aldermere's fens as an apprentice, the first commoner in its history. The great houses are scandalised, and the Free Clans send their brightest children to the Tower's shore.

outcomes.title: An Avalanche in Thornwatch's Passes
outcomes.text: An avalanche buries the mountain pass between Thornwatch and Hollowcrown under a village's worth of snow. The wall's supply road is cut, and Thornwatch must be fed by sea until the spring.

outcomes.title: The Exiles' Navy
outcomes.text: The Ashen Exiles launch a fleet of thirty longships built with Thornwatch's timber. For the first time the Horde's coast is raided from the sea by orcs who are not its own.

outcomes.title: Blight in Westmarch's Orchards
outcomes.text: A grey blight kills the apple and pear orchards of Westmarch's inland valleys. The cider towns are ruined, and their people drift to Bellhaven looking for work that is not there.

outcomes.title: The Lady of the Lake
outcomes.text: A woman claiming to be the spirit of Lake Halmoor appears on the shore of Wyn and speaks prophecies to fishermen. The Conclave cannot explain her, Hollowcrown's priests call her a demon and pilgrims come from every realm to hear her.

outcomes.title: A Rich Wreck on the Salt Isles' Reefs
outcomes.text: A Veyl treasure ship founders on the reefs of the Salt Isles. The Brotherhood strips it of a fortune in glass ducats, and Veyl demands its gold back or war.

outcomes.title: The Coven's Seventh Seat
outcomes.text: The Hag-Queens of Morrowgast offer the seventh seat of their circle, left empty by a death, to a commoner of the Coven-Realm. The offer is unheard of; Morrowgast's people are stirred, and the Order says it is a trick.

outcomes.title: The Dwarves' Water Engine
outcomes.text: Dwarven engineers build an engine that pumps water from the deep mines using the heat of the forges. The Deepholds' mines go deeper than ever, and their output of iron doubles.

outcomes.title: The Elderwood's Ambassador Murdered
outcomes.text: The Elderwood's ambassador to Aldermere is found dead in her rooms, an orc arrow in her heart. The elves suspect it was not an orc who shot it, and recall their healers from the Great Isle.

outcomes.title: The Western Storms
outcomes.text: A season of storms wrecks the fishing fleets of Westmarch's coast. The fishing towns starve, and the merchant princes' convoys are delayed for a month.

outcomes.title: The Prophetess of the Ashlands
outcomes.text: A girl in the unruled Ashlands begins to prophesy, and refugees, brigands and runaway Blessed gather around her. She preaches peace between Sunvale and Morrowgast, and both realms fear her.

outcomes.title: The Iron Wolves' Fortress
outcomes.text: The band of escaped slaves called the Iron Wolves takes an abandoned Horde fortress in the Northern Isle's mountains and fortifies it. Hundreds of escaped slaves flock to it, and the Spire sends an army.

outcomes.title: A Treaty of Marriage in the East
outcomes.text: The Deepholds and Veyl seal their alliance with the marriage of a dwarven prince and a Veyl banker's daughter. The Elderwood, not consulted, watches the Eastern Isle's balance shift.

outcomes.title: The Lake City's Plague Pits
outcomes.text: A spotted fever spreads through Aldermere's lake city, and the crown digs plague pits outside the walls. The court flees to the hills and the lower city is left to the dying.

outcomes.title: The Horde's Iron Fleet
outcomes.text: The Horde launches longships with iron prows forged in the Spire's own furnaces. They ram and sink Thornwatch's patrol galleys, and the strait belongs to the orcs again.

outcomes.title: The Flood of the Riviera
outcomes.text: Spring storms drive the sea over Sunvale's Riviera coast, flooding the vineyards and the palaces of Solenne. The court's summer palace is drowned, and the king moves his court inland.

outcomes.title: Thornwatch's Warden Captured
outcomes.text: The Warden of Thornwatch is captured by a Horde war-band in a raid on the strait's shore and carried to the Northern Isle. His captains rule the wall in his name, and the Spire sends terms for his release.

outcomes.title: The Brigands of Hollowcrown's Passes
outcomes.text: Outlaws seize a fortress in Hollowcrown's high passes and toll every caravan that crosses. The Prelacy's soldiers are on Thornwatch's wall, and the mountain lords are paid to look away.

outcomes.title: The Ice Palace of the North
outcomes.text: The Spire raises a palace of black ice on the Northern Isle's southern shore, facing Thornwatch across the strait. Malgrath's Voices hold court there, and orc chiefs come to kneel.

outcomes.title: A Duel of Princes
outcomes.text: Two princes of Sunvale's royal house fight a duel over the succession in the palace gardens. One dies, the other flees to Veyl, and the old king has no heir he trusts.

outcomes.title: The Conclave's Peace Envoy
outcomes.text: The Conclave of the Lake sends envoys to the Blackspire to learn what Malgrath wants. One returns, speaking in another voice; the Tower locks him in its deepest room and studies him.

outcomes.title: The Wild Horse Wars
outcomes.text: Sunvale's barons and Morrowgast's Blessed fight over the wild horse herds of the Ashlands. Hundreds die, and the herds scatter into the hills where neither side can catch them.

outcomes.title: The Free Clans' Witch
outcomes.text: An exiled Hag of Morrowgast teaches the Free Clans to curse their enemies. Aldermere's soldiers in the fens fall sick, their bows warp and their horses go lame, and the great houses demand a crusade.

outcomes.title: The Guild Wars of Veyl
outcomes.text: Veyl's glassmakers and lamp-blowers fight in the streets over the right to sell in the great market. The Glass Senate's guards cannot stop them, and the Republic's trade suffers.

outcomes.title: The Lake Kraken
outcomes.text: A kraken rises in Lake Halmoor and drags lake boats under. The Conclave says it came up through the lake's deep caves from the sea, and the crown begs the Tower to kill it.

outcomes.title: The Thornwatch Refugees
outcomes.text: Thousands of refugees from Thornwatch's burned coast flee south into Aldermere. The great houses refuse to take them in, and the crown must feed them or watch them starve.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Peace Offer
outcomes.text: The Blackspire offers the Council of the Kingdoms a ten-year peace: the strait for the Spire, the Great Isle untouched. The kingdoms are tempted, and Thornwatch is horrified.

outcomes.title: The Stone Giants of the East
outcomes.text: Giants of stone come down from the unruled mountains of the Eastern Isle and smash a dwarven caravan. The Deepholds send an army after them, and the giants vanish into the peaks.

outcomes.title: A Pirate Turns Admiral
outcomes.text: A Brotherhood captain accepts a pardon from Westmarch and takes command of its fleet against her old comrades. Red Mara puts a price on her head, and the Ostcombe Sea becomes a war of former friends.

outcomes.title: The Silver Mines' Strike
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's silver miners strike for higher pay, closing the mines. The Prelacy cannot pay its soldiers, and the war tithe is doubled on the peasants.

outcomes.title: The Elves' Last Ship
outcomes.text: The last elven ship leaves the Eastern Isle for the west, carrying elves who will not stay to see the Fading's end. The Lady of the Elderwood stays, and swears to fight.

outcomes.title: The Bandits of the Lake Road
outcomes.text: With the Lake Road's toll-forts abandoned, bandits rob every convoy that passes. Aldermere and Westmarch agree to clear the road together, the first thing they have agreed on in a year.

outcomes.title: The Coven's Envoy to Veyl
outcomes.text: Morrowgast sends an envoy to Veyl to borrow gold for its war. The Glass Senate lends it, and the kingdoms of the Great Isle learn that Veyl is funding both sides.

outcomes.title: A Great Fire in Red Harbour
outcomes.text: A fire sweeps through Red Harbour, burning the Brotherhood's warehouses and half its ships. Red Mara blames Westmarch's agents and swears revenge.

outcomes.title: The Heartwood's Second Seed
outcomes.text: The Heartwood drops a second seed, and the elves plant it on the Great Isle, in an unruled forest of Aldermere's south. Aldermere's lords do not know whether to guard it or claim it.

outcomes.title: The Lovers' War
outcomes.text: A prince of Westmarch elopes with the betrothed of Aldermere's heir, and Aldermere's knights ride to bring her back. Border skirmishes break out along the Lake Road, and the Concord's council must make peace.

outcomes.title: A Hag-Queen Turns to the Flame
outcomes.text: A Hag-Queen of Morrowgast converts to the Silver Flame and preaches against the Blessing in the Coven's own towns. Thousands of Morrowgast's people listen, and the Coven sends assassins after her.

outcomes.title: The Plague of Sleep
outcomes.text: A sickness spreads through Sunvale's east that makes its victims sleep and never wake. The court blames the Coven's witchcraft, and the Order of the Lantern sends knights to hunt the witches responsible.

outcomes.title: The Free Port of the Ashlands
outcomes.text: The brigand lord of the Ashlands opens a free market on the coast where pirates, smugglers and refugees can trade. The Ashlands become rich, and both Sunvale and Morrowgast covet them.

outcomes.title: The Ironworks of Thornwatch
outcomes.text: Thornwatch builds great ironworks on its coast with dwarven help, forging its own weapons for the wall. The Wardenmark grows rich on war, and its smiths become a power in its council.

outcomes.title: An Orc Prince at Aldermere
outcomes.text: A son of the Ashen Exiles' chief is sent to Aldermere's court as a hostage and an envoy. The court is scandalised, the people come to stare and the young orc learns the ways of men.

outcomes.title: The Great Wind
outcomes.text: A wind of terrible force sweeps across the Great Isle for three days, tearing roofs off houses and sinking ships. Every realm counts its damage, and the harvest is threatened.

outcomes.title: The Order Elects a Woman
outcomes.text: The knights of the Lantern elect a woman as Grand Master for the first time in the Order's history. She swears to bring the Order back to its founder's vows, and half the old knights leave.

outcomes.title: The Wreckers of the Strait
outcomes.text: Coastal folk of Thornwatch light false beacons to lure Horde longships onto the rocks, then strip the wrecks. The Horde swears vengeance on the whole coast.

outcomes.title: The Deepholds' Underground Lake
outcomes.text: Dwarven miners break into a vast underground lake beneath the eastern mountains, glowing with pale light. The Remembrancers say it is the lost sea of the Elder Age, and the Deepholds build boats.

outcomes.title: The Assassination of a Banker
outcomes.text: Veyl's richest banker is assassinated in the Glass Senate. His heirs fight over his fortune, the banks freeze their loans and the kingdoms that owe him rejoice.

outcomes.title: A Treaty of the Wall
outcomes.text: The kingdoms of the Great Isle sign the Treaty of the Wall: every realm will pay a share of Thornwatch's defence. For the first time, the wall is the Great Isle's, not just Thornwatch's.

outcomes.title: The Bandits of the Eastern Wilds
outcomes.text: Outlaws from Veyl and the Deepholds band together in the Eastern Isle's unruled wilds and raid both realms' caravans. The Republic and the dwarves must hunt them together.

outcomes.title: A Comet of Blood
