outcomes.text: A red comet hangs over Morrowgast for a week. The Coven's Hag-Queens say it is the sign of their victory, and the Blessed host marches toward the Ashlands.

outcomes.title: The Pilgrim Plague
outcomes.text: A plague spreads among the pilgrims to the Silver Flame and is carried home to every realm. The Prelacy closes the shrine, and Hollowcrown's people blame the Coven.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Prisoner Escapes
outcomes.text: An elven ranger held in the Blackspire for a year escapes and reaches Thornwatch. She brings news of the Spire's weaknesses, and the Council of the Kingdoms plans a raid.

outcomes.title: The Fishing Wars
outcomes.text: Fishermen of Westmarch and Sunvale fight over the shoals of the Ostcombe Sea. Several boats are sunk, and both crowns send warships to protect their fishermen.

outcomes.title: The Conclave's School
outcomes.text: The Conclave of the Lake opens a school for mages on the shore of Lake Halmoor, teaching any who can pay. The Order of the Lantern calls it a school of witches, and the Prelacy forbids its people to attend.

outcomes.title: The Drowned Village
outcomes.text: A village on Aldermere's lake shore sinks into the lake overnight, its people and houses gone. The Conclave says the lake's bed has collapsed; the people say the lake is hungry.

outcomes.title: The Horde's Civil War
outcomes.text: Two great war-chiefs of the Horde fight for command of the Spire's armies. Their clans fight each other on the Northern Isle, and the Spire's spring offensive is delayed.

outcomes.title: The Spring Muster
outcomes.text: Every kingdom of the Great Isle musters its soldiers for the spring campaign against the Spire. Armies march north along every road, and the farmers fear for their spring sowing.

outcomes.title: A Kingdom Sold
outcomes.text: A small lordship on Sunvale's coast is sold to the Brotherhood for a chest of gold. The pirates become lords, and the Grand Ministry cannot undo the sale.

outcomes.title: The Cursed Wells
outcomes.text: The wells of a dozen villages in Sunvale's east turn black and poisonous. The court blames the Coven, the Coven blames the Order and the villages are abandoned.

outcomes.title: The Dwarf Who Walked Under the Sea
outcomes.text: A dwarven miner emerges on Thornwatch's coast from a tunnel under the sea, having walked from the Eastern Isle in the dark. The Deepholds have a secret road to the Great Isle, and every kingdom wants it.

outcomes.title: The Rebellion of the Wool Towns
outcomes.text: Aldermere's wool towns rebel against the crown's war taxes, closing their gates. The great houses must choose between the crown and their own towns.

outcomes.title: The Ashen Exiles' Kingdom
outcomes.text: The Ashen Exiles proclaim their islet a kingdom and their chief its king. The Great Isle's kingdoms are asked to recognise it, and the Horde swears to destroy it.

outcomes.title: The Flood of the High Wilds
outcomes.text: The snowmelt floods the High Wilds' valleys, washing away villages and the gold-camps of the prospectors. Hundreds drown, and the gold-fields are buried under mud.

outcomes.title: The Lantern Burns Black
outcomes.text: The Order of the Lantern's lantern burns with a black flame for a night. The knights say it is the Spire's work, and the Order marches north to the wall.

outcomes.title: The Veyl Embargo
outcomes.text: Veyl refuses to trade with Aldermere until its debts are paid. Aldermere's markets empty of Veyl's glass and grain, and the great houses demand the crown pay or fight.

outcomes.title: A Prince of the Elderwood
outcomes.text: An elven prince of the Heartwood's line comes of age and is named heir to the Elderwood. He swears to lead the elves against the Spire himself.

outcomes.title: The Brotherhood Raids Bellhaven
outcomes.text: The Brotherhood's fleet raids Bellhaven's harbour at night, burning the merchant princes' ships. Westmarch's council swears to destroy the Salt Isles.

outcomes.title: The Coven's Peace Embassy
outcomes.text: Morrowgast's Hag-Queens send an embassy to Solenne offering peace and an alliance against the Spire. Sunvale's court is divided, and the Order threatens to march on Solenne if it is accepted.

outcomes.title: The Iron Shortage
outcomes.text: With the Horde's iron cut off and the Deepholds' mines flooded, iron becomes scarce across the world. Smiths cannot make weapons, and the armies on the wall go short of arrows.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Voices Divided
outcomes.text: Two of the Spire's Voices quarrel over the war's command, and one flees the Blackspire with a hundred orcs. He offers his knowledge to Thornwatch in exchange for his life.

outcomes.title: The Great Market of Thornwatch
outcomes.text: Thornwatch holds a great market for the soldiers of every kingdom on the wall. Merchants come from every realm, and the Wardenmark grows rich.

outcomes.title: A Royal Pardon in Sunvale
outcomes.text: Sunvale's king pardons the eastern barons who rebelled, and makes their leader Grand Minister. The court's old factions flee, and Sunvale is united for the first time in years.

outcomes.title: The Mountain Fever
outcomes.text: A fever spreads through Hollowcrown's mountain villages, killing the old and the young. The Prelacy's priests cannot stop it, and the mountain lords blame them.

outcomes.title: A New Island Rises
outcomes.text: A new island rises from the sea west of the Salt Isles in a burst of fire and steam. The Brotherhood, Westmarch and Sunvale all claim it.

outcomes.title: The Wolf-Riders
outcomes.text: Orc wolf-riders of the Horde cross the strait and raid deep into Thornwatch's hills. The wall's garrison cannot catch them, and the hill villages are abandoned.

outcomes.title: The Conclave's Spy
outcomes.text: A master of the Conclave is found to be spying for the Spire. He is executed on Wyn, and the Tower's secrets are changed.

outcomes.title: The Battle of the Strait
outcomes.text: The fleets of Thornwatch, the Elderwood and the Ashen Exiles meet the Horde's iron fleet in the strait. The battle lasts a day, and when it ends the strait belongs to the allies.

outcomes.title: A Queen Abdicates
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's queen abdicates in favour of her daughter and retires to a convent of the Silver Flame. The Prelacy rules as regent, and the mountain lords swear they will not be ruled by priests.

outcomes.title: The Rat King of Aldermere
outcomes.text: A beggar who calls himself the Rat King unites the thieves and beggars of Aldermere's lower city. They rule the streets, and the crown's officers must pay them to collect taxes.

outcomes.title: The Order Takes a Coven Town
outcomes.text: The knights of the Lantern storm a fortified town of Morrowgast and burn its Hag's tower. The Coven swears vengeance, and the Blessed host marches on Lanternhold.

outcomes.title: The Veyl Glass Shortage
outcomes.text: A fire in Veyl's great furnaces stops the Republic's glass production. The price of glass doubles across the world, and Veyl's banks call in their loans.

outcomes.title: The Thane-King's Voyage
outcomes.text: The Thane-King of Karak Dûm sails to Thornwatch to see the wall himself, the first dwarven king to visit the Great Isle in a thousand years. He promises more dwarves, and asks for iron mines in return.

outcomes.title: The Westmarch Blight
outcomes.text: A blight kills the wheat of Westmarch's lowlands. The breadbasket of the Great Isle has nothing to sell, and famine threatens every realm.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Bride Returns
outcomes.text: A princess of Aldermere, taken by the Spire's agents years ago, returns to Aldermere's court with a child she says is Malgrath's heir. The court is horrified, and the Conclave takes the child.

outcomes.title: The Hag-Queens' Rite
outcomes.text: Morrowgast's Hag-Queens work a great rite in the Coven Hollow, and the earth shakes for a day. The Blessed host grows stronger, and Sunvale's eastern barons send for help.

outcomes.title: An Orc Saint Martyred
outcomes.text: An orc of the Ashen Exiles who took the vows of the Silver Flame is killed by Horde raiders. Hollowcrown's priests proclaim him a saint, and orcs of the Exiles begin to convert.

outcomes.title: The Pirate Isle
outcomes.text: The Brotherhood builds a fortress on an unruled island west of the Salt Isles. The pirates have a second base, and their raids reach Westmarch's western coast.

outcomes.title: A Wedding of the Wall
outcomes.text: The heirs of Thornwatch and the Ashen Exiles marry, binding orcs and men together on the wall. The south is scandalised, and the Horde swears to destroy them both.

outcomes.title: The Snow Wolves
outcomes.text: White wolves come down from the High Wilds and kill travellers on the roads of Aldermere and Hollowcrown. The kings offer a bounty, and hunters flood the mountains.

outcomes.title: The Conclave's Victory
outcomes.text: The Conclave's battle-mages destroy a Horde war-band on Thornwatch's coast with a fire-storm. The orcs flee, and the Conclave's reputation is restored.

outcomes.title: The Grain Riots of Solenne
outcomes.text: Solenne's poor riot for bread when the court's grain ships are taken by pirates. The palace guard fires on the crowd, and Sunvale's people turn against the crown.

outcomes.title: A Lost City Found
outcomes.text: Explorers of Veyl find a lost Elder Age city in the unruled jungles of the Eastern Isle's south. It is full of treasure and danger, and every realm sends adventurers.

outcomes.title: The Deep Sickness
outcomes.text: A sickness spreads through the Deepholds from the newly opened mines. Dwarves who go below come back grey and silent, and the Thane-King seals the new mines.

outcomes.title: The Lake Kingdom Recognised
outcomes.text: Aldermere recognises the Free Clans as a free people with their own moot and two fens. The fens war ends, and the clans' warriors march north to the wall.

outcomes.title: The Bandit Lord of the West
outcomes.text: A disgraced knight of Westmarch gathers outlaws in the western forests and robs the merchant princes' convoys. The poor of the west call him a hero.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Herald Speaks
outcomes.text: A herald of the Blackspire stands on the Northern Isle's shore and calls across the strait to Thornwatch's wall: surrender, and live. The wall answers with arrows.

outcomes.title: The Goblin Warrens
outcomes.text: Goblins, a people the Great Isle thought long gone, pour out of warrens under the unruled High Wilds and raid the mountain villages of Aldermere and Hollowcrown at night. They take grain, iron and children, and nobody knows how many of them are down there.

outcomes.title: The False Prince
outcomes.text: A young man appears in Sunvale's east claiming to be a prince of the royal house thought drowned as a boy. He has the family's eyes and a ring nobody can explain; the eastern barons rally to him and Solenne's court calls him an impostor.

outcomes.title: The Werewolf of Chelbridge
outcomes.text: A beast that walks like a man kills shepherds around the Aldermere town of Chelbridge every full moon. The town's lord hangs a stranger; the killings go on, and the Order of the Lantern sends a knight who says the curse runs in a noble house.

outcomes.title: The Tournament of the Lake
outcomes.text: Aldermere's king holds the first great tournament in a generation on the shore of Lake Halmoor to raise knights for the north. Champions of every realm come, an orc of the Ashen Exiles wins the melee and the south is scandalised.

outcomes.title: The Red Tide
outcomes.text: The waters of the Ostcombe Sea turn red with a poison that kills the fish and sickens anyone who eats shellfish. The fishing towns of Westmarch, Aldermere and Sunvale go hungry for a season, and the priests call it a sign.

outcomes.title: The Freeing of the Serfs
outcomes.text: Westmarch's council frees every serf on the merchant princes' estates to win the guilds' support and raise a free army. Serfs in Aldermere and Sunvale hear of it and begin to run west.

outcomes.title: The Harpies of the Salt Isles
outcomes.text: Harpies nesting on the cliffs of an outlying Salt Isle begin attacking the Brotherhood's ships, carrying sailors off the rigging. Red Mara offers a fortune for their nests, and pirates turn hunters.

outcomes.title: The Crown of Aldric
outcomes.text: Labourers digging new foundations in Aldermere's old city uncover the lost crown of Aldric the Founder. Whoever wears it, the old songs say, rules the Great Isle; three great houses claim the right to keep it.

outcomes.title: The Mercenary Betrayal
outcomes.text: The free company Thornwatch hired to hold the wall's western towers sells them to the Horde for a chest of Spire gold. Orcs pour through before the Warden's own men can retake the towers.

outcomes.title: A Child Born Speaking
outcomes.text: A child is born in a Hollowcrown mountain village able to speak, and it names the day the Silver Flame will be tested. The Prelacy takes the child into the shrine and the realm waits for the named day.

outcomes.title: The Grain Tax Rebellion
outcomes.text: Sunvale's farmers refuse the crown's new grain tax and burn the tax-collectors' barns across the south. The court sends soldiers, the soldiers refuse to fire on their own villages and Sunvale's army begins to melt away.

outcomes.title: The Lich of the High Wilds
outcomes.text: Shepherds find a crowned skeleton sitting on a throne in a barrow of the High Wilds, its eyes burning. When the Conclave's mages come to see, the barrow is empty and three villages nearby are found dead.

outcomes.title: The Coinage Debased
outcomes.text: Aldermere's treasury mixes copper into its silver crowns to pay for the war. Merchants refuse the new coin, prices double and Veyl's ducat becomes the only money anyone trusts on the Great Isle.

outcomes.title: The Hollow Men
outcomes.text: Scarecrows rise from the fields of Sunvale's south at harvest-tide and walk toward the Ashlands. The villagers burn them, but the Coven's Hag-Queens are blamed, and the Order sends knights to find the witch.

outcomes.title: The Ashen Exiles' Smiths
outcomes.text: Orc smiths of the Ashen Exiles, taught by dwarven masters, begin forging steel as good as the Deepholds'. The Exiles arm their warriors and sell blades to Thornwatch, and the Horde loses its edge in iron.

outcomes.title: An Eclipse Over the Wall
outcomes.text: The sun goes black at noon over Thornwatch's wall, and the Horde attacks in the darkness. The defenders fight blind until the light returns, and the wall holds with half its towers burning.

outcomes.title: A University in Veyl
outcomes.text: Veyl's Glass Senate founds a great school of learning open to humans, dwarves and elves alike. Scholars flee the wars of the Great Isle to study there, and Veyl becomes the world's centre of learning.

outcomes.title: A Portal Opens in the Ashlands
outcomes.text: A ring of light opens in the unruled Ashlands, and through it come strange beasts and stranger men. Sunvale and Morrowgast both send soldiers, and both lose them.

outcomes.title: The Dwarven Rail-Road
outcomes.text: The Deepholds build iron rails from Karak Dûm to the sea, carrying ore in carts pulled by ponies. Their trade doubles, and the Elderwood watches the forest edge fall for sleepers.

outcomes.title: A Slave Revolt on the Northern Isle
outcomes.text: Human slaves in the Horde's iron mines rise, kill their overseers and seize a mountain fortress. They send word to Thornwatch begging for rescue, and the Spire sends an army.

outcomes.title: The Children's Crusade
outcomes.text: Thousands of children from Aldermere and Hollowcrown, stirred by a shepherd boy's visions, march north to fight the Spire with sticks and prayers. Lords try to stop them, the Horde does not, and the kingdoms are shamed into marching after them.

outcomes.title: A Vampire Lord
outcomes.text: A noble house of Westmarch's west is found to have been ruled by the same lord for three hundred years, drinking the blood of his serfs. The Order of the Lantern storms his castle; he escapes into the night and the serfs rise.

outcomes.title: The Sinking of the Lake Road
outcomes.text: The Lake Road's causeway across Aldermere's southern marshes sinks into the mud in a single night. Trade between Aldermere and Westmarch must go around by the hills, and both crowns lose a season's tolls.

outcomes.title: The Marsh-Folk
outcomes.text: A people of the deep fens, small and green-skinned, emerge to trade with the Free Clans for the first time in living memory. They know the paths no army can follow, and the Free Clans now have guides through every marsh of the Great Isle.

outcomes.title: The Usurer's War
outcomes.text: Veyl's banks call in every loan to Sunvale at once. Sunvale's barons, ruined, refuse to pay and seize Veyl's warehouses in Solenne; the Republic sends its glass-lens galleys to blockade Sunvale's ports.

outcomes.title: The Statue That Weeps
outcomes.text: A statue of the Silver Flame in Hollowcrown's capital begins to weep silver tears. The Prelacy says the god grieves for the war; the mountain lords say the priests are lying; pilgrims flood in either way.

outcomes.title: The Wild Magic Valley
outcomes.text: A valley of the unruled High Wilds is touched by wild magic: rivers run uphill, stones float and men who enter it come out years older. The Conclave fences it off, and treasure-hunters slip in anyway.

outcomes.title: The Last Elder Dragon
outcomes.text: A great golden dragon of the Elder Age wakes beneath the Eastern Isle's mountains and flies to the Heartwood, where it lies down beside the great tree. The elves say it has come to guard the Heartwood until the Binding is woven again.

outcomes.title: A Merchant Kingdom
outcomes.text: The richest merchant princes of Westmarch buy out the poorer ones and rule the realm as a company. Westmarch becomes the Westmarch Company in all but name, and its soldiers swear to the shareholders.

outcomes.title: The Exiled Queen Returns
outcomes.text: A Hag-Queen exiled from Morrowgast years ago returns at the head of an army of runaway Blessed and freed slaves. She demands her seat back, and the Coven-Realm goes to war with itself.

outcomes.title: The Ghouls of the Plague Pits
outcomes.text: Ghouls dig their way out of the plague pits outside Aldermere's lake city and feed on the dead and the living. The city closes its gates at night, and the Conclave is begged to cleanse the pits.

outcomes.title: The Treaty of the Three Isles
outcomes.text: The Great Isle's kingdoms, the Eastern Isle's realms and the Ashen Exiles sign a treaty of alliance against the Spire. For the first time since the Weeping Fields, every free people stands together.

outcomes.title: The Pirate Prince
outcomes.text: A son of Westmarch's First Prince, disinherited for gambling, joins the Brotherhood and becomes its most daring captain. He raids his father's ships first, and Westmarch's council is humiliated.

outcomes.title: A Bridge Across the Strait
outcomes.text: Dwarven and human engineers begin building a fortified bridge of stone across the narrowest part of the strait. If it is finished, the kingdoms can carry the war to the Northern Isle; the Horde attacks the works every night.

outcomes.title: A Locust Year
outcomes.text: Swarms of locusts out of the Ashlands strip the fields of Sunvale and Morrowgast alike. Both realms face famine, and the war between them pauses while both go hungry.

outcomes.title: An Orc Joins the Conclave
outcomes.text: A young orc of the Ashen Exiles is found to have the gift of magic and is taken into the Conclave of the Lake as an apprentice. The Order of the Lantern is outraged, and the orcs of the Exiles see a future beyond war.

outcomes.title: The Collapse of Karak Ornok
outcomes.text: The dwarven hold of Karak Ornok collapses in an earthquake, killing hundreds. The survivors come to Karak Dûm, crowding its halls, and the Thane-King must find them a new home.

outcomes.title: The Coronation of a Commoner
outcomes.text: Sunvale's eastern barons, with no heir they trust, crown a commoner general king of the east. Sunvale is split between a commoner king and the court at Solenne.

outcomes.title: The Elves' Gift of Seeds
outcomes.text: The elves of the Elderwood send seeds of their blight-proof grain to every realm of the Great Isle. Within a year the famine ends, and the elves are loved as they have not been in a thousand years.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Prisoner Released
outcomes.text: The Blackspire releases a captured lord of Thornwatch carrying a message: the Unbreathing will spare any realm that does not march north. Westmarch and Sunvale hesitate, and the alliance falters.

outcomes.title: The Centaurs of the Eastern Plains
outcomes.text: Riders who are half horse come out of the unruled grasslands of the Eastern Isle's north for the first time in living memory. They trade furs and horses with Veyl, warn the elves of orc scouts on their plains and refuse to kneel to any crown.

outcomes.title: The Spring Coronation at Solenne
outcomes.text: Sunvale crowns an heir it has kept hidden in a convent since infancy, claiming a prophecy forbade her to be shown sooner. The court's factions rally around her, but the eastern barons call her a puppet of the Grand Ministry.

outcomes.title: The Thornwatch Cog
outcomes.text: Thornwatch's shipwrights launch a new kind of ship, broad and high-sided, that the Horde's longships cannot board. Within a season the Warden's cogs hold the strait, and every kingdom with a coast wants the design.

outcomes.title: The Plague Doctor of Bellhaven
outcomes.text: A masked physician from Veyl ends a fever in Bellhaven's slums with a remedy of boiled water and lime. The guilds hail her, the priests call her a witch and the merchant princes make her the first public physician of any realm.

outcomes.title: A Lost Legion of the Weeping Fields
outcomes.text: Peat-cutters in the unruled moors north of Hollowcrown uncover a whole army of the First War of the Spire, preserved in the bog with their banners. The dead do not rise, but their Elder Age weapons and maps of the Northern Isle are priceless.

outcomes.title: The Coven's Daughter at Court
outcomes.text: A Hag-Queen of Morrowgast sends her own daughter to Sunvale's court as a hostage for a truce. The girl is clever, charming and plainly Blessed; half the court is afraid of her and the young lords fall in love with her.

outcomes.title: The Stone Circle Wakes
outcomes.text: An Elder Age stone circle in Aldermere's western hills begins to hum at dusk, and the cattle in the fields around it refuse to graze. The Conclave's scholars find it is a door of some kind, and argue over whether to open it.

outcomes.title: The Free Delvers' Republic
outcomes.text: Silver miners of Hollowcrown's mountains, long oppressed by the Prelacy's tithes, take the mines and declare a republic of the delvers. They ask the Deepholds for protection, and the dwarves are tempted.

outcomes.title: A Herd of Mammoths
outcomes.text: Herds of woolly mammoths, driven south by the Spire's long winters, cross the frozen strait onto Thornwatch's coast. The Wardenmark's people hunt them for meat and ivory, and the Horde's beast-masters try to tame them for war.

outcomes.title: The Brotherhood's Code
outcomes.text: Red Mara writes the Brotherhood's laws down for the first time: shares, votes, the treatment of prisoners and a ban on slave-taking. Pirates of every sea come to the Salt Isles to sail under a code that treats them fairly.

outcomes.title: The Great Silk Road of the East
outcomes.text: Veyl's merchants open a caravan road across the Eastern Isle's unruled interior to its far coast, finding a people there who make silk. Veyl's silk trade begins, and every court of the Great Isle wants to dress in it.

outcomes.title: The Archmagister's Confession
outcomes.text: The Archmagister of the Conclave confesses before Aldermere's council that the Tower has known for a century how Malgrath could be destroyed, and kept it secret because the cost is a mage's life every year. The council demands the secret; the Tower refuses.

outcomes.title: The Hounds of the Ashlands
outcomes.text: A pack of Blessed war-hounds, loosed by the Coven and abandoned, breeds in the unruled Ashlands into a wild pack of hundreds. They hunt anything that moves, and Sunvale's border villages are emptied.

outcomes.title: The Theatre Riot of Solenne
outcomes.text: A play mocking Sunvale's king opens in Solenne's great theatre, and the court sends soldiers to stop it. The audience fights them, the theatre burns and the playwright becomes the hero of Sunvale's poor.

outcomes.title: The Orc Smiths' Guild
outcomes.text: The orc smiths of the Ashen Exiles form a guild and sell their steel openly in Thornwatch's markets. Southern merchants buy it, the Deepholds' prices fall and the dwarves complain to the Council of the Kingdoms.

outcomes.title: A Swarm of Fire-Bees
outcomes.text: Bees whose sting burns like fire swarm out of the unruled forests of Aldermere's south and drive farmers from their fields. The Elderwood's healers know a cure, and the elves' standing on the Great Isle rises.

outcomes.title: The Great Hunt of the Strait
outcomes.text: Thornwatch's fishermen kill a great sea serpent that has haunted the strait for a generation. Its bones are hung on the wall, and the Horde's sailors say the sea has turned against the Spire.

outcomes.title: A Hidden Hold Discovered
outcomes.text: Elves of the Greywatch stumble on a dwarven hold in the Northern Isle's mountains that the Deepholds lost a thousand years ago. Its dwarves still live, cut off from their kin, and they have been fighting the Horde all along.

outcomes.title: The Price of Salt
outcomes.text: Westmarch's merchant princes buy up every salt pan on the Great Isle and raise the price of salt fivefold. Fishermen cannot cure their catch, and riots break out in every port.

outcomes.title: A Bard's Song
outcomes.text: A bard's song about the Battle of the Grey Strand spreads across every tavern of the Great Isle within a month. Young men march north to the wall singing it, and the kingdoms' armies swell with volunteers.

outcomes.title: The Eclipse Rebellion
outcomes.text: On the day of a solar eclipse, the peasants of Aldermere's southern valleys rise against their lords, taking the darkness as a sign. They burn manor rolls and tax records, and the rising spreads to three counties before the sun returns.

outcomes.title: The Prince Who Became a Priest
outcomes.text: Aldermere's heir renounces the crown to take the vows of the Silver Flame at Hollowcrown. The succession passes to a cousin, the great houses are thrown into confusion and Hollowcrown's Prelacy gains an influence over Aldermere it never had.

outcomes.title: The Fleet of the Gull Queen
outcomes.text: A woman pirate called the Gull Queen gathers the smugglers and outlaw fishermen of the Thornshaw coast into a fleet of fast boats. She raids only Veyl's banking ships, and the poor of every port toast her name.

outcomes.title: The Spirit of the Heartwood Appears
outcomes.text: A tall shape of green light walks out of the Heartwood and speaks to the elves for the first time in a thousand years. It tells them where the Binding's lost thread lies hidden, and the Greywatch rides out to find it.

outcomes.title: The Ashlands Land Grant
outcomes.text: Sunvale's court offers land in the unruled Ashlands to any soldier who will settle and hold it. Thousands of veterans take up the offer, and Sunvale's border creeps eastward farm by farm.

outcomes.title: The Glass Bridge Shatters
outcomes.text: Veyl's famous glass bridge over its harbour shatters in a storm, killing dozens. The Glass Senate's engineers are disgraced, and Veyl's pride takes a blow it will not soon forget.

outcomes.title: The Dwarven Lighthouse
outcomes.text: The Deepholds build a great lighthouse of star-iron on the Eastern Isle's western cape, its flame fed by underground gas. Ships can sail the eastern sea at night, and trade between the isles grows.

outcomes.title: An Orc King Baptised
outcomes.text: The chief of the Ashen Exiles takes the vows of the Silver Flame in Hollowcrown's shrine. Half his people follow him into the faith; the other half call it surrender to the humans, and the Exiles split.

outcomes.title: The Sea Wall Breaks
outcomes.text: The spring tides break the sea wall of a Westmarch harbour town and flood its streets. The town is abandoned, and its people pour into Bellhaven looking for work.

outcomes.title: The Book of Binding
outcomes.text: Scholars of the Conclave and the Elderwood together translate the Elder Age book that describes the Binding of the Blackspire. It names three things needed for a new Binding, and the kingdoms send expeditions to find them.

outcomes.title: The Coven's Silk
outcomes.text: Morrowgast's Hag-Queens find that silk spun by Blessed spiders is stronger than steel. They make armour of it for their warriors, and the Order's swords begin to fail against the Blessed.

outcomes.title: A Peace Fair in the Ashlands
outcomes.text: Merchants of Sunvale and Morrowgast meet at a fair in the Ashlands under a truce flag. They trade for a week, a Sunvale baron and a Hag-Queen's son become friends and the war pauses.

outcomes.title: The Wild Hunt Rides
outcomes.text: Ghostly riders sweep across the moors of Thornwatch on moonless nights, taking anyone caught outdoors. The Warden's men will not patrol after dark, and the Horde's raiders move freely.

outcomes.title: The Usurper of Hollowcrown
outcomes.text: A cousin of Hollowcrown's queen seizes the palace with the mountain lords' help and proclaims himself king. The queen flees to the Silver Flame's shrine, and the priests refuse to crown him.

outcomes.title: The Iron Mountain
outcomes.text: Dwarven miners hollow out an entire mountain of iron in the eastern range, the richest ever found. The Deepholds' iron floods the world's markets, and its price falls by half.

outcomes.title: The Elves' Gift of Ships
outcomes.text: The Elderwood gives Thornwatch three silver ships, faster than anything on the strait. The Warden uses them to scout the Northern Isle's coast, and finds the Horde's secret harbours.

outcomes.title: The Lake Freezes in Spring
outcomes.text: A cold snap freezes Lake Halmoor in spring, trapping the lake fleet and the Conclave's barges. The Tower of Stars is cut off for a month, and the court wonders what the mages are doing alone.

outcomes.title: The Westmarch Charter
outcomes.text: Westmarch's guilds win a charter from the merchant princes giving them seats on the council. The guild halls rule beside the princes, and the poor of Bellhaven celebrate in the streets.

outcomes.title: A Comet Over the Coven Hollow
outcomes.text: A green comet hangs over Morrowgast for nine nights. The Hag-Queens say it means their victory; the Blessed host marches toward the Ashlands.

outcomes.title: A King's Peace
outcomes.text: The kings of Aldermere and Westmarch meet on the Lake Road and sign a peace ending a century of toll quarrels. The road's tolls are abolished, and trade between them triples.

outcomes.title: The Spring Thaw Opens the Passes
outcomes.text: The spring thaw opens the mountain passes, and armies march north from every realm to Thornwatch's wall. The roads are choked with soldiers, the farms empty of men and the planting season is lost in half of Aldermere.

outcomes.title: The Prince of the Marsh-Folk
outcomes.text: The small green people of the deep fens send a prince to Aldermere's court, asking for a treaty to protect their marshes from drainage. The king grants it, the great houses who wanted the marshland are furious and the Free Clans gain new allies.

outcomes.title: The Wreck of the Treasure Fleet
outcomes.text: Westmarch's treasure fleet from the western colonies founders on an unknown reef in a spring storm. Its gold sinks to the bottom, and treasure-hunters, pirates and three navies race to find it.

outcomes.title: The Lantern's Pilgrimage
outcomes.text: The knights of the Order of the Lantern carry their founder's lantern on a pilgrimage through every realm of the Great Isle, lighting the hearths of the poor. The people love them, and recruits flock to Lanternhold.

outcomes.title: The Golem of Karak Dûm
outcomes.text: Dwarven smiths animate a giant of iron and stone to guard the gates of Karak Dûm. It works, and the Thane-King orders a hundred more; the elves fear the dwarves have built an army that cannot die.

outcomes.title: The Sunvale Inquisition
outcomes.text: Sunvale's court sets up an inquisition to root out Coven agents in its eastern provinces. It burns dozens of innocent women, and the eastern villages begin to look to Morrowgast for protection.

outcomes.title: The Free Port of Rosport
outcomes.text: Sunvale's coastal town of Rosport declares itself a free port, open to any ship. Pirates, smugglers and merchants flock to it, and Sunvale's court cannot afford to take it back.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Lost Voice
outcomes.text: One of Malgrath's masked Voices is found wandering on Thornwatch's coast, her mask gone and her memory with it. She was once a princess of Hollowcrown, taken a century ago; the Prelacy demands her return.

outcomes.title: The Great Market of Veyl
outcomes.text: Veyl opens a market hall of glass that covers a whole quarter of the city. Merchants of every realm, even the Horde, trade under its roof, and the Republic's customs duties double.

outcomes.title: The Dragon's Bargain
outcomes.text: The golden dragon guarding the Heartwood speaks to the elves: it will fight the Spire if the elves give it the Elderwood's oldest treasure. The elves debate for a month, and the dragon waits.

outcomes.title: The Burning of the Witch-Finders
outcomes.text: The people of a Westmarch town rise against the Hounds of the Hearth after they burn a beloved healer. They burn the witch-finders' hall and drive them out, and the Hounds' power in Westmarch is broken.

outcomes.title: The Treaty of the Isles
outcomes.text: The Ashen Exiles and the free orc clans of the Northern Isle's southern coast sign a treaty of alliance. A free orc realm is forming, and the Spire's grip on the Northern Isle loosens.

outcomes.title: The Locust Plague of the East
outcomes.text: Locusts sweep across the Eastern Isle's farms, stripping Veyl's fields and the Deepholds' hidden valleys. The east, which fed the Great Isle last year, must now buy grain from it.

outcomes.title: The Return of the Elder Kings
outcomes.text: A band of elves who left the Eastern Isle a thousand years ago returns, led by a prince who fought at the Weeping Fields. He remembers how the first Binding was woven, and the Elderwood rejoices.

outcomes.title: The Debt Strike
outcomes.text: The peasants of Aldermere's southern counties refuse to pay their debts to Veyl's banks. The banks seize their lands, the peasants burn the bankers' agents and the crown must choose a side.

outcomes.title: A Merchant Turns Lord
outcomes.text: A Veyl merchant buys a ruined lordship on Aldermere's coast and rebuilds its harbour. He becomes a lord of Aldermere, and the great houses are horrified to see a banker among them.

outcomes.title: The Horde's Wolf-Cavalry
outcomes.text: The Horde's beast-masters break giant wolves to the saddle, and orc wolf-riders raid deep into Thornwatch's hills. The wall cannot stop them, and the hill villages are abandoned.

outcomes.title: A Wedding of Dwarf and Elf
outcomes.text: A prince of the Deepholds marries a princess of the Elderwood, the first such marriage in history. The Pact of Root and Stone is renewed forever, and the Eastern Isle stands as one.

outcomes.title: The Fall of a Salt Isle
outcomes.text: An earthquake sinks one of the smaller Salt Isles into the sea, drowning its pirate town. The Brotherhood loses a tenth of its people, and Red Mara swears it is Westmarch's sorcery.

outcomes.title: The Prophet of the Hearth
outcomes.text: A blacksmith's daughter preaches that the Silver Flame burns in every hearth and needs no priests. Thousands follow her across Aldermere, and the Prelacy demands her surrender.

outcomes.title: The Blessed in the Mountains
outcomes.text: Morrowgast's Blessed host marches into the mountains and lays siege to Lanternhold, the Order of the Lantern's fortress. The knights hold their walls and send riders to every kingdom for help, and the kingdoms must decide whether the Order is worth saving.

outcomes.title: A Queen of the Free Delvers
outcomes.text: The silver miners of Hollowcrown's mountains crown a woman miner their queen. She sells silver to the Deepholds and Westmarch, and Hollowcrown's Prelacy loses its richest mines.

outcomes.title: The Wolf-Winter of the North
outcomes.text: A late snow buries the Northern Isle in spring, and wolves come down from the mountains into the Horde's camps. The orcs starve, and some clans flee south to beg Thornwatch for shelter.

outcomes.title: The Conclave's Envoy Murdered
outcomes.text: An envoy of the Conclave of the Lake is murdered in Hollowcrown by the Prelacy's zealots. The Tower demands justice, Hollowcrown refuses and the two powers come to the edge of war.

outcomes.title: The Great Drought of the East
outcomes.text: The rains fail on the Eastern Isle, and Veyl's reservoirs run dry. The Republic must buy water from the Deepholds' underground lakes, and the dwarves set a high price.

outcomes.title: A Royal Bastard Rebels
outcomes.text: A bastard son of Westmarch's First Prince gathers the western lords and rebels against his father. Westmarch's mercenaries march west, and the realm splits.

outcomes.title: The Fire-Ships of Westmarch
outcomes.text: Westmarch sends fire-ships against the Brotherhood's fleet at anchor. Twenty pirate ships burn, and Red Mara's power on the Ostcombe Sea is broken for a season.

outcomes.title: The Heartwood's Thread Found
outcomes.text: The Greywatch finds the lost thread of the first Binding in a ruined Elder Age shrine on the Northern Isle. They bring it home, and the elves begin to weave.

outcomes.title: The Merchant Wars of the Lake
outcomes.text: The merchants of Aldermere's lake towns fight a war of tariffs with Westmarch's merchant princes. Trade on the Lake Road stops, and both realms' markets empty.

outcomes.title: The Orc Princess's Wedding
outcomes.text: An orc princess of the Ashen Exiles marries a knight of Thornwatch in the Silver Flame's shrine. The orcs of the Exiles become kin to Thornwatch, and the Horde swears vengeance on both.

outcomes.title: The Sand-Storms of the Ashlands
outcomes.text: Great storms of red sand sweep out of the Ashlands into Sunvale and Morrowgast, burying fields and villages. Both realms' harvests are threatened, and their war pauses.

outcomes.title: The Deepholds' Secret Road
outcomes.text: The Deepholds reveal their secret tunnel under the sea to Thornwatch, offering to carry dwarven armies to the wall. The kingdoms are grateful, and wary of what else the dwarves have dug.

outcomes.title: The Ghost Ships of the Ostcombe
outcomes.text: Ships with no crews drift into the harbours of Sunvale and Westmarch, their holds full of gold. The sailors say they are cursed, and nobody will take the gold.

outcomes.title: An Embassy from Beyond the Sea
outcomes.text: Ships with red silk sails arrive at Veyl from a land beyond the eastern ocean, bringing an embassy from a great empire. They ask about the Spire, and the Glass Senate wonders what they want.

outcomes.title: The Brigand Queen of the Hills
outcomes.text: A woman called Red Annis unites the brigands of the hills between Aldermere and Hollowcrown and declares herself their queen. She taxes the roads, and neither kingdom can spare soldiers to stop her.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Shadow Falls
outcomes.text: A shadow falls across the Northern Isle at noon and does not lift for a week. The orc clans flee the darkness, and Thornwatch's lookouts see the Blackspire glowing.

outcomes.title: The Wool Fair of Aldermere
outcomes.text: Aldermere holds its first great wool fair in years. Merchants of every realm come, the price of wool rises and the lake towns' weavers grow rich again.

outcomes.title: The Coven's Sacrifice
outcomes.text: A Hag-Queen of Morrowgast gives her life in a rite that lifts the Blessing from a whole town. Its people wake as ordinary folk, and the Coven is divided over whether she was a saint or a traitor.

outcomes.title: The Dam of the High Wilds
outcomes.text: Aldermere's engineers dam a river in the High Wilds to water the lake country. The hill clans whose valley is drowned take up arms, and Aldermere must fight a war in the mountains.

outcomes.title: The Wall Belongs to All
outcomes.text: Every kingdom of the Great Isle pledges soldiers and silver to Thornwatch's wall every year, and the wall's captains are drawn from every realm. Thornwatch's Warden becomes the Great Isle's warden, and the Spire faces a united coast.

outcomes.title: The Crossing of the Strait
outcomes.text: For the first time in a thousand years, the armies of the Great Isle cross the strait and land on the Northern Isle. They take a beachhead below the Horde's camps, and the war is carried to the Spire's own land.

outcomes.title: A Hag-Queen Crowned Queen of Sunvale's East
outcomes.text: The villages of Sunvale's east, abandoned by the court, accept a Hag-Queen of Morrowgast as their ruler. Sunvale loses a third of its land without a battle, and the court is too divided to answer.

outcomes.title: The Gold Fever
outcomes.text: Gold is found in the rivers of the Northern Isle's unruled south, beside the Horde's camps. Adventurers, Exiles and free orcs pour in, and the Spire's war-bands hunt them.

outcomes.title: The Archmagister Dies Weaving
outcomes.text: The Archmagister of the Conclave dies weaving a ward over Thornwatch's wall. The ward holds, and the Tower mourns its greatest master.

outcomes.title: The Sinking of Kormouth
outcomes.text: The harbour town of Kormouth slides into the sea in an earthquake, its pirates and smugglers with it. Westmarch's council quietly celebrates.

outcomes.title: A Child Saint of the Fens
outcomes.text: A girl of the Free Clans heals the sick with a touch, and pilgrims flock to the fens. Aldermere's lords do not dare send soldiers against a saint.

outcomes.title: The Southern Sea Storms
outcomes.text: Great storms close the Ostcombe Sea for a month. Pirates and merchants alike stay in harbour, and the southern kingdoms' trade stops.

outcomes.title: The Battle of the Black Shore
outcomes.text: Thornwatch's raiders, landed on the Northern Isle's southern shore, beat a Horde host in open battle for the first time in a thousand years. The orc clans that watched it begin to doubt the Spire, and Thornwatch's captains plan to stay.

outcomes.title: The Lake Towns' League
outcomes.text: Aldermere's lake towns form a league to protect their trade, hiring their own soldiers. The crown cannot tax them, and the great houses fear their power.

outcomes.title: An Elven Bride for Aldermere
outcomes.text: Aldermere's heir marries an elven princess of the Elderwood. The elves and men bind themselves together, and the great houses are scandalised.

outcomes.title: Dwarves on the Northern Isle
outcomes.text: The Deepholds land an army on the Northern Isle's unruled eastern coast and dig in among its iron hills, claiming the mines for the Thane-King. The Spire sends war-bands against them, and dwarves and orcs fight in the snows below the Blackspire.

outcomes.title: The Lantern and the Flame Ride Together
outcomes.text: Knights of the Order of the Lantern and Hollowcrown's Silver Guard ride out together for the first time and rout a Blessed war-band in the Ashlands. The old rivals of the Flame are reconciled in the field, and Morrowgast's raids into the mountains stop.

outcomes.title: The Bandit War of the Ashlands
outcomes.text: Sunvale's soldiers and the brigands of the Ashlands fight a war in the hills. Neither side wins, and the Ashlands burn.

outcomes.title: A Treaty with the Centaurs
outcomes.text: Veyl signs a treaty with the centaurs of the Eastern Isle's plains, buying their horses for its cavalry. The Republic has an army that can ride, and the Deepholds take notice.

outcomes.title: The Pirate King Crowned
outcomes.text: A pirate captain crowns himself king of an unruled island west of the Salt Isles. The Brotherhood has a rival, and the western sea grows more dangerous.

outcomes.title: The Spire Calls Its Allies
outcomes.text: The Blackspire calls every dark power of the world to its aid. The Coven, the vampire lords and the goblins of the High Wilds answer, and the war becomes a war of the world.

outcomes.title: A Wedding in Westmarch
outcomes.text: Westmarch's heir marries a daughter of Sunvale's king. The southern kingdoms bind themselves together, and the northern kingdoms feel left out.

outcomes.title: The Heartwood Names a Weaver
outcomes.text: The Heartwood sings again and every elf in the world hears it name the one who could weave a new Binding: a mortal mage of the Great Isle, not an elf. The elves send envoys to the Conclave to find out who.

outcomes.title: The Black Powder Weapon
outcomes.text: Veyl's alchemists build a cannon that fires stone balls with black powder. The Glass Senate sells it to Thornwatch, and the Horde's longships learn to fear the shore.

outcomes.title: A King's Pilgrimage to the Wall
outcomes.text: Aldermere's king rides north to stand on Thornwatch's wall with his soldiers. The army cheers, the other kings are shamed into following and the Great Isle's armies have never been more united.

outcomes.title: The Sheep-Shearers' Revolt
outcomes.text: Aldermere's shepherds and shearers refuse to sell wool to the great houses at the price fixed by the Lake Guilds and drive their flocks to Westmarch's markets instead. The lake country's looms fall silent, and the crown is caught between the guilds and the shepherds.

outcomes.title: The Nameless Knight
outcomes.text: A knight in black armour with no device appears at tournaments across the Great Isle and beats every champion, then vanishes. Rumour says she is a Hag-Queen's daughter, an exiled princess or the Spire's spy, and every court wants to unmask her.

outcomes.title: The Eel Fishers' War
outcomes.text: Eel fishers of Aldermere's lake shore and the Free Clans fight over the eel weirs of the southern fens. A dozen die, the weirs are burned and the crown and the clans' moot must sit down together or lose the fens' richest trade.

outcomes.title: A Hold for the Exiles
outcomes.text: The Deepholds offer the Ashen Exiles an empty hold in the eastern mountains, abandoned in the earthquakes of a century ago. Half the Exiles' families sail east to live under the mountain, and orcs and dwarves become neighbours.

outcomes.title: The Silver Flood
outcomes.text: A Westmarch expedition returns from beyond the western sea with a fleet of ships loaded with silver. Silver's price collapses across the world, the Prelacy's mines lose half their worth and Hollowcrown's treasury is ruined overnight.

outcomes.title: The Book Burners of Hollowcrown
outcomes.text: Zealots of the Silver Flame burn the great library of Hollowcrown's capital, saying its books of lore were heresy. Scholars flee to Veyl with what they can carry, and the Conclave offers a fortune for any book saved.

outcomes.title: The Ashlands Canal
outcomes.text: Sunvale's engineers begin digging a canal through the unruled Ashlands to bring water to Sunvale's dry east. Morrowgast calls it an invasion, and its Blessed raid the diggers' camps every night.

outcomes.title: The Speaking Raven
outcomes.text: A raven that speaks with a dead king's voice lands on the walls of Aldermere's palace and names the noble who poisoned him. The court is thrown into uproar, the noble flees and the Conclave takes the raven.

outcomes.title: The Orc Markets of Thornwatch
outcomes.text: Free orcs of the Northern Isle cross the strait every week to trade furs, amber and iron at Thornwatch's markets. Thornwatch grows rich, the Horde loses its trade and the Spire forbids the crossings on pain of death.

outcomes.title: The Tide of Glass
outcomes.text: A strange tide washes up on Veyl's beaches covered in glittering sand that melts into glass in the sun. The Glass Senate claims it, the glassmakers grow rich and scholars say it comes from something burning beneath the sea.

outcomes.title: The Brothers of the Road
outcomes.text: Ex-soldiers of every kingdom, discharged from the wall without pay, band together on the roads of the Great Isle as the Brothers of the Road. They rob only lords and tax-collectors, and the villages feed them.

outcomes.title: The Thane-King's Daughter Elopes
outcomes.text: The Thane-King of Karak Dûm's daughter runs away to Thornwatch with a human captain of the wall. The Thane-King demands her return, the captain refuses and the Deepholds threaten to withdraw their warriors from the wall.

outcomes.title: The Sickness of the Horses
outcomes.text: A sickness kills the horses of Sunvale and Aldermere by the thousand. The kingdoms' cavalry is crippled for a season, and Westmarch's horse-traders grow rich selling remounts.

outcomes.title: The Free Cities' League
outcomes.text: The merchant towns of Aldermere's coast form a league with Westmarch's harbours, trading freely and defending each other. The crown of Aldermere loses its coast's taxes, and its council calls it treason.

outcomes.title: The Burning Sea
outcomes.text: Oil seeping from the seabed catches fire off the Salt Isles, and the sea burns for a week. The Brotherhood's harbours are choked with smoke, and its ships must sail away until the fire dies.

outcomes.title: The Prophetess of the Exiles
outcomes.text: A blind orc woman of the Ashen Exiles begins to prophesy that the Spire's master will be killed by an orc. The Exiles' warriors take heart, and orcs of the Horde begin to listen to her.

outcomes.title: A Fever in the Wardenmark
outcomes.text: A summer fever spreads through Thornwatch's Wardenmark from the marshes behind the wall. The garrison sickens, the levies desert and the Warden begs the kingdoms for physicians.

outcomes.title: The Lady of the Silver Mines
outcomes.text: A widow of Hollowcrown's mountains takes over her husband's silver mine and makes it the richest in the realm. She buys a seat on the Prelacy's council, the first woman of trade to sit there, and the priests are scandalised.

outcomes.title: The Pirate Hunters
outcomes.text: Westmarch hires a company of pirate-hunters, former pirates themselves, to clear the Thornshaw Sea. They sink a dozen pirate ships in a month and keep the prizes, and Westmarch's merchants sail more freely.

outcomes.title: A Plague of Sleepwalkers
outcomes.text: People across Sunvale's east begin to walk in their sleep toward the Ashlands. Some are found at dawn miles from home; some are never found, and the court blames the Coven's witchcraft.

outcomes.title: The May Day Riots
outcomes.text: The May Day festival in Bellhaven turns into a riot when the guilds march on the merchant princes' houses. The princes' sellswords fire on the crowd, and Westmarch's capital is under martial law for a month.

outcomes.title: A Kingdom Mortgaged
outcomes.text: Sunvale's court mortgages its royal estates to Veyl's banks to pay its soldiers. If the court cannot pay within the year, Veyl will own half of Sunvale's farmland.

outcomes.title: The Goblin King
outcomes.text: The goblins of the High Wilds unite under a king who wears a crown of iron nails, and raid the mountain villages of Aldermere and Hollowcrown together. The two kingdoms must cooperate to drive them back into the warrens.

outcomes.title: The Elves Leave the Wall
outcomes.text: The Elderwood recalls its archers from Thornwatch's wall after a quarrel with the Warden over command. The wall is weaker, and the Council of the Kingdoms must make peace between them.

outcomes.title: The Iron Fleet of the Deepholds
outcomes.text: The Deepholds launch a fleet of iron-plated ships built in their new sea-hold. No pirate or orc longship can harm them, and the Eastern Isle's sea-lanes are safe for the first time in a century.

outcomes.title: The Last of the Hag-Queens' Line
outcomes.text: The oldest Hag-Queen of Morrowgast dies, and with her the knowledge of the oldest rites. The Coven loses part of its power, and the Blessed who depended on her rites begin to weaken.

outcomes.title: The Harvest Fair of Sunvale
outcomes.text: Sunvale's first good harvest in three years is celebrated with a great fair in Solenne. Wine flows, the court's debts are forgotten for a week and the king is cheered in the streets.

outcomes.title: An Heir from the Fens
outcomes.text: A child of the Free Clans is found to be the grandchild of Aldermere's king, born of a secret marriage. The Free Clans claim a place in the succession, and Aldermere's great houses refuse to accept a fen-born heir.

outcomes.title: The Merchant Navy of Veyl
outcomes.text: Veyl's Glass Senate launches a navy to protect its trade, buying ships from the Deepholds. The Republic is no longer defenceless at sea, and the Brotherhood's raids on Veyl's ships stop.

outcomes.title: The Fall of a Great House
outcomes.text: One of Aldermere's oldest great houses is ruined by debts to Veyl and sells its castle and its lands. A Veyl banker buys them, and the great houses fear they will be next.

outcomes.title: The Wild Boars of the Ashlands
outcomes.text: Blessed boars the size of oxen breed in the unruled Ashlands and raid Sunvale's farms. Hunters from every realm come to kill them, and the Ashlands become a hunting ground.

outcomes.title: A Truce at the Wall
outcomes.text: The Horde and Thornwatch agree a truce for the spring sowing, exchanging prisoners on the strait's shore. For a month there is no fighting, and both sides plant their fields.

outcomes.title: The Collapse of the Lake Road Bridge
outcomes.text: The great bridge on the Lake Road collapses into the river under a convoy. Trade between Aldermere and Westmarch stops, and both realms blame each other's engineers.

outcomes.title: The Conclave's Children
outcomes.text: The Conclave of the Lake begins taking children with the gift of magic from every realm, whether their parents agree or not. The kingdoms protest, and some hide their gifted children.

outcomes.title: The Sea-Folk Appear
outcomes.text: People with gills and webbed hands are seen in the waters off the Salt Isles, watching the ships. The Brotherhood's sailors throw them gifts, and the sea-folk guide pirate ships through the reefs.

outcomes.title: The Order's Schism
outcomes.text: The Order of the Lantern splits over whether to accept mages into its ranks. The younger knights form a new order, the Order of the Torch, and march to Thornwatch's wall.

outcomes.title: The Great Flood of Westmarch
outcomes.text: The spring floods of Westmarch's rivers drown the lowland farms. The breadbasket of the Great Isle loses its harvest, and every realm faces higher bread prices.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Bargain with Veyl
outcomes.text: The Blackspire offers Veyl's Glass Senate a monopoly on the Northern Isle's iron if Veyl stays neutral. The Senate accepts in secret, and the kingdoms' spies discover it.

outcomes.title: The Witch of the Woods
outcomes.text: A witch who lives in the forests of Aldermere's south cures the sick and curses the cruel. The lords want her burned, the peasants protect her and the Conclave sends an envoy to learn her craft.

outcomes.title: The Lost Expedition Returns
outcomes.text: An expedition sent into the Eastern Isle's unruled interior a year ago returns with tales of a great inland sea and a people who ride giant birds. Veyl and the Deepholds send new expeditions.

outcomes.title: The Red Plague
outcomes.text: A plague that turns the skin red spreads from Sunvale's ports to every realm of the Great Isle. Thousands die, the armies on the wall are thinned and the kingdoms close their borders.

outcomes.title: A Usurper in Westmarch
outcomes.text: A merchant prince seizes Bellhaven's council chamber with his sellswords and proclaims himself First Prince for life. The other princes flee to their estates, and Westmarch's guilds call for a general strike.

outcomes.title: The Highlanders' Raid
outcomes.text: The hill clans of the unruled peaks between Aldermere and Hollowcrown raid both kingdoms' lowland farms in force, taking cattle and grain. The two kingdoms send soldiers into the hills, and the clans vanish.

outcomes.title: The Dwarf Who Became an Elf-Friend
outcomes.text: A dwarven smith forges a sword for the Lady of the Elderwood from star-iron and elven silver. The blade can cut the Spire's sorcery, and the elves and dwarves swear a new oath of friendship.

outcomes.title: The Great Comet
outcomes.text: A great comet appears in the sky and grows brighter every night. Prophets proclaim the end of the world, pilgrims flock to every shrine and the kingdoms' armies grow restless.

outcomes.title: The Coven's Ambassador to Aldermere
outcomes.text: Morrowgast sends an ambassador to Aldermere's court, offering an alliance against the Spire. The court is divided, and the Order threatens to leave the wall if it is accepted.

outcomes.title: The Wreck of the Glass Fleet
outcomes.text: Veyl's merchant fleet is wrecked in a storm off the Great Isle's coast. Its cargo of glass and gold washes ashore, and the coast folk strip the wrecks before Veyl's agents arrive.

outcomes.title: An Orc Becomes a Lord
outcomes.text: Thornwatch's Warden grants a coastal lordship to an orc chief of the Ashen Exiles for his service on the wall. An orc is a lord of the Great Isle for the first time, and the south is scandalised.

outcomes.title: The Wolves of the Lake
outcomes.text: Wolves cross the dry bed of a shrunken Lake Halmoor and raid the lake towns of Aldermere. The crown offers a bounty, and hunters flood the lake country.

outcomes.title: A Treaty of Trade
outcomes.text: The kingdoms of the Great Isle and the realms of the Eastern Isle sign a treaty of free trade. Tolls are abolished, trade doubles and the merchants of every realm grow rich.

outcomes.title: The Goblin Raids
outcomes.text: Goblins from the warrens of the High Wilds raid the mountain villages of Hollowcrown at night, taking grain and iron. The Prelacy sends the Silver Guard into the mountains, and the goblins vanish into their tunnels.

outcomes.title: The Heartwood's Fruit
outcomes.text: The Heartwood bears fruit for the first time in a thousand years. Elves who eat it live longer, and the Fading seems to slow.

outcomes.title: The Thornwatch Iron Strike
outcomes.text: The ironworkers of Thornwatch's forges strike for higher pay. The wall's weapons run short, and the Warden must pay or face the Horde without arrows.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Herald Defects
outcomes.text: A herald of the Blackspire defects to Thornwatch, bringing news of the Spire's plans. The Council of the Kingdoms learns that Malgrath intends to cross the strait in the summer.

outcomes.title: The Bandit Lords of the South
outcomes.text: Outlaws in Sunvale's southern hills unite under a former baron and declare a lordship. The court cannot spare soldiers to crush them, and the south slips from the crown's control.

outcomes.title: The Elves Weave a Ward
outcomes.text: The elves of the Elderwood weave a ward over Thornwatch's wall that no undead can pass. The Horde's risen dead fall at the wall, and the wall holds.

outcomes.title: The Brotherhood's Golden Age
outcomes.text: The Brotherhood of the Salt Isles grows rich on the trade of the Ostcombe Sea. Red Harbour becomes the richest port in the world, and merchants of every realm trade there openly.

outcomes.title: A Prince's Pilgrimage
outcomes.text: A prince of Sunvale makes a pilgrimage to the Silver Flame and is cured of a long illness. He converts to the Flame, and Sunvale's court is divided over whether to follow him.

outcomes.title: The Drowned Mines
outcomes.text: Floods drown the silver mines of Hollowcrown. The Prelacy's treasury loses its main income, and the war tithe is doubled.

outcomes.title: The First Printing Press
outcomes.text: A Veyl craftsman builds a machine that prints books from carved letters. Books become cheap, ideas spread fast and the Prelacy fears the heresies that will be printed.

outcomes.title: The Pilgrims' Road Opens
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's Prelacy and Aldermere's crown together build a guarded road for pilgrims from the lake country to the Silver Flame, with hostels every day's walk. Pilgrims pour along it, trade follows them and the mountain towns on the road grow rich.

outcomes.title: The Mad Prince of Westmarch
outcomes.text: The heir of Westmarch's First Prince, long kept from the court, is found to have killed three servants in fits of rage. The merchant princes demand he be disinherited, his father refuses and the council splits over the succession of a madman.

outcomes.title: The Centaur Raids
outcomes.text: The centaurs of the Eastern Isle's plains, angered by Veyl's settlers fencing their grasslands, raid the new farms and burn the fences. Veyl's Senate must choose between buying peace and fighting a people who can outride any army.

outcomes.title: The Elder Library Under Veyl
outcomes.text: Workmen digging Veyl's new cisterns break into a sealed library of the Elder Age beneath the city. Its scrolls describe the Thirteen Apprentices by name, and the Conclave, the Elderwood and Hollowcrown's Prelacy all demand them.

outcomes.title: The Summer Fair of the Free Clans
outcomes.text: The Free Clans hold a great fair in their fens and invite merchants of every realm. Aldermere's own traders come in secret, the clans' furs and eels sell for gold and the fens grow richer than the crown expected.

outcomes.title: A Hag-Queen Unmasked at Court
outcomes.text: A lady of Aldermere's court is revealed by the Conclave to be a Hag-Queen of Morrowgast who has lived there disguised for twenty years. She escapes across the lake in the night, and every court of the Great Isle searches its own halls.

outcomes.title: The Strait Fort Falls
outcomes.text: A storm and a Horde raid together bring down Thornwatch's new sea-fort on a rock in the middle of the strait, the work of two summers. Its garrison drowns or is taken, and the strait is open to the longships again.

outcomes.title: The Golden Dragon's Price
outcomes.text: The ancient golden dragon that sleeps near the Heartwood demands tribute from every realm of the Eastern Isle: a treasure each year, or it will burn a town. Veyl pays, the Deepholds refuse and the dragon flies toward the eastern mountains.

outcomes.title: The Mercenary Kingdom
outcomes.text: A free company of sellswords, unpaid by Sunvale's court, seizes three towns in Sunvale's west and declares them a kingdom under their captain. They offer to sell the towns back for their arrears, and the court has no gold to pay.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Vintage
outcomes.text: Sunvale's vintners discover that wine shipped to Veyl is being sold on to the Horde, and that their best customers are the Spire's chiefs. The court is shamed, and the eastern barons demand the trade be stopped.

outcomes.title: The Lake Drains
outcomes.text: An earthquake opens a crack in the bed of Lake Halmoor, and the lake begins to drain into the deep. Its shores retreat a mile in a month, the lake towns are left on mud and the isle of Wyn is no longer an island.

outcomes.title: The Ashen Exiles' University
outcomes.text: The chiefs of the Ashen Exiles invite scholars from Veyl to teach their children letters. The first orc school opens on the north-western islet, and the Exiles' envoys begin writing their own treaties.

outcomes.title: The Blessed Mercenaries
outcomes.text: Blessed warriors cast out of Morrowgast hire themselves to any realm that will pay. Sunvale's barons hire a company, the Order calls it damnation and the Blessed fight better than any sellsword the barons have known.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Library Raided
outcomes.text: Thalion Ash-Eye's Greywatch raid a Spire tower on the Northern Isle's coast and carry off its books. Among them is a journal in Malgrath's own hand, and the Conclave and the Elderwood fight over who will read it first.

outcomes.title: The Riviera Earthquake
outcomes.text: An earthquake shakes Sunvale's Riviera and brings down the cathedral of Solenne during a royal wedding. Nobles of every Sunvale house die under its stones, and the court is left without half its families.

outcomes.title: The Thornwatch Codex
outcomes.text: The Warden of Thornwatch has the march's laws written down for the first time, giving freed men, orcs of the Exiles and dwarven settlers the same rights. Southern lords call it madness; runaways from every realm head north.

outcomes.title: The Silver Tide
outcomes.text: Shoals of silverfish so thick that the sea shines fill the Ostcombe Sea for a week. Fishing towns across the south haul in their best catch in a century, and the price of fish falls by half.

outcomes.title: The Coven's Healing Houses
outcomes.text: Morrowgast opens healing houses in its border towns where anyone, even Sunvalese, may be treated by the Coven's witches without being Blessed. Sunvale's border folk cross over by the thousand, and the court in Solenne is alarmed.

outcomes.title: The Hill Giants' Migration
outcomes.text: Hill giants driven from the Northern Isle by the Spire's war cross the frozen strait in winter and settle in the unruled hills above Thornwatch. They keep to themselves, eat sheep and terrify the Wardenmark's shepherds.

outcomes.title: A Saint Born in Red Harbour
outcomes.text: A child born in the Brotherhood's capital heals the sick with a touch. Pirates who never prayed in their lives kneel to her, and Hollowcrown's priests do not know whether to bless or condemn a saint of the Salt Isles.

outcomes.title: The Midsummer Tournament of Solenne
outcomes.text: Sunvale holds the greatest tournament in a century to show its strength. Knights of every realm come, a Blessed champion of Morrowgast enters in disguise and wins, and the court does not know whether to crown or hang her.

outcomes.title: The Archmagister's Apprentice
outcomes.text: The Archmagister of the Conclave names a commoner girl from Aldermere's fens as her successor. The masters of the Tower rebel at a fen-born heir, and the Conclave splits for a season.

outcomes.title: The Wreckers of Westmarch
outcomes.text: The coast folk of Westmarch's west light false beacons and wreck three of the merchant princes' ships. The princes hang a dozen villagers, and the coast rises in revolt.

outcomes.title: The Silent City
outcomes.text: Travellers find a town in the unruled north of Aldermere where every inhabitant stands frozen in place, alive but unmoving. The Conclave and the Prelacy both send people, and both blame the other's magic.

outcomes.title: The Exiles' Great Hunt
outcomes.text: The Ashen Exiles hunt the mammoths that have crossed onto the Great Isle's northern coast and feast the whole Wardenmark. Thornwatch's people eat meat for the first time in a year, and the orcs are cheered in the villages.

outcomes.title: A Bride from Beyond the Sea
outcomes.text: Ships with red silk sails arrive at Veyl from an empire beyond the eastern ocean, and their envoys offer a princess of its empire in marriage to Veyl's First Magistrate. The Republic has never had a royal marriage, and the Senate debates for a month.

outcomes.title: The Toll-Free Summer
outcomes.text: Aldermere's crown abolishes all tolls on the Lake Road for one summer to revive trade after the war's hardships. Merchants flood the road, the lake towns prosper and the great houses who lived on the tolls are furious.

outcomes.title: The Return of the Lantern's Founder
outcomes.text: A knight in ancient armour walks into Lanternhold claiming to be Anselm the Lampbearer, returned from a hundred years of sleep. The Order's knights are divided between worship and suspicion, and the Grand Master locks him away to be tested.

outcomes.title: The Mountain Pass War
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown and Aldermere fight a short war over a toll-pass in the High Wilds. A hundred die before the Council of the Kingdoms forces a truce, and the pass is shared.

outcomes.title: The Elves Open Caras Ithrael
outcomes.text: The Lady of the Elderwood opens Caras Ithrael to visitors of every people for one midsummer week. Humans, dwarves and even orcs of the Exiles walk under the Heartwood, and the elves' reputation soars.

outcomes.title: The Pirate Lighthouse
outcomes.text: The Brotherhood builds a lighthouse on the Salt Isles and charges every passing ship for its light. Merchants pay gladly to avoid the reefs, and Red Harbour becomes a respectable port.

outcomes.title: The Hag-Queens' Council of Peace
outcomes.text: The Hag-Queens of Morrowgast invite envoys of Sunvale and the Order to a council at the Ashlands' edge. They offer to end the Blessing of children if the Order ends its crusade, and the Order's knights are split.

outcomes.title: The Great Locust Swarm
outcomes.text: A swarm of locusts so large it darkens the sun crosses from the Ashlands into Sunvale and Aldermere. The fields are stripped bare, and every realm of the south faces a hungry winter.

outcomes.title: The Thane-King's Hold of Glass
outcomes.text: The Thane-King of Karak Dûm builds a new hold with windows of Veyl glass, the first dwarven hall open to the sky. Old dwarves are scandalised, young dwarves move in by the hundred and the Deepholds begin to look outward.

outcomes.title: The Bandits Who Became Lords
outcomes.text: A band of outlaws who cleared the goblins from a valley of the High Wilds is granted the valley as a lordship by Hollowcrown's crown. Former brigands become knights, and outlaws across the Great Isle take note.

outcomes.title: The Unbreathing's Letter
outcomes.text: A letter in Malgrath's own hand arrives at the Council of the Kingdoms, offering to name the traitors in every court if the kingdoms withdraw from the strait. The council refuses, but every king reads the list of names that came with it.

outcomes.title: The Wine War
outcomes.text: Sunvale bans Westmarch's ships from its harbours after a quarrel over wine duties, and Westmarch answers by seizing Sunvale's wine fleet. The southern kingdoms come to the edge of war over barrels.

outcomes.title: A Comet Lands in the Fens
outcomes.text: A falling star lands in Aldermere's fens, and the Free Clans find a lump of star-iron in the crater. They forge it into a crown, and say it is a sign that the fens will be a kingdom.

outcomes.title: The Drowned Valley
outcomes.text: Aldermere's new dam in the High Wilds bursts in the spring floods, drowning the valley below it. Hundreds die, the hill clans swear vengeance and the crown's engineers are hanged.

outcomes.title: The Last Voice
outcomes.text: The last of the Spire's masked Voices is killed by a Hollowcrown priest's prayer on Thornwatch's wall. Malgrath has no more sorcerers to send south, and must come himself or not at all.

outcomes.title: The Summer of Blood Flies
outcomes.text: Biting flies hatch in their millions from the summer marshes of Aldermere and Sunvale, and a wasting fever follows them. Field-workers fall sick at harvest-time, armies on the march lose men to fever rather than swords, and the Elderwood's healers are begged for a cure.

outcomes.title: The Coronation at Thornwatch
outcomes.text: The Warden of Thornwatch, given the strait's defence by every kingdom, is crowned King of the North in the hall of Thornwatch Keep with a crown forged from orc axes. The southern kingdoms protest at a new crown among them; the soldiers on the wall cheer.

outcomes.title: The Dye-Makers' Secret
outcomes.text: Westmarch's dyers discover how to make a purple dye from a Salt Isles sea-snail, and purple cloth becomes the fashion of every court. The Brotherhood controls the snail-beds and doubles the price, and Westmarch must trade with its pirates.

outcomes.title: The Rebel Bishop
outcomes.text: A priest of the Silver Flame in Aldermere's eastern counties refuses Hollowcrown's Prelacy and declares the lake country's churches free. Aldermere's king protects him, the Prelacy excommunicates both and the two kingdoms' faiths begin to drift apart.

outcomes.title: The Goblin Tunnels Open
outcomes.text: Miners of Hollowcrown break into the goblins' warrens beneath the High Wilds and find tunnels running for miles under the mountains, some to Aldermere, some under the strait. Every crown wants maps of them, and the goblins fight for their home.

outcomes.title: The Coven Builds a City
outcomes.text: Morrowgast's Hag-Queens begin building a new city on the edge of the Ashlands, with walls of red stone raised by blood-magic in a single night. Sunvale sees a fortress aimed at its heart; the Coven says it is a market town.

outcomes.title: The Mercenaries' Strike
outcomes.text: The free companies hired to man Thornwatch's wall go unpaid for three months and down their weapons in the middle of the summer campaign. The Warden must find their wages or hold the wall with his own men.

outcomes.title: An Orc Ambassador to Aldermere
outcomes.text: The free orc clans of the Northern Isle send an ambassador to Aldermere's court asking for weapons and recognition. The king receives him in the great hall, and the great houses walk out.

outcomes.title: The Pearl Divers' Find
outcomes.text: Pearl divers off Sunvale's coast find a sunken Elder Age city on the sea floor, its streets still paved and its temples whole. Sunvale, the Brotherhood and Veyl all send divers, and the first treasures come up within the month.

outcomes.title: The Lost Heir of Hollowcrown
outcomes.text: A young shepherd of Hollowcrown's mountains is found to bear the silver birthmark of the royal line. The mountain lords proclaim him the rightful king; the Prelacy says he is a fraud, and the realm takes sides.

outcomes.title: The Grain Merchants' Cartel
outcomes.text: Veyl's grain merchants agree among themselves to raise the price of grain to the Great Isle. Bread prices double in every city, and the kingdoms threaten to seize Veyl's ships in their harbours.

outcomes.title: The Exiles' Pact with the Centaurs
outcomes.text: The Ashen Exiles and the centaurs of the Eastern Isle's plains, both outcasts among the peoples, swear an oath of friendship. Orc warriors ride centaur-back on raids, and both peoples grow bolder.

outcomes.title: The Drought of the Lake Country
outcomes.text: The summer rains fail in Aldermere and the lake shrinks a man's height. The lake towns' wells run dry, the eel weirs stand in mud and the crown must cart water from the hills.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Defector Prince
outcomes.text: A son of one of the Horde's great war-chiefs flees the Northern Isle with his warband and offers his service to the King of the North. He knows the Spire's paths and tunnels, and Thornwatch begins to plan a raid on the Blackspire itself.

outcomes.title: The Riviera Fire
outcomes.text: A fire sweeps through the dry vineyards of Sunvale's Riviera and burns for a week. A year's wine is lost, the court's summer palace burns and Sunvale's richest families are ruined.

outcomes.title: The Dwarven Cathedral
outcomes.text: The Deepholds carve a great hall of worship inside a mountain for their ancestors, the largest room ever made by any people. Pilgrims of every realm come to see it, and the dwarves begin to welcome visitors.

outcomes.title: The Plague Ships of the Brotherhood
outcomes.text: Pirate ships carrying a coughing sickness put into Sunvale's and Westmarch's harbours. Ports close their gates to every ship, and the southern sea's trade stops for a month.

outcomes.title: The Lake Treaty
outcomes.text: Aldermere and the Free Clans sign the Lake Treaty, sharing the fens' eel weirs and giving the clans a seat on Aldermere's council. The fens war ends for good, and the clans' warriors march north to the wall.

outcomes.title: The Bandits of the Pilgrim Road
outcomes.text: Outlaws prey on the pilgrims walking to the Silver Flame, robbing and killing them in the mountain passes. Hollowcrown's Silver Guard must turn from the wall to guard the pilgrim road.

outcomes.title: The Heartwood's Seedling Blooms
outcomes.text: The Heartwood seedling planted on the Great Isle blooms for the first time, and the sick of Aldermere's south come to sleep beneath it and wake healed. Aldermere's lords guard it jealously, and the elves ask for it back.

outcomes.title: The Battle of the Summer Strait
outcomes.text: The fleets of Thornwatch, the Elderwood and the Deepholds meet the Horde's whole fleet in the strait. The battle lasts from dawn to dusk, a hundred ships burn and when the smoke clears the strait belongs to the alliance.

outcomes.title: The Usurper of the Coven
outcomes.text: A young Blessed warlord kills two Hag-Queens of Morrowgast and proclaims that the Blessed will rule themselves. The Coven-Realm splits between the witches and the warriors, and its border with Sunvale goes quiet while it fights itself.

outcomes.title: The Free Women of Westmarch
outcomes.text: The widows of Westmarch's sailors lost at sea form a guild and demand the right to own their husbands' ships. The merchant princes refuse, the widows seize the harbour of Bellhaven and the guild halls back them.

outcomes.title: A Lord of the Exiles
outcomes.text: The chief of the Ashen Exiles is granted a lordship on Thornwatch's coast and takes a seat in the Council of the Kingdoms. An orc sits among kings, and the Horde's clans hear of it.

outcomes.title: The Midsummer Floods
outcomes.text: Summer storms flood the rivers of the Great Isle in the middle of the harvest. The wheat rots in the fields, the price of bread soars and every kingdom faces a hungry winter.

outcomes.title: The Glass Senate's Exile
outcomes.text: Veyl's Glass Senate exiles its First Magistrate for selling the Republic's secrets to the Spire. She flees to the Northern Isle, and the kingdoms fear what she has told Malgrath.

outcomes.title: The Mountain Republic
outcomes.text: The hill clans of the unruled peaks between Aldermere and Hollowcrown unite into a republic of shepherds with a council of elders. They ask both kingdoms to recognise them, and both send soldiers instead.

outcomes.title: The Lake Kingdom's Coronation
outcomes.text: The Free Clans crown their first king in the fens, a war-leader who fought on Thornwatch's wall. Aldermere's king sends a gift, and the great houses are horrified.

outcomes.title: The Pirates' Peace with Veyl
outcomes.text: The Brotherhood signs a peace with Veyl, guarding the Republic's ships in exchange for a share of its trade. Westmarch's merchants are left alone against the pirates.

outcomes.title: The Hag of the Wall
outcomes.text: A Hag-Queen exiled from Morrowgast comes to Thornwatch's wall and offers her blood-magic against the Horde. The Warden accepts, the Order threatens to leave the wall and the Prelacy calls it damnation.

outcomes.title: The Drowned Gold Mine
outcomes.text: The gold-camps of the High Wilds are flooded by a summer storm, and hundreds of prospectors drown. The gold-fields are buried under mud, and the boom-town is abandoned.

outcomes.title: The Elves' New Grove
outcomes.text: The elves plant a new Heartwood grove in the unruled forests of the Eastern Isle's north. Half the Elderwood's people move there, and the elves' borders spread for the first time in a thousand years.

outcomes.title: The Wool Famine
