outcomes.text: A sickness kills Aldermere's sheep by the thousand, and the wool trade collapses. The lake towns' weavers starve, and the great houses' revenues fall by half.

outcomes.title: The Black Shore Thaws
outcomes.text: A summer of unusual heat melts the ice that has gripped the Northern Isle's southern shore for years. Its coves open to boats, and Thornwatch's raiders land on the Northern Isle at places no one has reached in a generation.

outcomes.title: The Salt Pans Seized
outcomes.text: Brotherhood crews seize the salt pans of Sunvale's southern coast and sell the salt back to Sunvale at five times the price. The court cannot afford to retake them, and Sunvale's fishing towns cannot cure their catch.

outcomes.title: The Archmagister's Vision
outcomes.text: The Archmagister of the Conclave has a vision of the Blackspire falling, and of the price: the Tower of Stars itself. The Conclave's masters are divided over whether to pay it.

outcomes.title: The Highway Robbers
outcomes.text: Robbers on the road between Westmarch and Sunvale take a convoy of the merchant princes' gold. The princes accuse Sunvale's court, and Sunvale accuses Westmarch's own merchants.

outcomes.title: A Wedding at the Wall
outcomes.text: A prince of Aldermere marries a daughter of the King of the North on Thornwatch's wall, with the Horde's fires visible across the strait. The north and the south are bound together.

outcomes.title: The Swamp Fever
outcomes.text: A fever spreads from the fens of the Free Clans to Aldermere's lake towns. Thousands are sick, and the Elderwood's healers save many.

outcomes.title: The Dwarves' Iron Road North
outcomes.text: The Deepholds finish a road of iron rails from Karak Dûm to the Eastern Isle's northern coast, carrying dwarven warriors and ore to the sea in days. The dwarves can now reach the Northern Isle faster than any other people.

outcomes.title: The Long Summer Day Rebellion
outcomes.text: On midsummer day the serfs of Hollowcrown's southern valleys lay down their tools and march on the Prelacy's tithe-barns, singing hymns of the Silver Flame. The priests cannot bring themselves to order soldiers against hymn-singers, and the tithe is halved.

outcomes.title: The Sunvale Regency Crisis
outcomes.text: Sunvale's king falls into a long sickness and names no regent. The Grand Ministry and the eastern barons each proclaim a regency, two councils sign laws in the king's name and Sunvale's officials do not know whom to obey.

outcomes.title: The Trade Embassy from the East
outcomes.text: Ships with red silk sails come into Veyl from an empire beyond the eastern ocean, bringing silk, spices and a request for steel. Veyl's Senate trades with them, the Deepholds sell them arms and the kingdoms wonder what the strangers want steel for.

outcomes.title: The Escaped Slaves of the Spire
outcomes.text: Thousands of human and orc slaves of the Horde's iron mines rise in a single night across the Northern Isle's southern hills and flee to the coast. Thornwatch sends every boat it has to carry them off, and the Spire's forges go cold.

outcomes.title: The Burning Sky
outcomes.text: A rain of falling stars lights the sky over the Great Isle for three nights. Fires break out in dry fields from Westmarch to Hollowcrown, and every prophet in the world finds a meaning in it.

outcomes.title: The Tower's Crater
outcomes.text: A failed rite of renegade mages blows a crater in Lake Halmoor's eastern shore, killing a village and leaving a pit that glows at night. The Conclave denies any part in it, and Aldermere's council demands the Tower's masters be tried.

outcomes.title: The Elves' Arrow of Warning
outcomes.text: The Lady of the Elderwood sends a single white arrow to every crown of the world, the old elven sign that a great war is coming. Some courts laugh; Thornwatch, Hollowcrown and the Deepholds begin to arm.

outcomes.title: The Free Clans' Charter
outcomes.text: Aldermere's king grants the Free Clans of the Lakeshore a royal charter recognising their moot, their fens and their right to bear arms. The great houses who held the fens are compensated with lands taken from the crown, and the fens war ends.

outcomes.title: The Copper Strike
outcomes.text: Prospectors find copper in the unruled hills between Westmarch and Aldermere. Both realms claim the hills, miners of both pour in and the Concord's council is asked to draw a line.

outcomes.title: The Dragon's Child
outcomes.text: A dragon's egg found in the Deepholds' mines hatches in the heat of the great forge. The Thane-King raises the young dragon in Karak Dûm, the elves warn it will burn the world and every kingdom wants one.

outcomes.title: The Thieves of Veyl's Vaults
outcomes.text: A gang of thieves tunnels into the vaults of Veyl's oldest bank and takes a fortune in glass ducats. The thieves are never found, the bank fails and the merchants of three realms lose their savings.

outcomes.title: A Peace of the Ashlands
outcomes.text: Envoys of Sunvale and Morrowgast sign a treaty dividing the unruled Ashlands between them along an old Elder Age road. The raids stop for the first time in years, and both realms begin settling their halves.

outcomes.title: The Hill Clans Unite
outcomes.text: The hill clans of the unruled peaks between Aldermere and Hollowcrown unite under an elected chief and refuse both kingdoms' tolls on their passes. Both kingdoms must bargain with the clans or fight them in their own mountains.

outcomes.title: The Order's New Rule
outcomes.text: The knights of the Lantern adopt a new rule allowing any person of any people, even orcs and converted Blessed, to take the Order's vows. Old knights leave in disgust; new knights flock to Lanternhold from every realm.

outcomes.title: The Brotherhood Builds a Navy
outcomes.text: Red Mara orders a dozen war-galleys built in the yards of Red Harbour with timber bought from Westmarch's own merchants. The Brotherhood becomes a navy, and every kingdom with a coast must decide whether to fight it or hire it.

outcomes.title: The Blackspire Shudders
outcomes.text: The Blackspire shakes for an hour as if struck by an earthquake, and its black light flickers. The orc clans whisper that the Unbreathing is weakening, and three war-chiefs refuse the Spire's summons.

outcomes.title: The Merchants' Fair at Bellhaven
outcomes.text: Westmarch holds a great summer fair for merchants of every realm, even the free orcs. Trade treaties are signed, the price of grain falls and Westmarch's harbours fill again.

outcomes.title: A Princess Takes the Veil
outcomes.text: The heir of Aldermere's throne, a princess, takes the vows of the Silver Flame and renounces her claim. The succession passes to a cousin few respect, and the great houses begin to scheme.

outcomes.title: The Drought of the North
outcomes.text: The summer rains fail across Thornwatch and the Northern Isle. The Horde's herds die, Thornwatch's fields wither and both sides of the strait face a hungry winter.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Envoy at the Wall
outcomes.text: An envoy of the Blackspire comes to Thornwatch's wall under a white banner and offers a truce for the harvest. The Warden accepts, and for a month neither side fights while both bring in what grain they can.

outcomes.title: The Midsummer Fires
outcomes.text: On midsummer night the bonfires of every village on the Great Isle burn green instead of gold. Priests, mages and hedge-witches argue over what it means, and in Aldermere's east a mob burns the woman who first said it was a curse.

outcomes.title: The Steward Who Would Be King
outcomes.text: The royal steward of Hollowcrown, keeper of the palace keys for thirty years, locks the gates on the court during a feast and proclaims himself regent for a sickly heir. The Prelacy and the mountain lords, for once, unite against him.

outcomes.title: The Salt Isles' Pearl Rush
outcomes.text: A Brotherhood diver brings up a pearl the size of a hen's egg from the reefs of the Salt Isles. Fortune-seekers from every port sail south, Red Mara charges them for diving rights and the Brotherhood grows richer without firing a shot.

outcomes.title: The Hidden Valley of the Elves
outcomes.text: Rangers of the Elderwood find a hidden valley in the Eastern Isle's unruled mountains where a lost clan of elves has lived alone since the Fading began. They are wilder and more numerous than anyone guessed, and they do not want to be found.

outcomes.title: The Bellfounders' Plot
outcomes.text: The bellfounders' guild of Westmarch is caught casting cannon for Morrowgast in secret. The merchant princes hang the guildmaster, the Coven loses its new guns and Westmarch's foundries are put under the council's guard.

outcomes.title: The Wedding of the Strait
outcomes.text: A daughter of Thornwatch's Warden marries a chief of the free orc clans of the Northern Isle's southern coast. It is the first marriage alliance across the strait in history, and the Spire sends assassins to the wedding.

outcomes.title: The Heatwave
outcomes.text: A great heat settles on the Great Isle for a month. Wells run dry, the old and the sick die in the cities and the Horde, used to the cold, lies panting in its camps across the strait.

outcomes.title: The Great Library of the Lake
outcomes.text: The Conclave of the Lake opens a public library in Aldermere's lake city with copies of its least dangerous books. Scholars of every realm come, the Prelacy forbids its priests to enter and the lake city becomes the Great Isle's seat of learning.

outcomes.title: The Riders of the Plains
outcomes.text: The centaurs of the Eastern Isle's plains raid Veyl's new frontier farms, angry at the fences across their grazing. Veyl's Senate sends soldiers, the centaurs outride them and the Republic must choose between war and a treaty with horsemen.

outcomes.title: The Tithe of Children
outcomes.text: The Hag-Queens of Morrowgast decree that every family must give one child to the Blessing. Thousands flee west across the Ashlands into Sunvale, and the Coven's own border garrisons look away as they pass.

outcomes.title: The Lost Cog
outcomes.text: A Westmarch cog lost at sea two years ago drifts into Bellhaven with no crew and a hold full of maps of unknown coasts. The merchant princes fit out three ships to follow the maps, and every court's spies try to copy them.

outcomes.title: The Earthquake of the Deeps
outcomes.text: A deep earthquake shakes the Deepholds and opens a crack in the floor of Karak Dûm's great hall. Hot air rises from it, the dwarves smell sulphur and the Remembrancers say the mountain's heart is waking.

outcomes.title: The Smugglers' Coast
outcomes.text: Smugglers take over a stretch of unruled coast between Westmarch and Aldermere and build a town of warehouses there, trading in everything both crowns forbid. Neither crown can agree who should clear it.

outcomes.title: The Red Moon Over the Coven Hollow
outcomes.text: The moon rises red over Morrowgast every night for a week. The Blessed grow restless and violent, three border towns of Sunvale are attacked and the Hag-Queens say they did not order it.

outcomes.title: The Harvest of Plenty
outcomes.text: The best harvest in a generation comes in across Aldermere and Westmarch. Granaries overflow, bread is cheap and the crowns can feed their armies on the wall without taxing the poor.

outcomes.title: The Prince of Thieves
outcomes.text: A charming thief who has robbed every great house of Aldermere is caught and turns out to be the king's own nephew. The court is scandalised, the people love him and the king must decide between justice and family.

outcomes.title: The Iron Rain
outcomes.text: Hail of iron-grey stones falls on the Northern Isle's southern coast, killing herds and smashing longships. The orcs say the sky has turned against the Spire; Thornwatch's scholars collect the stones and find them full of star-iron.

outcomes.title: A Treaty of the Centaurs
outcomes.text: The Deepholds sign a treaty with the centaurs of the Eastern Isle's plains, trading steel for horses and grazing rights. The dwarves have cavalry for the first time, and Veyl watches the balance of the east shift.

outcomes.title: The Lake Pirates' Hideout
outcomes.text: Outlaws with fast boats raid the lake towns of Aldermere from hideouts in the reed islands of Lake Halmoor's southern shore. The crown's lake patrols cannot find them in the reeds, and the lake towns hire their own guards.

outcomes.title: The Elder Road North
outcomes.text: Scouts of Thornwatch find a paved Elder Age road running north under the strait's shallows at low tide. At the lowest tides of the year an army could walk to the Northern Isle, and both Thornwatch and the Spire set guards on it.

outcomes.title: The Fishermen's War
outcomes.text: The fishing fleets of Westmarch and Sunvale fight a pitched battle with boathooks and harpoons over the cod banks of the Ostcombe Sea. A dozen boats sink, both crowns send warships and the Concord's council must make peace on the water.

outcomes.title: A King Abdicates for Love
outcomes.text: The young king of Sunvale abdicates to marry a commoner actress from Solenne's theatres. His cousin takes the crown, the court is scandalised and the people of Sunvale sing songs about him in every tavern.

outcomes.title: The Witch-Trials of Hollowcrown
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's Prelacy holds great witch-trials in every mountain town after a run of failed harvests. Hundreds are accused, dozens burn and the mountain lords begin to hide their own healers.

outcomes.title: The Exiles' Iron Mine
outcomes.text: The Ashen Exiles find iron in the hills of their islet and open their own mine and forge. They no longer need Thornwatch's steel, and their chiefs begin to speak as equals at the Council of the Kingdoms.

outcomes.title: The Plague of Frogs
outcomes.text: Frogs swarm out of Aldermere's fens in their millions after a summer storm, fouling wells and fields. The great houses blame the Free Clans' witchcraft, and the Free Clans blame Aldermere's drainage of their marshes.

outcomes.title: The Glass Senate Elects a Dwarf
outcomes.text: Veyl's Glass Senate elects a dwarven senator as First Magistrate for the first time in the Republic's history. Human banking houses walk out of the Senate, and the dwarven quarter celebrates in the streets.

outcomes.title: The Bandit Bridge
outcomes.text: A band of outlaws seizes the great bridge over the river between Aldermere and Sunvale and charges a toll to every traveller. Neither crown will send soldiers into the other's land to clear it, so the outlaws grow rich.

outcomes.title: The Coven's Envoy Converts
outcomes.text: A Hag-Queen sent by Morrowgast as envoy to Hollowcrown takes the vows of the Silver Flame and asks for sanctuary. The Coven demands her back, Hollowcrown refuses and the two realms' priests and witches curse each other from the mountains.

outcomes.title: The Midsummer Tournament of Thornwatch
outcomes.text: Thornwatch holds a tournament on the wall itself to keep its soldiers' spirits up. Knights of every realm, orcs of the Exiles and dwarves of the Deepholds compete, and an elven archer wins the shooting.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Silence
outcomes.text: For a whole month no raid crosses the strait and no light shows on the Blackspire. Thornwatch does not know whether the Spire is weakening or preparing, and the Council of the Kingdoms argues over whether to strike.

outcomes.title: The Pirates' Feud
outcomes.text: Two Brotherhood captains fall out over a prize and their crews fight a battle in Red Harbour itself. A dozen ships burn at their moorings, and Red Mara must hang one captain to keep the peace.

outcomes.title: A Saint's Body Incorrupt
outcomes.text: The tomb of a Silver Flame saint is opened in Hollowcrown and her body is found uncorrupted after two centuries. Pilgrims pour in, the Prelacy's coffers fill and the mountain lords complain that the priests profit from the dead.

outcomes.title: The Dam Breaks in the Fens
outcomes.text: A dyke built by Aldermere to drain the fens breaks in a summer storm, flooding the new farms and drowning the settlers' cattle. The Free Clans say the fens took back what was stolen; the crown suspects sabotage.

outcomes.title: The Archmagister's Bargain
outcomes.text: The Archmagister of the Conclave offers to share the Tower's war-magic with any kingdom that recognises the Conclave as a sovereign power. Aldermere and Thornwatch accept; Hollowcrown refuses and calls the Conclave a kingdom of witches.

outcomes.title: The Market of the Ashlands
outcomes.text: Merchants of Sunvale and Morrowgast build a market town at a crossroads in the unruled Ashlands, trading under a truce. It grows into a town of thousands, and both realms claim it.

outcomes.title: The Lost Prince of Westmarch
outcomes.text: A young man arrives in Bellhaven claiming to be the son of a merchant prince drowned twenty years ago, with a ring and a birthmark to prove it. If he is real, he inherits the richest house in Westmarch, and its present heirs hire assassins.

outcomes.title: The Wild Hunt of the Fens
outcomes.text: Ghostly riders sweep through Aldermere's fens on moonless nights, carrying off anyone found out of doors. The Free Clans stay in their stockades, and Aldermere's patrols refuse to ride after dark.

outcomes.title: The Deepholds' Gift to the Wall
outcomes.text: The Deepholds send Thornwatch a great chain of star-iron to stretch across the narrowest part of the strait. Once raised, no longship can pass it, and the Horde's raids by sea become far harder.

outcomes.title: A Summer Without Rain
outcomes.text: No rain falls in Sunvale for two months. The vineyards wither, the rivers shrink to streams and Sunvale's peasants march on Solenne demanding the court open its granaries.

outcomes.title: The Hollow King
outcomes.text: A man in a mask who calls himself the Hollow King gathers the outlaws of the High Wilds and declares a kingdom of the dispossessed. His followers raid only lords, and the poor of two kingdoms send him bread.

outcomes.title: The Great Flood of the Lake
outcomes.text: A summer cloudburst over the High Wilds sends a wall of water down into Lake Halmoor. The lake rises in a night, Aldermere's lower city floods to the rooftops and thousands are left homeless at the height of summer.

outcomes.title: A Royal Marriage of the East
outcomes.text: The heir of Veyl's richest banking house marries a daughter of the Thane-King of Karak Dûm. Dwarven steel and Veyl's gold are joined, and the Elderwood finds itself the odd one out on its own isle.

outcomes.title: The Hornets of the Ashlands
outcomes.text: Giant hornets, made monstrous by the Coven's old rites, swarm out of the Ashlands and kill travellers on Sunvale's eastern roads. The court offers gold for every nest burned, and hunters flock east.

outcomes.title: The Silver Flame Marches
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's First Prelate leads ten thousand pilgrims armed with staves and prayers into the Ashlands to cleanse it of witchcraft. Morrowgast's Blessed meet them, and the slaughter shocks every realm.

outcomes.title: The Gold of the Fens
outcomes.text: Peat-cutters in the Free Clans' fens find a buried hoard of Elder Age gold. The clans use it to buy weapons and boats, and Aldermere's great houses demand a share of treasure found on what they call their land.

outcomes.title: A Chief of the Horde Converts
outcomes.text: A war-chief of the Horde, captured on Thornwatch's wall, takes the vows of the Silver Flame. Freed, he returns to the Northern Isle to preach, and the Spire's Voices hunt him across the island.

outcomes.title: The Tanners' Revolt
outcomes.text: The tanners and leather-workers of Aldermere's lake city, crushed by new taxes, seize the tanning quarter and barricade its streets. The stink of a month's untanned hides hangs over the city while the crown negotiates.

outcomes.title: The Exiles' Navy Victory
outcomes.text: The Ashen Exiles' longships sink a Horde fleet sent to destroy their islet. For the first time the Exiles are masters of their own waters, and orc clans across the Northern Isle hear the news.

outcomes.title: The Grain Ships Seized
outcomes.text: Veyl seizes Sunvale's grain ships in its harbour in payment of Sunvale's debts. Sunvale's court protests, its people go hungry and its barons begin to talk of war with the Republic.

outcomes.title: The Fall of a Watchtower
outcomes.text: A Horde war-band climbs Thornwatch's wall at night and takes one of its towers, holding it for three days before it is retaken. The breach shows the wall's weakness, and the kingdoms send more men north.

outcomes.title: A Plague of Mice
outcomes.text: Mice swarm out of the granaries of Westmarch in a plague year, eating the stored grain. The merchant princes' profits vanish, and the price of bread doubles across the Great Isle.

outcomes.title: The Comet of the Heartwood
outcomes.text: A comet appears over the Eastern Isle and its tail points at the Heartwood. The elves say it is a sign the Heartwood will soon be in danger, and the Greywatch rides out to guard the forest's borders.

outcomes.title: The Pirate Pardon
outcomes.text: Westmarch offers a pardon to any pirate who will sail for its navy against the Horde. A hundred Brotherhood sailors take it, Red Mara loses three ships and Westmarch gains a fleet of experienced fighters.

outcomes.title: A Prophet in the Deepholds
outcomes.text: A dwarven prophet in Karak Dûm preaches that the dwarves must abandon their holds and live under the sky. The young follow him out of the mountains, and the Thane-King fears his people are leaving.

outcomes.title: The Summer Storm of the North
outcomes.text: A storm out of the north wrecks Thornwatch's harbour and its fishing fleet. The Wardenmark's people go hungry, and the wall's garrison must be fed by sea from the south.

outcomes.title: A Lasting Peace Offered
outcomes.text: The Hag-Queens of Morrowgast offer Sunvale a lasting peace: an end to raids, the Ashlands divided and the Blessing forbidden on Sunvale's people. Sunvale's court accepts; the Order of the Lantern swears to fight on alone.

outcomes.title: The Wool Smugglers
outcomes.text: Smugglers carry Aldermere's wool past the crown's tolls to Westmarch's harbours by the mountain paths. The crown loses a quarter of its wool revenue, and the great houses demand the passes be closed.

outcomes.title: The Last Dragon Rider
outcomes.text: An old woman of Hollowcrown's mountains is found to be the last of an Elder Age order of dragon-riders, with a dragon's egg kept warm in her hearth for sixty years. Every crown wants the egg; she gives it to the Order of the Lantern.

outcomes.title: The Bridge of Boats
outcomes.text: Thornwatch's engineers build a bridge of boats across the strait at its narrowest for a single night's raid on the Northern Isle. The raid burns a Horde war-camp, and the bridge is cut loose before dawn.

outcomes.title: The Free Clans' Vote
outcomes.text: The Free Clans of the Lakeshore hold the first open vote in the history of the Great Isle, every clan member choosing the moot's leader. The great houses call it chaos; the peasants of Aldermere begin to ask why they cannot vote too.

outcomes.title: The Harvest Strike
outcomes.text: Field-workers across Aldermere's southern counties refuse to bring in the harvest unless their lords lower the rents. The wheat stands ripe in the fields, the lords bring in hired hands from Westmarch and fights break out in a dozen villages.

outcomes.title: The Glass Crown
outcomes.text: Veyl's richest banker, having bought up the debts of half the Great Isle, has a crown of glass made and wears it at his feasts. The Glass Senate fines him for pretending to royalty; he pays the fine and keeps the crown, and kings begin to court him.

outcomes.title: The River Pirates of Sunvale
outcomes.text: Outlaws in fast boats rob the barges on Sunvale's great river, which carry the Riviera's wine to the sea. The court's river-wardens are bribed or drowned, and Sunvale's wine trade dries up.

outcomes.title: The Ashen Exiles' Holy Mountain
outcomes.text: The Ashen Exiles' shamans declare a mountain on the Northern Isle's unruled west sacred to the old spirits and send warriors to hold it. Orcs who flee the Spire make pilgrimage there, and the Horde sends war-bands to tear down its shrines.

outcomes.title: The Forest Fire of the Elderwood
outcomes.text: A summer fire, set by lightning, burns along the Elderwood's eastern edge for two weeks. The elves fight it with songs that call the rain, and it dies at last, but a hundred ancient trees are lost.

outcomes.title: The Orphans' Crusade
outcomes.text: Orphans of the war in the north, thousands of them, gather at Thornwatch begging to be soldiers. The Warden takes the oldest as drummers and scouts, and sends the rest south to be fed by the kingdoms that sent their fathers.

outcomes.title: The Tin Mines of Westmarch
outcomes.text: Westmarch's prospectors find tin in its western hills. The merchant princes rush to mine it, bronze becomes cheap and Westmarch's foundries begin casting cannon to sell to any kingdom that pays.

outcomes.title: The Hag-Queen's Pardon
outcomes.text: A Hag-Queen of Morrowgast, captured by the Order of the Lantern, is pardoned by Sunvale's king in exchange for the secret of curing the Blessing. The Order is outraged, and the first cured Blessed walk out of Sunvale's prisons.

outcomes.title: The Wild Boars of Aldermere
outcomes.text: Great boars, driven out of the High Wilds by the drought, ravage the farmland of Aldermere's north. The crown declares a great hunt, and knights of every great house ride out to win glory against swine.

outcomes.title: The Lake Treaty Broken
outcomes.text: Aldermere's great houses, angry at the Free Clans' charter, send their own men into the fens to drive the clans out. The king cannot stop them, and the fens war begins again.

outcomes.title: The Silver Coin of the North
outcomes.text: Thornwatch begins striking its own silver coin from captured Horde silver, with an orc axe on one side. Merchants of every realm accept it, and the march becomes a kingdom in all but name.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Bride Rescued
outcomes.text: Thornwatch's raiders rescue a princess of Hollowcrown held in a Spire tower on the Northern Isle's coast for three years. She brings back knowledge of the Spire's inner halls, and the Council of the Kingdoms begins to plan.

outcomes.title: The Ghost Ship of Veyl
outcomes.text: A ship with no crew sails into Veyl's harbour with its hold full of black ice that does not melt. The Glass Senate's scholars study it, and three of them freeze to death in the night.

outcomes.title: The Deepholds' Iron Bridge
outcomes.text: The Deepholds build an iron bridge across the chasm that divided Karak Dûm from the eastern holds. The dwarves' trade flows freely, and the iron bridge becomes the wonder of the age.

outcomes.title: The Lake Fog
outcomes.text: A thick fog settles on Lake Halmoor and does not lift for a month. Boats lose their way, the Conclave's isle cannot be found and the lake towns whisper that the Tower has hidden itself.

outcomes.title: The Saint of the Ashlands
outcomes.text: A healer in the unruled Ashlands who tends Sunvalese and Blessed alike is proclaimed a saint by the people of both sides. The Order and the Coven both try to claim her, and she refuses both.

outcomes.title: The Summer of Wolves
outcomes.text: Wolf packs, driven by drought, come down from the hills into every realm of the Great Isle. Shepherds lose their flocks, travellers are attacked on the roads and the kings offer bounties.

outcomes.title: The Treaty of the Strait's Chain
outcomes.text: Thornwatch and the free orc clans of the Northern Isle's southern coast agree to share the strait: free orcs may fish its waters and Thornwatch's ships may land on their shore. The Spire's grip on the strait loosens.

outcomes.title: The Grain Riots of the Lake City
outcomes.text: Bread prices double in Aldermere's lake city after the harvest strike, and the poor storm the bakeries. The crown opens its granaries, the riots end and the great houses blame the king for giving way.

outcomes.title: The Conclave's Flying Ship
outcomes.text: The Conclave of the Lake launches a ship that sails on the wind above Lake Halmoor. It flies only a mile before it falls, but every kingdom's envoys rush to the Tower to ask what it could carry.

outcomes.title: The Blood Feud of the Great Houses
outcomes.text: A duel between heirs of two of Aldermere's great houses ends in death, and their families begin a blood feud that spreads across the lake country. Manors burn, ambushes fill the roads and the king cannot make them stop.

outcomes.title: The Coven's Queen
outcomes.text: The Hag-Queens of Morrowgast choose one of their number to rule as queen for the first time, a young witch who promises to end the Blessing of children. The old Hags resist, and the Coven-Realm is torn between reform and rite.

outcomes.title: The Merchant Fleet of the East
outcomes.text: Veyl, the Deepholds and the Elderwood join their merchant fleets into a single company sailing to the Great Isle. Their ships are faster, their cargoes cheaper and Westmarch's merchant princes begin to lose their trade.

outcomes.title: The Warden's Heir Lost at Sea
outcomes.text: The heir of Thornwatch's Warden is lost when his ship sinks in a summer storm on the strait. The Warden has no other child, and the captains of the wall begin to wonder who will hold it after him.

outcomes.title: The Plague Among the Horses
outcomes.text: A sickness kills the horses of Sunvale and Westmarch by the thousand. Cavalry is crippled, ploughs stand idle and the price of a horse rises tenfold.

outcomes.title: The Free City of the Ashlands
outcomes.text: The market town at the crossroads of the Ashlands declares itself a free city, owing nothing to Sunvale or Morrowgast. It hires a free company to guard its walls, and both realms send envoys instead of armies.

outcomes.title: The Goblin Market
outcomes.text: Goblins of the High Wilds come out of their warrens to trade at a market in the mountains for the first time. They sell gems and mushrooms for iron and salt, and Hollowcrown's priests are horrified.

outcomes.title: A Dwarven Queen
outcomes.text: The Hall of Thanes of the Deepholds elects a woman to the stone throne for the first time in a thousand years. Old thanes grumble, young dwarves cheer and the new Thane-Queen opens the Deepholds' gates wider than ever.

outcomes.title: The Wreck of the Salt Isles' Fleet
outcomes.text: A summer storm catches the Brotherhood's fleet at sea and drives it onto the reefs. Half the pirates' ships are lost, and the Ostcombe Sea is safer than it has been in a decade.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Herald at Veyl
outcomes.text: An envoy of the Blackspire arrives at Veyl and offers the Glass Senate the Northern Isle's iron mines in exchange for ships. The Senate refuses publicly; its banks lend the Spire money privately.

outcomes.title: The Brigands of the Riviera
outcomes.text: Brigands rob the rich travellers of Sunvale's Riviera roads, stripping lords and ladies of their jewels. The court sends soldiers, the brigands vanish into the hills and the poor of the Riviera hide them.

outcomes.title: The Elderwood's Open Door
outcomes.text: The Lady of the Elderwood opens the forest to any human who will swear an oath of peace. Hundreds of refugees from the Great Isle's wars come to live under the trees, and the elves learn to live beside men.

outcomes.title: The Strait Market
outcomes.text: Thornwatch's summer market on the strait's shore draws merchants of every realm and free orcs of the Northern Isle. Furs, amber and iron cross the strait in peace, and the Spire's hold on the orcs' trade breaks.

outcomes.title: The Hollow Crown Found
outcomes.text: The lost hollow crown of Hollowcrown's first priest-queen is found in a peasant's barn in the High Wilds. The Prelacy claims it, the mountain lords claim it and the queen crowns herself with it before either can take it.

outcomes.title: A Rebellion of the Westmarch Fleet
outcomes.text: Westmarch's sailors, unpaid for a season, seize their ships in Bellhaven's harbour and sail them out to sea. They offer their fleet to any crown that will pay, and the Brotherhood makes the first offer.

outcomes.title: The Deep Study's Return
outcomes.text: Mages expelled from the Conclave for practising necromancy build a tower in the unruled hills of Aldermere's north. They offer their dark arts to any kingdom fighting the Spire, and Thornwatch is tempted.

outcomes.title: The Drowning of the Fens
outcomes.text: The summer floods drown the Free Clans' fens. The clans lose their crops and their homes, and their warriors raid Aldermere's farms for food.

outcomes.title: The Treaty of the Isles' Faith
outcomes.text: The priests of the Silver Flame, the elves' Loremasters and the dwarves' Remembrancers meet for the first time and agree that each faith will respect the others. It is the first such agreement in history.

outcomes.title: The Summer Plague
outcomes.text: A spotted plague spreads from the crowded camps behind Thornwatch's wall into the Wardenmark. The garrison sickens, and the Warden must hold the wall with half his men.

outcomes.title: The Orc Who Became a Lord
outcomes.text: An orc of the Ashen Exiles who saved a prince of Aldermere in battle is made a lord of Aldermere by the grateful king. An orc holds lands on the lake shore, and the great houses refuse to sit with him.

outcomes.title: The Dog-Days Mutiny
outcomes.text: In the worst heat of summer the garrison of one of Thornwatch's eastern towers mutinies against its captain, who had them flogged for drinking on watch. They hold the tower for three days, the Warden pardons them to keep the wall manned and every captain on the wall learns to be gentler.

outcomes.title: The Merchant Who Bought a Throne
outcomes.text: A Veyl merchant buys the bankrupt lordship of a Sunvale duke, title and all, and takes his seat in Sunvale's council of lords. The old nobility walk out, the court needs his gold too badly to refuse him and money speaks louder than blood in Solenne.

outcomes.title: The Great Hailstorm
outcomes.text: Hailstones the size of eggs fall across Hollowcrown's valleys and Aldermere's north in a single afternoon. The ripening harvest is beaten flat, roofs cave in and the mountain kingdom faces a lean winter.

outcomes.title: The Hidden School of Witches
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's Prelacy discovers a school of hedge-witches hidden in a mountain convent of the Silver Flame, its nuns teaching healing magic in secret for a century. The Prelacy must decide whether to burn its own nuns or admit that magic can serve the Flame.

outcomes.title: The Sea-Folk's Warning
outcomes.text: People of the sea with gills and webbed hands rise beside a Westmarch fishing fleet and warn, in a broken tongue, that something is coming up from the deep. Within the month, three ships vanish off the Thornshaw coast.

outcomes.title: The Exiles' Champion at the Tournament
outcomes.text: A champion of the Ashen Exiles wins the great summer tournament of Aldermere, unhorsing the kingdom's best knights. The king must crown an orc champion of the realm, and the great houses demand the rules be changed.

outcomes.title: The Blue Pox
outcomes.text: A pox that turns the skin blue spreads through Westmarch's harbour towns. It kills few but marks many, and the marked are shunned; the Elderwood's healers find a cure, and the merchant princes pay well for it.

outcomes.title: The Coven's Lost Rite
outcomes.text: A Hag-Queen of Morrowgast loses the book of the Blessing's rites in a fire. Without it the Coven cannot make new Blessed for a season, and its army stops growing just as Sunvale's barons arm.

outcomes.title: The Hill Forts of Aldermere
outcomes.text: Aldermere's council orders a line of forts built along the High Wilds to keep the goblins and hill clans out. The forts cost a fortune, the taxes rise and the hill clans call it an invasion of their valleys.

outcomes.title: A Dwarven Ambassador to the Spire
outcomes.text: The Deepholds send an ambassador to the Blackspire to ransom dwarven prisoners. He returns with the prisoners and a map of the Spire's mines, and the dwarves begin to plan.

outcomes.title: The Wreckers of the Salt Isles
outcomes.text: Salt Isles islanders who hate the Brotherhood light false lights and wreck three pirate ships on the reefs. Red Mara hangs a village's men, and the islanders' hatred of the pirates grows.

outcomes.title: The Sleeping Army
outcomes.text: Shepherds in the unruled High Wilds find a cave where a hundred armoured warriors of the Elder Age sit sleeping around a stone table. The Conclave forbids anyone to wake them, and three kingdoms send guards to the cave's mouth.

outcomes.title: The Great Wine Glut
outcomes.text: The best grape harvest in a century floods the markets with Sunvale's wine. Its price collapses, the vintners are ruined by plenty and Sunvale's court loses the taxes it counted on.

outcomes.title: The Archmagister's Heir
outcomes.text: The Archmagister of the Conclave names a child of the Free Clans, born with magic in the fens, as heir to the Tower of Stars. The Conclave's masters are scandalised, and Aldermere's great houses fear a fen-born archmage.

outcomes.title: The Fisher-Kings' League
outcomes.text: The fishing towns of the Great Isle's northern coast form a league, sharing their catch and their boats against the Horde's raiders. They fortify their harbours, and the Horde's sea raids grow costly.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Library Burns
outcomes.text: A fire set by escaped slaves burns the great library of the Blackspire. Malgrath's thousand years of lore are lost, and the orc clans whisper that the Unbreathing raged for a week.

outcomes.title: The Riviera Bandits Pardoned
outcomes.text: Sunvale's court pardons the brigands of the Riviera hills if they will serve as the coast's guards. The brigands become wardens, the roads become safe and the Riviera's lords grumble at paying their old robbers.

outcomes.title: The Lantern's Light Over Morrowgast
outcomes.text: The Order of the Lantern raises its founder's lantern on a mountain within sight of Morrowgast, and its light burns over the Coven-Realm every night. The Blessed fall sick in its glow, and the Coven sends an army to break it.

outcomes.title: The Lake Freeze Market
outcomes.text: An unseasonal cold freezes a corner of Lake Halmoor in high summer, and the lake towns hold a market on the ice. The Conclave denies any part in it, and the market is the talk of the Great Isle.

outcomes.title: The Treaty of Three Faiths
outcomes.text: The First Prelate of the Silver Flame, the elves' eldest Loremaster and the dwarves' Keeper of Grudges meet at Veyl and swear that their faiths will not war on each other. It is the first such oath in history.

outcomes.title: The Reapers' Fair
outcomes.text: The harvest fairs of Aldermere and Westmarch are held together on the Lake Road for the first time, and farmers of both realms trade, wrestle and marry across the border. Old feuds soften, and the two crowns' councils notice their people getting along without them.

outcomes.title: The Banker's Coup
outcomes.text: A Veyl banking house that holds Westmarch's war debts calls them in all at once and offers to forgive them in exchange for seats on the merchant princes' council. The princes, unable to pay, accept, and Westmarch is governed in part from Veyl.

outcomes.title: The Silver Wolves of Hollowcrown
outcomes.text: Wolves with silver-grey coats that shine in the dark come down from Hollowcrown's high peaks and kill only the cattle of the Prelacy's tithe-farms. The peasants call them the Flame's own hounds and refuse to hunt them.

outcomes.title: The Exiles' First City
outcomes.text: The Ashen Exiles finish a walled town of stone on their islet, with a hall, a forge and a shrine to the old spirits. Orcs who flee the Horde come to live in a city for the first time, and the Exiles name it Freehold.

outcomes.title: The Bog Mummies
outcomes.text: Peat-cutters in the unruled moors north of Aldermere dig up a dozen bodies preserved in the bog, each with a silver coin of the Elder Age in its mouth. When the coins are taken, the bodies are found sitting up the next morning.

outcomes.title: The Duchess of the Riviera
outcomes.text: A Sunvale duchess who owns half the Riviera's vineyards refuses the court's new wine tax and closes her lands to the king's officers. The other great families watch to see if the crown dares march on its richest subject.

outcomes.title: The Strait Monster
outcomes.text: Something vast moves in the deep water of the strait, overturning Horde longships and Thornwatch fishing boats alike. Both sides of the strait keep to harbour, and for a month there is neither war nor fishing.

outcomes.title: The Deepholds' Census
outcomes.text: The Thane-King of Karak Dûm orders every dwarf in the Deepholds counted for the first time. The count shows the dwarves far fewer than anyone thought, and the Remembrancers demand every dwarf abroad come home.

outcomes.title: The Smugglers' Tunnel
outcomes.text: Smugglers dig a tunnel under the walls of Aldermere's lake city to carry untaxed wine and salt into the markets. When it is found, half the city's guard is found to have been paid to look away.

outcomes.title: The Coven's Marriage Offer
outcomes.text: The Hag-Queens of Morrowgast offer one of their daughters in marriage to Sunvale's heir, with the Ashlands as her dowry. Sunvale's court is tempted by the land and terrified of the bride.

outcomes.title: The Fire of the Silver Mines
outcomes.text: A fire in Hollowcrown's deepest silver mine burns for a month underground, poisoning the air for miles. The mine is lost, the Prelacy's silver income falls and the miners' families march on the capital.

outcomes.title: The Order's Lost Knights Return
outcomes.text: A company of knights of the Lantern, missing in the Ashlands for two years, returns to Lanternhold changed: taller, scarred and fevered with the Blessing. The Order must decide whether they are brothers or monsters.

outcomes.title: The Great Shipwreck
outcomes.text: A Westmarch merchant fleet carrying the year's tin and wool founders in a late summer storm off the Thornshaw coast. The merchant princes lose a fortune, and the coast folk grow rich on the wreckage.

outcomes.title: The Elves Teach the Kingdoms
outcomes.text: The Elderwood opens a school of healing in Aldermere's lake city, teaching human physicians the elves' arts. Deaths from fever fall across the Great Isle, and the elves' standing among men has never been higher.

outcomes.title: The Highwaymen's Code
outcomes.text: The highwaymen of the Great Isle's roads agree a code among themselves: no killing, no robbing the poor and a tithe to the widows of the war. The kings call them outlaws; the villages call them the Gentle Road.

outcomes.title: The Strait Treaty of Orcs
outcomes.text: Thornwatch and the free orc clans of the Northern Isle sign a treaty sharing the strait's fishing and trading rights. It is the first treaty between men and orcs on the strait in history, and the Spire calls the free orcs traitors.

outcomes.title: The Drought Ends in Floods
outcomes.text: The late summer storms break the drought all at once, and the dry rivers of Sunvale flood their banks. Villages are washed away, but the reservoirs fill and the next year's harvest is saved.

outcomes.title: The Lake Tower's Secret Opened
outcomes.text: The Conclave of the Lake opens a sealed room of the Tower of Stars and finds the preserved body of Aldwen, the Tower's founder. She opens her eyes, speaks a single warning about the Spire and dies again.

outcomes.title: The Bandit Bishop
outcomes.text: A priest of the Silver Flame turned outlaw leads a band that robs the Prelacy's tithe-wagons and gives the grain to starving villages. The Prelacy excommunicates him, and the mountain villages build him a church.

outcomes.title: The Free Clans' Navy
outcomes.text: The Free Clans launch a fleet of reed-boats on Lake Halmoor and raid the lake towns' warehouses. Aldermere has no lake fleet ready, and the clans rule the lake for a season.

outcomes.title: The Battle of the Burning Ford
outcomes.text: Sunvale's eastern barons and Morrowgast's Blessed meet at a ford on the edge of the Ashlands and fight from dawn to dusk. The river runs red, the barons hold the ford and Morrowgast's western raids stop for the rest of the year.

outcomes.title: The Princess of Thieves
outcomes.text: A princess of Aldermere is found to have been the leader of the lake city's thieves' guild for three years. The court is scandalised, the people adore her and the king exiles her to the Elderwood rather than hang his own daughter.

outcomes.title: The Ghost Lights of the Fens
outcomes.text: Lights dance over Aldermere's fens at night and lead travellers into the bogs. The Free Clans say the fens are angry at the drainage; Aldermere's engineers refuse to work after dark.

outcomes.title: The Dwarven Rebellion
outcomes.text: Miners of the Deepholds' outer holds rise against the Thane-King's taxes on iron and seize the eastern mines. The Deepholds' first rebellion in centuries shocks the dwarves, and the Thane-King must bargain with his own people.

outcomes.title: The Grain Ships of the North
outcomes.text: Thornwatch, after its best harvest in years, sends grain ships south to sell in Aldermere's markets. The north feeds the south for the first time, and the Warden's voice in the Council of the Kingdoms grows louder.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Lost Heir
outcomes.text: A child of the Horde's ruling clan, said to be marked by Malgrath himself, is smuggled out of the Northern Isle by the Ashen Exiles. Every power wants the child, and the Spire sends war-bands to take it back.

outcomes.title: The Silk Fever
outcomes.text: Silk from the empire beyond the eastern sea becomes the fashion of every court, and the great houses ruin themselves buying it. Veyl's merchants grow rich, and the old cloth guilds of Aldermere starve.

outcomes.title: The Order's Trial of Mages
outcomes.text: The Order of the Lantern puts three mages of the Conclave on trial for witchcraft at Lanternhold. The Conclave demands their release; the Order burns one, and the two powers come to the brink of war.

outcomes.title: The Tidal Wave
outcomes.text: An earthquake under the Ostcombe Sea sends a great wave crashing onto the coasts of Westmarch, Aldermere and Sunvale. Harbours are wrecked, fishing fleets drown and the Salt Isles are half swept away.

outcomes.title: The Elves' Gift of a Seed
outcomes.text: The Lady of the Elderwood gives Aldermere's king a seed of the Heartwood as a pledge of friendship. It is planted in the palace gardens, and Aldermere's people come to see the elven tree grow.

outcomes.title: The Wild Horse Herds
outcomes.text: Great herds of wild horses are found grazing in the unruled plains of the Eastern Isle. Veyl, the Deepholds and the centaurs who live there all claim them.

outcomes.title: A Royal Duel
outcomes.text: Two kings of the Great Isle settle a border quarrel by single combat between champions. The Concord's council is horrified, the people love it and the champion of the loser is made a lord anyway.

outcomes.title: The Pilgrims' Plague
outcomes.text: A fever spreads among the pilgrims at the Silver Flame and is carried home to every realm. The Prelacy closes the shrine for a season, and its treasury empties.

outcomes.title: The Hag of the Wall Betrayed
outcomes.text: A Hag of Morrowgast who came to fight on Thornwatch's wall is found to be sending messages to the Coven. The Warden hangs her, and the Coven swears revenge on Thornwatch.

outcomes.title: The Copper Riots
outcomes.text: Workers in the copper mines between Westmarch and Aldermere riot over wages and seize the mines. Both crowns send soldiers, and the miners hold out in the hills for a month.

outcomes.title: The Glass Senate's Vote
outcomes.text: Veyl's Glass Senate votes to end its neutrality and join the alliance against the Spire. The Republic's glass-lens galleys sail for the strait, and the Spire's last southern trade ends.

outcomes.title: The Wolf Packs of the Northern Isle
outcomes.text: Wolves grown huge on the war's dead roam the Northern Isle's wild coast. They attack the Horde's camps and the free orcs' villages alike, and both sides hunt them.

outcomes.title: The Lake City's New Walls
outcomes.text: Aldermere's king rebuilds the lake city's walls in stone, paid for by a tax on the great houses. The great houses protest, the walls go up and the lake city becomes the strongest fortress of the south.

outcomes.title: The Pirates' Shipyard
outcomes.text: The Brotherhood builds a shipyard on an unruled island and launches its own war-galleys. The pirates no longer need to steal ships, and their fleet doubles in a year.

outcomes.title: The Return of the Lost Elves
outcomes.text: A ship of elves who sailed west a century ago returns to the Eastern Isle, bringing word of a land beyond the western sea where elves still flourish. The Elderwood's people begin to dream of leaving.

outcomes.title: The Harvest Moon Raid
outcomes.text: The Horde launches a great raid across the strait under the harvest moon, aiming at Thornwatch's granaries. The raid is beaten back, but two granaries burn, and the Wardenmark will be hungry this winter.

outcomes.title: The Lady Regent
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's queen falls ill and names her sister regent instead of the First Prelate. The Prelacy refuses to accept a lay regent, and the realm splits between the palace and the shrine.

outcomes.title: The Brigands of the Copper Hills
outcomes.text: Unpaid miners from the copper hills between Westmarch and Aldermere become brigands, robbing both realms' convoys. Each crown blames the other, and neither sends soldiers.

outcomes.title: The Coven's Healer at Solenne
outcomes.text: A Hag of Morrowgast cures Sunvale's king of a wasting sickness his own physicians could not. The court is grateful and appalled, and the king begins to listen to the witch's counsel.

outcomes.title: The Great Comet of Autumn
outcomes.text: A great comet blazes in the autumn sky, brighter than the moon. Prophets in every market proclaim the end of the Spire or of the world, and the armies on the wall grow restless.

outcomes.title: The Thane-King's Expedition
outcomes.text: The Thane-King of Karak Dûm leads an expedition into the deep roots of the mountains to find the source of the earthquakes. He returns a month later with a crown of black crystal, and will not say what he found.

outcomes.title: The Floating Market of Veyl
outcomes.text: Veyl builds a market on rafts in its harbour, open to every ship of every realm. Merchants flock to it, and the Republic's customs fees double.

outcomes.title: The Orc Chieftain's Pilgrimage
outcomes.text: The chief of the Ashen Exiles makes a pilgrimage to the Silver Flame. Hollowcrown's priests receive him, and the orcs of the Exiles begin to worship the Flame beside their old spirits.

outcomes.title: The Burning of the Wool Halls
outcomes.text: Fire sweeps through Aldermere's wool halls in the lake city, destroying a year's cloth. The weavers are ruined, and the great houses' revenues fall.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Bargain Refused
outcomes.text: The Blackspire offers the Council of the Kingdoms a ten-year truce in exchange for the Ashen Exiles' heads. The council refuses, the Exiles are grateful and the Horde's war continues.

outcomes.title: The Rains of the North
outcomes.text: Heavy rains flood Thornwatch's fields at harvest time. The grain rots, and the Wardenmark must buy grain from the south.

outcomes.title: A Princess of the Free Clans
outcomes.text: A daughter of the Free Clans' moot-leader marries a son of one of Aldermere's great houses. The fens and the lake country are bound together, and the fens war ends.

outcomes.title: The Iron Wolves' Raid
outcomes.text: The band of escaped slaves called the Iron Wolves burns a Horde iron mine on the Northern Isle and frees hundreds of captives. The Spire sends an army after them, and the Wolves vanish into the mountains.

outcomes.title: The Archmagister's Fall
outcomes.text: The Archmagister of the Conclave is caught in a forbidden rite of the Deep Study and deposed by the Tower's masters. The Conclave elects a cautious scholar in her place, and its battle-mages leave for Thornwatch in protest.

outcomes.title: The Locust Year
outcomes.text: Locusts sweep across Sunvale and the Ashlands, stripping the fields. Both Sunvale and Morrowgast face famine, and their war pauses.

outcomes.title: The Dwarven Navy
outcomes.text: The Deepholds launch a navy of iron-clad ships, the first dwarven fleet in history. They sail for the strait, and the Horde's longships cannot harm them.

outcomes.title: The Pirates' Revolt
outcomes.text: Brotherhood crews revolt against Red Mara's new code that bans slave-taking. A third of the pirates leave to found their own band, and the Salt Isles split.

outcomes.title: The Prophecy of the Children
outcomes.text: Children in every realm of the Great Isle begin to dream the same dream: a tower falling into the sea. Prophets say it means the Blackspire's end, and the kingdoms' armies take heart.

outcomes.title: The Riviera's Golden Harvest
outcomes.text: Sunvale's Riviera brings in its best grape harvest in a century. The wine flows, the court's debts are paid and Sunvale's king is cheered in the streets.

outcomes.title: A New Order of Healers
outcomes.text: Healers of every realm found an order sworn to tend the wounded of any side. They walk onto Thornwatch's battlefields under a white banner, and even the Horde lets them pass.

outcomes.title: The Threshers' Guild
outcomes.text: The threshers and millers of Aldermere's grain country form a guild and fix the price of milling across the realm. Farmers who will not pay must grind by hand, the great houses' own mills are boycotted and the crown is asked to break a guild it never chartered.

outcomes.title: The Heir Who Fled to the Wall
outcomes.text: The heir of Sunvale's throne runs away from Solenne to serve as a common soldier on Thornwatch's wall. The court sends riders to bring him back; he refuses, and his letters home make him the hero of every tavern in the south.

outcomes.title: The Pumice Rain
outcomes.text: A volcano somewhere beyond the eastern sea rains grey pumice on the Eastern Isle for a week. Veyl's harbour is choked with floating stone, the Elderwood's leaves turn grey and the dwarves fear their mountain is next.

outcomes.title: A Hag-Queen's Confession
outcomes.text: A dying Hag-Queen of Morrowgast confesses that the Blessing was first taught to the Coven by an envoy of the Blackspire two centuries ago. If true, Morrowgast has been the Spire's creature from the start; the Coven's witches split over whether to believe it.

outcomes.title: The Reed-Cutters' War
outcomes.text: Reed-cutters of the Free Clans and Aldermere's thatchers fight over the reed-beds of the southern fens. The quarrel over roofing turns bloody, and the crown and the clans' moot must sit down together.

outcomes.title: The Hidden Dwarven Hold of the North
outcomes.text: Dwarven scouts on the Northern Isle find a sealed hold in the mountains near the Blackspire, abandoned since the First War of the Spire. Its forges are intact, and the Deepholds send an army to reclaim it behind the Horde's back.

outcomes.title: The Bellhaven Bank Crash
outcomes.text: The Bank of Bellhaven, founded by Westmarch's merchant princes to rival Veyl, collapses when its silver vaults are found half empty. Westmarch's merchants lose their savings, and Veyl's banks buy up the ruins.

outcomes.title: The Elves' Last Queen Weds
outcomes.text: The Lady of the Elderwood marries for the first time in her long life, taking a human mage of the Conclave as her consort. The elves are divided, the Conclave is delighted and the Prelacy calls the marriage an abomination.

outcomes.title: The Hornet Plague
outcomes.text: Swarms of hornets, maddened by the heat, attack villages across Sunvale's south. Hundreds are stung, a few die and the Riviera's harvest workers refuse to go into the vineyards.

outcomes.title: The Order's March on Morrowgast
outcomes.text: The knights of the Order of the Lantern march into Morrowgast's borderlands with the founder's lantern borne before them. The Blessed fall sick in its light, two border towns surrender and the Coven gathers its host to meet them.

outcomes.title: The Ironmongers' Shortage
outcomes.text: Iron runs short across the Great Isle as every forge works for the war. Ploughshares and nails become dear, farmers cannot replace their tools and the Deepholds raise their prices again.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Secret Envoy to Westmarch
outcomes.text: An envoy of the Blackspire is found hidden in a Westmarch merchant prince's house, negotiating the sale of ships. The prince is hanged, and Westmarch's council is purged of anyone who traded with the north.

outcomes.title: The Strait Fishermen's Truce
outcomes.text: Fishermen of Thornwatch and free orcs of the Northern Isle agree among themselves not to fight on the fishing grounds, whatever their masters do. The strait's fish feed both shores, and the Spire's captains cannot stop it.

outcomes.title: The Great House Extinguished
outcomes.text: The last heir of one of Aldermere's oldest great houses dies in a fall from a horse. Three families claim the inheritance, and the king seizes the lands for the crown, alarming every great house in the realm.

outcomes.title: The Floating Islands
outcomes.text: Islands of matted reed and earth break loose from the fens of Aldermere and drift onto Lake Halmoor, some large enough to carry a village. The Free Clans steer them like ships and raid the lake towns from them.

outcomes.title: The Exiles' Treaty with Veyl
outcomes.text: The Ashen Exiles sign a trade treaty with Veyl's Glass Senate, selling the Northern Isle's furs and amber for glass and grain. The Exiles grow rich, and orcs are seen in Veyl's markets for the first time.

outcomes.title: The Plague of Ravens
outcomes.text: Ravens gather in their thousands over Thornwatch's wall and pick at the dead. The soldiers say they are the Spire's spies; the Warden orders them shot, and the arrows run short.

outcomes.title: The Witch of the Wall
outcomes.text: A hedge-witch from Aldermere's fens comes to Thornwatch and uses her curses against the Horde's war-bands. The Order calls her damnable, the soldiers call her their luck and the Warden lets her stay.

outcomes.title: The Grape Rot
outcomes.text: A rot spreads through Sunvale's vineyards in the wet late summer. Half the year's wine is lost, and the vintners' guild demands the court lower its taxes.

outcomes.title: The Silent Treaty
outcomes.text: The Horde's eastern war-chiefs and Thornwatch's Warden agree, without a word written, to stop raiding each other's coasts. The eastern strait is quiet, and the Spire sends its Voices to punish the chiefs.

outcomes.title: The Autumn Muster
outcomes.text: Every kingdom of the Great Isle calls its levies for an autumn campaign against the Horde before the winter closes the strait. The harvest is left half in, and the farmers curse the war.

outcomes.title: A Royal Bastard Crowned
outcomes.text: The bastard son of Westmarch's late First Prince is elected First Prince by the guild halls over the merchant princes' candidate. The princes refuse to accept him, and Westmarch has two councils.

outcomes.title: The Wild Magic Spring
outcomes.text: A spring in the unruled High Wilds begins to flow with water that heals any wound. Pilgrims, mages and soldiers flock to it, and Aldermere and Hollowcrown both send guards to claim it.

outcomes.title: The Coven's Prisoners Freed
outcomes.text: Morrowgast frees all its Sunvalese prisoners as a gesture of peace. Some return Blessed and violent, others whole; Sunvale's court does not know whether it has been given a gift or a curse.

outcomes.title: The Lake Road Flood
outcomes.text: A late summer storm floods the Lake Road for a week, and convoys are stranded in the mud. Merchants lose their cargoes to rot and brigands, and Aldermere and Westmarch blame each other for the road's neglect.

outcomes.title: A Dragon Over the Northern Isle
outcomes.text: A young dragon of the eastern mountains, woken by the Deepholds' deep mining, flies north across the sea and burns a Horde war-camp on the Northern Isle. Nobody knows whether it will come back, or whom it will burn next.

outcomes.title: The Silver Shortage
outcomes.text: With Hollowcrown's mines flooded and Westmarch's silver fleet sunk, silver becomes scarce. Coins are clipped and debased, prices rise and Veyl's glass ducat becomes the only coin anyone trusts.

outcomes.title: A Slave Crowned King of Orcs
outcomes.text: The orc clans of the Northern Isle's southern coast, breaking with the Spire, crown a former slave of its iron mines as their king. Thornwatch's Warden sends a gift, and the Spire sends its war-bands to burn the new kingdom.

outcomes.title: The Pirates' Prize
outcomes.text: The Brotherhood captures a ship carrying the Glass Senate's tribute to the empire beyond the eastern sea. Veyl's Senate demands it back, the empire's envoys demand it back and Red Mara sells it to the highest bidder.

outcomes.title: The Silver Flame's Heir
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's First Prelate names a child prodigy of ten as his heir, a girl who recites the whole scripture of the Flame from memory. The mountain lords fear a child-pope, and the people adore her.

outcomes.title: The Beekeepers' Blight
outcomes.text: A sickness kills the bees of Aldermere and Westmarch. Without bees the orchards will not fruit, honey and wax become dear and the Elderwood is begged for its own bees.

outcomes.title: The Great House Wars
outcomes.text: Two of Aldermere's great houses go to war over a disputed marriage, raising their own armies and burning each other's villages. The king cannot stop them, and the realm's soldiers on the wall go home to defend their lords.

outcomes.title: The Smugglers of the Strait
outcomes.text: Smugglers carry Thornwatch's grain across the strait to the starving Horde clans for gold. The Warden hangs the ones he catches, and the trade goes on.

outcomes.title: The Elves' Return to the Northern Isle
outcomes.text: The Greywatch builds a hidden outpost in the Northern Isle's forests, the first elven home there since the First War of the Spire. From it they watch the Blackspire day and night.

outcomes.title: The Wool Glut
outcomes.text: A great clip of wool floods Aldermere's markets, and its price falls by half. The great houses' flocks lose their value, and the shepherds are paid nothing.

outcomes.title: The Conclave's War Mages Rebel
outcomes.text: The Conclave's battle-mages on Thornwatch's wall refuse the Tower's orders to return to Wyn. They form their own order, the Mages of the Wall, sworn to fight until the Spire falls.

outcomes.title: The Corsairs of the Riviera
outcomes.text: Sunvalese nobles ruined by debt take to the sea as corsairs, raiding Veyl's ships in revenge for the Republic's loans. Veyl blames Sunvale's court, and Sunvale's court cannot stop its own nobles.

outcomes.title: The Lantern Over the Strait
outcomes.text: The Order of the Lantern brings its founder's lantern to Thornwatch's wall, and its light reaches across the strait. The Horde's risen dead fall where it shines, and the orcs will not attack under it.

outcomes.title: The Autumn Storms Begin
outcomes.text: The autumn storms come early and close the Ostcombe Sea to shipping. Westmarch's and Sunvale's trade stops, and their merchants begin to go hungry.

outcomes.title: A Dwarf and an Orc Become Brothers
outcomes.text: A dwarven warrior and an orc of the Ashen Exiles who saved each other's lives on Thornwatch's wall swear blood-brotherhood. Their peoples hear of it, and old hatreds soften.

outcomes.title: The Harvest Home Riots
outcomes.text: The harvest-home festival in Bellhaven turns into a riot when the merchant princes' guards try to collect a new tax on ale. The guilds take the streets, the princes flee the city and the guild halls rule Bellhaven for a week.

outcomes.title: The Murder of a Prelate
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's First Prelate is found dead in the Silver Flame's shrine, a dagger in his back. The priests accuse the mountain lords, the lords accuse the Conclave and Hollowcrown's council fills with swords.

outcomes.title: The Mammoth Herds
outcomes.text: Herds of mammoths cross from the Northern Isle onto Thornwatch's coast as the Spire's cold drives them south. The Wardenmark's people hunt them for meat and ivory, and the Horde's beast-masters try to tame them for war.

outcomes.title: The Coven's Ship of Bones
outcomes.text: Morrowgast launches a war-galley built of the bones of a great sea beast, its oars pulled by Blessed rowers who never tire. It raids Sunvale's coast unopposed, and Sunvale's navy cannot catch it.

outcomes.title: The Fall of a Bridge
outcomes.text: The great bridge over Sunvale's river at Solenne collapses during the harvest festival, drowning hundreds. The court's engineers are hanged, and Solenne mourns for a month.

outcomes.title: The Fens Declared Crown Land
outcomes.text: Aldermere's new Lord Chancellor declares every fen of the Lakeshore crown land and orders the Free Clans' remaining stockades torn down. The clans take up arms, and the fens war flares across the lake country.

outcomes.title: The Red Plague of the South
outcomes.text: A red plague spreads from Sunvale's ports along the coast to Westmarch. The towns close their gates, and the merchants' ships rot at anchor.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Messenger to the Elves
outcomes.text: A messenger of the Blackspire arrives at the Heartwood with an offer: the Elderwood will be spared if the elves stay out of the war. The Lady of the Elderwood sends him back without his tongue.

outcomes.title: The Gold of the Ashlands
outcomes.text: Prospectors strike gold in the unruled Ashlands. Sunvale, Morrowgast and the Ashlands' brigands all race to claim it, and the gold-fields become a battlefield.

outcomes.title: A Prince Among the Exiles
outcomes.text: A prince of Hollowcrown, disinherited for his faith, joins the Ashen Exiles and fights beside them on the Northern Isle. The orcs make him a war-chief, and Hollowcrown's priests call him a traitor.

outcomes.title: The Brigands of the Wilds
outcomes.text: Outlaws in the unruled forests of Aldermere's south rob the king's tax-collectors. The king sends soldiers, the outlaws vanish into the forest and the villages feed them.

outcomes.title: The Deepholds' Gift of Iron
outcomes.text: The Deepholds send a gift of a thousand iron ploughshares to the farmers of the Great Isle. Their harvests double the next year, and the dwarves are blessed in every village.

outcomes.title: The Pirates' Prison
outcomes.text: The Brotherhood builds a prison on an unruled island to hold captives for ransom. Lords and merchants of every realm are held there, and their families pay or wait.

outcomes.title: The Wedding of the Kingdoms
outcomes.text: The heirs of Aldermere, Westmarch and Hollowcrown marry in a triple wedding at the lake city. The three kingdoms bind themselves together, and Sunvale feels left out.

outcomes.title: The Wolf Winter Begins
outcomes.text: An early snow falls on the north, and wolves come down from the mountains into Thornwatch's villages. The Wardenmark's people barricade their homes.

outcomes.title: The War-Mages Take the Tower
outcomes.text: The Conclave's battle-mages return from Thornwatch's wall and take over the Tower of Stars from the scholars, electing one of their own Archmagister. The Tower turns its whole power to war, and the scholars flee to Veyl.

outcomes.title: The Copper Miners' Republic
outcomes.text: The copper miners of the unruled hills between Westmarch and Aldermere declare a free republic of miners and refuse both crowns' taxes. Both crowns refuse to recognise it, and both quietly buy its copper.

outcomes.title: The Horde's Last Champion
outcomes.text: The greatest champion of the Horde challenges any warrior of the Great Isle to single combat on the strait's shore. An orc of the Ashen Exiles accepts, and kills him.

outcomes.title: The Glass Glut
outcomes.text: Veyl's furnaces produce so much glass that its price falls by half. The Republic's glassmakers are ruined by their own success, and the Glass Senate subsidises them.

outcomes.title: Ambassadors Across the Strait
outcomes.text: Thornwatch's Warden and the chiefs of the orc clans of the Northern Isle's southern coast, who have broken with the Spire, exchange ambassadors. For the first time in a thousand years, men and orcs sit at the same table to talk rather than fight.

outcomes.title: The Apple Wars
outcomes.text: Cider-makers of Westmarch and orchard-lords of Aldermere fall out over who may sell apples in the lake city's markets. Carts are overturned, orchards set alight on both sides of the border and the crowns' councils find themselves debating apples.

outcomes.title: The Silent King
outcomes.text: Aldermere's king is struck dumb by a fit and cannot speak or write. His council governs by reading his nods, every faction claims the king agrees with it and the great houses begin to say he is no longer king at all.

outcomes.title: The Basilisk of the Ashlands
outcomes.text: A creature that turns men to stone with its gaze is loosed in the unruled Ashlands, a relic of the Coven's old rites. Stone figures of brigands and herdsmen dot the hills, and neither Sunvale nor Morrowgast will send soldiers in.

outcomes.title: The Grand Master's Pilgrimage
outcomes.text: The Grand Master of the Order of the Lantern walks barefoot from Lanternhold to Thornwatch's wall to pray for victory. Thousands join her on the road, and the north's soldiers take heart from the sight of a whole order on pilgrimage.

outcomes.title: The Silver Ships of the West
outcomes.text: A fleet of elven ships from beyond the western sea anchors off Westmarch's coast and sends envoys ashore. They ask about the Heartwood and the Spire, trade starlight-silver for grain and sail on toward the Eastern Isle.

outcomes.title: The Bastard Prince of Morrowgast
outcomes.text: A son of a Hag-Queen and a Sunvalese knight, raised in secret in the Ashlands, claims a seat in the Coven's circle. He is neither Blessed nor witch, and both Morrowgast and Sunvale see a bridge or a threat in him.

outcomes.title: The Wreck of the Grain Barges
outcomes.text: Autumn storms sink Aldermere's grain barges crossing Lake Halmoor to the lake city. The capital's winter stores are halved, and the crown must buy grain from Veyl at a ruinous price.

outcomes.title: The Hold of the Exiles
outcomes.text: The Deepholds formally grant the Ashen Exiles an abandoned hold in the eastern mountains as their own. Orcs living under a mountain alongside dwarves become the talk of the Eastern Isle.

outcomes.title: The Tax-Farmers' Rising
outcomes.text: The peasants of Sunvale's west kill the tax-farmers who bought the right to collect the crown's taxes. The court, which sold the rights to pay its debts, must refund the tax-farmers or lose them as lenders.

outcomes.title: The Archive of Names
outcomes.text: Scholars of the Conclave find, in the Tower's oldest vault, a list of every soul Malgrath ever bound to the Spire. Some of the names are of families living in the Great Isle's courts today, and the list is stolen within the week.

outcomes.title: The Black Frost
outcomes.text: An early frost turns the late crops black across Hollowcrown's high valleys. The mountain kingdom's winter stores are short, and the Prelacy must choose between feeding its people and feeding its soldiers on the wall.

outcomes.title: The Copper Crown
outcomes.text: The miners of the unruled hills between Westmarch and Aldermere crown a woman miner as their queen, with a crown beaten from their own copper. Both kingdoms refuse to recognise her, and both buy her copper.

outcomes.title: The Plague Ship of the Strait
outcomes.text: A Horde longship drifts across the strait to Thornwatch's coast, its whole crew dead of a black fever. The Warden burns the ship and the village it touched, and the fever does not spread.

outcomes.title: The Treaty of the Lake Fisheries
outcomes.text: Aldermere and the Free Clans agree to share the fisheries of Lake Halmoor under a council of fishermen from both. It is the first time Aldermere has shared anything with the clans, and the great houses call it surrender.

outcomes.title: The Highland Clans' Raid
outcomes.text: The hill clans of the High Wilds come down in force and drive off the cattle of three of Hollowcrown's lowland valleys. The Prelacy sends the Silver Guard into the mountains; the clans vanish and come back the next month.

outcomes.title: An Elf Saint of the Flame
outcomes.text: An elven healer who tended Hollowcrown's wounded on the wall is declared a saint of the Silver Flame by the Prelacy, the first non-human saint in its history. The elves are honoured and puzzled in equal measure.

outcomes.title: The Usurers' Strike
outcomes.text: Veyl's banks stop all lending to the Great Isle until its kingdoms pay their arrears. Armies go unpaid, merchants cannot buy stock and the kingdoms' envoys hurry to Veyl to beg.

outcomes.title: The Prophet of the Spire's End
outcomes.text: A blind seer in Aldermere's lake city names the day the Blackspire will fall: the next midwinter. The kingdoms' armies plan their winter campaign around her words.

outcomes.title: The Weavers' Machine
outcomes.text: A weaver of Aldermere's lake towns builds a loom worked by a water-wheel that weaves ten times faster than any hand. The weavers' guild burns his workshop, and the great houses buy his secret.

outcomes.title: The Voice Who Wanted to Die
outcomes.text: One of the Spire's masked Voices surrenders at Thornwatch's wall and begs to be killed, saying the Spire's bond has kept her alive for three hundred years. The Conclave's mages free her from the bond, and she tells them all she knows before she dies.

outcomes.title: The Equinox Storm
outcomes.text: The autumn equinox brings a storm that sweeps the whole Great Isle in a single day. Roofs fly, harbours are wrecked and the harvest that was not yet in is lost in Aldermere, Westmarch and Sunvale alike.

outcomes.title: The Regent's Coup in Sunvale
outcomes.text: The regent who governs Sunvale for a sickly king locks the king in a tower and proclaims herself queen. The eastern barons ride for Solenne, the Coven offers the barons help and Sunvale tips toward civil war.

outcomes.title: The Fen Witches' Coven
outcomes.text: The hedge-witches of Aldermere's fens form a coven of their own, taking no orders from Morrowgast. They heal the Free Clans' sick and curse their enemies, and the great houses call for a witch-hunt.

outcomes.title: The Deepholds' Second King
outcomes.text: A rival thane proclaims himself Thane-King in the eastern holds of the Deepholds, refusing Karak Dûm's rule. The dwarves have two kings for the first time in their history, and their warriors on Thornwatch's wall are recalled.

outcomes.title: The Lake Road Robbers' Lord
outcomes.text: A robber captain who has terrorised the Lake Road for a year buys a pardon and a knighthood from Aldermere's king with his loot. The merchants he robbed are outraged, and outlaws across the Great Isle take note.

outcomes.title: The Return of the Iron Legion
outcomes.text: A legion of Thornwatch's soldiers captured by the Horde two years ago escapes from the Spire's mines and marches back across the frozen northern strait. They bring news of the Spire's mines and a hatred no peace could satisfy.

outcomes.title: The Salt Marsh Fever
outcomes.text: A fever rises from the salt marshes of Westmarch's coast in the warm autumn. The harbour towns sicken, the fleet cannot be crewed and Westmarch's war at sea stalls.

outcomes.title: The Glass Senate's Ultimatum
outcomes.text: Veyl's Glass Senate tells Sunvale's court to pay its debts within a month or lose its harbours to the Republic's fleet. Sunvale cannot pay, and Veyl's galleys sail for Solenne.

outcomes.title: The Goblin Exodus
outcomes.text: The goblins of the High Wilds abandon their warrens and march west in a long column, fleeing something in the deep. Aldermere's lords do not know whether to fight them or let them pass.

outcomes.title: The Children of the Heartwood
outcomes.text: Seven elf children born in the same season are found to share a single mind, speaking with one voice. The elves call them the Heartwood's children; the Loremasters say they are the weavers of the new Binding.

outcomes.title: The Wine Riots
outcomes.text: The price of wine doubles in Aldermere when Sunvale's harvest fails. Taverns close, the lake city's poor riot and the crown blames Sunvale's vintners for hoarding.

outcomes.title: The Lantern and the Conclave Reconciled
outcomes.text: The Grand Master of the Order of the Lantern and the Archmagister of the Conclave meet at Thornwatch's wall and swear to stop hunting each other's people. The Order's knights and the Tower's mages ride north together, and the Spire's undead fall before both light and fire.

outcomes.title: The Brotherhood's Lighthouse War
outcomes.text: The Brotherhood and Westmarch fight over the lighthouse on the Thornshaw coast, each wanting to charge ships for its light. The lighthouse burns, ships wreck on the reefs and both sides lose.

outcomes.title: The Coven's Envoy Murdered
outcomes.text: An envoy of Morrowgast travelling to Aldermere is murdered on the road by zealots of the Silver Flame. The Coven demands justice, the Prelacy protects the killers and the war between the faiths grows hotter.

outcomes.title: The Mammoth War-Beasts
outcomes.text: The Horde's beast-masters tame the mammoths that crossed onto the Northern Isle's coast and drive them against Thornwatch's wall. The wall's gates shake, and the defenders must burn the beasts with oil.

outcomes.title: A Merchant Becomes First Prince
outcomes.text: Westmarch's guild halls elect a cloth merchant as First Prince over the old merchant princes' candidate. The old families refuse to sit with him, and Westmarch's council splits between guilds and princes.

outcomes.title: The Locust Swarm of the East
outcomes.text: Locusts sweep across the Eastern Isle's farms, stripping Veyl's grain fields. The Republic, which sells grain to the Great Isle, must now buy it.

outcomes.title: The Lake Kingdom Recognised by Veyl
outcomes.text: Veyl's Glass Senate recognises the Free Clans of the Lakeshore as a sovereign kingdom and opens an embassy in the fens. Aldermere breaks off relations with Veyl in fury.

outcomes.title: The Pilgrim Road Opened Again
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's Silver Guard clears the bandits from the pilgrim road to the Silver Flame. Pilgrims flood back, the Prelacy's treasury fills and the mountain towns grow rich again.

outcomes.title: The Spire Shakes
outcomes.text: The Blackspire shakes for three days as if struck by an earthquake, and black smoke pours from its top. The orc clans flee its foot, and Thornwatch's scouts report the Spire's walls cracked.

outcomes.title: The Michaelmas Fair
