outcomes.text: The great autumn fair of the lake city draws merchants of every realm, even orcs of the Exiles and Blessed traders of Morrowgast under a truce flag. Trade booms, a riot breaks out between the Blessed and the Order's knights and the crown closes the fair early.

outcomes.title: The Abdication of the Warden
outcomes.text: The Warden of Thornwatch, wounded and grey after years on the wall, abdicates in favour of his captain rather than his young son. The captains of the wall cheer, the Warden's family protests and the north has a soldier-lord.

outcomes.title: The Wolf-Riders' Raid
outcomes.text: Horde wolf-riders cross the strait on the first ice and raid deep into Hollowcrown's northern valleys, carrying off cattle and children. The Prelacy calls for a crusade across the strait.

outcomes.title: The Conclave's Peace Envoy to the Spire
outcomes.text: The Conclave of the Lake sends an envoy to the Blackspire to ask Malgrath's terms. The envoy returns with a single word written in blood: everything. The Conclave prepares for war.

outcomes.title: The Silver Strike of the West
outcomes.text: Westmarch's prospectors find silver in the hills behind Bellhaven. The merchant princes rush to mine it, and the realm's treasury fills for the first time in years.

outcomes.title: A Hag-Queen Becomes a Saint
outcomes.text: A Hag-Queen of Morrowgast who gave her life to cure a town of the Blessing is declared a saint by the Coven's own people. The Hag-Queens forbid her worship, and her shrine becomes a centre of rebellion.

outcomes.title: The Tide Mills
outcomes.text: Westmarch's engineers build mills powered by the tide on its harbour walls. Flour becomes cheap, the millers of the inland rivers are ruined and Westmarch's bread is the cheapest on the Great Isle.

outcomes.title: The Free Orcs' Envoy at Aldermere
outcomes.text: An envoy of the orc clans that broke with the Spire is received at Aldermere's court. The great houses walk out, the king stays and an orc and a king talk alone for an hour.

outcomes.title: The Burning of the Granaries
outcomes.text: Saboteurs burn the royal granaries of Aldermere's lake city on the eve of winter. The capital faces hunger, and the crown blames the Spire's agents, the Free Clans and the great houses in turn.

outcomes.title: The Elves' Last Ship Returns
outcomes.text: An elven ship that sailed west a century ago returns with the news that the land beyond the western sea is real, and empty. The elves begin to argue over whether to stay and fight or leave the world to men.

outcomes.title: Copper Road Ambushes
outcomes.text: Unpaid miners from the copper hills between Westmarch and Aldermere ambush the ore wagons of both realms on the hill roads. Each crown blames the other's agents, and the copper trade grinds to a halt.

outcomes.title: The Grand Ministry's Fall
outcomes.text: Sunvale's Grand Ministry is dissolved by the king after a scandal of sold offices. The barons take the ministers' places, and Sunvale's court is ruled by soldiers.

outcomes.title: The Autumn Plague
outcomes.text: A fever spreads through the crowded cities of the Great Isle as the autumn rains begin. Thousands die, and the armies on the wall are thinned.

outcomes.title: The Deep Study's Lich Revealed
outcomes.text: The Conclave finds that one of its oldest masters has been dead for fifty years, kept alive by the rite that made Malgrath undying. The Tower destroys her, and the kingdoms fear how many more there are.

outcomes.title: The Smugglers' War
outcomes.text: Smugglers of the Salt Isles and the lake country fight over the trade in untaxed wine. A dozen die, and both crowns' customs men are found to have taken bribes from both sides.

outcomes.title: The Coven's Coronation
outcomes.text: The Hag-Queens of Morrowgast crown a Blessed warrior as the realm's first king, to lead the army they can no longer control. The witches rule beside a soldier, and Sunvale's border braces.

outcomes.title: The First Snow
outcomes.text: The first snow of the winter falls early on the north. The strait begins to freeze, and the Horde's war-bands gather on its far shore.

outcomes.title: The Treaty of Thornwatch
outcomes.text: The kingdoms of the Great Isle sign a treaty making Thornwatch's wall the common defence of all, with a council of every realm's captains to command it. The wall belongs to the Great Isle at last.

outcomes.title: The Lake City's Bread Riots
outcomes.text: The poor of Aldermere's lake city riot for bread as the winter begins. The crown opens what granaries are left, and the great houses refuse to open theirs.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Last Envoy
outcomes.text: The Blackspire sends a final envoy to the Council of the Kingdoms: surrender or burn. The council answers with a single arrow, and the war's last winter begins.

outcomes.title: The Chestnut Famine
outcomes.text: A blight kills the chestnut forests that feed the poor of Hollowcrown's foothills through the winter. Mountain villages face starvation, the Prelacy's tithe-barns are besieged by hungry crowds and refugees walk down into Aldermere.

outcomes.title: The Lord Chancellor's Flight
outcomes.text: Aldermere's Lord Chancellor flees the lake city by night with the crown's seal and a chest of the treasury's gold, bound for Veyl. Without the seal no law can be signed, and the council must forge a new one while every faction accuses the others.

outcomes.title: The Ice Trolls
outcomes.text: Trolls of ice come down from the frozen north of the Northern Isle and attack Horde and free orc camps alike. Both sides of the Spire's war must fight a third enemy, and some orc clans flee across the strait to Thornwatch.

outcomes.title: The Merchant Queen of Westmarch
outcomes.text: The widow of Westmarch's richest merchant prince takes her husband's seat on the council and, within the month, is elected First Princess. She is the first woman to rule Westmarch, and the old princes plot against her from the start.

outcomes.title: The Floating Bridge of Veyl
outcomes.text: Veyl's engineers float a bridge of glass-bottomed barges across the Republic's harbour mouth, where the old stone bridge fell. Crowds come to walk over the water, and the Republic's fees double.

outcomes.title: The Exiles' Prophetess Crowned
outcomes.text: The blind prophetess of the Ashen Exiles is crowned queen of the free orcs by the Exiles' moot. She says the Spire will fall by an orc's hand, and orcs across the Northern Isle begin to slip away to her.

outcomes.title: The Deer Plague
outcomes.text: A wasting sickness kills the deer of every forest on the Great Isle. Hunters go hungry, the lords' hunting parks stand empty and the poor who poached to live have nothing left to take.

outcomes.title: The Silver Flame's Heretic Burned
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's Prelacy burns a popular preacher who taught that the Flame burns in every hearth. Her followers riot in three towns, and Aldermere, where she had preached for years, recalls its envoy from Hollowcrown.

outcomes.title: The Pirates' Winter Quarters
outcomes.text: The Brotherhood takes over an unruled island off Sunvale's coast for its winter quarters and fortifies it. The pirates are now within a day's sail of Solenne, and Sunvale's court sleeps badly.

outcomes.title: The Thane-King's Exile
outcomes.text: The Hall of Thanes deposes the Thane-King of Karak Dûm for selling the Deepholds' secret tunnels to Veyl. He flees to the Northern Isle's lost dwarven hold, and swears to return as king.

outcomes.title: The Riverboat Wars
outcomes.text: Bargemen of Aldermere and Sunvale fight over the river trade between the two realms. Boats are burned at their moorings, and the river's commerce stops for a month.

outcomes.title: The Coven's Child-Queen
outcomes.text: The Hag-Queens of Morrowgast crown a child as queen, said to be the first born with the Blessing already in her blood. The Coven rallies around her, and Sunvale's court fears what she will become.

outcomes.title: The Bandit Fair
outcomes.text: The outlaws of the High Wilds hold a fair in the mountains to sell their loot. Merchants of every realm come to buy cheap, and the crowns of Aldermere and Hollowcrown are shamed into clearing the passes together.

outcomes.title: The Archmagister's Map
outcomes.text: The Archmagister of the Conclave reveals a map of the Blackspire's foundations, drawn from the memories of a freed Voice. It shows where the Spire can be broken, and the kingdoms' captains begin to plan.

outcomes.title: The Autumn Floods of the Fens
outcomes.text: The autumn rains flood Aldermere's fens, and the Free Clans' winter stores are swept away. The clans must raid Aldermere for food or starve, and the great houses brace.

outcomes.title: The Elven Envoy to the Ice
outcomes.text: The Lady of the Elderwood sends an envoy across the frozen north to treat with the ice trolls of the Northern Isle. The trolls, enemies of the Spire, agree not to attack the free orcs, and the Spire's northern flank is open.

outcomes.title: The Tin Rush
outcomes.text: Tin is found in the unruled hills of Sunvale's west, and prospectors pour in. Bronze becomes cheap, Sunvale's foundries cast new bells and cannon, and the court taxes every ingot.

outcomes.title: The King Who Walked Among the Poor
outcomes.text: Aldermere's king disguises himself as a beggar and walks the lake city's slums for a week. He returns and opens the royal granaries, and the poor of the lake city love him as they have loved no king in a century.

outcomes.title: The Smugglers' Lights
outcomes.text: Smugglers light false beacons on the Thornshaw coast to bring their boats in under the merchant princes' noses. Three merchant ships wreck on the false lights, and Westmarch hangs a whole fishing village.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Lost Fortress
outcomes.text: Thornwatch's raiders find an abandoned fortress of the Spire on the Northern Isle's southern coast, its gates open and its garrison gone. They take it, and the Great Isle has a foothold on the Spire's own shore.

outcomes.title: The Great Herring Run
outcomes.text: The herring come into the Ostcombe Sea in shoals so vast the boats cannot hold them. Fishing towns across the south grow rich, salt becomes dear and the Brotherhood takes its share from every boat.

outcomes.title: The Prince Who Joined the Coven
outcomes.text: A prince of Sunvale's royal house goes to Morrowgast and takes the Blessing willingly, saying it is the only strength that can stand against the Spire. The court disowns him; the Coven makes him a captain of its host.

outcomes.title: The Black Sails of the North
outcomes.text: A fleet of Horde longships with black sails slips past Thornwatch's patrols and raids the coast of Aldermere for the first time. The lake country, which thought the war far away, panics.

outcomes.title: The Glass Senate's New Law
outcomes.text: Veyl's Glass Senate passes a law freeing every slave in the Republic and forbidding any ship carrying slaves to enter its harbour. The Brotherhood's slave trade collapses, and the Republic's poor celebrate.

outcomes.title: The Wild Horses Tamed
outcomes.text: Sunvale's horse-breeders finally break the wild horses of the Ashlands to the saddle. Sunvale's cavalry becomes the finest on the Great Isle, and its barons ride east with new confidence.

outcomes.title: The Archmagister's Apprentice Murdered
outcomes.text: The chosen heir of the Conclave's Archmagister is found dead in the Tower of Stars, killed by a spell. The masters accuse each other, and the Tower's war-mages and scholars come to the edge of open battle.

outcomes.title: Veyl's Grain Fleet Lost
outcomes.text: Veyl's autumn grain fleet bound for the Great Isle sinks in a storm. The winter bread of three kingdoms is lost, and the price of grain rises across the Great Isle.

outcomes.title: The Heartwood's Dream
outcomes.text: Every elf in the Elderwood dreams the same dream on the same night: the Heartwood and the Blackspire, their roots touching under the sea. The Loremasters say the Spire draws on the Heartwood itself, and the elves prepare to cut the roots.

outcomes.title: The Hound Masters
outcomes.text: Men who breed great war-dogs found a guild in Thornwatch and sell their hounds to the wall's garrison. The hounds can smell orcs and the risen dead, and the Horde's night raids begin to fail.

outcomes.title: A Seat for the Free Clans
outcomes.text: Aldermere's king gives the Free Clans of the Lakeshore a seat on his council, for as long as they keep the peace in the fens. The great houses walk out of the council, and the fens war cools.

outcomes.title: The Black Market of Veyl
outcomes.text: Veyl's harbour becomes the world's market for stolen goods, its customs men paid to look away. The kingdoms' stolen treasures turn up on Veyl's stalls, and the Glass Senate is shamed.

outcomes.title: The Orc Who Spoke to the Spire
outcomes.text: An orc shaman of the Ashen Exiles walks alone to the Blackspire's gates and asks to speak with its master. He returns three days later, white-haired, and tells the Exiles that Malgrath is afraid.

outcomes.title: The Terraces Fall
outcomes.text: An earthquake shakes Sunvale's Riviera and brings down the old vineyard terraces in a cascade of stone. The year's vintage is buried under the rubble, and the court's richest families are ruined.

outcomes.title: The Treaty of the Healers
outcomes.text: Healers of every realm, even the Coven's witches and the Horde's shamans, agree to tend the wounded of any side on the battlefield. Their white banners walk the wall's battlefields, and even the Horde lets them pass.

outcomes.title: The Lake City's New Harbour
outcomes.text: Aldermere's king builds a great new harbour on the lake city's shore, paid for by Veyl's loans. Trade on the lake grows, and the crown's debts grow with it.

outcomes.title: The Queen Takes Back the Throne
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's queen, long kept from power by the Prelacy's regency on the pretext of illness, walks into the council chamber and takes back her throne. The Prelacy is furious, and the people cheer.

outcomes.title: The Pirate Hunters' Victory
outcomes.text: Westmarch's pirate-hunters catch a Brotherhood squadron in a fog and sink six ships. Red Mara loses her best captain, and the Ostcombe Sea is safer for a season.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Last Ally
outcomes.text: Morrowgast's Hag-Queens break their secret pact with the Blackspire, sending its envoy back without his head. The Spire has no allies left in the south, and the Coven's witches swear they were never its creatures.

outcomes.title: The Winter Fever Begins
outcomes.text: A coughing fever spreads through the Great Isle with the first cold. The old and the young die in thousands, and the armies on the wall are thinned.

outcomes.title: An Orc Knight of the Lantern
outcomes.text: An orc of the Ashen Exiles takes the vows of the Order of the Lantern and is knighted at Lanternhold. The Order's old knights protest, the young cheer and orcs across the Northern Isle hear of it.

outcomes.title: The Last Harvest of the War
outcomes.text: The last harvest before the winter is brought in under guard across the north, soldiers standing watch over the reapers. Every granary is filled, and the kingdoms prepare for a winter siege of the Spire.

outcomes.title: The Murder of a Hag-Queen's Daughter
outcomes.text: A daughter of Morrowgast's Hag-Queens, held as a hostage in Sunvale's court, is murdered in her bed. The Coven swears vengeance, and Sunvale's court cannot find the killer.

outcomes.title: The Bandits of the Strait
outcomes.text: Deserters from both sides of the strait band together on an unruled island in the middle of the strait and raid anyone who sails past. Neither the Horde nor Thornwatch can spare ships to clear them.

outcomes.title: The Conclave's Weapon Tested
outcomes.text: The Conclave tests a weapon of Elder Age lore against an empty fortress of the Spire on the Northern Isle's coast. The fortress is turned to glass, and the kingdoms debate whether to use it on the Blackspire itself.

outcomes.title: The Miners' Treaty
outcomes.text: The free miners of the unruled copper hills between Westmarch and Aldermere sign a treaty with both crowns, selling copper at a fixed price in exchange for being left alone. A miners' realm is born on the Great Isle without a battle.

outcomes.title: The Elves Cut the Roots
outcomes.text: The elves of the Elderwood cut the Heartwood's roots that run under the sea toward the Northern Isle. The Heartwood weakens, but the Blackspire's black light dims, and the Spire's undead fall where they stand for a day.

outcomes.title: The Wool Fleet Lost
outcomes.text: Aldermere's wool fleet to Veyl is lost in an autumn storm. The great houses' revenues fall, and the lake towns' weavers go unpaid.

outcomes.title: The Heart in the Ice
outcomes.text: A captive of the Spire, escaped across the strait, tells the Council of the Kingdoms that Malgrath's heart is kept in a box of black ice beneath the Blackspire. The kingdoms send their best scouts and mages to find out whether it is true.

outcomes.title: The Great Wolf Hunt
outcomes.text: The lords of Aldermere and Hollowcrown hold a great hunt in the High Wilds to clear the wolves before winter. Hundreds of wolves are killed, and the mountain villages sleep easier.

outcomes.title: An Orc Embassy to the Kingdoms
outcomes.text: The orc clans that have broken with the Spire send one embassy to every kingdom of the Great Isle, asking for alliance and recognition. The kingdoms are divided, and for the first time orcs argue their case in human halls.

outcomes.title: The Smuggler King
outcomes.text: A smuggler of the Salt Isles buys a lordship on Sunvale's coast and becomes a lord of the realm. The court cannot refuse his gold, and the smugglers of the south have a protector at court.

outcomes.title: A Rival Thane-King
outcomes.text: A thane of the Deepholds' eastern holds, backed by the miners there, proclaims himself Thane-King against Karak Dûm. The dwarves have two kings, and their warriors abroad are called home to choose a side.

outcomes.title: The Autumn Storms Close the Sea
outcomes.text: The autumn storms close the Ostcombe Sea to shipping. The southern kingdoms' trade stops, and their merchants go hungry.

outcomes.title: The Order Rides Across the Strait
outcomes.text: The knights of the Order of the Lantern cross the frozen strait and ride into the Northern Isle, their lantern burning before them. The Spire's undead fall where its light shines, and the knights reach the Blackspire's outer walls.

outcomes.title: The Lake City's Plague
outcomes.text: A plague breaks out in Aldermere's lake city as the winter begins. The court flees to the hills, and the lake city's poor are left to die.

outcomes.title: The Coven's Peace
outcomes.text: The Hag-Queens of Morrowgast and Sunvale's king sign a lasting peace, dividing the Ashlands and ending the raids forever. The Order of the Lantern calls it betrayal, and rides north to fight the Spire instead.

outcomes.title: The Brotherhood's Winter Raid
outcomes.text: The Brotherhood raids Westmarch's winter harbours, taking the merchant princes' ships at anchor. Westmarch's council swears to destroy the Salt Isles in the spring.

outcomes.title: The Exiles' Victory
outcomes.text: The Ashen Exiles defeat a Horde army on the Northern Isle's western coast and take its war-chief prisoner. Orcs across the Northern Isle desert the Spire for the Exiles' banner.

outcomes.title: The First Ice on the Strait
outcomes.text: The first ice forms on the strait. The Horde's war-bands gather on its northern shore, and Thornwatch braces for the winter.

outcomes.title: The Spire Calls Its Master Home
outcomes.text: The Blackspire's black light flares across the whole Northern Isle, and every orc on the island hears Malgrath's voice calling them home. The Horde's war-bands abandon the strait and march north toward the Spire.

outcomes.title: The Fog Over the Lake Country
outcomes.text: A thick autumn fog settles over Aldermere's lake country and does not lift for three weeks. Boats collide on the lake, travellers vanish on the roads and thieves rob the great houses under cover of the grey, while the Conclave insists the fog is not its doing.

outcomes.title: The Bride-Price of the North
outcomes.text: The Warden of Thornwatch offers his daughter in marriage to whichever prince of the Great Isle brings a thousand men to the wall. Princes of three kingdoms race north with their levies, and the wall's garrison swells as never before.

outcomes.title: The Turnip Riots
outcomes.text: When the grain runs short, Aldermere's crown orders the poor fed on turnips from the royal farms. The lake city's poor riot, pelting the palace with turnips, and the crown becomes a laughing-stock in every tavern.

outcomes.title: The Orc Shaman's Prophecy
outcomes.text: An old orc shaman of the Northern Isle's southern clans prophesies that the Spire will fall when an orc and a man stand together on its threshold. Orcs and men on Thornwatch's wall begin to fight side by side on purpose.

outcomes.title: The Vampire Bats of the Ashlands
outcomes.text: Bats as big as hawks swarm out of the caves of the unruled Ashlands at dusk and drain cattle of blood. Sunvale's border herdsmen keep their beasts indoors, and the Order's knights say the Coven bred them.

outcomes.title: The Hidden Treasury of the Prelacy
outcomes.text: A fire in Hollowcrown's shrine reveals a hidden treasury beneath it, holding the Prelacy's secret fortune in silver. The mountain lords demand it be used to pay the soldiers on the wall; the Prelacy says it belongs to the Flame.

outcomes.title: The Dwarven Embargo on Veyl
outcomes.text: The Deepholds stop selling steel to Veyl over a quarrel about the price of grain. Veyl's shipyards stop, its glass-lens galleys cannot be armed and the Republic must bargain with the dwarves on their terms.

outcomes.title: The Merchant Prince Who Freed His Slaves
outcomes.text: The richest merchant prince of Westmarch frees every servant bound to his house and gives them a share of his ships. The other princes call him mad; their servants begin to demand the same.

outcomes.title: The Mountain Avalanche
outcomes.text: An early snow sends an avalanche down onto the pilgrim road to the Silver Flame, burying a whole party of pilgrims. The road is closed for the winter, and the Prelacy's income from pilgrims stops.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Envoy at the Coven
outcomes.text: An envoy of the Blackspire arrives at the Coven Hollow and offers Morrowgast the whole of Sunvale if the Coven attacks in the spring. The Hag-Queens are divided, and Sunvale's spies send word to Solenne.

outcomes.title: The Salt Isles' Hurricane
outcomes.text: A hurricane sweeps the Salt Isles, flattening Red Harbour and scattering the Brotherhood's fleet across the southern sea. The pirates spend the winter rebuilding, and the Ostcombe Sea is quiet.

outcomes.title: The Elves' Gift to the Wall
outcomes.text: The Elderwood sends Thornwatch a hundred bows of white wood that never break and arrows that burn the undead. The wall's archers become the deadliest on the strait.

outcomes.title: The Horse Fair of the Ashlands
outcomes.text: Sunvale's and Morrowgast's horse-traders meet at a great fair in the unruled Ashlands under a truce. Blessed horses and Riviera mares change hands, and the two realms' riders race each other for sport.

outcomes.title: The Lost Prince Found
outcomes.text: A prince of Aldermere, lost as a child in a shipwreck twenty years ago, is found living as a fisherman on the Salt Isles. He has the royal birthmark; the Brotherhood demands a ransom, and the great houses whose claims he would displace hope he dies first.

outcomes.title: The Leather Shortage
outcomes.text: With the cattle plague and the war's demand for armour, leather runs short across the Great Isle. Boots and saddles become dear, and soldiers on the wall march in rags.

outcomes.title: A New Archmagister Chosen by the Lake
outcomes.text: The masters of the Conclave cannot agree on a new Archmagister, and agree instead to let Lake Halmoor choose. A fisherman's daughter is pulled from the lake alive after a night underwater, and the Tower crowns her.

outcomes.title: The Northern Lights Turn Green
outcomes.text: The northern lights over the strait burn bright green for a week, and the Horde's shamans say the old spirits are angry with the Spire. Three orc war-chiefs refuse to march, and the Spire's autumn raids falter.

outcomes.title: A Witch Takes the Flame
outcomes.text: Morrowgast's envoy to Hollowcrown takes the vows of the Silver Flame and refuses to go home. The Coven demands her return, Hollowcrown refuses and the two realms' priests and witches curse each other across the mountains.

outcomes.title: The Bandit Lord's Castle
outcomes.text: A bandit lord of the High Wilds takes a ruined castle on the border of Aldermere and Hollowcrown and repairs it. He charges both kingdoms' merchants for passage, and neither will send soldiers into the other's claim.

outcomes.title: The Treaty of the Strait's Fish
outcomes.text: Thornwatch and the orc clans that broke with the Spire agree to share the strait's fishing grounds. Orc and human fishermen work the same waters, and the Spire's grip on the northern sea loosens.

outcomes.title: The Night of the Dead
outcomes.text: On the night when the dead are honoured, the risen dead of the Spire's old battlefields walk out of the strait and onto Thornwatch's shore in thousands. The wall's defenders fight them with fire and prayer until dawn, and the shore is ash by morning.

outcomes.title: The Grand Master's Son
outcomes.text: The Grand Master of the Order of the Lantern is found to have a son by a Hag of Morrowgast, raised in secret. The Order is shaken, the Grand Master refuses to resign and the young man asks to take the Order's vows.

outcomes.title: The Harvest Festival of the Free Clans
outcomes.text: The Free Clans hold a great harvest festival in their fens and invite Aldermere's lake towns. Hundreds come, the clans' eel feasts are the talk of the lake country and the great houses are not invited.

outcomes.title: The Thane-King's Daughter Crowned
outcomes.text: The Thane-King of Karak Dûm abdicates in favour of his daughter, the first Thane-Queen of the Deepholds. Old thanes grumble, young dwarves cheer and she opens the Deepholds' gates to the world.

outcomes.title: The Rat Plague of the Ports
outcomes.text: Rats from the ships spread a plague through the harbour towns of Westmarch and Sunvale. The ports close, the ships rot at anchor and the merchants go hungry.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Ambassador to the Elves
outcomes.text: The Blackspire sends an ambassador to the Elderwood offering to spare the Heartwood if the elves leave the war. The Lady of the Elderwood refuses, and the Spire's raids on the Eastern Isle begin.

outcomes.title: The Great Hunt of the Ashlands
outcomes.text: Sunvale's nobles hold a great hunt in the unruled Ashlands for the Blessed beasts that roam there. They kill dozens and lose twenty knights, and the Ashlands' brigands rob the hunters' camps.

outcomes.title: The Copper Kingdom Recognised
outcomes.text: Aldermere and Westmarch recognise the free miners of the copper hills between them as a free realm. The miners' queen sits in the Council of the Kingdoms, and the old crowns grumble at a commoner among them.

outcomes.title: The Wolf Winter of the North
outcomes.text: Wolves come down from the Northern Isle's mountains into the Horde's camps in the first snows. The orcs starve and freeze, and some clans flee across the strait to Thornwatch.

outcomes.title: The Exiles' Navy Sails South
outcomes.text: The Ashen Exiles' longships sail south past Thornwatch to trade with Veyl and the Deepholds. Orc ships in southern harbours are a new sight, and the merchants of the south learn to deal with orcs.

outcomes.title: The Wine Fleet Sinks
outcomes.text: Sunvale's wine fleet bound for Veyl sinks in a storm off the Riviera. The year's vintage is lost, and the vintners' guild faces ruin.

outcomes.title: The Last of the Old Hags
outcomes.text: The oldest Hag-Queen of Morrowgast dies, and with her the memory of the Coven's founding rites. The Blessed who depended on her rites begin to weaken, and the Coven's younger witches seize the circle.

outcomes.title: The Highway Robbery of the Treasury
outcomes.text: Outlaws rob the convoy carrying Aldermere's taxes to the lake city. The crown cannot pay its soldiers on the wall, and the great houses are asked to lend.

outcomes.title: The Free Orcs Join the Concord
outcomes.text: The orc clans of the Northern Isle's southern coast are admitted to the Concord of the Lake as an ally. Orcs sit in the Council of the Kingdoms for the first time, and the great houses of every realm protest.

outcomes.title: The Iron Rain of the North
outcomes.text: A rain of iron stones falls on the Northern Isle's southern coast, smashing the Horde's longships and huts. The orcs say the sky has turned against the Spire, and Thornwatch's smiths collect the star-iron.

outcomes.title: The Archmagister's Last Spell
outcomes.text: The Archmagister of the Conclave dies weaving a ward over the whole of Thornwatch's wall. The ward holds, the risen dead fall at the wall and the Tower mourns its greatest master.

outcomes.title: The Lake Freezes Early
outcomes.text: Lake Halmoor freezes a month early, trapping the lake fleet and the Conclave's barges. The Tower of Stars is cut off for the winter, and the court wonders what the mages are doing alone.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Bride Returns Home
outcomes.text: A princess of Hollowcrown taken by the Spire years ago walks back across the frozen strait, freed by the Spire itself. She carries a message for the Council of the Kingdoms, and will speak it to no one else.

outcomes.title: The Smugglers' Feud
outcomes.text: Smugglers of the Salt Isles and the lake country fight over the trade in untaxed wine. A dozen die, and both crowns' customs men are found to have taken bribes from both sides.

outcomes.title: The Order's Pilgrimage to the Wall
outcomes.text: The knights of the Order of the Lantern carry their founder's lantern to Thornwatch's wall for the winter. Its light reaches across the strait, and the Horde's risen dead will not cross under it.

outcomes.title: The First Great Snow
outcomes.text: The first great snow of winter buries the north in a single night. The roads close, the strait begins to freeze and the Horde's war-bands gather on its far shore for the winter crossing.

outcomes.title: The Assassination of the Warden
outcomes.text: The Warden of Thornwatch is killed by an assassin of the Spire on the wall itself. His captains elect a successor in the snow, and the wall holds under new command.

outcomes.title: The Fur Traders' Fair
outcomes.text: Trappers of the Northern Isle's free clans and Thornwatch's merchants hold a winter fair on the strait's shore, trading furs for grain. The Spire forbids it, and its war-bands raid the fair on its last day.

outcomes.title: The Blessing of the Newborn
outcomes.text: Morrowgast's Hag-Queens work a great rite on the first night of winter, and the Blessing passes into every newborn of the Coven-Realm. A generation of Blessed is being born, and Sunvale's border watches with dread.

outcomes.title: The Bread Tax Repealed
outcomes.text: Aldermere's king repeals the bread tax after a winter of riots. The lake city's poor cheer him, the great houses who collected it lose a fortune and the crown's treasury empties.

outcomes.title: Dwarven Steel for the Winter
outcomes.text: The ruler of the Deepholds sends an embassy to every kingdom of the Great Isle, offering dwarven steel at a fair price for the war. The kingdoms accept, and their armies are armed for the winter.

outcomes.title: The Strait Freezes
outcomes.text: The strait freezes solid, and the Horde's war-bands begin to cross on the ice. Thornwatch's wall braces for a winter siege.

outcomes.title: The Elves' Winter Song
outcomes.text: The elves of the Elderwood sing a winter song that warms the whole of Thornwatch's wall. The soldiers do not freeze, and the Horde's winter siege fails.

outcomes.title: The Wolf Packs of the Great Isle
outcomes.text: Wolves come down from the High Wilds into the farmland of Aldermere and Hollowcrown in the first snows. Shepherds lose their flocks, and the kings offer bounties.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Heart Found
outcomes.text: Scouts of the Conclave and the Greywatch find a vault beneath the Northern Isle's ice that holds a black box humming with power. They believe it is Malgrath's heart, and the kingdoms debate whether to destroy it.

outcomes.title: The Winter Fever Spreads
outcomes.text: A winter fever spreads through the armies on Thornwatch's wall. Thousands are sick, and the wall's garrison is halved.

outcomes.title: The Free Clans' Winter March
outcomes.text: The Free Clans march north to Thornwatch's wall for the winter, the first time the fens have sent warriors to the north. Aldermere's great houses are shamed into sending more of their own.

outcomes.title: The Pirates' Winter Raid
outcomes.text: The Brotherhood raids Sunvale's winter harbours, taking the court's ships at anchor. Sunvale's king swears to destroy the Salt Isles in the spring.

outcomes.title: The Coven Offers Help
outcomes.text: Morrowgast's Hag-Queens offer Blessed warriors to Thornwatch's wall for the winter siege. The Warden accepts, the Order threatens to leave and the Council of the Kingdoms must decide.

outcomes.title: The Grain Ships of the East Arrive
outcomes.text: Veyl's winter grain fleet arrives at the Great Isle's harbours, and the famine eases. The Republic's name is blessed in every market, and its banks take the kingdoms' debts in hand.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Winter Siege
outcomes.text: The Horde crosses the frozen strait in force and besieges Thornwatch's wall. The siege will last the winter, and the kingdoms send every soldier they can spare north.

outcomes.title: The Merchant Princes' Winter
outcomes.text: Westmarch's merchant princes, ruined by the year's storms and pirates, sell their ships to Veyl. Westmarch's fleet is Veyl's in all but name, and the guild halls take the council.

outcomes.title: An Orc Saint Proclaimed
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's Prelacy proclaims an orc of the Ashen Exiles a saint of the Silver Flame for dying to save a village. Orcs across the Northern Isle hear of it, and some convert.

outcomes.title: The Lake City's Winter Market
outcomes.text: Aldermere's lake city holds a winter market on the frozen lake. Merchants of every realm come, and the lake city grows rich in the cold.

outcomes.title: The Spire Speaks to the World
outcomes.text: On the first night of winter, every living being in the world hears Malgrath's voice for a heartbeat: the winter will be the last. The kingdoms prepare for the final battle.

outcomes.title: The Candle-Makers' Corner
outcomes.text: With the winter dark coming and tallow scarce from the cattle plague, the candle-makers of Aldermere's lake city buy up every pound of wax and tallow and double the price of light. The poor sit in the dark, the crown seizes the stores and the guilds call it theft.

outcomes.title: The King's Second Marriage
outcomes.text: Aldermere's widowed king marries a daughter of Veyl's richest banking house, and her dowry pays off half the crown's debts. The great houses are appalled to see a banker's child as queen, and Veyl's influence in the lake city grows.

outcomes.title: The Sledge Raiders
outcomes.text: Outlaws on sledges pulled by dogs raid the snowbound villages of Hollowcrown's high valleys, taking food and furs. The Silver Guard cannot follow them over the drifts, and the mountain lords pay them to stay away.

outcomes.title: The Witch of the Heartwood
outcomes.text: An elf of the Elderwood is found practising the Coven's blood-witchcraft to heal the Heartwood's withering roots. The elves are horrified; the Heartwood, for the first time in a year, puts out new leaves.

outcomes.title: The Collapse of the Strait Ice
outcomes.text: The strait's ice breaks up in a sudden thaw while a Horde war-band is crossing it, and hundreds of orcs drown. The Horde's winter campaign stalls, and Thornwatch's wall breathes for a month.

outcomes.title: The Merchant Prince's Confession
outcomes.text: A merchant prince of Westmarch, dying, confesses that his family has sold weapons to the Horde for twenty years. His heirs are arrested, his ships seized and Westmarch's council is purged of everyone his ledgers name.

outcomes.title: The Dwarven Winter Market
outcomes.text: The Deepholds open a winter market in Karak Dûm's great hall, the first time outsiders have traded under the mountain. Humans, elves and orcs of the Exiles crowd in, and the dwarves grow rich and curious about the world.

outcomes.title: The Prince Who Came Back Blessed
outcomes.text: A prince of Sunvale, captured by Morrowgast a year ago, is returned changed by the Blessing: taller, scarred and fevered. Sunvale's court does not know whether to welcome him home or lock him away.

outcomes.title: The Great Wolf of the North
outcomes.text: A wolf as big as a horse leads the packs of the Northern Isle against the Horde's winter camps. The orcs call it a spirit of the old gods; the Spire sends its Voices to kill it, and they do not return.

outcomes.title: The Archmagister's Fool
outcomes.text: A jester at Aldermere's court is revealed to be a master of the Conclave in disguise, sent to watch the king. The court is outraged, the Tower apologises and the king keeps the jester, saying he is the only honest man at court.

outcomes.title: The Grain Hoarders Hanged
outcomes.text: Aldermere's king hangs three grain merchants caught hoarding while the lake city starved. The poor cheer, the merchants of every realm grow nervous and grain begins to flow again.

outcomes.title: The Exiles' Holy War
outcomes.text: The Ashen Exiles' prophetess declares a holy war against the Spire and calls every orc of the Northern Isle to her banner. Thousands of orcs leave the Horde's camps in the snow, and the Spire's host shrinks by a third.

outcomes.title: The Riviera Bankrupt
outcomes.text: Sunvale's court defaults on its debts to Veyl, and the Republic seizes the royal estates on the Riviera. Sunvale's king is a pauper in his own palace, and the barons begin to talk of a new king.

outcomes.title: The Last Elf of the West
outcomes.text: An elf who sailed west a thousand years ago returns alone to the Eastern Isle, the last of her people beyond the sea. She brings the lost songs of the first Binding, and the Elderwood's Loremasters weep.

outcomes.title: The Snowbound Pilgrims
outcomes.text: A party of a thousand pilgrims to the Silver Flame is trapped by snow in the High Wilds' passes. Hollowcrown's Silver Guard digs them out, but hundreds have frozen, and the Prelacy is blamed for sending them in winter.

outcomes.title: The Order Takes a Hag's Tower
outcomes.text: The knights of the Order of the Lantern storm a Hag-Queen's tower on Morrowgast's western border in the snow. The witch escapes, but her books of rites are taken, and the Order's scholars begin to learn how the Blessing is undone.

outcomes.title: The Ice Fishermen
outcomes.text: With the lakes frozen, Aldermere's fishermen cut holes in the ice of Lake Halmoor and fish through the winter. A good catch feeds the lake city, and the crown taxes every hole.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Peace Offer to the Exiles
outcomes.text: The Blackspire offers the Ashen Exiles a free kingdom on the Northern Isle if they abandon Thornwatch. The Exiles' moot refuses, and the Spire's war-bands march on their islet.

outcomes.title: Miners Down Tools in the Snow
outcomes.text: The miners of the copper hills between Westmarch and Aldermere strike for higher pay in the winter cold. Both Westmarch and Aldermere's foundries go short, and the price of bronze doubles.

outcomes.title: The Free Clans' Winter Feast
outcomes.text: The Free Clans invite Aldermere's king to their midwinter feast in the fens, and he comes. The great houses are scandalised, and the king and the clans' moot-leader are seen drinking together.

outcomes.title: The Long Night Riots
outcomes.text: In the longest nights of the year, the poor of Westmarch's harbour towns, without work since the storms closed the sea, riot for bread and fuel. The merchant princes' warehouses burn, and the guild halls take over the towns.

outcomes.title: The Usurper of the Deepholds
outcomes.text: A thane of the Deepholds seizes Karak Dûm's stone throne in a night of axes while the ruler is away inspecting the mines. The Deepholds' warriors on Thornwatch's wall are recalled to fight for one side or the other.

outcomes.title: The Wraiths of the High Passes
outcomes.text: Wraiths of the snow walk the high passes of the High Wilds and freeze travellers where they stand. The passes between Aldermere and Hollowcrown close for the winter, and both kingdoms are cut off from each other.

outcomes.title: Morrowgast Asks to Join the Concord
outcomes.text: Morrowgast sends an embassy to the Council of the Kingdoms offering to join the war against the Spire in exchange for recognition as a kingdom of the Concord. The council is divided, and the Order threatens to leave the wall if it is accepted.

outcomes.title: The Herring Fails
outcomes.text: The winter herring do not come into the Ostcombe Sea. The fishing towns of the south go hungry, and the Brotherhood's sailors turn to robbing the fishing fleets.

outcomes.title: The Bastard of Thornwatch
outcomes.text: A bastard son of Thornwatch's late Warden comes forward with proof of his birth and a claim to the wardenship. The captains of the wall are divided, and the north's command splits in the middle of the winter siege.

outcomes.title: The Black Ice of the Strait
outcomes.text: The strait freezes black, and the ice is so thick the Horde can drive its mammoths across. The war-beasts batter Thornwatch's gates, and the wall's defenders burn them with oil.

outcomes.title: The Silver Flame's Winter Miracle
outcomes.text: The Silver Flame burns so bright on midwinter's eve that it melts the snow for a mile around Hollowcrown's shrine. Pilgrims come through the snow to see it, and the Prelacy's power grows.

outcomes.title: The Fur Trade War
outcomes.text: Trappers of the Northern Isle's free clans and Thornwatch's merchants fall out over the price of furs. The winter fair on the strait's shore turns into a brawl, and the trade between orcs and men stops for a season.

outcomes.title: The Lady of the Elderwood Falls Ill
outcomes.text: The Lady of the Elderwood falls into a sleep from which she cannot be woken, her life bound to the withering Heartwood. The Loremasters rule in her name, and the elves fear their queen will not wake.

outcomes.title: The Brigand King's Pardon
outcomes.text: Aldermere's king pardons the bandit lord of the High Wilds and makes him warden of the mountain passes. The former brigand clears the passes of other outlaws, and the roads are safe for the first time in years.

outcomes.title: A Voice Escapes Wyn
outcomes.text: A Voice of the Spire held prisoner by the Conclave on Wyn escapes across the frozen lake. The Tower's wards are broken, and the Conclave hunts the Voice across Aldermere's snows.

outcomes.title: The Lake City's Winter Plague
outcomes.text: A plague breaks out in Aldermere's lake city in the depth of winter. The court flees to the hills, and the poor are left to die in the cold.

outcomes.title: The Free Orcs' King Slain
outcomes.text: The king of the orc clans that broke with the Spire is slain by a Horde assassin. His clans mourn, choose a new king and swear vengeance on the Spire.

outcomes.title: The Gold Fleet of the West
outcomes.text: Westmarch's colony beyond the western sea sends home a fleet laden with gold. The merchant princes' debts are paid, and the guild halls demand a share.

outcomes.title: The Order and the Coven Talk
outcomes.text: The Grand Master of the Order of the Lantern and a Hag-Queen of Morrowgast meet under a truce flag in the Ashlands, the first such meeting in history. They agree on nothing, but agree to meet again.

outcomes.title: The Salt Shortage
outcomes.text: The Brotherhood's blockade of the salt pans leaves the Great Isle short of salt for the winter. Meat cannot be preserved, and the armies on the wall go hungry.

outcomes.title: The Heartwood's Second Seedling
outcomes.text: A seedling of the Heartwood planted on the Great Isle puts out its first flower in the snow. The elves come to see it, and Aldermere's lords begin to fear what grows in their forest.

outcomes.title: The Snow Bears
outcomes.text: Great white bears come down from the frozen north of the Northern Isle and attack the Horde's camps. The orcs are driven south, and some cross the strait to beg Thornwatch for shelter.

outcomes.title: The Last Embassy to the Spire
outcomes.text: The Council of the Kingdoms sends a final embassy to the Blackspire offering peace. The envoys are sent back blind, and the kingdoms prepare for the final campaign.

outcomes.title: The Winter Siege Breaks
outcomes.text: The Horde's winter siege of Thornwatch's wall breaks after a month of assaults on the ice. The orcs retreat to the Northern Isle, leaving thousands dead on the strait, and the wall stands.

outcomes.title: The Regent of Sunvale
outcomes.text: Sunvale's king, broken by debt and grief, names his cousin the commoner general regent and retires to a monastery. The court's nobles refuse to obey a soldier, and the barons back the regent.

outcomes.title: The Ice Market
outcomes.text: The merchants of Thornwatch hold a market on the frozen strait itself, with stalls on the ice. Free orcs, dwarves and men trade side by side, and the Spire's war-bands watch from the far shore.

outcomes.title: A Hag-Queen Seeks Asylum
outcomes.text: A Hag-Queen of Morrowgast, condemned by her sisters for refusing to Bless children, flees to Sunvale and asks for asylum. Sunvale's court takes her in, and the Coven demands her head.

outcomes.title: The Frozen Harbour of Veyl
outcomes.text: Veyl's harbour freezes, trapping the Republic's fleet. Its trade stops for a month, and its banks call in their loans to cover the losses.

outcomes.title: The Deepholds' Two Kings
outcomes.text: The dwarves of the Deepholds, unable to choose between two claimants to the stone throne, divide the holds between them. The Deepholds have two kings, and their warriors abroad are recalled.

outcomes.title: The Winter Wolves of the Lake
outcomes.text: Wolves cross the frozen Lake Halmoor into Aldermere's lake city at night and kill a dozen people. The crown offers a bounty, and hunters patrol the ice.

outcomes.title: The Exiles' Victory in the Snow
outcomes.text: The Ashen Exiles defeat a Horde war-band in a snowstorm on the Northern Isle's western coast. The orcs of the Horde begin to desert to the Exiles in hundreds.

outcomes.title: The Collapse of a Silver Mine
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's richest silver mine collapses in the winter cold, killing hundreds. The Prelacy's treasury empties, and the war tithe is doubled.

outcomes.title: The Conclave's Winter Ward
outcomes.text: The Conclave of the Lake weaves a ward over the whole of the Great Isle's north that no undead can pass. The Spire's risen dead fall at the ward's edge, and the Horde's winter raids end.

outcomes.title: The Bread Fleet
outcomes.text: Westmarch sends a fleet of grain ships to Thornwatch for the winter. The wall's garrison is fed, and Westmarch's voice in the Council of the Kingdoms grows.

outcomes.title: The Prophetess's Vision
outcomes.text: The blind prophetess of the Ashen Exiles sees the Blackspire fall in a vision and names the day: the next midwinter. Orcs and men on the wall prepare for the final battle.

outcomes.title: The Winter Fair of Solenne
outcomes.text: Sunvale holds a winter fair in Solenne to raise money for its debts. It is a failure, the merchants go home and Sunvale's court sinks deeper into debt.

outcomes.title: The Treaty of the Strait
outcomes.text: Thornwatch and the orc clans that broke with the Spire sign a treaty of alliance for the final campaign. Orcs and men will march on the Blackspire together.

outcomes.title: The Plague of the Wall
outcomes.text: A camp fever spreads through Thornwatch's wall in the winter. Thousands are sick, and the wall's garrison is halved.

outcomes.title: The Lady of the Elderwood's Vision
outcomes.text: The Lady of the Elderwood sits a night and a day beneath the Heartwood and rises saying she has seen how the Binding can be woven again. The elves prepare the rite, and the kingdoms are asked to send their mages.

outcomes.title: The Brotherhood's Winter
outcomes.text: The Brotherhood winters in Red Harbour, rebuilding its fleet after the storms. The Ostcombe Sea is quiet, and the southern merchants sail freely.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Final Envoy
outcomes.text: The Blackspire sends a final envoy to the Council of the Kingdoms: surrender by midwinter or burn. The council refuses, and the kingdoms prepare for the final battle.

outcomes.title: The Ice Fishing Wars
outcomes.text: The fishermen of Aldermere and the Free Clans fight over the ice-fishing holes on Lake Halmoor. A dozen die, and the crown and the clans' moot must make peace on the ice.

outcomes.title: The King Rides North
outcomes.text: Aldermere's king rides north to Thornwatch's wall for the final campaign. The army cheers, and the other kings are shamed into following.

outcomes.title: The Advent Fast Riots
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's Prelacy orders a month-long fast before midwinter to win the Silver Flame's favour for the war. The hungry poor of the mountain towns, already half-starved, break the fast and the tithe-barns together, and the Silver Guard will not fire on them.

outcomes.title: The Heir Who Chose the Wall
outcomes.text: The heir of Westmarch's First Prince renounces his inheritance to take the oath of the wall's garrison at Thornwatch. His father disinherits him, the guild halls name a street after him and young men across the south follow him north.

outcomes.title: The Glass Forest
outcomes.text: A freezing rain coats the forests of Aldermere's north in ice so thick the trees shatter under it. The woods ring like bells for a week, timber becomes scarce and the charcoal-burners are ruined.

outcomes.title: The Blessed Who Came to Kneel
outcomes.text: A company of Morrowgast's Blessed warriors walks across the Ashlands to Lanternhold and kneels before the Order of the Lantern, asking to be cured or killed. The Grand Master must choose between mercy and the Order's oldest vow.

outcomes.title: The Pawnbrokers' Collapse
outcomes.text: The pawnbrokers of Aldermere's lake city, holding the pledges of half the poor, go bankrupt when the price of silver falls. The poor lose their tools and their wedding rings, and the crown is begged to step in.

outcomes.title: The Thane's Ghost
outcomes.text: The ghost of a Thane-King of the Elder Age walks the halls of Karak Dûm, demanding that the lost hold of Karak Varn be avenged. The Remembrancers take it as a command, and the dwarves prepare to march into the deep.

outcomes.title: The Whalers' Strike
outcomes.text: The whale fleets of Westmarch and Thornwatch refuse to sail until the merchant princes pay them in silver instead of credit. Whale-oil runs short, the Great Isle's lamps go dark early and the princes give way.

outcomes.title: The Exiles' Coronation
outcomes.text: The Ashen Exiles crown their first king in their walled town on the north-western islet, an orc who was born a slave and won his freedom on Thornwatch's wall. Envoys of three kingdoms attend, and the Horde's clans hear that orcs can rule themselves.

outcomes.title: The Snowbound Army
outcomes.text: An army of Aldermere marching north to the wall is trapped by blizzards in the High Wilds' passes for a month. Hundreds freeze, the rest eat their horses and the wall waits for men who do not come.

outcomes.title: The Veyl Embassy to the Silk Empire
outcomes.text: Veyl sends its first embassy across the eastern ocean to the silk empire beyond it, carrying glass and dwarven steel. If the empire's fleets join the trade, the whole balance of the known world's commerce will shift.

outcomes.title: The Ice Pirates
outcomes.text: Pirates with ships fitted with iron runners sail over the frozen strait and rob both the Horde's camps and Thornwatch's supply sledges. Neither side can catch them on the ice.

outcomes.title: The Midwinter Truce Proposed
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's First Prelate proposes a truce for the twelve days of midwinter, with prisoners exchanged on the strait's ice. The Horde's war-chiefs accept, the Spire does not forbid it and for twelve days no one dies on the wall.

outcomes.title: The Lamp-Oil Famine
outcomes.text: With the whale fleets idle and the olive harvest poor, lamp-oil becomes so dear the Great Isle's cities go dark at sunset. Thieves flourish in the dark streets, and the crowns order the watch doubled.

outcomes.title: The Conclave's Star-Glass
outcomes.text: The Conclave of the Lake grinds a lens of star-glass that lets its scholars see the Blackspire from Wyn's tower. Through it they watch Malgrath walk his walls, and learn that he is thinner and slower than the songs say.

outcomes.title: The Avalanche at Lanternhold
outcomes.text: An avalanche buries the outer walls of Lanternhold and half the Order's stables. The knights dig out through the snow, and the Order's winter crusade is cancelled.

outcomes.title: The Bride from the Fens
outcomes.text: Aldermere's king marries a widow of the Free Clans, a moot-leader's daughter, in the lake city's cathedral. The fens and the crown are bound by blood, and the great houses who wanted the fens drained are left without a cause.

outcomes.title: The Pig Plague
outcomes.text: A sickness kills the pigs of Westmarch and Sunvale before the winter slaughter. Families who counted on salted pork for the winter go hungry, and the price of meat soars.

outcomes.title: The Hag-Queen's Penance
outcomes.text: A Hag-Queen of Morrowgast walks barefoot through the snow to Sunvale's border and offers her own life as payment for the villages the Blessed burned. Sunvale's barons do not know whether to kill her, pardon her or make her a hostage.

outcomes.title: The Frozen River Road
outcomes.text: The great rivers of the Great Isle freeze so hard that merchants drive sledges along them for a month. Trade moves faster on the ice than on the roads, and the bridge-tollers grow poor.

outcomes.title: The Free Orc Queen's Bargain
outcomes.text: The leader of the orc clans that broke with the Spire offers Thornwatch the secret paths of the Northern Isle's mountains in exchange for a place in the Concord. The Warden accepts, and the kingdoms argue for a month.

outcomes.title: The Darkest Fortnight
outcomes.text: The two weeks before midwinter bring the darkest, coldest days in living memory. Rivers freeze to their beds, the old die in every village and on Thornwatch's wall the soldiers burn the furniture of the keep to stay alive.

outcomes.title: The Prince Who Spoke for the Spire
outcomes.text: A prince of Hollowcrown stands up in the Council of the Kingdoms and argues for peace with the Blackspire. The council is in uproar, his family disowns him and he is later found to have dreamed of the Spire every night for a year.

outcomes.title: The Ice Wolves of the Strait
outcomes.text: Wolves of white ice, made by the Spire's sorcery, run across the frozen strait at night and attack Thornwatch's sentries. Fire kills them, and the wall burns its stores of oil to keep them away.

outcomes.title: The Coven's Winter Gift
outcomes.text: Morrowgast sends wagons of grain and Blessed-made medicines across the Ashlands to Sunvale's starving border villages as a midwinter gift. The villagers eat, Sunvale's court fumes and the Order calls it the Coven buying souls.

outcomes.title: The Fall of the Lake City's Bridge
outcomes.text: The great bridge between the lake city of Aldermere and its mainland suburbs collapses under the weight of ice. The city is cut in two for the winter, and boats cannot cross the frozen lake.

outcomes.title: The Deep Study's Confession
outcomes.text: A master of the Conclave's Deep Study confesses that her circle has been speaking with Malgrath through a black mirror for years, trying to learn how to kill him. The Tower must decide whether she is a traitor or the world's best hope.

outcomes.title: The Winter Wedding Feast Poisoned
outcomes.text: A wedding feast of two great houses of Aldermere ends in poisoning, and both bridegrooms' fathers die. The houses blame each other, and the lake country's feuds grow hotter in the cold.

outcomes.title: The Elves Light the Wall
outcomes.text: The elves of the Elderwood send a hundred singers to Thornwatch, and their songs light the wall with a pale green fire that does not burn. The Spire's sorcery cannot cross it, and the soldiers sleep without dreams.

outcomes.title: The Silver Hoard Found
outcomes.text: A ploughman in Westmarch's west turns up a hoard of Elder Age silver in a frozen field. The merchant princes, the guild halls and the ploughman's lord all claim it, and the case goes to the council.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Last Letter
outcomes.text: A letter in Malgrath's own hand arrives at every court of the Great Isle on the same morning, naming the day he will cross the strait. The kingdoms do not know whether to believe it, and every army marches north to be sure.

outcomes.title: The Snow Fever
outcomes.text: A fever that comes with the snow spreads through the crowded cities of the Great Isle. The physicians are overwhelmed, and the Elderwood's healers are begged to come south.

outcomes.title: The Order Crowns a Saint
outcomes.text: The Order of the Lantern declares its founder, Anselm the Lampbearer, a saint, against the wishes of Hollowcrown's Prelacy. The Order and the Prelacy quarrel, and pilgrims flock to Lanternhold instead of Hollowcrown.

outcomes.title: The Pirates' Winter Haven
outcomes.text: The Brotherhood winters on an unruled island off Sunvale's coast, within a day's sail of Solenne. Sunvale's court sleeps badly, and its fleet is frozen in harbour.

outcomes.title: The Last Elf of the First War
outcomes.text: The oldest elf of the Elderwood, who fought at the Weeping Fields, dies in the Heartwood's shade. Before she dies she tells the Loremasters the true name of the Binding's weaver, and the Elderwood sends for her.

outcomes.title: The Bread Riots of Solenne
outcomes.text: The poor of Solenne riot for bread in the depth of winter, storming the court's granaries. The palace guard fires on the crowd, and Sunvale's people turn against the crown.

outcomes.title: The Dwarves March to Karak Varn
outcomes.text: The Deepholds' warriors march into the deep roots of the mountains to reclaim the lost hold of Karak Varn. Whatever lives there fights them in the dark, and the dwarves send for the Conclave's fire-mages.

outcomes.title: The Wool Fleet Frozen
outcomes.text: Aldermere's wool fleet is frozen in the harbour of the lake city for the whole winter. The great houses' revenues stop, and the lake towns' weavers starve.

outcomes.title: The Exiles' Chief Weds
outcomes.text: The chief of the Ashen Exiles marries a daughter of Thornwatch's captains in a ceremony of both peoples. Orcs and men dance together on the wall, and the Horde's spies report it to the Spire.

outcomes.title: The Winter Hunt of the High Wilds
outcomes.text: The lords of Aldermere and Hollowcrown hold a winter hunt in the High Wilds to clear the wolves and the goblins before spring. Dozens of goblins are killed, and the goblins swear vengeance.

outcomes.title: The Lady's Last Song
outcomes.text: The Lady of the Elderwood sings a song that is heard on every shore of the known world. The Blackspire's black light dims for an hour, and the elves say the Binding has begun.

outcomes.title: The Midwinter Crossing
outcomes.text: The strait freezes solid on the longest night, and the Horde's whole host walks across the ice toward Thornwatch's wall under the Spire's black light. Every realm's soldiers stand on the wall together, and the battle lasts from dusk until a red dawn.

outcomes.title: The King Who Went Onto the Ice
outcomes.text: Aldermere's king rides out onto the frozen strait at the head of the kingdoms' knights to meet the Horde before it reaches the wall. Whether he returns or not, the songs of the Great Isle will sing of the charge on the ice for a thousand years.

outcomes.title: The Solstice Fires
outcomes.text: On midwinter night every hearth in the Great Isle is lit from the Silver Flame, carried village to village by runners through the snow. For one night the faiths, the kingdoms and the peoples share one fire, and the Spire's undead cannot cross into any lit village.

outcomes.title: The Weaver Found
outcomes.text: The Elderwood finds the one its oldest lore names as the weaver of a new Binding: a girl of the Free Clans, born in Aldermere's fens with the gift of magic. The elves, the Conclave and the girl's own clan-mothers argue over whether to let a child bear such a weight.

outcomes.title: The Mutiny in the Horde
outcomes.text: On the night of the great crossing, three of the Horde's war-chiefs turn their warriors against the Spire's Voices in the middle of the ice. The Horde's host breaks in two, and orc fights orc on the frozen strait.

outcomes.title: The Fall of a Hag-Queen's Tower
outcomes.text: A Hag-Queen's tower on Morrowgast's border falls in a midwinter storm, killing the witch and every Blessed warrior bound to her. The Coven-Realm's border garrisons are left leaderless, and Sunvale's barons ride through the snow to see.

outcomes.title: The Frozen Harbours
outcomes.text: Every harbour of the Great Isle freezes in the great cold. No ship sails, no fish are caught and the coastal towns live on what they have stored.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Heart Struck
outcomes.text: Scouts of the Greywatch and mages of the Conclave reach the black box of ice beneath the Blackspire said to hold Malgrath's heart, and strike it with every spell they know. The Spire screams across the whole Northern Isle, and its black light goes out for a night.

outcomes.title: The Midwinter Truce of the South
outcomes.text: Sunvale and Morrowgast keep a truce for the twelve days of midwinter, exchanging prisoners at the Ashlands' edge. Families separated for years meet on the snow, and neither side wants the fighting to begin again.

outcomes.title: A Child Born on the Wall
outcomes.text: A child is born on Thornwatch's wall on midwinter night, to an orc mother of the Exiles and a human soldier of the garrison. The Prelacy's priests bless the child, and the soldiers call it the wall's luck.

outcomes.title: The Wolves Go Quiet
outcomes.text: For the twelve nights of midwinter, no wolf howls anywhere on the Great Isle. Shepherds say the beasts are waiting for something, and the Conclave's scholars cannot explain it.

outcomes.title: The Thane-Queen's Oath
outcomes.text: The ruler of the Deepholds swears on the Book of Grudges that the dwarves will not rest until the Blackspire falls. Every dwarf of the Eastern Isle hears it, and the Deepholds empty their halls of warriors.

outcomes.title: The Bread of Midwinter
outcomes.text: Every kingdom of the Great Isle opens its granaries to the poor for the midwinter feast, for the first time in memory. For one night no one in the Great Isle goes hungry, and the poor bless their kings.

outcomes.title: The Conclave's Sacrifice
outcomes.text: Twelve masters of the Conclave give their lives to raise a ward over Thornwatch's wall on the night of the great crossing. The ward holds, the Spire's risen dead fall at its edge and the Tower of Stars has never been so honoured or so empty.

outcomes.title: The Midwinter Fair on the Ice
outcomes.text: Merchants of every realm, free orcs and dwarves among them, hold a fair on the frozen Lake Halmoor for the twelve days of midwinter. It is the merriest the lake country has been since the Black Dawn.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Bargain to the Elves
outcomes.text: The Blackspire sends a message to the Elderwood: send whoever could weave a new Binding to the Spire, and the war ends without another death. Every court of the world argues whether she should go.

outcomes.title: The Great Snow Melts
outcomes.text: A warm wind out of the south melts the snow of the whole Great Isle in a single day of midwinter. The rivers flood, the strait's ice cracks under the Horde's host and thousands of orcs drown on the night they meant to cross.

outcomes.title: The Last Voice Speaks
outcomes.text: The last of the Spire's masked Voices walks onto Thornwatch's wall under a white banner and takes off her mask. She is a princess of Aldermere taken four hundred years ago, and she tells the kingdoms that Malgrath is dying.

outcomes.title: The Snow Lights
outcomes.text: Lights of every colour dance over the snows of the whole known world on midwinter night. Elves, dwarves, orcs and men all stop what they are doing to watch, and many say they have never seen the world so beautiful.

outcomes.title: The Order Rides Onto the Northern Isle
outcomes.text: The knights of the Order of the Lantern ride across the frozen strait with their founder's lantern burning before them. The Spire's undead fall in its light, and the Order plants its banner on the Northern Isle's shore.

outcomes.title: The Last Week of the Year 524
outcomes.text: The year 524 ends in snow, war and hope. The rulers of every realm send midwinter gifts to each other for the first time, and the chroniclers of the Great Isle write that the world has never stood so close together, or so close to the edge.

outcomes.title: The Fall of the Blackspire
outcomes.text: In the last week of the year the Blackspire's black light gutters and goes out, and a great crack runs down its walls from top to foot. Whether Malgrath is dead, sleeping or gone, the orc clans fall silent and the Northern Isle waits for spring.

outcomes.title: The New Year's Council
outcomes.text: The Council of the Kingdoms meets at Aldermere at the year's end with envoys from every people: the kingdoms, the Eastern Isle, the Exiles, the free orcs, even Morrowgast. For the first time in history they agree on a single thing: to meet again.

outcomes.title: The Year-End Abdication
outcomes.text: An old ruler of the Great Isle, worn out by two years of war, abdicates on the last day of the year in favour of a younger heir. The new ruler's first act is to send envoys to every court asking for peace.

outcomes.title: The Great Thaw
outcomes.text: The new year begins with a thaw that melts the strait's ice and breaks the winter. The Horde's host on the ice retreats to the Northern Isle, and the spring will bring either peace or the last battle.

outcomes.title: The Weaver's Choice
outcomes.text: A young mage of the Free Clans, whom the elves' oldest lore names as the weaver of a new Binding, makes her choice on the year's last night and tells only the Lady of the Elderwood. The elves begin to prepare a rite on the strait's shore, and every mage of the world is asked to come.

outcomes.title: The Year-End Tithe Forgiven
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's Prelacy forgives the year's tithe to every peasant of the mountain kingdom in thanks for the wall's survival. The mountain villages cheer, and the Prelacy's treasury empties for a better reason than war.

outcomes.title: The Exiles' Homecoming
outcomes.text: The chief of the Ashen Exiles leads his people back across the sea to their old valleys on the Northern Isle's western coast, which the Horde has abandoned. Orcs who fled the Spire come home, and the Northern Isle has a free orc realm on its own soil.

outcomes.title: The Merchants' New Year
outcomes.text: The merchants of every realm meet in Veyl's glass market for the new year and sign a charter of free trade across the whole known world. Tolls fall, trade doubles and the bankers of Veyl grow richer than ever.

outcomes.title: The Coven's New Year Embassy
outcomes.text: Morrowgast's Hag-Queens send an embassy to Solenne at the new year offering a lasting peace and an end to the Blessing of children. Sunvale's court accepts, and the Order of the Lantern rides to Solenne to protest.

outcomes.title: The New Year Fires
outcomes.text: Bonfires burn on every hill of the Great Isle on the year's last night. From Thornwatch's wall the soldiers can see them stretching south to the horizon, and for one night the war seems far away.

outcomes.title: A Dwarven Hold Reclaimed
outcomes.text: The Deepholds' warriors reclaim the lost hold of Karak Varn on the last day of the year, driving out whatever lived in the deep. The Book of Grudges is closed on its oldest page, and the dwarves feast for a week.

outcomes.title: The Year's End Storm
outcomes.text: A great storm sweeps the Great Isle on the year's last night, tearing roofs and sinking ships in harbour. The new year begins with every realm counting its damage and helping its neighbours.

outcomes.title: The Elderwood's New Queen
outcomes.text: The Lady of the Elderwood names an heir at the year's end, a child of the Heartwood's line born in the war. The elves have a future again, and the Fading seems to have stopped.

outcomes.title: The Brotherhood's Pardon
outcomes.text: The kingdoms of the Great Isle offer the Brotherhood of the Salt Isles a general pardon in exchange for its fleet's service against the Horde in the spring. Red Mara accepts, and the pirates become, for a season, the Great Isle's navy.

outcomes.title: The Last Night of the Year
outcomes.text: On the last night of the year, the stars over the Northern Isle shine for the first time in a century, unhidden by the Spire's black haze. Orcs who have never seen the stars weep, and the Horde's clans begin to speak of a world without the Spire.

outcomes.title: The New Year's Bread
outcomes.text: Veyl's grain fleet arrives at the Great Isle's harbours on the new year's first day, and the winter's hunger ends. The poor bless the Republic, and the kingdoms' debts to Veyl grow again.

outcomes.title: A Tower on the Strait
outcomes.text: The Conclave of the Lake begins building a new tower on the shore of the strait, facing the Northern Isle. The Tower of Stars on Wyn is left to the scholars, and the war-mages move north for good.

outcomes.title: The Year's Chronicle
outcomes.text: The chroniclers of every realm finish the year's chronicle, and for the first time they all record the same events. The Great Isle has a single history at last, and its scholars begin to write it.

outcomes.title: The First Day of Spring
outcomes.text: The first green shoots appear on the strait's shore on the first day of the new year, far earlier than any farmer has ever seen. The elves say the Heartwood is waking, and the world waits to see what spring will bring.

outcomes.title: The Midsummer Play
outcomes.text: A troupe of players performs a satire of King Edric's court in the lake city's square on midsummer eve. The king laughs, the great houses mocked in it do not, and the playwright is found in the lake a week later; the lake city's crowds riot for justice.

outcomes.title: The Painter's Portrait
outcomes.text: A painter of Veyl paints Sunvale's Grand Minister so truly that the portrait shows the poison in her heart. The court is scandalised, the portrait is burned and the painter flees to the Elderwood, where the elves ask her to paint the Heartwood.

outcomes.title: The Song That Spread
outcomes.text: A song mocking Westmarch's merchant princes is sung in every tavern of the Great Isle within a month. The princes ban it, the ban makes it more popular and the guild halls adopt it as their anthem.

outcomes.title: The Tapestry of the Founding
outcomes.text: Weavers of Aldermere finish a tapestry of the Founding a hundred yards long, ten years in the making, for the lake city's cathedral. Pilgrims come to see it, the Lake Guilds grow proud and a thief cuts out the panel showing the first king's face.

outcomes.title: The Bards' Contest
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's mountain lords hold a bards' contest at midsummer, and an orc of the Ashen Exiles wins with a song of the Oathbreaking. The Prelacy is outraged; the mountain folk sing the orc's song all summer.

outcomes.title: The Sculptor's Commission
outcomes.text: Thornwatch's Warden commissions a statue of the first Warden to stand on the wall, carved from black granite by dwarven masons. Its unveiling draws soldiers from every realm on the wall, and the Horde shoots arrows at it from the strait.

outcomes.title: The Midsummer Fires of the Coven
outcomes.text: Morrowgast's people light midsummer fires on every hill of the Coven-Realm, and Sunvale's border villages see them burning red. The barons take it for a muster and call their levies; it is only a festival, and the Coven laughs at their fear.

outcomes.title: The Library Sold
outcomes.text: A great house of Aldermere, ruined by debt, sells its ancestral library to Veyl's new university. Books of lore older than the kingdom leave the Great Isle, and the Conclave tries too late to buy them back.

outcomes.title: The Dancers of Solenne
outcomes.text: A company of dancers from Solenne tours every court of the Great Isle, and one of them is caught stealing state papers in Westmarch. The company is arrested, the papers are missing and Sunvale's court denies everything.

outcomes.title: The Elves' Gift of Music
outcomes.text: The Elderwood sends a harper to Aldermere's court, and her playing heals a fever that has kept the king abed for a month. The court is grateful, and the elves' standing on the Great Isle rises.

outcomes.title: The Comedy of the Wall
outcomes.text: Soldiers on Thornwatch's wall stage a comedy mocking the Horde's war-chiefs and the southern kings alike. It is performed on the wall's battlements within earshot of the strait, and the orcs across it are heard laughing.

outcomes.title: The Theatre Burned
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's Prelacy orders the realm's only theatre burned as a house of sin. The players flee to Aldermere, and the mountain kingdom's young people follow them south to see the plays.

outcomes.title: The Feast of the Free Clans
outcomes.text: The Free Clans hold their midsummer feast in the fens with eel, ale and dancing, and invite the poor of the lake towns. Hundreds come, and the great houses fear their own peasants are learning to love the clans.

outcomes.title: The Silver Flame's Choir
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's Prelacy founds a choir of a hundred voices to sing at the Silver Flame. Its music draws pilgrims from every realm, and the shrine's coffers fill as never before.

outcomes.title: The Lost Poem
outcomes.text: A poem said to have been written by Aldric the Founder is found in a ruined abbey. It names a second heir of the first king, and three great houses claim descent from her.

outcomes.title: The Great Fair of the Deepholds
outcomes.text: The Deepholds open their great hall for a midsummer fair, and the dwarves' smiths show their finest work. Envoys of every realm come, and the dwarves sell more steel in a week than in a year.

outcomes.title: The Pearl Fishers' War
outcomes.text: Pearl fishers of Sunvale's coast and divers of the Salt Isles fight over the pearl beds off the Riviera. Boats are sunk and divers drowned, and both Sunvale's court and the Brotherhood send ships to protect their own.

outcomes.title: The Harbour Chain of Bellhaven
outcomes.text: Westmarch raises a great iron chain across the mouth of Bellhaven's harbour that can be lifted to stop any ship. The Brotherhood's raids on the capital end, and the merchant princes rest easy for the first time in years.

outcomes.title: The Coastal Plague
outcomes.text: A fever brought by a foreign ship spreads along the Great Isle's southern coast from Sunvale to Westmarch. Harbour towns close their gates, ships are turned away and the southern sea's trade stops for a month.

outcomes.title: The Sea Wall of Solenne
outcomes.text: Sunvale's court builds a sea wall around Solenne's harbour with Veyl's money. The capital is safe from storms and pirates, and its debt to Veyl doubles.

outcomes.title: The Shipwrights' Strike
outcomes.text: The shipwrights of Westmarch's yards strike against the merchant princes' new wages. No new ships are launched for a season, and Westmarch's fleet cannot replace its losses to pirates.

outcomes.title: The Lost Isle Found
outcomes.text: Fishermen of Thornwatch blown far to the east find an unruled island in the northern sea, green and full of seals. Thornwatch claims it, and settlers sail for it before the Horde can follow.

outcomes.title: The Smugglers' Coves
outcomes.text: Smugglers carve coves into the cliffs of Aldermere's southern coast to hide untaxed wine and salt. The crown's customs men find one, and a hundred more are rumoured.

outcomes.title: The Brotherhood's Navy Day
outcomes.text: Red Mara reviews the Brotherhood's whole fleet in Red Harbour on midsummer day, fifty ships firing salutes. Every merchant who sees it pays the pirates' toll without arguing.

outcomes.title: The Wreck of the Treasure Ship
outcomes.text: A Sunvale treasure ship carrying the court's payment to Veyl sinks in a storm off the Riviera. Divers, pirates and three navies race to the wreck, and Sunvale's debt to Veyl grows.

outcomes.title: The Sea-Folk's Gift
outcomes.text: The sea-folk of the northern waters bring Thornwatch's fishermen a great net woven of seaweed that never breaks. Thornwatch's fishing fleet doubles its catch, and the Wardenmark eats well.

outcomes.title: The Fishermen's Guild
outcomes.text: The fishermen of the Great Isle's coasts form a guild across all the kingdoms, fixing the price of fish. The crowns protest, and the fishermen stay in harbour until the crowns give way.

outcomes.title: The Lighthouse of the Salt Isles
outcomes.text: The Brotherhood builds a lighthouse on the Salt Isles and charges every ship for its light. Merchants pay to avoid the reefs, and Red Harbour grows respectable.

outcomes.title: The Cliff Collapse
outcomes.text: A great cliff on Westmarch's coast collapses into the sea, taking a fishing village with it. Westmarch's merchant princes are slow to help, and the coast folk curse them.

outcomes.title: The Coast Watch
outcomes.text: Aldermere sets up watchtowers along its southern coast to warn of pirates. The raids fall by half, and the coast folk sleep easier.

outcomes.title: The Salt Pans Flooded
outcomes.text: A spring tide floods the salt pans of Sunvale's coast. Salt becomes dear, the fishing towns cannot cure their catch and the Brotherhood's salt rises in price.

outcomes.title: The Admiral's Duel
outcomes.text: Westmarch's High Admiral challenges a Brotherhood captain to single combat on the deck of a ship. He wins, the Brotherhood's crew surrenders and the Admiral becomes a hero of the western sea.

outcomes.title: The Miracle of the Flame
outcomes.text: A dying child is carried to the Silver Flame and rises healed. Pilgrims flood Hollowcrown from every realm, the Prelacy's power grows and the mountain lords complain the priests profit from miracles.

outcomes.title: The Tithe of Silver
