outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's Prelacy demands a tithe in silver instead of grain to pay for the war, and the mountain villages, who have no silver, must sell their cattle to pay it. The cattle markets crash, the villages go hungry and the mountain lords take the villages' side.

outcomes.title: The Coven's Rite of Rain
outcomes.text: Morrowgast's Hag-Queens work a rite that brings rain to their drought-stricken fields. Sunvale's fields, next door, stay dry, and the barons accuse the Coven of stealing their rain.

outcomes.title: The Conclave's Open Day
outcomes.text: The Conclave of the Lake opens the Tower of Stars to visitors for a single day, showing its wonders. Thousands cross to Wyn, and the Tower's reputation in the lake city has never been higher.

outcomes.title: The Bridge of Pilgrims
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's Prelacy throws a great bridge of stone across the gorge on the pilgrim road to the Silver Flame, paid for by a year's pilgrim offerings. The journey shortens by three days, pilgrims double and the mountain towns along the old road are ruined.

outcomes.title: The Elves' Rite of Healing
outcomes.text: The elves of the Elderwood perform a rite that heals the blighted fields of the Eastern Isle. The harvest is saved, and Veyl and the Deepholds thank the elves with gifts.

outcomes.title: The Witch-Finder's Fall
outcomes.text: A witch-finder of Westmarch is found to have been a witch himself, burning his rivals. The witch-finders' order is disgraced, and Westmarch's people turn against the burnings.

outcomes.title: The Dwarves' Ancestor Rite
outcomes.text: The dwarves of the Deepholds hold their great rite of the ancestors, and the dead of Karak Varn are said to speak. They demand vengeance on whatever took their hold, and the dwarves prepare to march into the deep.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Black Mass
outcomes.text: The Blackspire's black light flares on midsummer night, and every orc on the Northern Isle falls to its knees. Thornwatch's sentries see it across the strait and brace for an attack.

outcomes.title: The Orc Shamans' Council
outcomes.text: The shamans of the orc clans meet in secret on the Northern Isle's unruled west to speak of the old spirits. They agree that the Spire is not a god, and begin to preach against it.

outcomes.title: The Wild Magic Rain
outcomes.text: A rain of wild magic falls on Aldermere's north, turning wheat to gold and cattle to stone. The Conclave sends mages to study it, and the farmers do not know whether they are rich or ruined.

outcomes.title: The Silver Flame's New Prelate
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's First Prelate dies, and the priests elect a reformer who opens the Prelacy's treasury to the poor. The old priests rebel, and the Prelacy splits.

outcomes.title: The Coven's Converts
outcomes.text: Villagers of Sunvale's east, abandoned by their own court, begin to worship at the Coven's shrines. Sunvale's priests are horrified, and the court sends inquisitors east.

outcomes.title: The Magic Spring Dries
outcomes.text: The healing spring of the High Wilds dries up overnight. The bath-houses built around it are abandoned, and the Conclave suspects a rival's curse.

outcomes.title: The Hedge-Witches' Guild
outcomes.text: The hedge-witches of the Great Isle form a guild and ask the crowns for protection from the witch-finders. Aldermere grants it; Hollowcrown refuses.

outcomes.title: The Prophecy of the Founding
outcomes.text: A prophecy is found in the lake city's cathedral, written by the first king's priest: the Great Isle will be saved by a child of the fens. The Free Clans take heart, and the great houses fear what it means.

outcomes.title: The Wool Exchange
outcomes.text: Aldermere's Lake Guilds open an exchange in the lake city where wool is bought and sold on paper before it is shorn. Fortunes are made and lost on next year's clip, three great houses are ruined by a bad bet and the crown is asked to ban the trading.

outcomes.title: The Glass Ducat Falls
outcomes.text: A rumour that Veyl's banks lent half their gold to the Horde sends the glass ducat's value down by a third in a week. Merchants across the world who hold ducats lose their savings, and Veyl's Senate must open its vaults to prove the rumour false.

outcomes.title: The Spice Monopoly
outcomes.text: A Westmarch merchant prince buys every pepper and cinnamon cargo arriving from beyond the eastern sea for a year. The price of spice triples, Sunvale's kitchens go bland and the other merchant princes plot to break him.

outcomes.title: The Debasement Discovered
outcomes.text: Sunvale's court is found to have mixed lead into its silver coins to pay its debts. Merchants refuse Sunvale's coin, prices in Solenne double overnight and the court must strike new coins it cannot afford.

outcomes.title: The Salt Price Collapses
outcomes.text: A new salt mine in the unruled Ashlands floods the south with cheap salt. The Brotherhood's salt trade collapses, its pirates turn back to robbery and Sunvale's fishing towns can cure their catch again.

outcomes.title: The First Bank of the North
outcomes.text: Thornwatch opens its own bank, lending the Wardenmark's merchants money against the wall's future victories. Southern bankers laugh; northern merchants borrow, and the Wardenmark's trade grows.

outcomes.title: The Copper Glut
outcomes.text: The copper miners of the hills between Westmarch and Aldermere flood the market with ore, and copper's price falls by half. Bronze becomes cheap, Westmarch's foundries cast cannon and the miners go hungry.

outcomes.title: The Toll Abolition
outcomes.text: Aldermere's king abolishes every toll on the Lake Road for a year to revive trade. Merchants flood the road, the great houses who lived on the tolls rebel and the crown's treasury empties.

outcomes.title: The Grain Speculators
outcomes.text: Merchants of every realm buy up the Great Isle's grain in a dry summer, betting on famine. The price of bread triples, the poor riot and the crowns must choose between the merchants and the mobs.

outcomes.title: The Dwarven Gold Standard
outcomes.text: The Deepholds begin minting their own gold coins, the anvil, and refuse payment in any other money. Veyl's ducat loses its place as the world's coin, and the Glass Senate fumes.

outcomes.title: The Fur Trade of the North
outcomes.text: Trappers of the Northern Isle's free clans sell furs in Thornwatch's markets for grain and iron. The fur trade grows, the Horde loses its trappers and the Spire forbids the trade on pain of death.

outcomes.title: The Merchant Princes' Loan
outcomes.text: Westmarch's merchant princes lend Aldermere's crown a fortune for the war in exchange for the Lake Road's tolls for twenty years. Aldermere's great houses are furious, and Westmarch's princes become Aldermere's bankers.

outcomes.title: The Smugglers' Fortune
outcomes.text: A smuggler of the Salt Isles becomes the richest man in Sunvale by running untaxed wine. He buys a lordship, and the court cannot refuse his gold.

outcomes.title: The Coven's Market
outcomes.text: Morrowgast opens a market on its border where Sunvale's merchants may buy the Coven's medicines and herbs. Sunvale's poor flock to it, and the court fears the Coven is buying its people.

outcomes.title: The Wool Fleet Insurance
outcomes.text: Westmarch's merchant princes begin selling insurance on ships and cargoes. Merchants sail more boldly, and the princes grow rich on others' risks until a storm sinks three fleets at once.

outcomes.title: The Elves' Gold
outcomes.text: The Elderwood sells a hoard of Elder Age gold to Veyl's banks to buy grain for a hard winter. The gold floods the market, prices rise and the elves are richer than anyone knew.

outcomes.title: The Giants of the Northern Isle
outcomes.text: Hill giants come down from the unruled mountains of the Northern Isle's north and smash a Horde war-camp. The orcs flee south, and the Spire sends its Voices to drive the giants back.

outcomes.title: The Lost Valley of the High Wilds
outcomes.text: Explorers find a hidden valley in the High Wilds where people live as they did in the Elder Age, speaking the old tongue. Aldermere and Hollowcrown both claim the valley, and its people want neither.

outcomes.title: The Centaur Herds
outcomes.text: Herds of centaurs are seen on the unruled plains of the Eastern Isle's north, the first in living memory. Veyl sends envoys, the Deepholds send traders and the centaurs ask only to be left alone.

outcomes.title: The Ashlands Oasis
outcomes.text: A spring of fresh water is found in the heart of the unruled Ashlands, and a green oasis grows around it. Sunvale and Morrowgast both send soldiers to claim it, and the oasis becomes a battlefield.

outcomes.title: The Goblin Tunnels
outcomes.text: Miners of Hollowcrown break into the goblins' warrens beneath the High Wilds and find tunnels running for miles. The goblins fight back in the dark, and the miners flee.

outcomes.title: The Exiles' New Lands
outcomes.text: The Ashen Exiles find unruled land on the Northern Isle's western coast, abandoned by the Horde, and settle it. The Exiles have land of their own on the Northern Isle, and the Horde swears to take it back.

outcomes.title: The Wild Forest of the East
outcomes.text: The Elderwood's rangers find a forest in the Eastern Isle's unruled interior older than the Heartwood itself. Its trees speak, and the elves send Loremasters to listen.

outcomes.title: The Mammoth Hunters
outcomes.text: Hunters of Thornwatch cross the strait in winter and hunt the mammoths of the Northern Isle's unruled north. The meat feeds the Wardenmark, and the Horde's beast-masters hunt the hunters.

outcomes.title: The Lost Dwarven Hold
outcomes.text: Dwarven scouts find a lost hold in the unruled mountains of the Northern Isle, sealed since the First War of the Spire. Its forges are intact, and the Deepholds send an army to reclaim it.

outcomes.title: The Wild Men of the Fens
outcomes.text: Wild men who live in the deepest fens of Aldermere, beyond even the Free Clans, come out to trade for the first time. They know paths no army can follow, and both the Free Clans and the great houses court them.

outcomes.title: The Wolves of the Ashlands
outcomes.text: Wolf packs made huge by the Coven's old rites roam the unruled Ashlands. Travellers are attacked, and Sunvale and Morrowgast both send hunters.

outcomes.title: The Hidden Elven City
outcomes.text: Elven rangers find a hidden city of their own people in the unruled forests of the Eastern Isle's north, cut off since the Fading. The Elderwood's people double.

outcomes.title: The Settlers of the High Wilds
outcomes.text: Landless families of Aldermere build stockades in the unruled valleys of the High Wilds. The land begins to become Aldermere's, and the hill clans fight back.

outcomes.title: The Sea Caves of the North
outcomes.text: Fishermen of Thornwatch find sea caves on the Northern Isle's coast that lead under the island to the Blackspire's foundations. The Warden's captains begin to plan a raid through the caves.

outcomes.title: The Wild Horse Roundup
outcomes.text: Sunvale's barons round up the wild horses of the unruled Ashlands for their cavalry. Morrowgast's Blessed raid the roundup, and the horses scatter.

outcomes.title: The Island of Seals
outcomes.text: Thornwatch's fishermen find an unruled island full of seals in the northern sea. The seal-oil trade begins, and the Wardenmark grows rich on it.

outcomes.title: The King's Birthday Feast
outcomes.text: Aldermere's king holds a great feast for his birthday and invites every ruler of the Great Isle. Westmarch's First Prince refuses to come, Sunvale's king comes drunk and the feast ends in a quarrel over seating.

outcomes.title: The Royal Divorce
outcomes.text: Sunvale's king divorces his Aldermere-born queen to marry a Veyl banker's daughter. Aldermere breaks its old friendship with Sunvale, and Veyl's banks take Sunvale's debts in hand.

outcomes.title: The Court Poisoner Caught
outcomes.text: A poisoner who has served three courts of the Great Isle is caught in Hollowcrown's palace. Under torture she names her employers in every court, and the kings of the Great Isle look at each other with new suspicion.

outcomes.title: The Regent's Ambition
outcomes.text: The regent who governs Hollowcrown for a sickly heir begins to call himself king. The Prelacy refuses to crown him, and the mountain lords take up arms.

outcomes.title: The Courtiers' Duel
outcomes.text: Two favourites of Westmarch's First Prince fight a duel in the council chamber. One dies, the other flees to Veyl and the First Prince is shamed before the guild halls.

outcomes.title: The Heir's Marriage
outcomes.text: Aldermere's heir is betrothed to a princess of Hollowcrown. The two kingdoms bind themselves together, and Westmarch and Sunvale feel left out.

outcomes.title: The Court Astrologer
outcomes.text: Sunvale's king takes advice only from a court astrologer, who reads the war in the stars. The ministers cannot get a decision made, and Sunvale's court drifts.

outcomes.title: The Queen's Lover
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's queen is found to have a lover among the mountain lords. The Prelacy demands she do penance, the mountain lords defend her and the realm splits.

outcomes.title: The Chancellor's Fortune
outcomes.text: Aldermere's Lord Chancellor is found to have grown rich on the war's contracts. The great houses demand his head, the king protects him and Aldermere's council splits.

outcomes.title: The Prince's Coming of Age
outcomes.text: Westmarch's heir comes of age and demands a seat on the merchant princes' council. The princes refuse, the guild halls back the heir and Westmarch's council splits.

outcomes.title: The Court Moves
outcomes.text: Sunvale's court moves from Solenne to a palace in the hills to escape the summer heat and the plague. The government stalls for a month, and the barons rule the east.

outcomes.title: The King's Bastard
outcomes.text: A bastard son of Aldermere's king is found living as a fisherman on Lake Halmoor. The king acknowledges him, and the great houses fear he will be named heir.

outcomes.title: The Court's Masque
outcomes.text: Hollowcrown's court holds a masque at midsummer, and an assassin in a mask kills a mountain lord. The Prelacy and the lords accuse each other.

outcomes.title: The Throne of Glass
outcomes.text: Veyl's First Magistrate has a throne of glass made for the Glass Senate. The senators call it a step toward kingship, and impeach her.

outcomes.title: The Royal Hunt
outcomes.text: Aldermere's king holds a royal hunt in the High Wilds, and a great lord dies of an arrow. The court divides into factions, each suspecting the other.

outcomes.title: The Old King's Memoirs
outcomes.text: A former king of Sunvale, long retired to a monastery, publishes his memoirs revealing the court's secrets. The present court is scandalised, and the memoirs are banned and read everywhere.

outcomes.title: The Summer Assault on the Wall
outcomes.text: The Horde throws a summer assault at Thornwatch's wall with siege towers built from the Northern Isle's forests. Two towers reach the battlements before Hollowcrown's priests burn them, and the wall's garrison loses a quarter of its men.

outcomes.title: The Warden's Gambit
outcomes.text: The Warden of Thornwatch leaves a gate deliberately open to lure a Horde war-band into a killing ground behind the wall. The trap works, three hundred orcs die and the Horde's captains grow wary of Thornwatch's cunning.

outcomes.title: The Strait Blockade
outcomes.text: Thornwatch, the Elderwood and the Deepholds together blockade the strait with every ship they have. The Horde cannot cross by sea, and its war-bands must wait for the winter ice.

outcomes.title: The Northern Raid
outcomes.text: Thornwatch's best raiders land on the Northern Isle at night and burn the Horde's summer harvest. The Spire's clans face a starving winter, and the Horde swears revenge on every Thornwatch village.

outcomes.title: The Siege Towers Burned
outcomes.text: Saboteurs of the Ashen Exiles slip across the strait and burn the Horde's new siege towers before they can be used. The Horde's summer assault is delayed, and the Exiles' standing on the wall grows.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Sorcerer Slain
outcomes.text: A battle-mage of the Conclave kills one of the Spire's masked Voices in a duel of spells above the strait. The orcs on the far shore fall silent, and the wall's defenders cheer.

outcomes.title: The Wall's New Towers
outcomes.text: Dwarven masons finish three new towers on Thornwatch's wall, built of black granite no fire can crack. The Horde's next assault breaks on them, and the wall is stronger than it has been in a century.

outcomes.title: The Orc Deserters
outcomes.text: A whole war-band of the Horde, three hundred strong, crosses the strait and surrenders to Thornwatch, saying they will not die for the Spire. The Warden takes them in, and the Horde's chiefs begin to fear their own warriors.

outcomes.title: The Northern Fever
outcomes.text: A fever spreads through the Horde's war-camps on the strait's northern shore. Thousands of orcs sicken, and the Spire's summer offensive stalls.

outcomes.title: The Battle of the Grey Strand Avenged
outcomes.text: Thornwatch's soldiers ambush a Horde war-band on the Grey Strand, where the old Warden died. Every orc is killed, and Thornwatch's people call it vengeance.

outcomes.title: The Iron Supply Cut
outcomes.text: The Horde's iron mines on the Northern Isle are flooded by a summer storm. The Spire's forges go cold, and the Horde's weapons run short.

outcomes.title: The Elves on the Wall
outcomes.text: A company of elven archers from the Elderwood arrives on Thornwatch's wall. Their arrows burn the Spire's undead, and the wall's defenders take heart.

outcomes.title: The Horde's Mammoths
outcomes.text: The Horde's beast-masters drive mammoths against Thornwatch's gates. The gates hold, the mammoths burn and the Horde loses its war-beasts.

outcomes.title: The Spire's Bargain
outcomes.text: The Blackspire offers Thornwatch a truce: the strait for the Spire, the Wardenmark untouched. The Warden refuses, and the war goes on.

outcomes.title: The Wall's Supply Fleet
outcomes.text: Westmarch sends a fleet of grain ships to Thornwatch's wall. The garrison is fed, and Westmarch's standing in the Council of the Kingdoms rises.

outcomes.title: The Northern Lights
outcomes.text: The northern lights over the strait burn blood-red for a week. The Horde's shamans say the old spirits are angry, and three war-chiefs refuse to march.

outcomes.title: The Great Migration
outcomes.text: Thousands of refugees from Thornwatch's burned coast walk south into Aldermere and Hollowcrown. The kingdoms do not know how to feed them, and refugee camps grow into towns.

outcomes.title: The Orc Settlers
outcomes.text: Orc families of the Ashen Exiles settle on an empty coast of the Great Isle's north, with Thornwatch's leave. The south is scandalised, and the orcs build a village.

outcomes.title: The Unblessed Flee West
outcomes.text: Whole villages of Morrowgast's people who will not give their children to the Blessing slip west across the Ashlands by night. Sunvale's border fills with refugees who speak the Coven's tongue, and the court cannot tell refugees from spies.

outcomes.title: The Dwarves Come to the Great Isle
outcomes.text: Dwarven families from the crowded Deepholds settle in the mountains of the Great Isle, buying land from Hollowcrown's lords. The dwarves open mines, and the mountain kingdom grows rich.

outcomes.title: The Elves Leave the West
outcomes.text: A company of elves who had lived on the Great Isle's western coast for centuries sails home to the Eastern Isle. Their lands are left empty, and Westmarch's settlers move in.

outcomes.title: The Free Clans' Wandering
outcomes.text: The Free Clans, driven from their fens, wander across Aldermere's south looking for new land. The great houses drive them from estate to estate, and the clans grow desperate.

outcomes.title: The Goblins' Flight
outcomes.text: Goblins flee their warrens beneath the High Wilds, driven out by something in the deep. They swarm into the mountain valleys, and Aldermere and Hollowcrown must deal with them.

outcomes.title: The Highland Clans Come Down
outcomes.text: The hill clans of the unruled peaks between Aldermere and Hollowcrown come down into the lowlands after a hard winter. They take land by force, and the kingdoms must fight or bargain.

outcomes.title: The Silk-Sailed Settlers
outcomes.text: Settlers from the empire beyond the eastern sea arrive at Veyl and ask for land. The Glass Senate grants them a district, and a new people comes to the known world.

outcomes.title: The Centaurs Move West
outcomes.text: The centaurs of the Eastern Isle's plains move west, driven by drought. They graze on Veyl's farmland, and the Republic must decide whether to fight or bargain.

outcomes.title: The Sea-Folk Come Ashore
outcomes.text: The sea-folk of the northern waters come ashore on Thornwatch's coast for the first time, fleeing something in the deep. Thornwatch takes them in, and a new people lives on the Great Isle.

outcomes.title: The Blessed Settlers
outcomes.text: Blessed warriors cast out of Morrowgast settle in the unruled Ashlands and build a town. Sunvale and Morrowgast both claim them, and they want neither.

outcomes.title: The Westmarch Colonists
outcomes.text: Westmarch's merchant princes send a thousand colonists to an unruled island in the western sea. The colony grows, and Westmarch's power spreads beyond the Great Isle.

outcomes.title: The Pilgrims Who Stayed
outcomes.text: Thousands of pilgrims to the Silver Flame stay in Hollowcrown's mountains rather than return home. The mountain kingdom's population doubles, and the Prelacy cannot feed them.

outcomes.title: The Bandits' Exodus
outcomes.text: Outlaws of the Great Isle, hunted by every crown, flee to the Salt Isles and join the Brotherhood. The pirates' numbers double, and the Ostcombe Sea grows more dangerous.

outcomes.title: The Return of the Exiles
outcomes.text: Orcs of the Ashen Exiles return to the Northern Isle's western coast, abandoned by the Horde. The Exiles have their own land, and the Horde swears to take it back.

outcomes.title: The Siege Engine
outcomes.text: Thornwatch's engineers build a siege engine that throws stones half a mile. It smashes Horde longships in the strait, and every kingdom wants one.

outcomes.title: The Printing of Maps
outcomes.text: A Veyl craftsman prints maps from carved wooden blocks. Maps become cheap, every captain carries one and the kingdoms' borders are drawn the same way everywhere for the first time.

outcomes.title: The Water Clock
outcomes.text: Westmarch's guilds build a water clock in Bellhaven's square that tells the hours exactly. Merchants keep time by it, and the merchant princes' councils start on time.

outcomes.title: The Spectacles of Veyl
outcomes.text: Veyl's glassmakers grind lenses that let old eyes read again. Scholars of every realm buy them, and the old masters of the Conclave can study for another twenty years.

outcomes.title: The Windmill
outcomes.text: Aldermere's engineers build a windmill to grind grain where there is no river. The mills spread across the lake country, and the river-millers are ruined.

outcomes.title: The Compass
outcomes.text: Veyl's scholars find that a needle of lodestone always points north. Ships can sail in fog and at night, and trade between the isles grows.

outcomes.title: The Plough of Iron
outcomes.text: The Deepholds forge a plough of iron that cuts deeper than any wooden plough. Harvests double where it is used, and the dwarves sell it to every realm.

outcomes.title: The Crossbow
outcomes.text: Thornwatch's smiths build a crossbow that any farmer can shoot. The wall's levies become deadly, and the Horde's assaults fail.

outcomes.title: The Glass Lantern
outcomes.text: Veyl's glassmakers build lanterns of clear glass that do not blow out in the wind. Ships and soldiers carry them, and the night is less dangerous.

outcomes.title: The Canal Lock
outcomes.text: Aldermere's engineers build a lock that lets boats climb hills on a canal. The lake city's canal to the sea is finished, and Aldermere's trade grows.

outcomes.title: The Fireworks of Solenne
outcomes.text: An alchemist of Sunvale's court sets off rockets of coloured fire over Solenne at the king's feast. The court is delighted, the Horde's spies in the crowd are not and every captain of the wall wonders what such fire could do to a siege tower.

outcomes.title: The Spinning Wheel
outcomes.text: A weaver of Aldermere's lake towns builds a spinning wheel that spins ten times faster than a hand-spindle. The wool trade grows, and the old spinners are ruined.

outcomes.title: The Diving Bell
outcomes.text: Veyl's engineers build a diving bell that lets men work under the sea. Divers find a sunken Elder Age city, and every realm sends treasure-hunters.

outcomes.title: The Telescope
outcomes.text: The Conclave's scholars build a tube of lenses that brings far things near. From Thornwatch's wall they watch the Blackspire, and learn where its walls are weakest.

outcomes.title: The Iron Ship
outcomes.text: The Deepholds launch a ship plated with iron that no ram can sink. The Horde's longships cannot harm it, and the strait is safer.

outcomes.title: The Healing Salve
outcomes.text: The Elderwood's healers teach the Great Isle's physicians a salve that stops wounds festering. Deaths from wounds fall by half, and the armies on the wall grow stronger.

outcomes.title: The Forgers of the Seal
outcomes.text: A ring of forgers in the lake city is caught making copies of Aldermere's royal seal. Hundreds of false charters, pardons and land-grants are in circulation, and the crown must declare every document of the past year void until checked.

outcomes.title: The Poisoned Envoy
outcomes.text: Westmarch's envoy to Sunvale dies at the court of Solenne after drinking the king's wine. Westmarch accuses Sunvale's ministers, Sunvale accuses Veyl's agents and the two southern kingdoms recall their ambassadors.

outcomes.title: The Thieves' Guild of Bellhaven
outcomes.text: The thieves of Bellhaven organise into a guild with its own laws and its own tax on every pickpocket and burglar. The merchant princes find it easier to pay the guild than the watch, and Bellhaven's streets grow safer for those who pay.

outcomes.title: The Spy in the Tower
outcomes.text: A servant of the Conclave's Tower of Stars is caught copying the Archmagister's letters for an unknown master. Before he can be questioned, he burns in a fire of his own making, and the Tower's masters suspect each other.

outcomes.title: The Kidnapped Heiress
outcomes.text: The heiress of Veyl's richest banking house is kidnapped from a pleasure barge on the harbour. The ransom note demands the cancellation of three kingdoms' debts, and the Glass Senate must decide whether to pay with other people's money.

outcomes.title: The Blackmailed Prelate
outcomes.text: A letter proving that Hollowcrown's First Prelate fathered a child with a mountain lord's wife is sent to every court of the Great Isle. The Prelate denies it, the mountain lords demand his resignation and the Prelacy is shaken.

outcomes.title: The Smuggling Ring Exposed
outcomes.text: A ring of smugglers moving Horde iron through Westmarch's harbours is exposed by Thornwatch's agents. Three merchant princes are named, and Westmarch's council must hang its own or face the Concord's anger.

outcomes.title: The Assassins' Contract
outcomes.text: A contract for the life of the Warden of Thornwatch is offered in the thieves' markets of three cities, paid in Spire gold. Every killer in the Great Isle heads north, and the Warden doubles his guard.

outcomes.title: The Counterfeit Ducats
outcomes.text: False glass ducats flood the markets of the Great Isle, so well made that only Veyl's assayers can tell them apart. Merchants refuse all ducats, trade slows and Veyl's Senate hunts the counterfeiters.

outcomes.title: The Traitor Captain
outcomes.text: A captain of Thornwatch's wall is caught signalling to the Horde across the strait with a lantern. He names his paymaster as a lord of Aldermere, and the Council of the Kingdoms demands the lord be handed over.

outcomes.title: The Grave Robbers
outcomes.text: Grave robbers strip the tombs of Aldermere's kings beneath the lake city's cathedral, taking crowns, rings and bones. The great houses demand the robbers be found; the Conclave fears what someone wants with royal bones.

outcomes.title: The Double Agent
outcomes.text: A spy who has served both Morrowgast and Sunvale for ten years is unmasked at Solenne. Under questioning she reveals that the Coven's Hag-Queens knew every move Sunvale's court made, and Sunvale's ministers are purged.

outcomes.title: The Stolen Relic
outcomes.text: The relic of Hollowcrown's first priest-queen is stolen from the Silver Flame's shrine. The Prelacy offers a fortune for its return, and every thief in the Great Isle claims to have it.

outcomes.title: The Poisoned Wells
outcomes.text: Wells in three villages of Sunvale's east are poisoned in a single night. The court blames the Coven, the Coven blames the brigands of the Ashlands and the villages are abandoned.

outcomes.title: The Bribed Judges
outcomes.text: Aldermere's judges are found to have taken bribes from the great houses in every land dispute for a decade. The king dismisses them all, and peasants who lost their land demand it back.

outcomes.title: The Secret Treaty
outcomes.text: A secret treaty between Westmarch and Veyl to divide the Great Isle's trade between them is found in a captured courier's bag. The other kingdoms are outraged, and Westmarch's envoys are expelled from Aldermere.

outcomes.title: The Golden Harvest
outcomes.text: The best harvest in a generation comes in across Aldermere, Westmarch and Hollowcrown. Granaries overflow, bread is cheap for the first time since the Black Dawn and the crowns can feed their armies without taxing the poor.

outcomes.title: The Hailstorm of the Riviera
outcomes.text: A hailstorm of stones as big as eggs flattens Sunvale's Riviera vineyards a week before the vintage. The year's wine is lost, the court's revenues collapse and Sunvale must borrow from Veyl again.

outcomes.title: The Late Summer Drought
outcomes.text: The rains fail in the last month of summer, and the late crops wither in Westmarch's lowlands. The merchant princes' grain exports stop, and the price of bread rises across the Great Isle.

outcomes.title: The Harvest Moon Festival
outcomes.text: The Free Clans and Aldermere's lake towns celebrate the harvest moon together for the first time, with feasts in the fens and on the lake shore. The great houses stay away; their peasants do not.

outcomes.title: The Locust Swarm
outcomes.text: Locusts sweep out of the unruled Ashlands into Sunvale and Morrowgast, stripping both realms' fields. The war between them pauses while both go hungry.

outcomes.title: The Northern Harvest Saved
outcomes.text: Thornwatch's soldiers guard the Wardenmark's reapers through the harvest, and the Horde's raids fail. The north brings in its first full harvest in three years.

outcomes.title: The Autumn Floods Come Early
outcomes.text: Heavy rains flood the rivers of Hollowcrown's valleys before the harvest is in. The mountain kingdom's wheat rots in the fields, and the Prelacy must buy grain from Aldermere.

outcomes.title: The Grape Harvest of the East
outcomes.text: Veyl's vineyards bring in a great harvest, and the Republic's wine floods the Great Isle's markets. Sunvale's vintners, already ruined by hail, cannot compete.

outcomes.title: The Blight of the Orchards
outcomes.text: A blight kills the apple orchards of Westmarch and Aldermere. Cider becomes scarce, the orchard-lords are ruined and the price of fruit soars.

outcomes.title: The Harvest Tithe Revolt
outcomes.text: The peasants of Hollowcrown refuse to pay the Prelacy's harvest tithe after a poor year. The tithe-collectors are driven from the villages, and the Prelacy must choose between mercy and force.

outcomes.title: The Early Frost
outcomes.text: An early frost kills the late harvest across the north. Thornwatch's fields are lost, and the wall's garrison will be fed by the south this winter.

outcomes.title: The Elves' Harvest Gift
outcomes.text: The Elderwood sends its harvest surplus to the starving villages of Sunvale's east as a gift. The villages bless the elves, and Sunvale's court is shamed by its own neglect.

outcomes.title: The Storm of the Harvest Moon
outcomes.text: A great storm sweeps the Great Isle on the night of the harvest moon, flattening the last of the wheat. Every realm counts its losses, and the winter will be lean.

outcomes.title: The Dwarven Granaries
outcomes.text: The Deepholds open their granaries, filled from their hidden valleys, to the kingdoms of the Great Isle at a fair price. The dwarves are blessed in every market, and the kingdoms owe them more than steel.

outcomes.title: The Fishing Harvest
outcomes.text: The autumn herring come into the Ostcombe Sea in shoals so vast the boats cannot hold them. The fishing towns grow rich, and the poor of the south eat well into the winter.

outcomes.title: The Harvest Peace
outcomes.text: Sunvale and Morrowgast agree to a truce for the harvest, so both can bring in their crops. For a month there is no fighting in the Ashlands, and both sides' granaries fill.

outcomes.title: Plague in Solenne
outcomes.text: A spotted fever breaks out in Solenne (Sunvale) and spreads along the roads; the city closes its gates, trade stops and the dead are counted in the hundreds.

outcomes.title: Smugglers in Graanhoven Strand
outcomes.text: A ring of smugglers working out of Graanhoven Strand (Westmarch) is exposed; its ledgers name officials of Westmarch and merchants of the Elderwood.

outcomes.title: Strange lights in Silmark
outcomes.text: Pale lights dance every night over the marshes of Silmark; travellers who follow them do not return, and the Elderwood's border folk will not go near.

outcomes.title: Gold strike in Korwood
outcomes.text: Prospectors find river gold in Korwood, beside the Elderwood; fortune-seekers flood in from every realm and the Elderwood sends men to claim the land before others do.

outcomes.title: A miracle at Celay
outcomes.text: A blind beggar in Celay (Sunvale) regains his sight at a roadside shrine; pilgrims pour in, the priests are divided, and the local lord taxes them.

outcomes.title: A lord rebels in Dorence
outcomes.text: The lord of Dorence refuses Sunvale's taxes and closes his castle gates; his neighbours wait to see whether the crown can bring him to heel.

outcomes.title: A bridge collapses in Scarmark
outcomes.text: The great stone bridge of Scarmark (Thornwatch) falls into the river with a column of wagons on it; the road is cut and the master builder hangs himself.

outcomes.title: Shipwreck off Matinmouth
outcomes.text: A great storm wrecks a fleet of merchantmen off Matinmouth (Hollowcrown); the coast folk strip the wrecks and the owners in other realms demand their cargo back.

outcomes.title: The river changes course in Marlfield
outcomes.text: After a winter of floods the great river of Marlfield (Aldermere) cuts a new channel, leaving a port town high and dry and flooding a lord's estate.

outcomes.title: Refugees from Silmarsh
outcomes.text: Thousands of ragged refugees stream out of Silmarsh into Thornwatch, fleeing something they will not name; the border lords do not know whether to feed them or turn them back.

outcomes.title: The wells run dry in Scarhythe
outcomes.text: The wells of Scarhythe (Thornwatch) fail in a dry summer; water is carted in at great cost and the poorer quarters begin to empty.

outcomes.title: A deserter army in Morwood
outcomes.text: Hundreds of deserters from the Elderwood's armies gather in Morwood, beside Sunvale, and declare themselves free men; a new band of raiders is born.

outcomes.title: A dragon sighted over Ysolstead Heights
outcomes.text: Herders swear a dragon flew over Ysolstead Heights (Hollowcrown) at dusk; whether true or not, the realm's lords look to the sky and the Conclave's mages ride out.

outcomes.title: Settlers into Ravhaven
outcomes.text: Landless families from Sunvale cross into Ravhaven and build stockades there; the land begins to become Sunvale's, whether its crown planned it or not.

outcomes.title: A mercenary company in Violac
outcomes.text: A free company of sellswords, the Red Lanterns, takes winter quarters in Violac (Sunvale) uninvited; they offer their swords to the highest bidder and loot when unpaid.

outcomes.title: The river changes course in Hallowrest
outcomes.text: After a winter of floods the great river of Hallowrest (Hollowcrown) cuts a new channel, leaving a port town high and dry and flooding a lord's estate.

outcomes.title: Earthquake in Ysolstead Heights
outcomes.text: The ground shakes in Ysolstead Heights (Hollowcrown); mines collapse, a mountain road is buried and a crack opens onto a cavern nobody has seen before.

outcomes.title: A ghost ship on The Selcrest Sea
outcomes.text: A crewless ship drifts ashore from The Selcrest Sea onto the coast of Hollowcrown, its hold full of gold and its deck stained with blood; the sailors call it cursed.

outcomes.title: Salt fails on Kingsbridge
outcomes.text: The salt pans of Kingsbridge (Aldermere) are ruined by a flood tide; without salt the fishing towns cannot keep their catch, and hunger follows.

outcomes.title: A hoard in Silbrook
outcomes.text: A shepherd stumbles on an Elder Age hoard in a barrow in Silbrook; word spreads, and treasure-hunters from Hollowcrown and Thornwatch come to blows over it.

outcomes.title: A whale-road opens on The Belford Sea
outcomes.text: Whalers from Sunvale find the great whale herds in The Belford Sea; oil and bone pour into its markets, and other fleets follow.

outcomes.title: A miracle at Avonton
outcomes.text: A blind beggar in Avonton (Aldermere) regains his sight at a roadside shrine; pilgrims pour in, the priests are divided, and the local lord taxes them.

outcomes.title: A guild strike in Lavaret
outcomes.text: The guilds of Lavaret (Sunvale) lay down their tools over a new tax; the city's trade stops and the crown must choose between giving way and sending soldiers.

outcomes.title: A mine of iron in Silbrook
outcomes.text: Scouts find a mountain of iron ore in Silbrook, beside Hollowcrown; the Deepholds' agents arrive within a week to buy the rights.

outcomes.title: A deserter army in Zarshaw Peaks

scriptedEvents.text: The Iron Horde of Gor-Vathra launches an invasion of Thornwatch, landing war-bands on the Wardenmark's coast to take and hold it, not to raid. Open the war in warUpdates (op start): side A The Iron Horde of Gor-Vathra, side B Thornwatch, with its title and cause, and carry it on in later periods until a peace, a surrender or a collapse ends it. Hollowcrown is bound to Thornwatch by the Strait Compact and must decide whether to join.

scriptedEvents.title: The Coven's Second Declaration
scriptedEvents.text: With its first chance passed by, Morrowgast declares war on Sunvale after all, its Blessed host marching through the Ashlands toward the eastern march. Open the war in warUpdates (op start): side A The Coven-Realm of Morrowgast, side B Sunvale, with its title and cause, and carry it on in later periods until a peace, a surrender or a collapse ends it.

scriptedEvents.title: The Hunt Becomes a War
scriptedEvents.text: The Iron Horde of Gor-Vathra sends a fleet and a war-host against the Ashen Exiles' islet to destroy them for good. Open the war in warUpdates (op start): side A The Iron Horde of Gor-Vathra, side B The Ashen Exiles, with its title and cause, and carry it on in later periods until a peace, a surrender or a collapse ends it. Thornwatch, which has dealt with the Exiles, must choose whether to stand by them.

scriptedEvents.title: The Lantern's Crusade
scriptedEvents.text: The Order of the Lantern declares a crusade and marches on Morrowgast's borderlands with its founder's lantern before it. Open the war in warUpdates (op start): side A The Order of the Lantern, side B The Coven-Realm of Morrowgast, with its title and cause, and carry it on in later periods until a peace, a surrender or a collapse ends it. Hollowcrown's Prelacy is asked to join the holy war.

scriptedEvents.title: Westmarch Declares War on the Salt Isles
scriptedEvents.text: Westmarch's council, its merchants bled by a year of raids, declares war on the Brotherhood of the Salt Isles and sends its fleet to take Red Harbour. Open the war in warUpdates (op start): side A Westmarch, side B The Brotherhood of the Salt Isles, with its title and cause, and carry it on in later periods until a peace, a surrender or a collapse ends it.

conditions.polityId: The Brotherhood of the Salt Isles

scriptedEvents.title: The Spring Invasion of the Wardenmark
scriptedEvents.text: The Iron Horde invades Thornwatch's Wardenmark in the spring with its whole host, to take the coast and the wall. Open the war in warUpdates (op start): side A The Iron Horde of Gor-Vathra, side B Thornwatch, with its title and cause, and carry it on in later periods until a peace, a surrender or a collapse ends it. If the two are already at war, this is its great spring offensive and no new war is opened.

scriptedEvents.title: A Border War Among the Kingdoms
scriptedEvents.text: Two of the kingdoms of the Great Isle go to war over a border quarrel.

outcomes.title: The Lake Road War
outcomes.text: Aldermere and Westmarch go to war over the Lake Road's tolls and the forts on their border, each seizing the other's toll-forts. Open the war in warUpdates (op start): side A Westmarch, side B Aldermere, with its title and cause, and carry it on in later periods until a peace, a surrender or a collapse ends it. The Concord's council is asked to stop it.

outcomes.title: The War of the High Passes
outcomes.text: Aldermere and Hollowcrown go to war over the passes of the High Wilds between them, each sending soldiers to hold the passes. Open the war in warUpdates (op start): side A Aldermere, side B Hollowcrown, with its title and cause, and carry it on in later periods until a peace, a surrender or a collapse ends it. The Concord's council is asked to stop it.

outcomes.title: The Vineyard War
outcomes.text: Sunvale and Aldermere go to war over the border country between them, Sunvale's barons seizing an Aldermere valley. Open the war in warUpdates (op start): side A Sunvale, side B Aldermere, with its title and cause, and carry it on in later periods until a peace, a surrender or a collapse ends it.
